````csharp
using System;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Globalization;using System.Windows.Forms;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  enum LayoutPrompt { Staff, Range, Confirm, Duplicate, Text, Vertical, Groups, Output, Continue, Discard, FileName, FileCount, Part, Normalize }
  LayoutPrompt layoutPrompt;short layoutBottom,layoutTop;float layoutLeft,layoutRight;
  short layoutRequestedStaff,layoutRequestedTop;bool layoutTextCheckpoint;
  LayoutParentPreparation layoutPreparation;float[] layoutScales;
  List<string> layoutTranscript;
  readonly LayoutJustificationWorkspace layoutWorkspace=new LayoutJustificationWorkspace();
  LayoutLineupWorkspace lineupWorkspace=new LayoutLineupWorkspace();
  bool IsLayoutGroup {get{return groupCommand=="J"||groupCommand=="JT"||groupCommand=="VJ"||groupCommand=="DEC"||groupCommand=="COM"||groupCommand=="SEP"||groupCommand=="RIP"||groupCommand=="L"||groupCommand=="LI"||groupCommand=="LJ"||groupCommand=="RIP";}}
  bool IsLineupGroup {get{return groupCommand=="L"||groupCommand=="LI"||groupCommand=="LJ"||groupCommand=="RIP";}}
  bool ExecuteMainLayout(string verb,string arguments){
   if(verb!="J"&&verb!="JT"&&verb!="VJ"&&verb!="DEC"&&verb!="COM"&&verb!="SEP"&&verb!="RIP"&&verb!="L"&&verb!="LI"&&verb!="LJ")return false;
   if(LayoutNumbers(arguments).Length>20)throw new NotSupportedException("Original layout command argument buffer capacity exceeded.");
   if(verb=="RIP"){groupCommand=verb;rippleInput.Clear();layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Staff;Message("How many staves in a system? (B=backup) ->");return true;}
   if(verb=="SEP"){separateWorking=null;groupCommand=verb;layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Range;Message(SeparateRangePrompt);return true;}
   if(verb=="COM"){BeginMainCombine();return true;}
   if(verb=="DEC"){BeginMainDecombine();return true;}
   if(verb=="VJ"){groupCommand=verb;groupRange=null;layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Vertical;Message(VerticalClearancePrompt);command.Focus();return true;}
   groupCommand=verb;groupRange=null;layoutTextCheckpoint=false;layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Staff;Message(SystemSourcePrompt);command.Focus();return true;
  }
  // Original16D3:05EF..0799 accumulates integer digits, stores them as
  // binary32, then divides by a binary32 decimal power. Direct Float.Parse
  // can round differently. Minus signs toggle the stored sign; signed zero
  // is replaced by the measured -1 sentinel at0722..0732.
  static float OriginalCommandNumber(string token){
   if(token.Length==0)throw new InvalidDataException("Enter a SCORE number.");
   if(token.Length>11)throw new NotSupportedException("This numeric token exceeds the original eleven-character conversion domain.");
   int sign=1,dot=-1,start=token[0]=='+'?1:0;uint digits=0;bool any=false,afterMinus=false;
   for(int n=start;n<token.Length;n++){
    char c=token[n];if(c=='-'){sign=-sign;afterMinus=true;continue;}if(c==' '&&afterMinus)continue;afterMinus=false;if(c=='.'){dot=n;continue;}
    if(c<'0'||c>'9')throw new NotSupportedException("This numeric-token control still requires original verification.");
    any=true;digits=unchecked(digits*10+(uint)(c-'0'));
   }
   if(!any||digits>Int32.MaxValue)return 0;
   float power=dot<0?1:(float)Math.Pow(10,token.Length-dot-1);
   double number=(double)(float)digits*sign/power;
   if(number==0&&sign<0)return -1;
   return (float)number;
  }
  static float[] LayoutNumbers(string text,bool allSeparators=false){
   // Outer16D3:04AE..05E7 consumes one numeric terminator. A further
   // non-space separator can create an explicit zero parameter; splitting
   // and dropping empty fields loses that original positional control.
   var values=new System.Collections.Generic.List<float>();int state=-1;
   for(int at=0;at<text.Length;){char c=text[at];if(c==' '){state=1;at++;continue;}
    if((c>='0'&&c<='9')||c=='.'||c=='-'){
     int end=at;bool afterMinus=false;while(end<text.Length){char digit=text[end];if(digit=='-'){afterMinus=true;end++;continue;}if(digit==' '&&afterMinus){end++;continue;}if((digit>='0'&&digit<='9')||digit=='.'){afterMinus=false;end++;continue;}break;}
     if(!allSeparators&&end<text.Length&&text[end]!=' '&&text[end]!=','&&text[end]!='+'&&text[end]!='\t')throw new NotSupportedException("This numeric terminator still requires original verification.");values.Add(OriginalCommandNumber(text.Substring(at,end-at)));state=-1;at=Math.Min(text.Length,end+1);
    }else{if(!allSeparators&&c!=','&&c!='+'&&c!='\t')throw new NotSupportedException("This numeric argument separator still requires original verification.");if(state!=0)values.Add(0);if(allSeparators&&state>0)values.Add(0);state=0;at++;}
   }return values.ToArray();
  }
  void SubmitMainLayout(string text){
   if(groupCommand=="SEP"){SubmitMainSeparate(text);return;}
   if(groupCommand=="RIP"&&layoutPrompt!=LayoutPrompt.Duplicate){SubmitMainRipple(text);return;}
   if(groupCommand=="VJ"){SubmitMainVerticalJustification(text);return;}
   if(groupCommand=="DEC"){SubmitMainDecombine(text);return;}
   if(groupCommand=="COM"){SubmitMainCombine(text);return;}
   if(layoutPrompt==LayoutPrompt.Duplicate){
    string answer=text.Trim();if(!answer.Equals("Y",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&&!answer.Equals("N",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){LayoutDuplicateQuestion(true);return;}
    layoutTranscript.Add(LayoutDuplicateText()+"  "+answer.ToUpperInvariant());layoutPreparation.AnswerDuplicate(answer.Equals("Y",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));ContinueMainJustification();return;
   }
   if(text.Trim().Equals("B",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){if(layoutPrompt==LayoutPrompt.Text){PrepareMainTextJustification();ClearMainGroup();Message(score.Items.Count>0?"*** Sorting by staff number.":"");return;}if(layoutPrompt==LayoutPrompt.Range){layoutLeft=0;layoutRight=200;layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Confirm;Message(GroupDeletePrompt);}else{ClearMainGroup();Message("");}return;}
   if(layoutPrompt==LayoutPrompt.Text){var values=LayoutNumbers(text);if(values.Length>20)throw new NotSupportedException("Original text-level argument capacity exceeded.");short staff=TransposeWord(values.Length>0?values[0].ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture):"0");PrepareMainTextJustification();CommitMainTextJustification(staff,values.Length>1?values[1]:0);return;}
   if(layoutPrompt==LayoutPrompt.Staff){
    var values=LayoutNumbers(text);if(values.Length>20)throw new NotSupportedException("Original system argument buffer capacity exceeded.");
    short first=TransposeWord(values.Length>0?values[0].ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture):"0"),count=TransposeWord(values.Length>1?values[1].ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture):"0");
    layoutRequestedStaff=first;
    if(first>32){layoutBottom=1;layoutTop=32;layoutRequestedTop=0;}else{if(first==0)first=1;if(count==0)count=1;layoutBottom=first;layoutTop=unchecked((short)(first+count-1));layoutRequestedTop=layoutTop;}
    if(layoutBottom<1||layoutTop<layoutBottom)throw new NotSupportedException("Original layout staff traversal would leave its staff table.");
    if(IsLineupGroup){layoutLeft=0;layoutRight=200;layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Confirm;Message(GroupDeletePrompt);}else{layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Range;Message("Enter Left position, Right position. ->");}return;
   }
   if(layoutPrompt==LayoutPrompt.Range){
    var values=LayoutNumbers(text);if(values.Length>20)throw new NotSupportedException("Original range argument buffer capacity exceeded.");layoutLeft=values.Length>0?values[0]:0;layoutRight=values.Length>1?values[1]:0;
    if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(layoutRight),0)==0)layoutRight=200;
    if(layoutRight<=layoutLeft){Message("Enter Left position, Right position. ->");return;}
    layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Confirm;Message(GroupDeletePrompt);return;
   }
   if(!String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))throw new NotSupportedException("Only the measured Enter/B layout confirmation is implemented.");
   if(groupCommand=="JT"){layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Text;Message("Type text's staff # and P4 level of text (99=any level)");return;}
   CommitMainJustification();
  }
  void CommitMainJustification(){
   var scales=new PageCoordinates();
   foreach(var item in score.Items.Where(i=>i.Code==8)){
    var p=new float[Math.Max(21,item.Count+1)];for(int j=1;j<=item.Count;j++)p[j]=item.P(j);scales.SetStaff(p,NativeMeasurements.Get(score)==1);
   }
   layoutScales=scales.Scales;layoutTranscript=new List<string>();if(score.Items.Count>0)layoutTranscript.Add("*** Sorting by staff number.");layoutPreparation=new LayoutParentPreparation(score.Items.Select(TransposeRow).ToList(),layoutBottom,layoutTop,layoutLeft,layoutRight,false,IsLineupGroup);ContinueMainJustification();
  }
  string LayoutDuplicateText(){var row=layoutPreparation.Rows[layoutPreparation.DuplicateIndex];string position=((double)row[2]).ToString(".00",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(6);return "*** Do you want to delete duplicate item?  Code# "+TransposeWord(row[0].ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))+", Staff# "+TransposeWord(row[1].ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))+", P3="+position;}
  void LayoutDuplicateQuestion(bool rejected){
   if(rejected)System.Media.SystemSounds.Beep.Play();
   Message(String.Join(Environment.NewLine,layoutTranscript.Concat(new[]{LayoutDuplicateText()})));command.Focus();
  }
  void ContinueMainJustification(){
   var prepared=layoutPreparation;
   if(!prepared.Complete){layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Duplicate;LayoutDuplicateQuestion(false);return;}
   if(prepared.Rows.Count==0||prepared.Top<prepared.Bottom){ClearMainGroup();Message("");return;}
   var starts=new int[prepared.Rows.Count];var words=new float[16384];int at=0;
   for(int i=0;i<prepared.Rows.Count;i++){var row=prepared.Rows[i];if(at+row.Length+1>words.Length)throw new NotSupportedException("Original layout record bank capacity exceeded.");starts[i]=at+1;var original=(groupCommand=="RIP"?rippleWorking:score).Items[prepared.Origins[i]];words[at++]=original.Count==row.Length?BitConverter.ToSingle(original.Bytes,0):row.Length;Array.Copy(row,0,words,at,row.Length);at+=row.Length;}
   if(at+score.Trailer.Length/4<=words.Length)Buffer.BlockCopy(score.Trailer,0,words,at*4,score.Trailer.Length);
   var pref=NativePreferences.Read(source);var aft=new[]{pref.Number("AFTC",0),pref.Number("AFTB",0),pref.Number("AFTK",0),pref.Number("AFTM",0)};
   bool noRhythm=false;bool justifyAfter=!IsLineupGroup||groupCommand=="LJ"||groupCommand=="RIP";
   lineupWorkspace.Scor4DurationScale=scor4Interface;
   if(IsLineupGroup){var lineup=LayoutLineupSystem.Apply(words,starts,prepared.Bottom,prepared.Top,layoutScales,BitConverter.ToSingle(BitConverter.GetBytes(0x3f15c01au),0),32,2800,lineupWorkspace);foreach(var total in lineup.BeatTotals){string beats=SingleFixedDecimal.Format(total.Total,3);if(beats.StartsWith("0."))beats=beats.Substring(1);layoutTranscript.Add("Staff"+total.Staff.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(3)+" has"+beats.PadLeft(7)+" beats");}noRhythm=lineup.Bottom<0;if(noRhythm)justifyAfter=false;prepared.Bottom=lineup.Bottom;prepared.Top=lineup.Top;prepared.Left=lineup.Left;prepared.Right=lineup.Right;}
   bool scor4LineupAndJustify=scor4Interface&&groupCommand=="LJ";
   if(scor4Interface&&IsLineupGroup&&(!justifyAfter||scor4LineupAndJustify)&&!noRhythm)
    RepositionScor4LineupText(prepared.Rows,words,starts,prepared.Bottom,prepared.Top);
   if(justifyAfter){layoutWorkspace.Scor4NumberJustification=scor4Interface;layoutWorkspace.OriginalQuarterToneWidths=NativeEditCompatibility.OriginalQuarterToneWidths;var calculation=LayoutJustificationSystem.Apply(words,starts,prepared.Bottom,prepared.Top,prepared.Left,prepared.Right,layoutScales,aft,32,2800,layoutWorkspace);
    if(calculation.Gaps.CompressedMinimums){layoutTranscript.Add("*** Not enough space to justify ideally.");layoutTranscript.Add(((double)calculation.Gaps.MinimumTotal).ToString(".000",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(8)+((double)calculation.Gaps.Width).ToString(".000",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(9));}}
   var next=new List<Item>();for(int i=0;i<starts.Length;i++){var row=new float[prepared.Rows[i].Length];Array.Copy(words,starts[i],row,0,row.Length);var item=Item.Make(row);Buffer.BlockCopy(words,(starts[i]-1)*4,item.Bytes,0,4);next.Add(item);}
   if(groupCommand=="RIP"){ContinueRippleLineup(next);return;}
   // 2D31:0651/0657 schedules CW after the system core, before Main returns.
   var centered=score.Clone();centered.Items=next;var centerChanges=new List<NativeRestCenterChange>();
   // 8190 retains the raw staff word even when AFF4 normalizes zero to one.
   // 8192 retains the requested top rather than the later record-based clamp.
   if(justifyAfter){
    Func<int,List<NativeRestCenterChange>> center=staff=>scor4LineupAndJustify
     ?NativeRestCentering.PlanWholeRests(centered,staff):NativeRestCentering.Plan(centered,staff);
    if(layoutRequestedStaff>32)centerChanges.AddRange(center(33));
    else if(layoutRequestedStaff>0)for(int staff=layoutRequestedStaff;staff<=Math.Min(32,(int)layoutRequestedTop);staff++)centerChanges.AddRange(center(staff));
   }
   NativeRestCentering.Apply(centerChanges);
   // Lineup and justification redraw the retained display banks on the ordinary path.
   bool trackDisplay=(IsLineupGroup||groupCommand=="J")&&!noRhythm&&next.Count==score.Items.Count&&
    layoutRequestedStaff>=1&&layoutRequestedTop<=32&&CanTrackDisplayRedraw();
   string transcript=String.Join(Environment.NewLine,layoutTranscript);
   Checkpoint();score.Items=next;originalLayoutMarksModified|=!noRhythm||InputTranspositionOrder.MarksModified(next.Count,false);
   dirty=true;ClearMainGroup();RefreshTransposeTextTerminators();RefreshAll(null);
   if(trackDisplay)RebuildTrackedDisplay(centeredRests:centerChanges.Count==0?null:centerChanges.Select(change=>next.IndexOf(change.Item)));
   Message(transcript);
  }

  static void RepositionScor4LineupText(IList<float[]> rows,float[] words,int[] starts,short bottom,short top){
   foreach(var staff in Enumerable.Range(0,rows.Count).GroupBy(i=>(int)rows[i][1])){
    if(staff.Key<bottom||staff.Key>top)continue;
    var anchors=staff.Where(i=>IsScor4LineupTextAnchor((int)rows[i][0]))
     .GroupBy(i=>rows[i][2]).OrderBy(group=>group.Key).Select(group=>group.First()).ToArray();
    int right=1;
    foreach(int index in staff.Where(i=>rows[i][0]==16).OrderBy(i=>rows[i][2])){
     float source=rows[index][2];
     while(right<anchors.Length&&source>rows[anchors[right]][2])right++;
     if(right>=anchors.Length)break;
     int a=anchors[right-1],b=anchors[right];
     float oldLeft=rows[a][2],oldRight=rows[b][2];
     if(source<oldLeft)continue;
     double left=words[starts[a]+2],rightPosition=words[starts[b]+2];
     words[starts[index]+2]=(float)(left+((double)source-oldLeft)*(rightPosition-left)/((double)oldRight-oldLeft));
    }
   }
  }
  static bool IsScor4LineupTextAnchor(int code){return code>=1&&code<=3||code==14||code==17||code==18;}
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;

namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  string pendingAppendPath;
  Score pendingAppendScore;
  byte[] pendingAppendBaseline;

  bool ExecuteMainLetterCommand(string verb,string arguments){
   if(scor4Interface){
    switch(verb){
     case "DIRS": case "DIRSET": RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);RefreshScor4Files();return true;
     case "OP": RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);OpenScor4FromMenu();return true;
     case "DB": case "DX": RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);StepScor4File(verb=="DB"?-1:1);return true;
     case "SNB": RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);SavePreviousScor4File();return true;
     case "DATE": RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);ShowScoreVersion();return true;
     case "RS": if(arguments.Length==0){RestartScor4Score();return true;}break;
    }
    short staff;
    if((verb=="CD"&&Int16.TryParse(arguments,NumberStyles.Integer,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out staff))||
       (verb.Length>2&&verb.StartsWith("CD",StringComparison.Ordinal)&&arguments.Length==0&&
        Int16.TryParse(verb.Substring(2),NumberStyles.Integer,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out staff))){
     CenterScor4GroupDashes(staff);return true;
    }
    if(verb=="CD"&&arguments.Length==0){CenterScor4GroupDashes(0);return true;}
   }
   if(verb.Length>3&&verb.StartsWith("DPY",StringComparison.Ordinal)&&(Char.IsDigit(verb[3])||verb[3]=='-'||verb[3]=='+')){arguments=verb.Substring(3)+(arguments.Length==0?"":" "+arguments);verb="DPY";}
   if(scor4Interface&&verb=="GP"){
    RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);
    if(String.IsNullOrEmpty(scor4PreviousFile))Message("No previous file.");
    else OpenScor4File(scor4PreviousFile);
    return true;
   }
   if(scor4Interface&&verb=="RSM"){
    RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);
    RestartScor4SameFile();
    return true;
   }
   if(scor4Interface&&verb=="PA"){
    RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);
    ChangeScor4Path();
    return true;
   }
   if(ExecuteMainItemOrder(verb,arguments))return true;
   switch(verb){
    case "M":case "C":case "A":case "DE":case "CS":case "MS":
     StartMainGroup(verb,arguments);
     return true;
    case "VER":
     RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);
     ShowScoreVersion();
     return true;
    case "CD":
     if(arguments.Length!=0)Directory.SetCurrentDirectory(Path.GetFullPath(arguments));
     Message("");
     return true;
    case "DIR":
     ShowScoreDirectory(arguments);
     return true;
    case "DEL":
     StartDiskDelete(arguments);return true;
    case "DRV":
     RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);StartDriveChange();return true;
    case "TYPE":
     if(arguments.Length==0&&NativeDiskDialogChoice.Files){arguments=ChooseCommandFile("Open text listing",false,TextFileFilter);if(arguments==null)return true;}
     StartTypeListing(arguments);return true;
    case "DPY":
     StartDrawExport(arguments);return true;
    case "PMX":
     RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);pendingParameterExport=true;if(NativeDiskDialogChoice.Files){string chosen=ChooseCommandFile("Save score parameters",true,TextFileFilter);if(chosen!=null)return SubmitParameterExport(chosen);pendingParameterExport=false;return true;}Message("Enter filename ->");return true;
    case "PM":
     RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);
     ShowScoreParameters();
     return true;
    case "PR":
     RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);EnterOriginalPrintMenu();return true;
    case "SNX":
     RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);SaveNextScoreFile();return true;
    case "NX":case "NB":
     RequireNoLetterArguments(verb,arguments);
     StepScoreFile(verb=="NX");
     return true;
    case "GM":
     if(arguments.Length==0&&NativeDiskDialogChoice.Files){arguments=ChooseWindowsDiskFile("GM");if(arguments==null)return true;}
     string path=Resolve(arguments,Directory.GetCurrentDirectory());
     if(!File.Exists(path)){
      ShowLetterListing("File not found - "+Path.GetFileName(path)+"\r\nPress any key to continue.");
      return true;
     }
     pendingAppendPath=path;
     Message("Type a number for staff offset or press <Enter> ->");
     return true;
    default:return false;
   }
  }

  static void RequireNoLetterArguments(string verb,string arguments){
   if(arguments.Length!=0)throw new InvalidDataException(verb+" does not take arguments.");
  }

  void ShowScoreVersion(){
   uint serial=NativeScoreIdentity.Require(source,false).Serial;
   var culture=CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
   string version=scor4Interface?"4.0100":"3.1100";
   string text=String.Format(culture,"Version =   {0}  --  Serial # = {1}",version,serial);
   if(score.Trailer.Length==24&&!String.IsNullOrEmpty(current)&&File.Exists(current)){
    uint creator=BitConverter.ToUInt32(score.Trailer,4);
    if(creator>=1000000&&creator<=9999999)
     text+="\r\n"+String.Format(culture,"This file created by Serial # = {0}{1}File created: {2:MM-dd-yy   HH:mm}",
      creator,scor4Interface?" ═══════ ":"        ",File.GetLastWriteTime(current));
   }
   Message(text+"\r\n"+BuildVersion.DisplayVersion);
  }

  void ShowScoreDirectory(string arguments){
   string pattern=arguments.Length==0?"*.*":arguments;
   string directory=Path.GetDirectoryName(pattern);
   string folder=String.IsNullOrEmpty(directory)?Directory.GetCurrentDirectory():Path.GetFullPath(directory);
   string filter=Path.GetFileName(pattern);
   if(String.IsNullOrEmpty(filter))throw new InvalidDataException("Enter a directory search pattern.");
   var names=Directory.Exists(folder)?Directory.GetFileSystemEntries(folder,filter)
    .Select(Path.GetFileName).Select(name=>name.ToUpperInvariant()).ToList():new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
   if(filter=="*.*"&&Directory.Exists(folder))names.InsertRange(0,new[]{".",".."});
   var lines=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>{"Directory of "+pattern.ToUpperInvariant()};
   for(int i=0;i<names.Count;i+=6)
    lines.Add(String.Concat(names.Skip(i).Take(6).Select(name=>name.PadRight(Math.Max(13,name.Length+1)))).TrimEnd());
   if(names.Count==0)lines.Add("File not found.");
   if(ShowCommandList("Directory",new[]{lines.ToArray()}))return;
   lines.Add("Press any key to continue.");
   ShowLetterListing(String.Join("\r\n",lines));
  }

  void ShowLetterListing(string text){
   pendingEditAcknowledgement=true;
   Message(text);
   textWindow.AutoScrollPosition=System.Drawing.Point.Empty;
   command.Focus();
  }

  void ShowScoreParameters(){
   if(score.Items.Any(item=>item.Code!=16&&item.Count>20))throw new NotSupportedException("PM records above20 parameters require verification; the measured30-parameter case reaches an original console-write error.");
   var pages=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string[]>();var page=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();int row=0;
   for(int index=0;index<score.Items.Count;index++){
    string formatted=FormatScoreParameterRow(score.Items[index],index+1);string[] lines=formatted.Split(new[]{"\r\n","\n"},StringSplitOptions.None);page.AddRange(lines);foreach(string line in lines)row+=1+line.Length/80;
    // Original3054:11EF queries BIOS cursor DX and compares with1400h.
    // The native display uses full-width logical rows; only pagination
    // retains the original80-column cursor accounting.
    if(row>=20){page.Add("Press any key to continue.");pages.Add(page.ToArray());page.Clear();row=0;}
   }
   page.Add("Press any key to continue.");pages.Add(page.ToArray());
   if(ShowCommandList("Score parameters",pages))return;
   letterHelpPages=pages;letterHelpIsType=false;letterHelpIsParameters=true;letterHelpPage=0;letterHelpTopicPending=false;letterHelpPreviousMessage="";ShowLetterHelpPage();
  }

  static readonly string[] OriginalParameterLabels={"","NOTE ","REST ","CLEF ","LINE ","SLUR ","BEAM ","TRILL","STAFF","MISC ","NUMB ","LIBRY","CIRCL","DUMMY","BARS ","POST ","WORD ","KSIG ","METER","MPUMX"};
  static string FormatScoreParameterRow(Item item,int number){
   if(item.Code<1||item.Code>=OriginalParameterLabels.Length)throw new NotSupportedException("PM item label is outside the original table.");
   var row=new StringBuilder(number.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(3)).Append(") ").Append(OriginalParameterLabels[item.Code]);
   if(item.Code==16||item.Code==15||item.Code==11){
    row.Append((ExportFixed(item.P(1),0)+".").PadLeft(4)).Append(ExportFixed(item.P(2),1).PadLeft(5));
    for(int p=3;p<=Math.Min(item.Count,12);p++)row.Append(ExportFixed(item.P(p),p==3?3:2).PadLeft(p==3?8:9));
    string text=item.Code==16?item.Text:Encoding.GetEncoding(437).GetString(item.Bytes,56,Math.Min(item.Code==11?5:24,Math.Max(0,item.Bytes.Length-56)));
    return row.Append("\r\n").Append(text).ToString();
   }
   row.Append((ExportFixed(item.P(1),0)+".").PadLeft(4)).Append(ExportFixed(item.P(2),1).PadLeft(4));
   int count=item.Code==16?Math.Min(item.Count,11):item.Count;
   for(int p=3;p<=count;p++){int places=p==3||p==6?3:p==7?4:2,width=p==3?8:p==6?10:p==7?11:p<=13?9:8;row.Append(ExportFixed(item.P(p),places).PadLeft(width));}
   if(item.Code==16)row.Append("\r\n").Append(item.Text);
   return row.ToString();
  }

  bool SubmitScoreAppend(string text){
   if(pendingAppendPath==null)return false;
   int offset=0;
   if(!String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text)&&!Int32.TryParse(text.Trim(),NumberStyles.Integer,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out offset))
    throw new InvalidDataException("Enter an integer staff offset.");
   string path=pendingAppendPath;
   pendingAppendPath=null;
   if(!File.Exists(path)){
    ShowLetterListing("File not found - "+Path.GetFileName(path)+"\r\nPress any key to continue.");
    return true;
   }
   var added=PrepareOriginalLoadedScore(Score.Load(path));
   foreach(var item in added.Items){
    float destination=item.P(2)+offset;
    if(destination<1||destination>=33||Single.IsNaN(destination))
     throw new InvalidDataException("The staff offset would put an item outside staff 1–32.");
    if(offset!=0)item.Set(2,destination);
   }
   var next=score.Clone();
   next.Items.AddRange(added.Items);
   next.Encode();
   using(canvas.TextLayout.PreserveAlignmentMetricHistory())using(var probe=new Canvas()){probe.Score=next;probe.Library=canvas.Library;probe.TextLayout=canvas.TextLayout;probe.LayoutScore();}
   var occupied=score.Items.Where(item=>item.Code==8).Select(item=>item.Staff);
   if(added.Items.Where(item=>item.Code==8).Select(item=>item.Staff).Intersect(occupied).Any()){
    pendingAppendScore=next;
    pendingAppendBaseline=score.Encode();
    Message("Warning: This action will cause existing staves to be overwritten.\r\nPress ESC to abort, any other key to continue");
   }else CommitScoreAppend(next);
   return true;
  }

  void ClearScoreAppend(){
   pendingAppendPath=null;
   pendingAppendScore=null;
   pendingAppendBaseline=null;
  }

  void CommitScoreAppend(Score next){
   Checkpoint();
   score=next;
   dirty=true;
   Message("");
   RefreshAll(null);
  }

  bool HandleScoreAppendKey(System.Windows.Forms.KeyEventArgs key){
   var code=key.KeyCode;
   if(pendingAppendScore!=null){
    if(code==System.Windows.Forms.Keys.ShiftKey||code==System.Windows.Forms.Keys.ControlKey||code==System.Windows.Forms.Keys.Menu)return false;
    var next=pendingAppendScore;
    bool unchanged=score.Encode().SequenceEqual(pendingAppendBaseline);
    ClearScoreAppend();
    if(code==System.Windows.Forms.Keys.Escape)Message("");
    else if(unchanged)CommitScoreAppend(next);
    else Message("The score changed while GM was waiting. Run GM again.");
    key.SuppressKeyPress=true;
    return true;
   }
   if(pendingAppendPath==null)return false;
   if(code==System.Windows.Forms.Keys.Escape){
    pendingAppendPath=null;
    command.Clear();
    Message("");
   }else if(!key.Control&&!key.Alt&&(code<System.Windows.Forms.Keys.F1||code>System.Windows.Forms.Keys.F24))return false;
   key.SuppressKeyPress=true;
   return true;
  }

  void SaveNextScoreFile(){if(String.IsNullOrEmpty(current)){StartLetterSave("SCOREAB.MUS");return;}string stem=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(current),extension=Path.GetExtension(current);string name=OriginalFilenameSequence.Step(stem,extension,true,false,NativeScoreBehaviour.Enabled?(char?)null:'A');StartLetterSave(Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(current),name));}
  string originalSequenceFile,originalSequenceOwner;
  void StepScoreFile(bool forward){
   if(String.IsNullOrEmpty(current)){Message("Open a score in the file sequence first.");return;}
   string folder=Path.GetDirectoryName(current);
   string stem=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(current);
   string extension=Path.GetExtension(current);
   if(stem.Length==0){Message("The current score has no filename stem.");return;}
   if(NativeScoreBehaviour.Enabled||stem[stem.Length-1]>='0'&&stem[stem.Length-1]<='9'){
    string previousSequence=originalSequenceFile;
    if(NativeScoreBehaviour.Enabled&&originalSequenceOwner==current&&!String.IsNullOrEmpty(originalSequenceFile)){
     folder=Path.GetDirectoryName(originalSequenceFile);stem=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(originalSequenceFile);extension=Path.GetExtension(originalSequenceFile);
    }
    string target=OriginalFilenameSequence.Target(folder,stem,extension,forward);
    if(NativeScoreBehaviour.Enabled){originalSequenceFile=target;originalSequenceOwner=current;}
    if(!File.Exists(target)){Message("File not found - "+Path.GetFileName(target));return;}
    string prior=current;LoadFile(target);
    if(current==prior&&current!=target)originalSequenceFile=previousSequence;
    return;
   }
   char last=Char.ToUpperInvariant(stem[stem.Length-1]);
   if(last<'A'||last>'Z'||forward&&last=='Z'){
    Message("No verified "+(forward?"next":"previous")+" filename in this sequence.");
    return;
   }
   string next;
   if(!forward&&last=='A'){
    next=Directory.EnumerateFiles(folder).Where(path=>
      String.Equals(Path.GetExtension(path),extension,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&&
      Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path).EndsWith("A",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)&&
      StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.Compare(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path),stem)<0)
     .OrderByDescending(path=>Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path),StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).FirstOrDefault();
   }else{
    char step=(char)(stem[stem.Length-1]+(forward?1:-1));
    next=Path.Combine(folder,stem.Substring(0,stem.Length-1)+step+extension);
   }
   if(next==null||!File.Exists(next)){
    Message(next==null?"No previous file in this sequence.":"File not found - "+Path.GetFileName(next));
    return;
   }
   LoadFile(next);
  }

  void CheckMainLetters(){
   foreach(var sample in new[]{new[]{"N4701","N4702.MUS","N4700.MUS"},new[]{"W47Z09","W47Z10.MUS","W47Z08.MUS"},new[]{"W47Z99","W48A00.MUS","W47Z98.MUS"},new[]{"W47Z00","W47Z01.MUS","W47Y99.MUS"},new[]{"J","I.MUS","I.MUS"},new[]{"T47A","T47B.MUS","T46Z.MUS"}}){
    if(OriginalFilenameSequence.Step(sample[0],".MUS",true,false)!=sample[1]||OriginalFilenameSequence.Step(sample[0],".MUS",false,false)!=sample[2])throw new Exception("Recovered filename step differs: "+sample[0]);
   }
   if(OriginalFilenameSequence.Step("W48A00",".MUS",true,true)!="W48A10.MUS"||OriginalFilenameSequence.Step("A46Z",".MUS",false,true)!="A46A.MUS"||OriginalFilenameSequence.Step("H",".MUS",false,true)!="A.MUS")throw new Exception("Original missing-file fallback differs.");
   string previousDirectory=Directory.GetCurrentDirectory();
   string folder=Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(),"score-letter-"+Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
   var previousDecision=unsavedDecision;
   var previousScore=score;
   string previousFile=current;
   Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
   try{
    string a=Path.Combine(folder,"SONAA.MUS"),b=Path.Combine(folder,"SONAB.MUS"),later=Path.Combine(folder,"SONBA.MUS");
    File.Copy(Path.Combine(source,"MUSDAT","PRACTICE.MUS"),a);
    File.Copy(Path.Combine(source,"MUSDAT","MOZART.MUS"),b);
    File.Copy(b,later);
    Execute("CD "+folder);
    if(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory()!=folder)throw new Exception("CD did not change the process working folder.");
    Execute("DIR *.MUS");
    if(!pendingEditAcknowledgement||!responseLine.Text.Contains("SONAA.MUS")||
       !responseLine.Text.Contains("SONBA.MUS"))throw new Exception("DIR listing differs.");
    Execute("");
    if(pendingEditAcknowledgement)throw new Exception("DIR acknowledgment did not return to Main.");
    SetDocument(NativeMeasurements.New(source),"");
    score.Items.Clear();
    score.Items.Add(Item.Make(8,1,0,0,1,200));
    score.Items.Add(Item.Make(1,1,50,7,10,0,1));
    Execute("PM");
    if(!responseLine.Text.Contains("  1) STAFF  8. 1.0    .000      .00     1.00   200.000")||
       !responseLine.Text.Contains("  2) NOTE   1. 1.0  50.000     7.00    10.00      .000     1.0000"))
     throw new Exception("PM rows differ from the DOS fixture.");
    Execute("");
    Execute("VER");
    if(!responseLine.Text.Contains("Version =   3.1100  --  Serial # = "+NativeScoreIdentity.Require(source,false).Serial))
     throw new Exception("VER identity differs.");
    SetDocument(Score.Load(a),a);
    Execute("NX");
    if(current!=b)throw new Exception("NX did not step the filename stem.");
    Execute("VER");
    uint producer=BitConverter.ToUInt32(score.Trailer,4);
    if(!responseLine.Text.Contains("This file created by Serial # = "+producer)||
       !responseLine.Text.Contains(File.GetLastWriteTime(b).ToString("MM-dd-yy   HH:mm",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)))
     throw new Exception("VER file identity and DOS timestamp differ.");
    Execute("NB");
    if(current!=a)throw new Exception("NB did not step back.");
    SetDocument(Score.Load(later),later);
    Execute("NB");
    if(current!=a)throw new Exception("NB did not select the preceding A-ending stem.");
    score.Items.Add(Item.Make(2,1,20));
    unsavedDecision=()=>System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult.Cancel;
    Execute("NX");
    if(current!=a)throw new Exception("Cancelled NX replaced the open score.");
    string numericA=Path.Combine(folder,"wandh01.mus"),numericB=Path.Combine(folder,"wandh02.mus");
    File.Copy(a,numericA);File.Copy(b,numericB);
    SetDocument(Score.Load(numericA),numericA);Execute("NX");
    if(current!=numericB)throw new Exception("NX did not load the next numeric suffix in the same folder.");
    Execute("NX");
    if(current!=numericB)throw new Exception("A missing numeric successor replaced the open score.");
    Execute("NB");
    if(current!=numericA)throw new Exception("NB did not load the previous numeric suffix.");
    score.Items.Add(Item.Make(2,1,20));Execute("NX");
    if(current!=numericA)throw new Exception("Cancelled numeric NX replaced the open score.");
    SetDocument(Score.Load(a),a);
    var prefix=score.Encode();
    var incoming=Score.Load(b).Items;
    Execute("GM SONAB");
    Execute("");
    if(pendingAppendScore==null)throw new Exception("GM failed to warn about occupied staves.");
    HandleScoreAppendKey(new System.Windows.Forms.KeyEventArgs(System.Windows.Forms.Keys.Escape));
    if(!score.Encode().SequenceEqual(prefix))throw new Exception("Cancelled GM changed the score.");
    int count=score.Items.Count;
    Execute("GM SONAB");
    Execute("10");
    if(current!=a||!dirty||score.Items.Count!=count+incoming.Count)throw new Exception("GM offset did not append to the current score.");
    for(int n=0;n<incoming.Count;n++){
     var expected=incoming[n].Clone();
     expected.Set(2,expected.P(2)+10);
     if(!score.Items[count+n].Bytes.SequenceEqual(expected.Bytes))throw new Exception("GM offset changed another parameter.");
    }
    var beforeMissing=score.Encode();
    Execute("GM MISSING");
    if(!score.Encode().SequenceEqual(beforeMissing)||!pendingEditAcknowledgement||pendingAppendPath!=null||
       !responseLine.Text.StartsWith("File not found",StringComparison.Ordinal))
     throw new Exception("Missing GM changed the current score.");
    Execute("");
    Execute("GM SONAB");
    Execute("");
    HandleScoreAppendKey(new System.Windows.Forms.KeyEventArgs(System.Windows.Forms.Keys.Space));
    if(score.Items.Count!=count+incoming.Count*2||
       incoming.Where((item,index)=>!item.Bytes.SequenceEqual(score.Items[count+incoming.Count+index].Bytes)).Any())
     throw new Exception("Confirmed GM did not preserve the incoming records.");
    Console.WriteLine("PASS: VER, PM, DIR, CD, NX, NB and GM letter commands.");
   }finally{
    Directory.SetCurrentDirectory(previousDirectory);
    unsavedDecision=previousDecision;
    SetDocument(previousScore,previousFile);
    foreach(string file in Directory.GetFiles(folder))File.Delete(file);
    Directory.Delete(folder);
   }
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;

namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  const string EnharmonicNormalize="ENH-NORMALIZE";
  const string EnharmonicNormalizePrompt="Normalize stem directions?  (y or n, <Enter>=yes) ->";
  int originalInputStageHeader;
  short? testGraceWord;

  bool ExecuteMainNotationCommand(string verb,string arguments){
   if(ExecuteMainLayout(verb,arguments))return true;
   if(ExecuteMainTranspose(verb,arguments))return true;
   if(verb=="STUD"){
    studyStage=0;groupCommand="STUD";groupRange=null;
    Message(SystemSourcePrompt);command.Focus();return true;
   }
   if(verb=="ENH"){
    StartMainGroup(verb,"");
    Message("Enter Staff number, Left pos., Right pos. ->");
    return true;
   }
   if(verb=="STM"){ShortenOriginalStems(arguments);return true;}
   if(verb=="AD"){AdjustOriginalBeamStems(arguments);return true;}
   if(verb=="FL"||verb=="FLU"||verb=="FLD"||verb=="FLO"||verb=="FLN"){
    StartMainGroup(verb,"");
    string description=verb=="FLU"?"Up.":verb=="FLD"?"Down.":"to Opposite Direction.";
    Message((verb=="FLN"?"Normalize Stem Directions.":"Flip Stems, etc. "+description)+Environment.NewLine+
     "Enter Staff number, Left pos., Right pos. ->");
    return true;
   }
   if(verb!="CRV")return false;
   StartMainGroup(verb,arguments);
   return true;
  }

  void CommitOriginalGroupEnharmonic(){
   var order=score.Items.OrderBy(item=>item.Staff).ThenBy(item=>item.P(3)).ToArray();
   bool flats=false,sharps=false;
   foreach(var note in order.Where(item=>item.Code==1&&InMainGroup(item))){
    int accidental=(int)note.P(5)%10;
    flats|=accidental==1||accidental==4;
    sharps|=accidental==2||accidental==5;
   }
   if(flats&&sharps){
    ClearMainGroup();
    pendingEditAcknowledgement=true;
    ApplyMainOrder(order,"*** Can't mix sharps and flats.");
    return;
   }
   if(!flats&&!sharps){
    ClearMainGroup();pendingEditAcknowledgement=true;
    ApplyMainOrder(order,"*** No enharmonic changes made.");return;
   }
   bool changedAny=false;
   for(int i=0;i<order.Length;i++){
    var note=order[i];
    if(note.Code!=1||!InMainGroup(note))continue;
    // Once a direction is established, SCORE respells every selected note,
    // including naturals. The typed enharmonic leaf supplies each delta.
    int step=sharps?1:-1,delta;
    if(!TryOriginalEnharmonicDelta(OriginalEnharmonicClef(note),note.P(4),note.P(5),step,out delta))continue;
    var changed=note.Clone();
    changed.Set(4,note.P(4)+step);
    changed.Set(5,note.P(5)+delta);
    order[i]=changed;
    changedAny=true;
   }
   if(!changedAny){
    ClearMainGroup();
    pendingEditAcknowledgement=true;
    ApplyMainOrder(order,"*** No enharmonic changes made.");
    return;
   }
   groupCommand=EnharmonicNormalize;
   ApplyMainOrder(order,EnharmonicNormalizePrompt);
  }

  bool IsFlipGroup {get{return groupCommand=="FL"||groupCommand=="FLO"||
   groupCommand=="FLU"||groupCommand=="FLD"||groupCommand=="FLN";}}

  void CommitOriginalFlip(string operation=null,bool separatePartsCaller=false){
   CommitOriginalFlipWithTies(operation,separatePartsCaller,1);
  }
  void CommitOriginalFlipWithTies(string operation,bool separatePartsCaller,short tiesMode){
   operation=operation??groupCommand;
   var order=BuildOriginalFlip(score,operation,separatePartsCaller,tiesMode,groupRange,source,ref originalInputStageHeader,testGraceWord);
   ClearMainGroup();
   ApplyMainOrder(order,"");
  }
  internal static List<Item> NormalizePageStems(IList<Item> input,string root,bool page4=false){
   var score=NativeMeasurements.New(root);score.Items=input.ToList();int stage=0;
   int staffCount=input.Where(item=>item.Code==8).Select(item=>item.Staff).DefaultIfEmpty(1).Max();
   // PAGE's fitter at 1A38:0897 reads +0.0 from its own slope storage.
   return BuildOriginalFlip(score,"FLN",true,0,new[]{1f,0f,200f,0f,staffCount},root,ref stage,null,0f,page4).ToList();
  }
  static Item[] BuildOriginalFlip(Score score,string operation,bool separatePartsCaller,short tiesMode,float[] range,string root,ref int stage,short? graceWord,float? beamSlope=null,bool page4=false){
   var order=score.Items.OrderBy(item=>item.Staff).ThenBy(item=>item.P(3)).ToArray();
   Func<Item,bool> selected=item=>(range[0]>32||item.Staff>=range[0]&&item.Staff<=range[4])&&
    item.P(3)>=range[1]-.001f&&item.P(3)<=range[2]+.001f&&(range[3]==0||item.Code==(int)range[3]);
   short? retained=NativeEditCompatibility.OriginalGraceState?(graceWord??(stage==2?null:(short?)0)):null;
   var completedChords=new HashSet<int>();
   var overCapacity=new HashSet<int>(order.Where(item=>item.Code==1&&selected(item)).GroupBy(item=>item.Staff).Where(g=>g.Count()>100).Select(g=>g.Key));
   if(overCapacity.Count!=0&&!NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)
    throw new NotSupportedException("The original refuses more than 100 selected notes on one staff.");
   for(int n=0;n<order.Length;n++){
    var item=order[n];
    if(overCapacity.Contains(item.Staff))continue;
    if(completedChords.Contains(n)||!selected(item))continue;
    if(item.Code!=1)continue;
    int[] chord=Enumerable.Range(n,order.Length-n).Where(index=>order[index].Code==1&&
     order[index].Staff==item.Staff&&order[index].P(3)==item.P(3)).ToArray();
    int stem=(int)item.P(5)%100/10;
    bool separateChord=separatePartsCaller&&chord.Length>1;
    if(stem!=1&&stem!=2&&!separateChord){
     if(NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)continue;
     throw new NotSupportedException("Flip requires explicit stems in the selected note range.");
    }
    int target=operation=="FLU"?1:operation=="FLD"?2:
     operation=="FLN"?(Math.Abs(item.P(4))>=100||item.P(4)%100<7?1:2):3-stem;
    if(chord.Length>1){
     if(separateChord){int chordRoot=Array.FindIndex(chord,index=>(int)order[index].P(5)%100/10!=0);if(chordRoot>0)chord=chord.Skip(chordRoot).Concat(chord.Take(chordRoot)).ToArray();}
     if(!separateChord&&chord.Skip(1).Any(index=>(int)order[index].P(5)%100/10!=0)){
      if(NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates){foreach(int index in chord)completedChords.Add(index);continue;}
      throw new NotSupportedException("The original refuses two explicit stems in the same chord.");
     }
     ReconstructOriginalNoteGroup(order,chord,operation=="FLN"?0:target*10,retained);
     foreach(int index in chord)completedChords.Add(index);
     continue;
    }
    ReconstructOriginalNoteGroup(order,new[]{n},operation=="FLN"?0:target*10,retained);
   }
   var fittedBeamStems=new Dictionary<string,int>();
   var sameStartBeams=new Dictionary<string,Item>();
   var adjustedBeams=new HashSet<int>();
   for(int n=0;n<order.Length;n++){
    var beam=order[n];
    if(beam.Code!=6||!selected(beam)||overCapacity.Contains(beam.Staff))continue;
    string key=beam.Staff+":"+BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(beam.P(3)),0);
    Item earlier;bool adjusted=true;
    // Main36:04BF-057B tags subsequent beams at the same exact X as
    // siblings; 0F29-10F2 restores their saved fields around the first fit.
    if(beam.P(7)>=0&&beam.P(7)<30&&sameStartBeams.TryGetValue(key,out earlier)){
     var sibling=beam.Clone();sibling.Set(4,earlier.P(4));sibling.Set(5,earlier.P(5));
     sibling.Set(7,(int)earlier.P(7)/10*10+(int)beam.P(7)%10);order[n]=sibling;
    }else{
     adjusted=RefitOriginalFlipBeam(order,n,operation,fittedBeamStems,range,root,retained,beamSlope);
     if(adjusted)sameStartBeams[key]=order[n];
    }
    if(adjusted)adjustedBeams.Add(n);
   }
   if(adjustedBeams.Count!=0){stage=4;ApplyRecoveredBeamAdjustment(score,order,33,false,-1,adjustedBeams,page4);}
   var previousSlurEndpoints=new Dictionary<int,Tuple<int,int>>();
   var generatedSlurs=new Dictionary<int,Queue<float[]>>();
   for(int n=0;n<order.Length;n++){
    var slur=order[n];
    if(slur.Code!=5||!selected(slur)||overCapacity.Contains(slur.Staff))continue;
    // 2DC2:02A4..0302 collects Code5 with at least seven parameters,
    // excluding integer P8=1/2 and a bitwise-zero P7. Ties (P8=-2)
    // participate in normalization too; selection is not limited to -1.
    if(slur.Count<7)continue;
    if(slur.Count>=8){long offsetWord;if(!FiniteBinary32Integer64.TryConvert(BitConverter.ToUInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(slur.P(8)),0),out offsetWord))throw new NotSupportedException("Non-finite slur offset in original normalization.");short slurOffset=unchecked((short)offsetWord);if(slurOffset==1||slurOffset==2)continue;}
    if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(slur.P(7)),0)==0)continue;
    var notes=order.Where(item=>item.Code==1&&item.Staff==slur.Staff&&selected(item)).ToArray();
    if(notes.Length==0)continue;
    var eventGroups=notes.GroupBy(item=>item.P(3)).ToArray();int events=eventGroups.Length;
    int[] map=new int[events+1];int offset=0,first=0,last=events+1;
    int leftWord=unchecked((short)(int)Math.Truncate(slur.P(3))),rightWord=unchecked((short)(int)Math.Truncate(slur.P(6)));
    // Main 36:1130-1394: word-quantised endpoints, last match wins;
    // the start comparison takes precedence over the end comparison.
    for(int e=0;e<events;e++){
     map[e+1]=offset+1;offset+=eventGroups[e].Count();
     int x=unchecked((short)(int)Math.Truncate(eventGroups[e].Key));
     if(Math.Abs((int)unchecked((short)(leftWord-x)))<=1)first=e+1;
     else if(Math.Abs((int)unchecked((short)(rightWord-x)))<=1)last=e+1;
    }
    // 2DC2:11F6..1206 suppresses consecutive equal endpoint pairs in
    // the eligible curve list; 1279..1282 retains the last emitted pair.
    Tuple<int,int> previousPair;
    if(previousSlurEndpoints.TryGetValue(slur.Staff,out previousPair)&&previousPair.Item1==first&&previousPair.Item2==last)continue;
    previousSlurEndpoints[slur.Staff]=Tuple.Create(first,last);
    var rows=notes.Select(item=>{
     var row=new float[15];for(int k=0;k<15;k++)row[k]=item.P(k+1);
     // Main's transcription passes pitch/stem/rhythm/marks; P12 is retained
     // in the original compact item but not forwarded as a slur input control.
     row[11]=0;return row;
    }).ToList();
    var endpoints=InputEndpointProjection.Decode(first,last,5,rows,map,null,range[1],range[2]);
    var builtRows=InputSlurConstruction.Build(rows,endpoints,slur.Staff,events+1,tiesMode,range[2]);
    stage=5;
    var built=builtRows[rows.Count];
    for(int k=0;k<notes.Length;k++)if(notes[k].P(11)!=builtRows[k][10]){
     int at=Array.IndexOf(order,notes[k]);var marked=notes[k].Clone();marked.Set(11,builtRows[k][10]);order[at]=marked;
    }
    if(tiesMode==0){
     int bank=beamSlope.HasValue?slur.Staff:0;
     Queue<float[]> queue;
     if(!generatedSlurs.TryGetValue(bank,out queue))generatedSlurs.Add(bank,queue=new Queue<float[]>());
     foreach(var generated in builtRows.Skip(rows.Count))queue.Enqueue(generated);
     continue;
    }
    // Main 36:1404-1438 compares the two stored start-coordinate words
    // before copying the reconstructed curve back to the compact item.
    if(!SameFlipPosition(slur.P(3),built[2]))continue;
    var normalized=slur.Clone();normalized.Set(4,built[3]);normalized.Set(5,built[4]);
    float height=OriginalCurvature(slur.P(3),built[3],built[4],slur.P(6));
    normalized.Set(7,built[6]<0?-height:height);order[n]=normalized;
   }
   if(tiesMode==0){
    // PAGE 12C0:1391..1657 restarts the candidate cursor on each staff.
    // A nonmatching generated record can stall writes on its own staff.
    for(int n=0;n<order.Length;n++){
     var slur=order[n];
     if(slur.Code!=5||slur.Count<7||!selected(slur)||slur.P(7)==0||overCapacity.Contains(slur.Staff))continue;
     short offset=unchecked((short)(int)slur.P(8));if(offset==1||offset==2)continue;
     Queue<float[]> queue;
     if(!generatedSlurs.TryGetValue(beamSlope.HasValue?slur.Staff:0,out queue)||
      queue.Count==0||!SameFlipPosition(slur.P(3),queue.Peek()[2]))continue;
     var built=queue.Dequeue();
     var normalized=slur.Clone();normalized.Set(4,built[3]);normalized.Set(5,built[4]);
     normalized.Set(7,InputSlurConstruction.InitialHeight(slur.P(3),slur.P(6),built[3],built[4],built[7],built[6]));
     order[n]=normalized;
    }
   }
   return order;
  }
  static bool SameFlipPosition(float a,float b){return BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(a),0)==BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(b),0);}

  static void ReconstructOriginalNoteGroup(Item[] order,int[] group,int stem,short? retained){
   var rows=new List<float[]>();foreach(int index in group){var item=order[index];var row=new float[item.Count];for(int p=0;p<row.Length;p++)row[p]=item.P(p+1);rows.Add(row);}
   var result=InputMainNoteReconstruction.Build(rows,stem,retained,NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates);
   for(int i=0;i<group.Length;i++){
    var original=order[group[i]];var changed=original.Clone();
    foreach(int parameter in new[]{4,5,8,9,10})changed.Set(parameter,result[i][parameter-1]);
    changed.Set(11,i==0?OriginalFlipMark(original.P(11),changed.P(4),changed.P(5)):0);
    order[group[i]]=changed;
   }
  }

  static float OriginalFlipMark(float value,float pitch,float stem){
   int mark=(int)value;
   return value>=0&&Array.IndexOf(new[]{4,5,8,9,10,19},mark)>=0?
    InputAttachedMarks.DefaultValue(mark,pitch,stem):value;
  }

  static bool RefitOriginalFlipBeam(Item[] order,int index,string operation,Dictionary<string,int> fittedBeamStems,float[] range,string root,short? retained,float? beamSlope){
   var beam=order[index];
   int descriptor=(int)beam.P(7);
   if(descriptor<0||descriptor>=30||beam.P(6)<range[1]||beam.P(6)>range[2]){
    if(NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)return false;
    throw new NotSupportedException("Original beam flip refuses this tremolo or out-of-range endpoint; original invalid-state compatibility retains its partial note writes.");
   }
   var notes=order.Where(item=>item.Code==1&&item.Staff==beam.Staff&&
    item.P(3)>=beam.P(3)-.001f&&item.P(3)<=beam.P(6)+.001f).ToArray();
   // Section59 carries the first endpoint cue class across the beam.
   bool cue=notes.Length>0&&Math.Abs(notes[0].P(4))>=100&&Math.Abs(notes[0].P(4))<200;
   if(notes.Length<2||notes[0].P(3)!=beam.P(3)||notes[notes.Length-1].P(3)!=beam.P(6)){
    if(NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)return false;
    throw new NotSupportedException("Beam flip requires ordinary pitched endpoints.");
   }
   var groups=notes.GroupBy(item=>item.P(3)).Select(group=>group.ToArray()).ToArray();
   if(groups.Length<2){
    if(NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)return false;
    throw new NotSupportedException("The original refuses a beam without distinct endpoint events.");
   }
   int[] levels=groups.Select(group=>(int)InputRhythmDecoder.Decode(
    (float)(((int)group[0].P(9)/10)*1000.0+group[0].P(7))).FlagCount).ToArray();
   int flags=levels.Max();
   if(levels.Min()<1){
    if(NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)return false;
    throw new NotSupportedException("The original refuses a beam containing a note without a tail.");
   }
   int direction=operation=="FLU"?10:operation=="FLD"?20:operation=="FLN"?0:(int)notes[0].P(5)%100/10*10;
   // Section59's endpoint leaf takes the persistent first nonzero endpoint
   // stem. Its final loop retains the working stem map between beam inputs.
   if(direction==0){int prior;
    if(fittedBeamStems.TryGetValue(beam.Staff+":"+notes[0].P(3).ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),out prior)||
       fittedBeamStems.TryGetValue(beam.Staff+":"+notes[notes.Length-1].P(3).ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),out prior))direction=prior;
   }
   if(operation=="FLN"&&cue)direction=10;
   if(groups.Any(group=>group.Length>1)){
    // Section59 selects a shared chord direction before taking each chord's
    // final member as the fitter's representative pitch.
    if(direction==0)direction=7-notes.Min(item=>item.P(4)%100)<=notes.Max(item=>item.P(4)%100)-7?20:10;
    foreach(var group in groups){
     if(group.Length<2||(int)group[0].P(5)%100/10==direction/10)continue;
     ReconstructOriginalNoteGroup(order,group.Select(item=>Array.IndexOf(order,item)).ToArray(),direction,retained);
    }
    notes=order.Where(item=>item.Code==1&&item.Staff==beam.Staff&&item.P(3)>=beam.P(3)-.001f&&item.P(3)<=beam.P(6)+.001f).ToArray();
    groups=notes.GroupBy(item=>item.P(3)).Select(group=>group.ToArray()).ToArray();
   }
   var representatives=groups.Select(group=>group[group.Length-1]).ToArray();
   float slope=beamSlope??(float)((double)(root==null?.5f:NativePreferences.Read(root).Number("BEAM",.5f))/100);
   var fit=InputBeamFit.Fit(representatives.Select(item=>item.P(4)%100).ToArray(),
    representatives.Select(item=>item.P(3)).ToArray(),direction,flags,slope);
   int a=(int)fit.Start,b=(int)fit.End,offset=0;
   if(flags>2){
    offset=2;
    if(fit.Direction>19&&a>13||fit.Direction<20&&a<1)offset=4;
    offset+=(flags-3)*3;
   }
   if(fit.Direction<20){if(a==b&&a>9)offset-=2;}
   else{offset=-offset;if(a==b&&a<5)offset+=2;}
   var changed=beam.Clone();
   float shift=cue?(fit.Direction<20?.800000011920929f:-.800000011920929f):offset/2f;
   changed.Set(4,(float)((double)fit.Start+shift+(cue?(fit.Start<0?-100:100):0)));
   changed.Set(5,(float)((double)fit.End+shift));
   changed.Set(7,fit.Direction+levels.Min());
   order[index]=changed;
   foreach(var note in notes)fittedBeamStems[beam.Staff+":"+note.P(3).ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)]=fit.Direction;
   foreach(var note in notes){
    if((int)note.P(5)%100/10==0)continue;
    int at=Array.IndexOf(order,note);var replacement=note.Clone();
    replacement.Set(5,note.P(5)+(fit.Direction/10-(int)note.P(5)%100/10)*10);
    replacement.Set(11,OriginalFlipMark(note.P(11),note.P(4),replacement.P(5)));
    order[at]=replacement;
   }
   return true;
  }

  void ShortenOriginalStems(string arguments){
   int staff;
   if(!Int32.TryParse(arguments,NumberStyles.Integer,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out staff)||staff<1)
    throw new InvalidDataException("STM requires a staff number. Use a number greater than 32 for all staves.");
   var order=score.Items.Select(note=>{
    if(note.Code!=1||staff<=32&&note.Staff!=staff||Math.Abs(note.P(4))>=100||note.Count<5)return note;
    int stem=(int)note.P(5);
    if(stem<10)return note;
    float extension=note.P(8);
    float tip=(float)((stem<20?note.P(4):14.0-note.P(4))+extension);
    if(tip<8)return note;
    float adjustment=tip<10?(float)((10.0-tip)*.5-1.5):-1.5f;
    if((int)note.P(9)%10>=1)adjustment+=.5f;
    float adjusted=(float)((extension<0?0:extension)+(double)adjustment);
    if(note.P(8)==adjusted)return note;
    var changed=note.Clone();
    changed.Set(8,adjusted);
    return changed;
   }).ToArray();
   ApplyMainOrder(order,"");
  }

  void AdjustOriginalBeamStems(string arguments){
   var fields=arguments.Split(new[]{' ', ',', '\t'},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
   float staffValue,force=0;
   if(fields.Length<1||fields.Length>2||!Single.TryParse(fields[0],NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out staffValue)||Single.IsNaN(staffValue)||Single.IsInfinity(staffValue)||staffValue<short.MinValue||staffValue>=32768)
    throw new InvalidDataException("AD requires a finite signed-word staff value.");
   int staff=(short)Math.Truncate(staffValue);
   if(staff<1&&!NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)throw new NotSupportedException("A nonpositive AD staff is prevented; original invalid-state compatibility permits the measured no-op.");
   if(fields.Length>1&&(!Single.TryParse(fields[1],NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out force)||Single.IsNaN(force)||Single.IsInfinity(force)))
    throw new InvalidDataException("AD's optional direction override must be finite.");
   if(force<short.MinValue||force>=32768)throw new InvalidDataException("AD direction override outside the original signed-word domain.");
   var order=score.Items.ToArray();ApplyRecoveredBeamAdjustment(order,staff,(short)Math.Truncate(force)!=0,-1);ApplyMainOrder(order,"");
  }

  void ApplyRecoveredBeamAdjustment(Item[] order,int staff,bool force,int onlyBeam,ISet<int> selectedBeams=null){
   ApplyRecoveredBeamAdjustment(score,order,staff,force,onlyBeam,selectedBeams);
  }
  static void ApplyRecoveredBeamAdjustment(Score score,Item[] order,int staff,bool force,int onlyBeam,ISet<int> selectedBeams,bool page4=false){
   var rows=order.Select(item=>Enumerable.Range(1,item.Count).Select(p=>item.P(p)).ToArray()).ToList();
   int maximum=order.Where(item=>item.Code==8).Select(item=>item.Staff).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max();
   var result=BeamStemAdjustment.Apply(rows,staff,force,new NativePageDocument(score).Tables,maximum,onlyBeam,selectedBeams,page4);
   for(int i=0;i<order.Length;i++){
    bool changed=result[i].Length!=rows[i].Length;
    if(!changed)for(int p=0;p<rows[i].Length;p++)if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(rows[i][p]),0)!=BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(result[i][p]),0)){changed=true;break;}
    if(!changed)continue;var item=order[i].Clone();for(int p=0;p<result[i].Length;p++)item.Set(p+1,result[i][p]);order[i]=item;
   }
  }

  // Original resident 13A9:0006 stores the span, divides it by DS:69BE (20),
  // then adds the unrounded slope product and DS:69C2. Multiplying by .05f differs.
  static float OriginalCurvature(float left,float y1,float y2,float right){
   float span=(float)((double)right-left);
   return (float)(Math.Abs((double)y2-y1)*.1f+(double)span/20+.9f);
  }
  static Item WithOriginalCurvature(Item item){
   if(item.Code!=5||(item.P(8)!=-1&&item.P(8)!=0))return item;
   float curvature=OriginalCurvature(item.P(3),item.P(4),item.P(5),item.P(6));
   if(item.P(7)<0)curvature=-curvature;
   if(item.P(7)==curvature)return item;
   var changed=item.Clone();
   changed.Set(7,curvature);
   return changed;
  }
 }
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Linq;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Globalization;using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  Score rippleWorking;short rippleStaves,rippleSource,rippleDestination,rippleBars;int rippleStage;List<float> rippleInput=new List<float>();
  void SubmitMainRipple(string text){if(text.Trim().Equals("B",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){ClearMainGroup();rippleWorking=null;Message("");return;}var values=LayoutNumbers(text);if(values.Length>20)throw new NotSupportedException("Original RIP argument capacity exceeded.");if(rippleInput.Count==0&&values.Length>=4&&TransposeWord(values[3].ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))!=0){rippleInput.AddRange(values.Take(4));}else if(values.Length>0)rippleInput.Add(values[0]);else rippleInput.Add(0);
   if(rippleInput.Count<4){string[] prompts={"How many staves in a system? (B=backup) ->","Type staff number of bottom of source system. ->","Type staff number of bottom of destination system. ->","How many bars to move? ->"};Message(prompts[rippleInput.Count]);return;}
   Func<int,short> word=i=>TransposeWord(rippleInput[i].ToString("R",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));rippleStaves=word(0);rippleSource=word(1);rippleDestination=word(2);rippleBars=word(3);var rows=score.Items.Select(TransposeRow).ToList();int[] order=InputTranspositionOrder.OrderForMain(rows,false);var words=new float[16384];var starts=new int[order.Length];int at=0;foreach(int index in order){var item=score.Items[index];int slot=Array.IndexOf(order,index);starts[slot]=at+1;if(at+item.Bytes.Length/4>words.Length)throw new NotSupportedException("Original RIP source word capacity exceeded.");Buffer.BlockCopy(item.Bytes,0,words,at*4,item.Bytes.Length);at+=item.Bytes.Length/4;}if(at+score.Trailer.Length/4<=words.Length)Buffer.BlockCopy(score.Trailer,0,words,at*4,score.Trailer.Length);var result=LayoutRipple.Prepare(words,starts,rippleStaves,rippleSource,rippleDestination,rippleBars);rippleWorking=score.Clone();rippleWorking.Items=new List<Item>();foreach(int w in result.Starts){int n=(int)Math.Truncate(words[w-1]);byte[] bytes=new byte[(n+1)*4];Buffer.BlockCopy(words,(w-1)*4,bytes,0,bytes.Length);rippleWorking.Items.Add(new Item(bytes));}rippleStage=0;if(!result.Applied){FinishMainRipple();return;}StartRippleLineup();
  }
  void StartRippleLineup(){short bottom=rippleStage==0?rippleSource:rippleDestination;var scales=new PageCoordinates();foreach(var item in rippleWorking.Items.Where(item=>item.Code==8)){var p=new float[Math.Max(21,item.Count+1)];for(int j=1;j<=item.Count;j++)p[j]=item.P(j);scales.SetStaff(p,NativeMeasurements.Get(rippleWorking)==1);}layoutScales=scales.Scales;layoutTranscript=new List<string>();layoutPreparation=new LayoutParentPreparation(rippleWorking.Items.Select(TransposeRow).ToList(),bottom,(short)(bottom+rippleStaves-1),0,200,false,true);ContinueMainJustification();}
  void ContinueRippleLineup(List<Item> next){
   rippleWorking.Items=next;rippleStage++;if(rippleStage<2){StartRippleLineup();return;}
   int low=Math.Min(rippleSource,rippleDestination),high=Math.Max(rippleSource,rippleDestination);
   // 2C0C tail compares P1 with the literal 3: these are clefs, not staves.
   for(int k=0;k<rippleStaves;k++){
    var a=rippleWorking.Items.FirstOrDefault(item=>item.Staff==low+k&&item.Code==3);
    var b=rippleWorking.Items.LastOrDefault(item=>item.Staff==high+k&&item.Code==3);
    if(a==null||b==null)continue;float first=a.Count>=5?a.P(5):0,second=b.Count>=5?b.P(5):0;
    if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(first),0)!=BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(second),0)){
     if(a.Count<5)a.Set(a.Count+2,0);a.Set(4,0);a.Set(5,second);
    }
   }
   FinishMainRipple();
  }
  void FinishMainRipple(){
   bool trackDisplay=rippleWorking.Items.Count==score.Items.Count&&CanTrackDisplayRedraw();
   if(rippleStage<2){
    // Even when the source and destination coincide, RIP sorts the item
    // table and marks the score changed. Its display banks are left intact.
    Checkpoint();score.Items=rippleWorking.Items;originalLayoutMarksModified|=InputTranspositionOrder.MarksModified(score.Items.Count,false);
    dirty=true;rippleWorking=null;ClearMainGroup();
    if(trackDisplay&&rippleSource==rippleDestination)RecordUnchangedTrackedDisplay();
    RefreshAll(null);
    Message("");return;
   }
   var restOrdinals=new List<int>();
   for(int staff=Math.Min(rippleSource,rippleDestination);staff<=Math.Max(rippleSource,rippleDestination)+rippleStaves-1;staff++)
   {
    var centered=NativeRestCentering.Plan(rippleWorking,staff);
    NativeRestCentering.Apply(centered);
    if(trackDisplay)restOrdinals.AddRange(centered.Select(change=>rippleWorking.Items.IndexOf(change.Item)+1));
   }
   Checkpoint();score.Items=rippleWorking.Items;originalLayoutMarksModified|=InputTranspositionOrder.MarksModified(score.Items.Count,false);
   dirty=true;rippleWorking=null;ClearMainGroup();RefreshTextCaches();RefreshTransposeTextTerminators();RefreshAll(null);
   // RIP replaces each centered rest using the earlier display pointer
   // order, then redraws the full score.
   if(trackDisplay)ReplayTrackedDisplayReplacements(restOrdinals,2,true);
   Message("");
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Linq;using System.Collections.Generic;using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  Score separateWorking;short separateBottom,separateTop;float separateLeft,separateRight;bool separateBottomChoice,separateNormalize,separateDisplayPrepared;
  const string SeparateRangePrompt="Type bottom staff number, left pos., right pos., top staff num. --";
  void BackoutMainSeparate(){
   var sorted=separateWorking;separateWorking=null;ClearMainGroup();
   if(sorted!=null&&InputTranspositionOrder.MarksModified(sorted.Items.Count,false)){
    bool trackDisplay=separateDisplayPrepared&&CanTrackDisplayRedraw();
    Checkpoint();score.Items=sorted.Items;originalLayoutMarksModified=true;dirty=true;RefreshTransposeTextTerminators();
    separateDisplayPrepared=false;
    if(trackDisplay)RecordUnchangedTrackedDisplay();
    RefreshAll(null);
   }
   Message("");
  }
  void SubmitMainSeparate(string text){
   if(layoutPrompt==LayoutPrompt.Range){if(text.Trim().Equals("B",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){ClearMainGroup();Message("");return;}var p=LayoutNumbers(text);if(p.Length>20)throw new NotSupportedException("Original SEP argument capacity exceeded.");separateBottom=p.Length>0?TransposeWord(p[0].ToString("R",System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)):(short)0;separateTop=p.Length>3?TransposeWord(p[3].ToString("R",System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)):(short)0;if(separateTop<separateBottom)separateTop=separateBottom;if(separateBottom>32){separateBottom=1;separateTop=32;}if(separateBottom<1||separateTop>32)throw new NotSupportedException("Original SEP staff scope is outside the verified table.");separateLeft=p.Length>1?p[1]:0;separateRight=p.Length>2&&BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(p[2]),0)!=0?p[2]:220;var rows=score.Items.Select(TransposeRow).ToList();int[] order=InputTranspositionOrder.OrderForMain(rows,false);separateWorking=score.Clone();separateWorking.Items=order.Select(i=>score.Items[i].Clone()).ToList();LayoutSeparateParts.Validate(separateWorking.Items.Select(TransposeRow).ToList(),separateBottom,separateTop,separateLeft,separateRight);
    separateDisplayPrepared=PrepareTrackedSeparateDisplay(separateWorking);
    layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Part;Message("*** Sorting by staff number.\nT = delete top notes, B = delete bottom notes ->");return;}
   if(layoutPrompt==LayoutPrompt.Part){separateBottomChoice=text.Trim().Equals("B",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Normalize;Message("Normalize stem directions. Y/N ? [Enter=Y] ->");return;}
   if(layoutPrompt==LayoutPrompt.Normalize){separateNormalize=!text.Trim().Equals("N",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);layoutPrompt=LayoutPrompt.Confirm;Message(GroupDeletePrompt);return;}
   if(text.Trim().Equals("B",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){BackoutMainSeparate();return;}if(!String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))throw new NotSupportedException("Only the measured Enter/B SEP confirmation is implemented.");
   var originalItems=separateWorking.Items;var result=LayoutSeparateParts.Apply(originalItems.Select(TransposeRow).ToList(),separateBottom,separateTop,separateLeft,separateRight,separateBottomChoice);var next=new List<Item>();for(int i=0;i<result.Rows.Count;i++){var item=Item.Make(result.Rows[i]);var original=originalItems[result.Origins[i]];if(item.Count==original.Count)Array.Copy(original.Bytes,0,item.Bytes,0,4);next.Add(item);}separateWorking.Items=next;
   bool trackedNormalization=separateNormalize&&result.ChangedStaffs.All(staff=>SupportedSeparateDisplayNormalization(next,staff));
   bool trackDisplay=separateDisplayPrepared&&(!separateNormalize||trackedNormalization)&&CanTrackDisplayRedraw();
   try{if(separateNormalize&&result.ChangedStaffs.Count>0){
    if(separateWorking.Items.Any(item=>item.Code==1&&result.ChangedStaffs.Contains((short)item.Staff)&&item.P(3)>=0&&item.P(3)<=220&&item.Count>=10&&BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(item.P(10)),0)!=0))throw new NotSupportedException("SCORE reports: WILL NOT FLIP OFFSET NOTE. SEP normalization is refused without publishing a partial edit.");
    NormalizeSeparateCandidate(result.ChangedStaffs);
   }}catch{
    if(separateDisplayPrepared)InvalidateDisplayStorage();
    separateDisplayPrepared=false;separateWorking=null;ClearMainGroup();throw;
   }
   trackDisplay&=separateWorking.Items.Count==next.Count;
   Checkpoint();score.Items=separateWorking.Items;originalLayoutMarksModified|=InputTranspositionOrder.MarksModified(score.Items.Count,false);dirty=true;separateWorking=null;separateDisplayPrepared=false;ClearMainGroup();RefreshTransposeTextTerminators();RefreshAll(null);
   if(trackDisplay){
    // SEP compacts the sorted display before the full redraw.
    var live=originalItems.ToList();
    var survivors=result.Origins.Select((origin,index)=>new{origin,item=next[index]}).ToDictionary(pair=>pair.origin,pair=>pair.item);
    int removed=0;
    foreach(var staff in originalItems.Select(item=>item.Staff).Distinct()){
     for(int index=0;index<originalItems.Count;index++){
      if(originalItems[index].Staff!=staff)continue;
      Item survivor;
      if(survivors.TryGetValue(index,out survivor)){live[index-removed]=survivor;continue;}
      physicalDisplayStorage.DeleteItem(index+1-removed);
      live.RemoveAt(index-removed);
      removed++;
     }
     if(trackedNormalization&&result.ChangedStaffs.Contains((short)staff))
      physicalDisplayStorage.WriteSeparatedChordNormalizationScratch(live,staff);
    }
    RebuildTrackedDisplay();
   }
   Message("");
  }
  static bool SupportedSeparateDisplayNormalization(List<Item> rows,int staff){
   if(rows.Any(item=>item.Staff==staff&&(item.Code==5||item.Code==6)))return false;
   var notes=rows.Where(item=>item.Staff==staff&&item.Code==1&&item.P(3)>=0&&item.P(3)<=220).ToArray();
   return notes.Length<=5&&notes.Length>0&&notes.All(item=>item.P(7)==1&&item.P(6)==0&&item.P(9)==0&&item.Count<=9)&&
    notes.GroupBy(item=>item.P(3)).All(chord=>chord.Count()<=2&&chord.Count(item=>item.P(5)==10||item.P(5)==20)==1&&
     chord.All(item=>item.P(5)==0||item.P(5)==10||item.P(5)==20));
  }
  void NormalizeSeparateCandidate(IList<short> staffs){var priorScore=score;string priorGroup=groupCommand;var priorRange=groupRange;bool priorDirty=dirty;int depth=undo.Count;var priorRedo=redo.ToArray();try{score=separateWorking;foreach(short staff in staffs){groupRange=new float[]{staff,0,220,0,staff};groupCommand=EnharmonicNormalize;CommitOriginalFlip("FLN",true);}separateWorking=score;}finally{while(undo.Count>depth)undo.Pop();redo.Clear();for(int i=priorRedo.Length-1;i>=0;i--)redo.Push(priorRedo[i]);score=priorScore;groupCommand=priorGroup;groupRange=priorRange;dirty=priorDirty;RefreshAll(null);}}
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;

namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  int studyStage,studyBottom,studyCount,studyNoteStaff;
  float studyLeft,studyRight;

  void SubmitOriginalStemSpacing(string text){
   if(text.Trim().Equals("B",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){
    ClearMainGroup();Message("");return;
   }
   if(studyStage==3){
    if(!String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))throw new InvalidDataException(GroupDeletePrompt);
    ApplyOriginalStemSpacing();
    return;
   }
   var fields=text.Split(new[]{' ',',','	'},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
   var values=new float[fields.Length];
   for(int i=0;i<fields.Length;i++)
    if(!Single.TryParse(fields[i],NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out values[i])||
       Single.IsNaN(values[i])||Single.IsInfinity(values[i]))
     throw new InvalidDataException("Enter finite SCORE parameters.");
   if(studyStage==0){
    if(values.Length!=2)throw new InvalidDataException(SystemSourcePrompt);
    studyBottom=GroupInteger(values[0],1,32);
    studyCount=GroupInteger(values[1],1,33-studyBottom);
    studyStage=1;Message("Enter Left position, Right position. ->");
   }else if(studyStage==1){
    if(values.Length!=2)throw new InvalidDataException("Enter Left position, Right position. ->");
    studyLeft=values[0];studyRight=values[1]<=studyLeft?220:values[1];
    studyStage=2;Message("Type number of staff containing notes to be adjusted.->");
   }else{
    if(values.Length!=1)throw new InvalidDataException("Type number of staff containing notes to be adjusted.->");
    studyNoteStaff=GroupInteger(values[0],1,32);
    studyStage=3;Message(GroupDeletePrompt);
   }
  }

  void ApplyOriginalStemSpacing(){
   var original=score.Items.OrderBy(item=>item.Staff).ThenBy(item=>item.P(3)).ToArray();
   var order=original.Select(item=>item.Clone()).ToArray();
   var notes=order.Where(item=>item.Code==1&&item.Staff==studyNoteStaff&&item.Count>=5&&
    Math.Abs(item.P(4))<100&&(int)item.P(5)>=10&&item.P(3)>=studyLeft&&item.P(3)<=studyRight).ToArray();
   if(notes.Length>80)throw new NotSupportedException("The original STUD note list is limited to 80 notes.");
   if(notes.Length>=2){
    var page=new NativePageDocument(score);
    float width=(float)((double)page.Tables.Scales[studyBottom]*2.8333001136779785f/25);
    float first=notes[0].P(3),left=first,span=notes[notes.Length-1].P(3)-first;
    float offset=1000;
    bool aborted=false;int intervals=0;
    int previous=(int)notes[0].P(5)%100/10;
    foreach(var note in notes.Skip(1)){
     float right=note.P(3);
     int stem=(int)note.P(5)%100/10;
     float delta=stem>previous?width:stem<previous?-width:0;
     float distance=right-left;
     // Original 2CF5:1276-127F returns immediately on a zero interval,
     // without the final rescaling. Earlier interval writes remain committed.
     if(distance==0){
      if(intervals!=0&&!NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)
       throw new NotSupportedException("STUD's coincident-note return would retain intermediate shifted coordinates. Original invalid-state compatibility permits that partial result.");
      aborted=true;break;
     }
     float destination=left+offset;
     float factor=(float)(((double)right+delta-left)/distance);
     TransformStemSpacingInterval(order,left,right,destination,factor);
     intervals++;
     offset+=delta;left=right;previous=stem;
    }
    float finalLeft=first+1000,finalRight=left+offset;
    float finalSpan=finalRight-finalLeft;
    if(!aborted){
     if(finalSpan==0)throw new InvalidDataException("STUD produced a zero horizontal span.");
     TransformStemSpacingInterval(order,finalLeft,finalRight,first,(float)((double)span/finalSpan));
    }
   }
   for(int i=0;i<order.Length;i++)
    if(order[i].Bytes.SequenceEqual(original[i].Bytes))order[i]=original[i];
   ClearMainGroup();
   ApplyMainOrder(order,"");
  }

  void CheckOriginalStemSpacing(){
   var previous=score;
   string previousFile=current;
   try{
    foreach(bool reverse in new[]{false,true}){
     var fixture=NativeMeasurements.New(source);
     fixture.Items.Clear();
     fixture.Items.Add(Item.Make(8,1,0,0,1,200));
     for(int i=0;i<4;i++)fixture.Items.Add(Item.Make(1,1,20+i*20,7,(i%2==0)^reverse?10:20,0,1,0));
     fixture.Items.Add(Item.Make(2,1,40,5,-2,0,1));
     SetDocument(fixture,"");
     byte[] before=score.Encode();
     Execute("STUD");Execute("1 1");Execute("0 220");Execute("1");Execute("");
     float[] wanted=reverse?new[]{19.999998092651367f,38.017547607421875f,61.982444763183594f,79.99987030029297f}:
      new[]{20.00000762939453f,41.803672790527344f,58.19634246826172f,80.0001220703125f};
     var actual=score.Items.Where(item=>item.Code==1).Select(item=>item.P(3)).ToArray();
     if(!actual.SequenceEqual(wanted)||score.Items.Single(item=>item.Code==2).P(3)!=wanted[1])
      throw new InvalidOperationException("STUD differs from the original alternating-stem and rest positions.");
     Undo(false);
     if(!score.Encode().SequenceEqual(before))
      throw new InvalidOperationException("STUD undo did not restore the original records.");
    }
    Console.WriteLine("PASS: DOS STUD alternating-stem spacing and undo.");
   }finally{ClearMainGroup();SetDocument(previous,previousFile);}
  }

  void TransformStemSpacingInterval(Item[] order,float left,float right,float destination,float factor){
   float origin=(float)(destination-(double)left*factor);
   float low=left-.001f,high=right+.001f;
   foreach(var item in order){
    if(item.Staff<studyBottom||item.Staff>=studyBottom+studyCount)continue;
    if(item.Code<1||item.Code>18)throw new NotSupportedException("STUD requires a supported SCORE item code.");
    NativeItemMotion.TransformHorizontal(item,x=>x>=low&&x<=high?(float)((double)x*factor+origin):x);
   }
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Globalization;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  LayoutTextJustificationWorkspace textJustificationWorkspace=new LayoutTextJustificationWorkspace();
  void PrepareMainTextJustification(){
   // The original sorts after the text-level response, including B.
   // The pre-answer records are unchanged in the measured prompt trace.
   var rows=score.Items.Select(TransposeRow).ToList();var order=InputTranspositionOrder.OrderForMain(rows,false);bool modified=InputTranspositionOrder.MarksModified(rows.Count,false);
   if(modified||order.Where((value,index)=>value!=index).Any()){Checkpoint();layoutTextCheckpoint=true;score.Items=order.Select(index=>score.Items[index]).ToList();originalLayoutMarksModified|=modified;dirty|=modified;RefreshAll(null);}
  }
  void CommitMainTextJustification(short textStaff,float level){
   var scales=new PageCoordinates();foreach(var item in score.Items.Where(i=>i.Code==8)){var p=new float[Math.Max(21,item.Count+1)];for(int j=1;j<=item.Count;j++)p[j]=item.P(j);scales.SetStaff(p,NativeMeasurements.Get(score)==1);}
   var rows=score.Items.Select(TransposeRow).ToList();int[] order=InputTranspositionOrder.OrderForMain(rows,false);var starts=new int[order.Length];var words=new float[16384];int at=0;
   for(int i=0;i<order.Length;i++){var original=score.Items[order[i]];var row=rows[order[i]];if(at+row.Length+1>words.Length)throw new NotSupportedException("Original text-justification source bank capacity exceeded.");starts[i]=at+1;words[at++]=BitConverter.ToSingle(original.Bytes,0);Array.Copy(row,0,words,at,row.Length);at+=row.Length;}
   if(at+score.Trailer.Length/4<=words.Length)Buffer.BlockCopy(score.Trailer,0,words,at*4,score.Trailer.Length);
   var calculation=LayoutTextJustification.Apply(words,starts,layoutBottom,layoutTop,layoutLeft,layoutRight,textStaff,level,scales.Scales,32,2800,textJustificationWorkspace);
   var next=new List<Item>();for(int i=0;i<order.Length;i++){var row=new float[rows[order[i]].Length];Array.Copy(words,starts[i],row,0,row.Length);var item=Item.Make(row);Buffer.BlockCopy(words,(starts[i]-1)*4,item.Bytes,0,4);next.Add(item);}
   var transcript=new List<string>();if(rows.Count>0)transcript.Add("*** Sorting by staff number.");if(calculation.Gaps!=null&&calculation.Gaps.CompressedMinimums){transcript.Add("*** Not enough space to justify ideally.");transcript.Add(((double)calculation.Gaps.MinimumTotal).ToString(".000",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(8)+((double)calculation.Gaps.Width).ToString(".000",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(9));}
   bool changed=InputTranspositionOrder.MarksModified(rows.Count,false)||next.Count!=score.Items.Count||next.Where((item,i)=>!item.Bytes.SequenceEqual(score.Items[i].Bytes)).Any();
   if(changed){if(!layoutTextCheckpoint)Checkpoint();score.Items=next;originalLayoutMarksModified|=InputTranspositionOrder.MarksModified(rows.Count,false);dirty=true;}
   ClearMainGroup();if(calculation.PointCount>0)RefreshTransposeTextTerminators();RefreshAll(null);Message(String.Join(Environment.NewLine,transcript));
  }
 }
}
````
