````csharp
using System;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Globalization;using System.Windows.Forms;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  enum TransposePrompt { Staff, Interval, Menu, Clefs, ClefChoice, Key, Warning, Normalize }
  const string TransposeStaffPrompt="Enter staff number to transpose or \"B\" or <ESC> to backout. ->";
  const string TransposeIntervalPrompt="Enter number of half steps (+/-) or \"M\" for a Menu of transpositions. ->";
  const string TransposeClefsPrompt="Change clefs? (y or n, <Enter>=no) ->";
  const string TransposeKeyPrompt="Add key signature? (y or n, <Enter>=no) ->";
  TransposePrompt transposePrompt;float transposeStaff;
  bool transposeCheckpoint;
  TranspositionOperationSession transposeOperation;
  Score transposeDisplayStart;
  RetainedParameterStorage transposeParameterStart;
  // Fresh original DS captures establish these resident words; the workspace
  // persists between transpositions rather than resetting on each request.
  readonly TranspositionWorkspace transposeWorkspace=new TranspositionWorkspace(new TranspositionCollectorState(0),new TranspositionClefState(0x2020,0x2020),new short[200],new short[200],0,new TranspositionRelationshipWindow(),false);
  bool IsTransposeGroup {get{return groupCommand=="TR"||groupCommand=="TRK";}}
  bool ExecuteMainTranspose(string verb,string arguments){
   if(verb!="TR"&&verb!="TRK")return false;
   var numericArguments=arguments.Split(new[]{' ',',','\t'},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
   foreach(string value in numericArguments){float number;if(!Single.TryParse(value,NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out number)||Single.IsNaN(number)||Single.IsInfinity(number))throw new InvalidDataException("TR requires finite numeric arguments.");}
   transposeDisplayStart=CanTrackDisplayRedraw()?score.Clone():null;
   transposeParameterStart=null;
   if(NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates&&score.Trailer.Length==20&&score.RawStorageLayoutVerified&&
      score.OriginalFilePayload!=null&&!parameterStorageDirty){
    var active=ParameterBytes(score);
    if(active.Length+20==score.OriginalFilePayload.Length&&
       active.SequenceEqual(score.OriginalFilePayload.Take(active.Length))&&parameterStorage.Matches(active))
     transposeParameterStart=parameterStorage.Clone();
   }
   groupCommand=verb;groupRange=null;transposeOperation=null;transposeCheckpoint=false;
   var rows=score.Items.Select(TransposeRow).ToList();
   int[] order=InputTranspositionOrder.OrderForMain(rows,transposeWorkspace.AlreadySorted).ToArray();
   bool modified=InputTranspositionOrder.MarksModified(rows.Count,transposeWorkspace.AlreadySorted);
   if(modified||order.Where((value,index)=>value!=index).Any()){
    Checkpoint();transposeCheckpoint=true;score.Items=order.Select(index=>score.Items[index]).ToList();originalLayoutMarksModified|=modified;dirty|=modified;RefreshAll(null);
    if(transposeDisplayStart!=null)transposeDisplayStart.Items=order.Select(index=>transposeDisplayStart.Items[index]).ToList();
   }
   transposePrompt=TransposePrompt.Staff;
   string first=numericArguments.FirstOrDefault();
   // Main's parent reads the first numeric argument; later numeric words do
   // not supply a range. A literal positive zero takes the staff-question path.
   float numeric;
   if(first==null||Single.TryParse(first,NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out numeric)&&BitConverter.ToUInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(numeric),0)==0)Message(TransposeStaffPrompt);
   else SubmitMainTranspose(first);
   command.Focus();return true;
  }
  static float[] TransposeRow(Item item){var result=new float[item.Count];for(int p=0;p<result.Length;p++)result[p]=item.P(p+1);return result;}
  static string SeparateTransposeStaff(string text){
   int length=text.StartsWith("TRK",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)?3:text.StartsWith("TR",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)?2:0;
   if(length!=0&&text.Length>length){char value=text[length];if(Char.IsDigit(value)||value=='+'||value=='-'||value=='.')return text.Insert(length," ");}
   return text;
  }
  static short TransposeWord(string text){
   float value;if(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))value=0;
   else if(!Single.TryParse(text,NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out value)||Single.IsInfinity(value)||Single.IsNaN(value))throw new InvalidDataException("Enter a finite SCORE number.");
   long integer;if(!FiniteBinary32Integer64.TryConvert(BitConverter.ToUInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(value),0),out integer))throw new InvalidDataException("Number outside the original integer converter.");
   return unchecked((short)integer);
  }
  void TransposeShow(TransposePrompt next,string text){transposePrompt=next;Message(text);command.Focus();}
  void PublishTransposeRows(){
   if(transposeOperation==null)return;
   var next=transposeOperation.Result.Rows.Select(row=>Item.Make(row)).ToList();
   // The engine edits parameter words in existing records. Equal-length
   // records retain their raw count word, including converter-written bits.
   // A new/extended record receives the newly constructed count instead.
   for(int i=0;i<Math.Min(next.Count,score.Items.Count);i++)if(next[i].Count==score.Items[i].Count)Buffer.BlockCopy(score.Items[i].Bytes,0,next[i].Bytes,0,4);
   bool changed=next.Count!=score.Items.Count||next.Where((item,index)=>index>=score.Items.Count||!item.Bytes.SequenceEqual(score.Items[index].Bytes)).Any();
   if(changed){if(!transposeCheckpoint){Checkpoint();transposeCheckpoint=true;}score.Items=next;dirty=true;RefreshAll(null);}
  }
  void TransposeAskKey(){
   if(transposeOperation.Result.KeyQuestion)TransposeShow(TransposePrompt.Key,TransposeKeyPrompt);
   else FinishMainTranspose(false);
  }
  void FinishMainTranspose(bool key){
   var result=InputTranspositionOperation.Finish(transposeOperation,key);PublishTransposeRows();
   RefreshTransposeTextTerminators();
   if(result.WarningRequired)TransposeShow(TransposePrompt.Warning,InputTranspositionEmbeddedControl.FingeringWarning);
   else TransposeShow(TransposePrompt.Normalize,EnharmonicNormalizePrompt);
  }
  void SubmitMainTranspose(string input){
   string text=input.Trim(),answer=text.ToUpperInvariant();
   if(answer=="B"){
    switch(transposePrompt){
     case TransposePrompt.Clefs:case TransposePrompt.ClefChoice:transposeOperation=null;TransposeShow(TransposePrompt.Interval,TransposeIntervalPrompt);return;
     case TransposePrompt.Key:TransposeShow(TransposePrompt.Clefs,TransposeClefsPrompt);return;
     default:ClearMainGroup();transposeOperation=null;Message("");return;
    }
   }
   switch(transposePrompt){
    case TransposePrompt.Staff:
     transposeStaff=TransposeWord(text);
     if(transposeStaff<1&&!NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)throw new InvalidDataException("Enter a positive staff number.");
     TransposeShow(TransposePrompt.Interval,"Transpose staff number "+transposeStaff.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)+Environment.NewLine+TransposeIntervalPrompt);return;
    case TransposePrompt.Interval:
     if(answer=="M"){
      var menu=new List<string>();for(short n=1;n<=16;n++)menu.Add(n.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)+": "+InputTranspositionInterval.Menu(n).ToString("+0;-0;0",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
      TransposeShow(TransposePrompt.Menu,String.Join("   ",menu)+Environment.NewLine+"Type number ->");return;
     }
     BeginMainTranspose(TransposeWord(text));return;
    case TransposePrompt.Menu:
     short choice=TransposeWord(text);if(choice<1||choice>16){ClearMainGroup();Message("");return;}
     BeginMainTranspose(InputTranspositionInterval.Menu(choice));return;
    case TransposePrompt.Clefs:
     if(answer=="Y")TransposeShow(TransposePrompt.ClefChoice,"Change all clefs to: 0=treble, 1=bass, 2=alto, 3=tenor.  ->");
     else TransposeAskKey();return;
    case TransposePrompt.ClefChoice:
     short clef=TransposeWord(text);if(clef<0&&!NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)throw new InvalidDataException("Negative clef table indices are prevented.");
     if(clef<=3){InputTranspositionOperation.ChangeClef(transposeOperation,clef);PublishTransposeRows();}
     TransposeAskKey();return;
    case TransposePrompt.Key:FinishMainTranspose(answer=="Y");return;
    case TransposePrompt.Warning:TransposeShow(TransposePrompt.Normalize,EnharmonicNormalizePrompt);return;
    case TransposePrompt.Normalize:
     if(answer=="N"){transposeParameterStart=null;ObserveDisplayTranspose(transposeDisplayStart);ClearMainGroup();transposeOperation=null;Message("");return;}
     var displayBefore=transposeDisplayStart;
     var displayBeforeNormalize=displayBefore==null&&transposeParameterStart==null?null:score.Clone();
     transposeDisplayStart=null;
     groupRange=new[]{transposeStaff,-10f,200f,0f,transposeStaff};groupCommand=EnharmonicNormalize;
     transposeOperation=null;int depth=undo.Count;CommitOriginalFlip("FLN");
     // Native undo treats the whole interactive command as one operation.
     // Keep its initial checkpoint rather than an extra pre-normalization one.
     if(transposeCheckpoint)while(undo.Count>depth)undo.Pop();
     bool retainedLastWord=ApplyOriginalTransposeTail(displayBeforeNormalize);
     RefreshTransposeTextTerminators();
     ObserveDisplayTranspose(displayBefore,displayBeforeNormalize,(int)transposeStaff,retainedLastWord);return;
   }
  }
  bool ApplyOriginalTransposeTail(Score before){
   var storage=transposeParameterStart;
   transposeParameterStart=null;
   if(storage==null||before==null||before.Items.Count==0||before.Items.Count!=score.Items.Count)return false;
   var last=score.Items.Last();
   if(!last.Bytes.SequenceEqual(before.Items.Last().Bytes)||
      before.Items.Zip(score.Items,(old,current)=>current.Count<old.Count).Any(shrunk=>shrunk))return false;
   int length=score.Items.Sum(item=>item.Bytes.Length);
   int previousLength=before.Items.Sum(item=>item.Bytes.Length);
   if(before.OriginalFilePayload==null||previousLength+20!=before.OriginalFilePayload.Length||length<=previousLength)return false;
   // The original backwards copy begins at the low half of the packed
   // bank's last word (13A9:01E8–0225 and 202B:0714–0735).
   var high=storage.ReadKnown(length-2,2);
   if(high==null)return false;
   var word=BitConverter.GetBytes(last.P(last.Count));
   if(high[0]==word[2]&&high[1]==word[3])return false;
   Array.Copy(high,0,word,2,2);
   var updated=last.Clone();
   updated.Set(updated.Count,BitConverter.ToSingle(word,0));
   bool tracked=parameterStorage.Matches(ParameterBytes(score));
   score.Items[score.Items.Count-1]=updated;
   var active=ParameterBytes(score);
   if(tracked)parameterStorage.Pack(active);
   else parameterStorage.Opaque(active);
   score.RetainedUndefinedWord=parameterStorage.UndefinedWord();
   RefreshAll(null);
   return true;
  }
  void RefreshTransposeTextTerminators(){
   // DOS redraw runs its text converter again after note reconstruction.
   // That reconstruction may replace a record whose count byte was touched
   // by the converter before normalization. Reapply the measured converter,
   // with the existing protection/compatibility policy, rather than patching
   // a saved-file offset or a particular item number.
   foreach(var word in score.Items.Where(item=>item.Code==16).ToArray())NativeTextTerminator.Refresh(score,word);
  }
  void BeginMainTranspose(short semitones){
   var request=new TranspositionRequest{Staff=transposeStaff,Left=-10,Right=200,Semitones=semitones,ForceKeyQuestion=groupCommand=="TRK"};
   transposeOperation=InputTranspositionOperation.Begin(score.Items.Select(TransposeRow).ToList(),request,transposeWorkspace);
   if(transposeOperation.Result.Collection.FirstPass.Records.Count==0){ClearMainGroup();transposeOperation=null;Message("");return;}
   TransposeShow(TransposePrompt.Clefs,TransposeClefsPrompt);
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;using System.Globalization;using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.IO;

using System.Windows.Forms;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativeBeamDisplay {
  public static BeamAppearance Appearance{get;private set;}
  static string Settings{get{return "beams";}}
  public static void Load(){Appearance=BeamAppearance.Printed;try{if(NativeSettings.Exists(Settings)&&NativeSettings.ReadAllText(Settings).Trim()=="dos")Appearance=BeamAppearance.DosScreen;}catch(IOException){}}
  public static void Set(BeamAppearance value,bool save){Appearance=value;if(save)NativeSettings.WriteAllText(Settings,value==BeamAppearance.Printed?"printed":"dos");foreach(Form f in Application.OpenForms)f.Invalidate(true);}
  public static void AddMenu(ContextMenuStrip menu){NativeNotationView.AddMenu(menu);
   menu.Items.Add(new ToolStripSeparator());var printed=new ToolStripMenuItem("Beams/slurs: printed / EPS");var dos=new ToolStripMenuItem("Beams/slurs: DOS screen geometry");
   printed.Click+=(s,e)=>Set(BeamAppearance.Printed,true);dos.Click+=(s,e)=>Set(BeamAppearance.DosScreen,true);menu.Items.Add(printed);menu.Items.Add(dos);NativeTupletFonts.AddMenu(menu);NativeSlurDisplay.AddMenu(menu);NativeEditCompatibility.AddMenu(menu);
   menu.Opening+=(s,e)=>{printed.Checked=Appearance==BeamAppearance.Printed;dos.Checked=Appearance==BeamAppearance.DosScreen;};
  }
  static float Pitch(float value){return Math.Abs(value)>=100&&Math.Abs(value)<200?value-Math.Sign(value)*100:value;}
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,float staffStep,float staffBase){return Draw(g,item,staffStep,staffBase,null);}
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,float staffStep,float staffBase,ScoreText text,NativeNotationContext page=null){
   int code=(int)item.P(7);if(code==0||(Math.Abs(code)/10!=1&&Math.Abs(code)/10!=2))return false;
   float[] p=new float[21];for(int n=1;n<=20;n++)p[n]=item.P(n);
   // Normalize the original caller's coordinate space to the existing canvas:
   // horizontal SCORE units remain five canvas units; one vertical scale step
   // remains staffStep. The recovered routine itself is shared with the proofs.
   float scale=page==null?5*staffStep:page.Scale,verticalStep=7*scale;
   var context=new BeamGeometryContext{Scale=scale,LeftVertical=page==null?(float)((double)Pitch(p[4])*verticalStep):page.Prepared.Y,Vertical=v=>page==null?(float)((double)Pitch(v)*verticalStep):page.Vertical(v)};
   BeamReference reference;var shapes=BeamGeometry.Build(p,context,Appearance,out reference);
   Action drawLabel=()=>{
    short number=unchecked((short)(int)Math.Truncate(p[8]));
    if(number>0&&text!=null){
     var t=TupletGeometry.Build(number,Math.Abs(code)/10,reference.Cue,p[16],p[19],reference.StaffScale,reference.LeftX,reference.LeftY,reference.Dx,reference.Dy);
     var position=page==null?new PointF(120+(int)t.X/30f,staffBase+3*staffStep-(int)t.Y/35f):page.Point((int)t.X,(int)t.Y);NativeTupletFonts.Draw(g,text.ExternalFontName(2),t.Number,position.X,position.Y,TupletGeometry.PrintedEm(t.FontScale,reference.StaffScale),page!=null);
    }
   };
   if(Appearance==BeamAppearance.Printed)drawLabel();
   foreach(var shape in shapes){
    if(Appearance==BeamAppearance.Printed&&page!=null){var raw=new System.Collections.Generic.List<BarlinePoint>();for(int n=0;n<shape.Vertices.Length;n++){var v=shape.Vertices[n];raw.Add(new BarlinePoint(NativeNotationContext.Word(v.X,true),NativeNotationContext.Word(v.Y,false),n==0?2:0));}if(raw.Count>1){raw.Add(new BarlinePoint(raw[0].X,raw[0].Y,0));raw.Add(raw[1]);}NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,raw,NativePrintContext.BeamWidth);continue;}
    PointF[] points=shape.Vertices.Select(v=>page==null?new PointF(120+((int)v.X)/30f,staffBase+3*staffStep-((int)v.Y)/35f):page.Point(NativeNotationContext.Word(v.X,true),NativeNotationContext.Word(v.Y,false))).ToArray();
    if(Appearance==BeamAppearance.Printed){g.VectorFillPolygon(Brushes.Black,points,FillMode.Alternate);using(var pen=new Pen(Color.Black,0))g.VectorDrawPolygon(pen,points);}
    else {using(var pen=new Pen(Color.Black,50/35f))g.VectorDrawLines(pen,new[]{points[2],points[1],points[0],points[3]});}
   }
   if(Appearance!=BeamAppearance.Printed)drawLabel();
   return true;
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativeDatNumbers {
  static float F(double x){return (float)x;}
  public static List<PrimitiveTextPoint> Prepare(Item i,NativeNotationContext page,ScoreText text,NativeDatGlyphs dat,out short finalFont){
   NativeNumberFrame frame;
   if(text==null||!NativeNumberDisplay.Prepare(i,page,out frame))
    throw new NotSupportedException("DAT number controls outside the measured route.");
   string value=NativeNumberDisplay.Value(frame.Number);
   var body=NativeNumberDisplay.TextItem(i,frame);
   var position=NativeNumberDisplay.Position(page,frame);
   var points=text.ScanStrokeText(body,value,position,0,out finalFont);
   if(frame.Enclosure==0)return points;
   float width=text.PrepareLayout(body,value,page.Scale,0,true).Width;
   var area=NativeNumberDisplay.Enclosure(i,page,frame,width);
   int thickness=i.P(10)==0?1:(int)i.P(10);
   int copies=frame.Enclosure>2?0:(int)F((double)thickness*page.Scale/25);
   if(frame.Enclosure==2){
    for(int n=0;n<=(copies>0?1:0);n++){
     float delta=25*copies*n;
     points.AddRange(NativeDatSpecialItems.Box(F((double)area.X-area.Width-delta),F((double)area.Y-area.Height-delta),
      F((double)area.X+area.Width+delta),F((double)area.Y+area.Height+delta),false));
    }
    return points;
   }
   float factor=F((double)page.Scale*3.5);
   float h=F((double)area.Width/factor),v=F((double)area.Height/factor);
   points.AddRange(dat.Circle(page.Scale,area.X,area.Y,h,v,false,12));
   {
    if(copies>0){
     float delta=F((double)7.142899990081787f*copies/page.Scale);
     points.AddRange(dat.Circle(page.Scale,area.X,area.Y,F((double)h+delta),F((double)v+delta),false,12));
    }
   }
   return points;
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern{
 public static class NativeDatSpecialItems{
  static float F(double x){return (float)x;}
  public static List<PrimitiveTextPoint> Prepare(Item i,NativeNotationContext p,NativeDatGlyphs dat){
   if(i.Code==13)return new List<PrimitiveTextPoint>();
   if(i.Code==7){if(i.P(7)!=0||i.P(6)>i.P(3)||i.P(5)<0||i.P(5)>2)throw new NotSupportedException("DAT trill continuation controls need verification.");for(int n=8;n<=20;n++)if(i.P(n)!=0)throw new NotSupportedException("DAT trill auxiliary controls need verification.");var q=NativeTrillGlyph.Prepare(i.P(5),p.Prepared.X,p.Prepared.Y,p.Scale);return dat.Expand(q.Glyph,q.Horizontal,q.Vertical,p.Scale,q.X,q.Y);}
   if(i.Code==12&&i.P(5)==10)return NativeAccordionButton.Scan(i,p,dat);
   if(i.Code==12&&i.P(5)==2)return NativeGuitarBend.Scan(i,p,dat);
   if(i.Code==12){if(i.P(5)!=0&&i.P(5)!=1)throw new NotSupportedException("DAT special shape subtype needs verification.");for(int n=8;n<=20;n++)if(i.P(n)!=0&&n!=8&&n!=13&&n!=9&&n!=10&&n!=11&&n!=12)throw new NotSupportedException("DAT shape auxiliary controls need verification.");float h=i.P(7)==0?i.P(6):i.P(7);List<PrimitiveTextPoint> points;
    int extra=(short)(int)F((double)i.P(8)*p.Scale/25);
    if(i.P(5)==1){
     int step=(int)i.P(12);if(step==0)step=1;
     int start=(int)i.P(10),stop=(int)i.P(11);
     if(start<0)start+=360;
     if(stop==0)stop=360;
     if(stop<start)stop+=360;
     if(step<1||start<0||start>360||stop>720)throw new NotSupportedException("DAT circle angular domain needs verification.");
     points=dat.ShapeCircle(p.Scale,p.Prepared.X,p.Prepared.Y,i.P(6),h,i.P(13)!=0,step,start,stop);
     float expansion=F((double)7.142899990081787f*extra/p.Scale);
     if(extra>0){
      // A wrapped arc keeps only the initial expanded vertex in SCORE's
      // DAT outline pass. The primary arc still crosses zero normally.
      int outlineEnd=stop>360?start:stop;
      points.AddRange(dat.ShapeCircle(p.Scale,p.Prepared.X,p.Prepared.Y,F((double)i.P(6)+expansion),F((double)h+expansion),false,step,start,outlineEnd));
     }
    }else{
     float factor=F((double)p.Scale*3.5),dx=F((double)factor*i.P(6)),dy=F((double)factor*h),shear=(short)(int)i.P(10)!=0?F((double)p.Scale*i.P(10)*7):0;

     points=new List<PrimitiveTextPoint>();
     for(int n=0;n<=(extra>0?1:0);n++){
      float delta=25*extra*n;
      var outline=Box(F((double)left-delta),F((double)bottom-delta),F((double)right+delta),F((double)top+delta),i.P(13)!=0);
      for(int k=2;k<4;k++){var q=outline[k];q.X=F((double)q.X+shear);outline[k]=q;}
      points.AddRange(outline);
     }
    }
    if((short)(int)i.P(9)!=0){for(int n=0;n<points.Count;n++){var q=points[n];q.X=NativeNotationContext.Word(q.X,true);q.Y=NativeNotationContext.Word(q.Y,false);points[n]=q;}NativeDatLines.Rotate(points,i.P(9),p.Prepared.X,p.Prepared.Y);}return points;}

   if(i.Code==15){i=IncludedPostScriptDisplay.WorkingItem(i);if(i.P(13)!=0&&!i.ExternalDrawingResetResolved)throw new NotSupportedException("DAT included-PS rotation/reset controls need verification.");
    if(i.P(11)==-9999){float h=i.P(5)==0?1:i.P(5),v=i.P(6)==0?h:i.P(6),factor=F((double)p.Scale/.44999998807907104),right=F(((double)i.P(9)-i.P(7))*h*factor+p.Prepared.X),top=F(((double)i.P(10)-i.P(8))*factor*v+p.Prepared.Y),left=p.Prepared.X,bottom=p.Prepared.Y;var points=new List<PrimitiveTextPoint>{new PrimitiveTextPoint{X=left,Y=bottom,Operation=1},new PrimitiveTextPoint{X=left,Y=top},new PrimitiveTextPoint{X=right,Y=top},new PrimitiveTextPoint{X=right,Y=bottom},new PrimitiveTextPoint{X=left,Y=bottom},new PrimitiveTextPoint{X=right,Y=top},new PrimitiveTextPoint{X=left,Y=top,Operation=1},new PrimitiveTextPoint{X=right,Y=bottom}};if((short)(int)i.P(12)!=0){for(int n=0;n<points.Count;n++){var q=points[n];q.X=NativeNotationContext.Word(q.X,true);q.Y=NativeNotationContext.Word(q.Y,false);points[n]=q;}NativeDatLines.Rotate(points,i.P(12),p.Prepared.X,p.Prepared.Y);}return points;}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.IO;using System.Collections.Generic;

 public sealed partial class ScoreText {

  internal void ResetDatMetricVerification(){if(verificationDatBackup!=null){textDat=verificationDatBackup;verificationDatBackup=null;}}
  int DatMetricFace(int face){if(face>=90)return face;RequireMetricFace(face);return face;}
  bool TryDatScreenMetric(int face,int code,out float metric){
   metric=0;Face data;if(faces.TryGetValue(face,out data)){if(code<0||code>=data.Widths.Length)return false;metric=ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments.TextMetricArithmetic.Normalize(data.Widths[code],638);return true;}
   // Isolated original screen-bank measurements are required for every
   // unsupplied face admitted here; this never supplies a Type1 font.
   return face==-1&&((code>=0&&code<=76)||code==94);
  }
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Drawing;using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativeEditCursorPosition {
  // Recovered object cursor paths in original 1E75:054C..070E.
  // Cursor pitch is an integer control with its own type/rest offset table;
  // graphics coordinates retain their independent fractional controls.
  static readonly short[] TypeOffsets={1,-1,0,0,-1,0,0,-1,2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,0,-1,-1,4,3};
  static readonly short[] RestOffsets={5,5,7,8,7,4,4,2,2,1,1,1,1};
  static short Word(float value){long n;if(!FiniteBinary32Integer64.TryConvert(BitConverter.ToUInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(value),0),out n))throw new NotSupportedException("Cursor parameter outside the recovered finite conversion range.");return unchecked((short)n);}
  static short Pixel(double value){if(Double.IsNaN(value)||Double.IsInfinity(value)||value<Int32.MinValue||value>Int32.MaxValue)throw new NotSupportedException("Cursor projection outside the recovered signed-integer range.");return unchecked((short)(int)value);}
  public static Point Get(Item item,NativeNotationContext page,short dx,short dy,short originX,short originY){
   if(item.Code>=1&&item.Code<=18){
    short pitch=Word(item.P(4)),offset=TypeOffsets[item.Code],xoffset=0;
    if(item.Code<=3||item.Code==6)pitch=(short)(pitch%100);
    short head=Word(item.P(6)),extension=Word(item.P(8));if(item.Code==1&&head<=-4&&extension>0)pitch=unchecked((short)((-(head%10)-extension)*2+3));
    if(item.Code==2){int rest=Word(item.P(5));if(rest< -5||rest>7)rest=-5;offset=RestOffsets[rest+5];}
    else if(item.Code==14){pitch=3;offset=0;}
    else if(item.Code==6){if(Word(Math.Abs(item.P(7)))>=20)offset=-7;else{offset=6;xoffset=2;}}
    else if(item.Code==5){if(extension==-1)xoffset=1;else if(extension==-2)xoffset=3;}
    else if(item.Code==8){pitch=2;offset=0;}
    short control=unchecked((short)(pitch+offset));float rawY=(float)((double)page.Scale*control*7+page.RawBase);
    return new Point(Pixel(((double)item.P(3)+xoffset)*150/dx+originX),Pixel((double)originY-(double)rawY/dy));
   }
   return new Point(unchecked((short)(NativeNotationContext.Word(page.Prepared.X,true)/dx+originX)),unchecked((short)(-NativeNotationContext.Word(page.Prepared.Y,false)/dy+originY)));
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
  // Publish only a finished page. A failed render must leave an existing EPS intact.
  static void WritePage(Canvas canvas,Graphics g,string file){
   string destination=System.IO.Path.GetFullPath(file);
   string directory=System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(destination);
   string temporary=System.IO.Path.Combine(directory,".score-"+Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")+".tmp");
   try{
    var active=NativePrintJob.Active;
    var geometry=active??new NativePrintJob{Freeze=true};
    string box="0 0 612 792",boundsWarning=null;
    try{box=(geometry.ResolvedExtents??NativePrintMinimum.Extents(canvas)).DscBox(geometry);}
    catch(NotSupportedException error){boundsWarning="SCORE bounding scan unavailable. Page bounds used. "+error.Message;}
    canvas.PageDocument.DatBarlineUnit=NativePrintContext.ExportGeometryUnit;
    bool exited=false;
    using(var eps=new NativeEpsExport(g,temporary,canvas.PageWidth,canvas.PageHeight,box,boundsWarning,canvas.Score)){
     try{canvas.Draw(g,false);}
     catch(NativePrintFinishException){}
     catch(NativePrintExitException){eps.Abort();exited=true;}
     catch{eps.Abort();throw;}
    }
    if(exited&&!NativePrintBehaviour.RetainIncomplete)throw new NativePrintExitException();
    if(File.Exists(destination))File.Replace(temporary,destination,null);
    else File.Move(temporary,destination);
    if(exited)throw new NativePrintExitException();
   }finally{File.Delete(temporary);}
  }
  public static void Write(Canvas canvas,string root,string file){
   using(var bitmap=new Bitmap(1,1))using(var g=Graphics.FromImage(bitmap)){
    canvas.LayoutScore();
    if(canvas.PageDocument.Issues.Count!=0)throw new NotSupportedException(String.Join("\r\n",canvas.PageDocument.Issues.ToArray()));
    using(NativePrintContext.Begin(root))WritePage(canvas,g,file);
   }
  }
  public static int Run(string[] args){try{if(args.Length<4)throw new ArgumentException("--export-eps SCORE_ROOT MUS_FILE OUTPUT_EPS");NativePrintJob job=NativePrintJob.Defaults(args[1]);foreach(string arg in args)if(arg.StartsWith("--print-settings="))job=NativePrintJob.Read(arg.Substring(17),job);var score=Score.Load(args[2]);using(var canvas=new Canvas())using(var bitmap=new Bitmap(1,1))using(var g=Graphics.FromImage(bitmap)){canvas.Library=new DrawingLibrary(args[1]);canvas.TextLayout=new ScoreText(args[1]);canvas.Score=score;canvas.Scor4Interface=NativeLibraryLocation.IsScor4(args[1]);canvas.LayoutScore();if(canvas.PageDocument.Issues.Count!=0)throw new NotSupportedException(String.Join("; ",canvas.PageDocument.Issues.ToArray()));if(job!=null)job.Resolve(canvas);using(var jobScope=job==null?null:job.Begin())using(NativePrintContext.Begin(args[1])){WritePage(canvas,g,args[3]);Console.WriteLine("PASS vector EPS.");}}return 0;}catch(Exception e){Console.Error.WriteLine(e);return 1;}}
 }
 public static class NativeVectorDrawing {
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Drawing;using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed class NativeHairpinPlan {public List<BarlinePoint> Points=new List<BarlinePoint>();public short WidthSelector;public float Width;}
 public static class NativeHairpins {
  static float F(double x){return (float)x;}
  // Relative 04ED:0009..008F, 01B3..026D, 04F2..056B.
  // Printed P9 rotation uses the same buffered point transform as the DOS screen path.
  internal static void ValidateTrims(Item item){if(NativeSlurDisplay.RejectInvalidTrims&&(item.P(14)<0||item.P(14)>1||item.P(15)<0||item.P(15)>1||item.P(14)!=0&&item.P(15)!=0&&item.P(14)>item.P(15)))throw new NotSupportedException("Hairpin trim range is reversed or outside0-1. The original trim-behaviour option retains its measured extrapolated geometry.");}
  internal static bool SupportedAuxiliary(Item item){
   // Original SCOR4 AUX0/AUX1: P8 is unused for hairpins (tested 0, +/-.4, 1, 5, 99).
   foreach(int n in new[]{11,12,19,20})if(item.P(n)!=0)return false;
   return item.P(16)==1||item.P(16)==0&&item.P(17)==0&&item.P(18)==0;
  }
  public static NativeHairpinPlan Prepare(Item i,NativeNotationContext p){
   if(p==null||i.Code!=4||Single.IsNaN(i.P(5))||i.P(5)<999||i.P(5)>32767||i.P(7)<-32767||i.P(7)>32767||Single.IsNaN(i.P(7))||i.P(10)<-32767||i.P(10)>32767||Single.IsNaN(i.P(10))||Single.IsNaN(i.P(6))||Single.IsInfinity(i.P(6)))return null;
   if(!SupportedAuxiliary(i))return null;
   if(Single.IsNaN(i.P(9))||Math.Abs(i.P(9))>32767||Single.IsNaN(i.P(13))||Math.Abs(i.P(13))>32767)return null;
   ValidateTrims(i);
   short selector=(short)((int)i.P(7)==-1?0:(int)i.P(10));var result=new NativeHairpinPlan{WidthSelector=selector,Width=NativePrintContext.Width((short)(selector*2))};foreach(var point in NativeDatLines.Hairpin(i,p))result.Points.Add(new BarlinePoint(point.X,point.Y,point.Operation));return result;
  }
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item i,NativeNotationContext p){var plan=Prepare(i,p);if(plan==null)return false;NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,p,plan.Points,plan.Width);if(plan.WidthSelector!=0)NativePrintContext.RestoreDefaultLineWidth();return true;}
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativeJustDialog : ScoreDialog {
  readonly string root;
  readonly bool scor4;
  readonly ListBox inputs=new ListBox{Dock=DockStyle.Fill,IntegralHeight=false,HorizontalScrollbar=true};
  readonly Label status=new Label{AutoSize=true,Text="Select one or more SCORE files."};
  readonly ComboBox operation=new ComboBox{DropDownStyle=ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList,Width=245};
  readonly NumericUpDown height=new NumericUpDown{DecimalPlaces=3,Minimum=.001m,Maximum=999,Value=1,Width=78,Enabled=false};
  readonly FlowLayoutPanel limits=new FlowLayoutPanel{AutoSize=true,Dock=DockStyle.Fill,Visible=false};
  readonly CheckBox customLimits=new CheckBox{Text="Set horizontal limits",AutoSize=true};
  readonly NumericUpDown left=new NumericUpDown{DecimalPlaces=6,Minimum=-200,Maximum=300,Width=100,Enabled=false};
  readonly NumericUpDown right=new NumericUpDown{DecimalPlaces=6,Minimum=-200,Maximum=300,Value=200,Width=100,Enabled=false};

  internal NativeJustDialog(string root,bool scor4=false){
   this.root=root;this.scor4=scor4;
   Text=scor4?"JUST4":"JUST";StartPosition=FormStartPosition.CenterParent;ClientSize=new Size(650,330);MinimumSize=new Size(480,245);
   var panel=new TableLayoutPanel{Dock=DockStyle.Fill,ColumnCount=1,RowCount=4,Padding=new Padding(12)};
   panel.RowStyles.Add(new RowStyle(SizeType.AutoSize));
   panel.RowStyles.Add(new RowStyle(SizeType.Percent,100));
   panel.RowStyles.Add(new RowStyle(SizeType.AutoSize));
   panel.RowStyles.Add(new RowStyle(SizeType.AutoSize));
   var actions=new FlowLayoutPanel{AutoSize=true,Dock=DockStyle.Fill};
   var heightLabel=new Label{Text="New height (file units)",AutoSize=true,Visible=false};
   var choose=new Button{Text="Open scores...",AutoSize=true};
   var numbered=new Button{Text="Open numbered series...",AutoSize=true};
   operation.Items.AddRange(new object[]{"Line up (L)","Height (H)","Justify (J)","Line up and justify (JL)",
    "Justify and height (JH)","Line up and height (LH)","Line up, justify and height (JLH)"});
   operation.SelectedIndex=0;
   operation.SelectedIndexChanged+=(sender,args)=>{
    height.Enabled=operation.SelectedIndex==1||operation.SelectedIndex>=4;
    height.Visible=heightLabel.Visible=height.Enabled;
    limits.Visible=operation.SelectedIndex==2||operation.SelectedIndex==4||
     operation.SelectedIndex==3||operation.SelectedIndex==6;
   };
   limits.Controls.AddRange(new Control[]{customLimits,new Label{Text="Left",AutoSize=true},left,new Label{Text="Right",AutoSize=true},right});
   customLimits.CheckedChanged+=(sender,args)=>left.Enabled=right.Enabled=customLimits.Checked;
   var layout=new Button{Text="Apply and save...",AutoSize=true,Enabled=false};
   var close=new Button{Text="Close",AutoSize=true};
   height.Visible=false;
   actions.Controls.AddRange(new Control[]{choose,numbered,operation,heightLabel,height,layout,close});
   panel.Controls.Add(status,0,0);panel.Controls.Add(inputs,0,1);panel.Controls.Add(limits,0,2);panel.Controls.Add(actions,0,3);
   Controls.Add(panel);
   close.Click+=(sender,args)=>Close();
   choose.Click+=(sender,args)=>{
    using(var dialog=new OpenFileDialog{Filter="SCORE files (*.mus;*.pag)|*.mus;*.pag|All files (*.*)|*.*",Multiselect=true,RestoreDirectory=true}){
     if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
     SetInputs(dialog.FileNames,layout);
    }
   };
   numbered.Click+=(sender,args)=>ChooseNumbered(layout);
   layout.Click+=(sender,args)=>{
    try{SaveLayout();}
    catch(Exception error){
     if(!(error is IOException||error is InvalidDataException||error is NotSupportedException||
      error is UnauthorizedAccessException||error is ArgumentException||error is InvalidOperationException))throw;
     MessageBox.Show(this,error.Message,Text,MessageBoxButtons.OK,MessageBoxIcon.Error);
    }
   };
  }

  void SetInputs(string[] files,Button apply){
   inputs.Items.Clear();inputs.Items.AddRange(files.Cast<object>().ToArray());
   apply.Enabled=inputs.Items.Count!=0;
   status.Text=inputs.Items.Count+" selected";
  }

  void ChooseNumbered(Button apply){
   using(var file=new OpenFileDialog{Filter="SCORE files (*.mus;*.pag)|*.mus;*.pag|All files (*.*)|*.*",
    Title="Choose the first input file",RestoreDirectory=true}){
    if(file.ShowDialog(this)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
    using(var dialog=new ScoreDialog("JUST-series"){Text="Numbered input series",ClientSize=new Size(330,85),
     StartPosition=FormStartPosition.CenterParent}){
     var row=new FlowLayoutPanel{Dock=DockStyle.Fill,Padding=new Padding(12)};
     var count=new NumericUpDown{Minimum=1,Maximum=100,Value=2};
     var open=new Button{Text="Open",AutoSize=true,DialogResult=DialogResult.OK};
     row.Controls.AddRange(new Control[]{new Label{Text="Number of files",AutoSize=true},count,open});
     dialog.Controls.Add(row);dialog.AcceptButton=open;
     if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
     try{
      var files=NativePageFilenameSequence.OriginalNames(file.FileName,(int)count.Value);
      var missing=files.FirstOrDefault(path=>!File.Exists(path));
      if(missing!=null)throw new FileNotFoundException("File not found: "+missing);
      SetInputs(files,apply);
     }catch(Exception error){
      if(!(error is IOException||error is NotSupportedException||error is ArgumentException||
       error is InvalidOperationException))throw;
      MessageBox.Show(this,error.Message,Text,MessageBoxButtons.OK,MessageBoxIcon.Error);
     }
    }
   }
  }

  void SaveLayout(){
   string[] source=inputs.Items.Cast<string>().ToArray();
   if(source.Length==0)return;
   bool adjustHeight=height.Enabled;
   bool justify=operation.SelectedIndex==2||operation.SelectedIndex==4;
   bool combined=operation.SelectedIndex==3||operation.SelectedIndex==6;
   bool lineUp=operation.SelectedIndex==0||operation.SelectedIndex==5;
   var destinations=new List<string>();
    using(var dialog=new SaveFileDialog{Filter="SCORE files (*.mus;*.pag)|*.mus;*.pag|All files (*.*)|*.*",
     DefaultExt=Path.GetExtension(source[0]).TrimStart('.'),InitialDirectory=NativeOutputLocation.Folder(root),
     Title=source.Length==1?"Save JUST output":"Choose the first output filename",
     FileName=source.Length==1?Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(source[0])+"-JUST"+Path.GetExtension(source[0]):
      "JUST1"+Path.GetExtension(source[0]),RestoreDirectory=true,OverwritePrompt=source.Length==1}){
     if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
     if(source.Length==1)destinations.Add(dialog.FileName);
     else destinations.AddRange(NativePageFilenameSequence.OriginalNames(dialog.FileName,source.Length));
    }
   if(destinations.Intersect(source,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Any())
    throw new IOException("Choose a different destination to preserve the input files.");
   if(source.Length>1&&destinations.Any(File.Exists)&&MessageBox.Show(this,"Replace the existing output files?",Text,
    MessageBoxButtons.YesNo,MessageBoxIcon.Question,MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button2)!=DialogResult.Yes)return;
   var scores=source.Select(Score.Load).ToArray();
   var notices=new List<string>();
   if(justify||combined||lineUp)
    scores=NativeJustLayout.ApplyHorizontalBatchWithMessages(scores,lineUp||combined,justify||combined,
     (justify||combined)&&customLimits.Checked?(float?)left.Value:null,
     (justify||combined)&&customLimits.Checked?(float?)right.Value:null,
     notices.Add,scor4);
   if(adjustHeight)scores=NativeJustLayout.AdjustHeightBatch(scores,(float)height.Value);
   var results=scores.Select((score,index)=>NativeJustLayout.EncodeOutput(score,index!=0)).ToArray();
   int written=0;
   try{
    for(;written<results.Length;written++)ScoreFileStorage.Write(destinations[written],results[written]);
   }finally{
    status.Text=String.Join(Environment.NewLine,new[]{"Saved "+written+" of "+results.Length+" files."}.Concat(notices));
   }
  }
 }

 public sealed partial class Editor {
  void ShowNativeJust(){using(var dialog=new NativeJustDialog(source,scor4Interface){Icon=Icon})dialog.ShowDialog(this);}
  void ShowNativeDraw(){using(var dialog=new NativeDrawDialog(NativeLibraryLocation.DirectoryFor(source,true)){Icon=Icon})dialog.ShowDialog(this);}
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal static class NativeJustLayout {
  const short StaffLimit=98;

  internal static byte[] EncodeOutput(Score source,bool framed){
   var output=source.Clone();
   if(source.Trailer.Length==24){
    output.Trailer=new byte[20];
    Buffer.BlockCopy(source.Trailer,0,output.Trailer,0,4);
    Buffer.BlockCopy(source.Trailer,8,output.Trailer,4,16);
   }
   BitConverter.GetBytes(4f).CopyTo(output.Trailer,12);
   if(framed&&output.Items.Count>0)
    BitConverter.GetBytes((float)output.Items[0].Count).CopyTo(output.Trailer,0);
   var bytes=output.Encode();
   return framed?FortranRecords.Write(bytes):bytes;
  }

  internal static Score AdjustHeight(Score source,float height){
   return AdjustHeightBatch(new[]{source},height)[0];
  }

  internal static Score[] AdjustHeightBatch(IList<Score> scores,float height){
   if(scores.Count==0)throw new ArgumentException("Choose scores for height adjustment.");
   if(!(height>0)||Single.IsInfinity(height))throw new ArgumentException("Enter a finite positive height.");
   short units=NativeMeasurements.Get(scores[0]);
   float total=0;
   for(int index=scores.Count-1;index>=0;index--){
    if(NativeMeasurements.Get(scores[index])!=units)
     throw new NotSupportedException("The files in a JUST height job must use the same measurement units.");
    total=(float)((double)total+HeightGuide(scores[index]).P(8));
   }
   float ratio=(float)((double)height/total);
   if(!(ratio>0)||Single.IsInfinity(ratio))throw new NotSupportedException("The height ratio is outside the finite range.");
   return scores.Select(score=>ScaleHeight(score,ratio)).ToArray();
  }

  static Item HeightGuide(Score source){
   var staves=source.Items.Where(item=>item.Code==8).ToArray();
   if(staves.GroupBy(item=>item.Staff).Any(group=>group.Count()>1))
    throw new NotSupportedException("JUST needs one staff definition per staff in this file.");
   var first=staves.FirstOrDefault(item=>item.Staff==1);
   if(first==null||!(first.P(8)>0)||Single.IsInfinity(first.P(8)))
    throw new NotSupportedException("JUST needs the current height in staff 1 parameter 8.");
   return first;
  }

  static Score ScaleHeight(Score source,float ratio){
   var result=source.Clone();
   var staves=result.Items.Where(item=>item.Code==8).OrderBy(item=>item.Staff).ToArray();
   if(staves.Any(staff=>staff.Staff<1||staff.Staff>StaffLimit||Single.IsNaN(staff.P(4))||
    Single.IsInfinity(staff.P(4))||!(staff.P(5)>=0)||Single.IsInfinity(staff.P(5))))
    throw new NotSupportedException("This staff position or size leaves the verified JUST height domain.");
   int index=0;
   // H uses the local 32-entry staff table, even when J or L uses higher
   // staves. A gap in that table points forward to the next staff record.
   for(int position=1;position<=32&&index<staves.Length;position++){
    while(index<staves.Length&&staves[index].Staff<position)index++;
    if(index==staves.Length||staves[index].Staff>32)break;
    var staff=staves[index];
    double size=staff.P(5)==0?1:staff.P(5);
    double nominal=18.0*(position-1)/size;
    staff.Set(4,(float)(((double)staff.P(4)+nominal)*ratio-nominal));
    if(position==1)staff.Set(8,(float)((double)staff.P(8)*ratio));
   }
   var rows=result.Items.Select(item=>Enumerable.Range(1,item.Count).Select(item.P).ToArray()).ToList();
   result.Items=InputTranspositionOrder.OrderForMain(rows,false).Select(itemIndex=>result.Items[itemIndex]).ToList();
   return result;
  }

  internal static Score LineUp(Score source){
   return ApplyHorizontal(source,true);
  }

  internal static Score Justify(Score source){
   return Justify(source,null,null);
  }

  internal static Score Justify(Score source,float? left,float? right){
   return ApplyHorizontal(source,false,left,right);
  }

  internal static Score LineUpAndJustify(Score source){
   return ApplyHorizontal(source,true,justifyAfterLineup:true);
  }

  internal static Score[] ApplyHorizontalBatch(IList<Score> scores,bool lineup,bool justify,float? left,float? right){
   return ApplyHorizontalBatchWithMessages(scores,lineup,justify,left,right,null);
  }

  internal static Score[] ApplyHorizontalBatchWithMessages(IList<Score> scores,bool lineup,bool justify,
   float? left,float? right,Action<string> report,bool scor4=false){
   if(scores.Count==0)throw new ArgumentException("Choose scores for horizontal layout.");
   var combined=scores[0].Clone();
   combined.Items.Clear();
   var offsets=new int[scores.Count+1];
   for(int index=0;index<scores.Count;index++){
    var score=scores[index];
    if(score.Items.Count==0)throw new InvalidDataException("A JUST input contains no items.");
    if(NativeMeasurements.Get(score)!=NativeMeasurements.Get(combined))
     throw new NotSupportedException("The files in a JUST layout job must use the same measurement units.");
    int top=score.Items.Max(item=>item.Staff);
    if(top<1||top>StaffLimit-offsets[index]||score.Items.Any(item=>item.Staff<1))
     throw new NotSupportedException("This JUST job exceeds the supported combined staff range of 1–98.");
    offsets[index+1]=offsets[index]+top;
    foreach(var original in score.Items){
     var item=original.Clone();
     if(offsets[index]!=0)item.Set(2,item.P(2)+offsets[index]);
     combined.Items.Add(item);
    }
   }
   combined=ApplyHorizontal(combined,lineup,left,right,lineup&&justify,report,scor4);
   var result=new Score[scores.Count];
   for(int index=0;index<scores.Count;index++){
    result[index]=scores[index].Clone();
    result[index].Items=combined.Items.Where(item=>item.Staff>offsets[index]&&item.Staff<=offsets[index+1]).ToList();
    if(offsets[index]!=0)
     foreach(var item in result[index].Items)item.Set(2,item.P(2)-offsets[index]);
   }
   return result;
  }

  static Score ApplyHorizontal(Score source,bool lineup,float? left=null,float? right=null,bool justifyAfterLineup=false,
   Action<string> report=null,bool scor4=false){
   if(source.Items.Count==0)throw new InvalidDataException("The input score contains no items.");
   if(source.Items.Count>9999)throw new InvalidDataException("The job exceeds JUST's 9,999-item capacity.");
   short bottom=checked((short)source.Items.Min(item=>item.Staff));
   short top=checked((short)source.Items.Max(item=>item.Staff));
   if(bottom<1||top>StaffLimit)throw new NotSupportedException("This JUST job exceeds the supported staff range of 1–98.");
   if(source.Items.Where(item=>item.Code==8).GroupBy(item=>item.Staff).Any(group=>group.Count()>1))
    throw new NotSupportedException("JUST needs one staff definition per staff in this file.");
   var rows=source.Items.Select(item=>Enumerable.Range(1,item.Count).Select(item.P).ToArray()).ToList();
   var order=InputTranspositionOrder.OrderForMain(rows,false);
   var words=new float[32000];
   var starts=new int[rows.Count];
   int position=0;
   for(int index=0;index<order.Length;index++){
    var item=source.Items[order[index]];
    if(position+item.Count+1>words.Length)throw new InvalidDataException("The score exceeds the JUST parameter capacity.");
    starts[index]=position+1;
    Buffer.BlockCopy(item.Bytes,0,words,position*4,item.Bytes.Length);
    position+=item.Count+1;
   }
   if(position+source.Trailer.Length/4<=words.Length)
    Buffer.BlockCopy(source.Trailer,0,words,position*4,source.Trailer.Length);
   var scales=Enumerable.Repeat(25f,StaffLimit+1).ToArray();
   foreach(var item in source.Items.Where(item=>item.Code==8)){
    float size=item.P(5);
    scales[item.Staff]=(float)((size==0?1.0:size)*25);
   }
   if(lineup){
    var lined=LayoutLineupSystem.ApplyWithBeatPolicy(words,starts,bottom,top,scales,
     BitConverter.ToSingle(BitConverter.GetBytes(0x3f15c01au),0),StaffLimit,2800,
     new LayoutLineupWorkspace{MaximumStaff=StaffLimit,StandaloneJust=true,Scor4DurationScale=scor4},true);
    if(lined.Bottom<0)throw new NotSupportedException("The score has no rhythmic streams to line up.");
    if(lined.UnequalBeats&&report!=null)report("JUST stopped lining up at staff "+lined.BeatTotals.Last().Staff+
     " because its beat total differs.");
    bottom=lined.Bottom;top=lined.Top;
    if(!lined.UnequalBeats){left=lined.Left;right=lined.Right;}
   }
   if(!lineup||justifyAfterLineup){
    var bars=source.Items.Where(item=>item.Code==14&&item.Staff==bottom).ToArray();
    float low=left??(bars.Length==0?-999:bars.Min(item=>item.P(3)));
    float high=right??(bars.Length==0?-999:bars.Max(item=>item.P(3)));
    if(low!=high||left.HasValue||right.HasValue){
     if(!(low<high))throw new ArgumentException("The right limit must be greater than the left limit.");
     var justified=LayoutJustificationSystem.Apply(words,starts,bottom,top,low,high,scales,new float[4],StaffLimit,2800,
      new LayoutJustificationWorkspace{Scor4NumberJustification=scor4,StandaloneJust=true,PositionJoinTolerance=.1f,
       OriginalQuarterToneWidths=NativeEditCompatibility.OriginalQuarterToneWidths});
     if(justified.Gaps.CompressedMinimums&&report!=null)report("JUST reduced minimum spacing from "+
      justified.Gaps.MinimumTotal.ToString("0.000")+" to fit "+justified.Gaps.Width.ToString("0.000")+".");
    }
   }
   var result=source.Clone();
   result.Items.Clear();
   for(int index=0;index<starts.Length;index++){
    int length=source.Items[order[index]].Bytes.Length;
    var bytes=new byte[length];
    Buffer.BlockCopy(words,(starts[index]-1)*4,bytes,0,length);
    result.Items.Add(new Item(bytes));
   }
   return result;
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Drawing;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativeKeySignatures {
  static float F(double x){return (float)x;}
  // Key signature path, relative 0B0D:0008..033A.
  public static List<PrimitiveGlyphRequest> Prepare(Item i,NativeNotationContext page){
   if(page==null||i.Code!=17||Single.IsNaN(i.P(5))||Single.IsInfinity(i.P(5))||Math.Abs(i.P(5))>32767||Single.IsNaN(i.P(6))||Single.IsInfinity(i.P(6))||Math.Abs(i.P(6))>32767)return null;
   for(int j=17;j<=20;j++)if(i.P(j)!=0)return null;if(i.P(14)!=0&&i.P(14)!=1)return null;if(Single.IsNaN(i.P(15))||Single.IsInfinity(i.P(15))||Math.Abs(i.P(15))>32767)return null;
   int signed=(int)i.P(5),count=Math.Abs(signed),clef=(int)i.P(6),glyph=signed<0?6:7;
   if(count>=100){glyph=8;count%=100;}count=Math.Max(1,count);
   float origin=F((double)page.Prepared.X+i.P(15)*150),scale=page.Scale,x=F(scale*15.0+origin),gap=F(scale*16.799999237060547),size=1;
   if(i.P(7)!=0)gap=F(i.P(7)*(double)gap);
   if(clef>=100){size=.800000011920929f;gap=F(size*(double)gap);clef-=100;}
   if(i.P(8)!=0){
    var explicitKey=new List<PrimitiveGlyphRequest>();
    foreach(int field in new[]{8,9,10,11,12,13,16}){
     float value=i.P(field);
     if(value==0)break;
     if(value!=(int)value||value<100||value>399)return null;
     int word=(int)value;
     explicitKey.Add(new PrimitiveGlyphRequest{Glyph=word/100+5,X=x,Y=F((word%100*7)*(double)scale+page.Prepared.Y),Horizontal=size,Vertical=size});
     x=F((double)x+gap);
    }
    return explicitKey;
   }
   if(i.P(5)<-107||i.P(5)>107||i.P(5)!=(int)i.P(5)||count>7||clef<0||clef>3)return null;
   for(int field=9;field<=13;field++)if(i.P(field)!=0)return null;
   if(i.P(16)!=0)return null;
   float[] flats={49,35,42,56},sharps={77,63,70,35};
   float y=F((signed<0?flats[clef]:sharps[clef])*(double)scale+page.Prepared.Y),threshold=F((clef==0?84.5:clef==1?70.5:77.5)*scale+page.Prepared.Y),span=F(scale*49.0),signedScale=signed<0?-scale:scale,up=F(signedScale*28.0),down=F(-signedScale*21.0);
   int direction=signed>=0&&clef==3?1:-1;var result=new List<PrimitiveGlyphRequest>();
   for(int j=0;j<count;j++){result.Add(new PrimitiveGlyphRequest{Glyph=glyph,X=x,Y=y,Horizontal=size,Vertical=size,WidthSelector=0});direction=-direction;x=F((double)x+gap);y=F((double)y+(direction>=0?down:up));if(y>threshold){y=F((double)y-span);direction=-direction;}}
   return result;
  }
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item i,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library,HashSet<int> cache){var plan=Prepare(i,page);if(plan==null)return false;foreach(var r in plan){Glyph glyph;if(library==null||!library.Symbols.TryGetValue(r.Glyph,out glyph))return false;}// Cached calls print immediately. The original flushes the expanded paths after the key.
   using(var buffer=NativePrintedPointBuffer.Begin(g)){if(cache!=null)foreach(var r in plan)if(cache.Contains(r.Glyph)&&!NativePrimitiveGlyphs.Draw(g,page,library,cache,r))return false;
   foreach(var r in plan)if((cache==null||!cache.Contains(r.Glyph))&&!NativePrimitiveGlyphs.Draw(g,page,library,null,r))return false;buffer.Complete();return true;}}
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Linq;using System.IO;using System.Text;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Windows.Forms;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativeLibraryLocation {
  public sealed class Selection {public string Folder;public bool All;}
  static readonly Dictionary<string,int> revisions=new Dictionary<string,int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
  static readonly Dictionary<string,Selection> choices=new Dictionary<string,Selection>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
  static readonly Dictionary<string,Selection> scor4Choices=new Dictionary<string,Selection>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
  static readonly HashSet<string> scor4Roots=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
  static string Key(string root){string full=Path.GetFullPath(root);return full.Length==Path.GetPathRoot(full).Length?full:full.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar,Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar);}
  static string Settings{get{return "library";}}
  public static int RevisionFor(string root){int value;revisions.TryGetValue(Key(root),out value);return value;}
  internal static bool IsScor4(string root){return scor4Roots.Contains(Key(root));}
  static void AdvanceRevision(string root){string key=Key(root);revisions[key]=RevisionFor(root)+1;}
  internal static void SetProfile(string root,bool scor4){
   if(scor4?scor4Roots.Add(Key(root)):scor4Roots.Remove(Key(root)))AdvanceRevision(root);
  }
  internal static Selection GetSelection(string root,bool scor4){
   Selection found;
   return (scor4?scor4Choices:choices).TryGetValue(Key(root),out found)?found:null;
  }
  internal static bool HasScor4Resources(string root){
   var value=IsScor4(root)?GetSelection(root,true):null;
   return value!=null&&value.All;
  }
  public static Selection Get(string root){return (IsScor4(root)?GetSelection(root,true):null)??GetSelection(root,false);}
  internal static void SetSelection(string root,bool scor4,string folder,bool all){
   var selections=scor4?scor4Choices:choices;
   string key=Key(root);
   if(String.IsNullOrEmpty(folder))selections.Remove(key);
   else selections[key]=new Selection{Folder=Path.GetFullPath(folder),All=all};
   AdvanceRevision(root);
  }
  public static void Set(string root,string folder,bool all){SetSelection(root,IsScor4(root),folder,all);}
  public static string DirectoryFor(string root,bool drawing){var value=Get(root);return value!=null&&(drawing||value.All)?value.Folder:NativePreferences.ResourceDirectory(root,"LIBRARY","LIB");}
  public static string FileFor(string root,string name){if(name.Equals("PREF.SCR",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return NativePreferences.SourcePath(root);if(name.Equals("CODE9.DAT",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)||name.Equals("GUITAR.DAT",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){string mapped=NativePreferences.ResourceFile(root,name.StartsWith("CODE9",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)?"CODE9":"GUITAR",name);var selection=Get(root);if(selection!=null&&selection.All){string chosen=Path.Combine(selection.Folder,Path.GetFileName(mapped));if(File.Exists(chosen))return chosen;}return File.Exists(mapped)?mapped:Path.Combine(root,"LIB",name);}if(name.Equals("SCOR3_10.DAT",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return NativeScoreIdentity.Require(root,false).Path;string candidate=Path.Combine(DirectoryFor(root,Path.GetExtension(name).Equals(".DRW",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)),name);return File.Exists(candidate)?candidate:Path.Combine(root,"LIB",name);}
  public static string CacheKey(string root){int revision;revisions.TryGetValue(Key(root),out revision);return DirectoryFor(root,true)+"|"+DirectoryFor(root,false)+"|"+revision;}
  static string SelectionKey(string root,bool scor4=false){return NativeSettings.InstallationKey(scor4?"library-scor4":Settings,root);}
  public static void Save(string root){
   SaveSelection(root,IsScor4(root));
  }
  internal static void SaveSelection(string root,bool scor4){
   var value=GetSelection(root,scor4);
   NativeSettings.WriteAllText(SelectionKey(root,scor4),value==null?"":(value.All?"all":"drawings")+"\n"+value.Folder);
  }
  internal static void LoadScor4(string root){
   string saved=NativeSettings.Read(SelectionKey(root,true));
   int separator=String.IsNullOrEmpty(saved)?-1:saved.IndexOf('\n');
   if(separator>0)SetSelection(root,true,saved.Substring(separator+1),saved.Substring(0,separator)=="all");
  }
  public static void Load(){Load(null);}
  internal static void Load(string startupRoot){
   try{
    string legacy=NativeSettings.Read(Settings);
    string[] lines=(legacy??"").TrimEnd('\r','\n').Split(new[]{"\r\n","\n"},StringSplitOptions.None);
    if(lines.Length>=3&&Directory.Exists(lines[0]))
     NativeSettings.Import(SelectionKey(lines[0]),()=>String.IsNullOrEmpty(lines[1])?"":lines[2]+"\n"+lines[1]);
    if(String.IsNullOrEmpty(startupRoot))startupRoot=lines.Length>=3&&Directory.Exists(lines[0])?lines[0]:null;
    if(String.IsNullOrEmpty(startupRoot))return;
    string saved=NativeSettings.Read(SelectionKey(startupRoot));
    if(saved==null&&lines.Length==2&&Directory.Exists(lines[0])&&(lines[1]=="all"||lines[1]=="drawings")){
     saved=lines[1]+"\n"+lines[0];
     NativeSettings.WriteAllText(SelectionKey(startupRoot),saved);
     NativeSettings.WriteAllText(Settings,null);
    }
    if(String.IsNullOrEmpty(saved))return;
    int separator=saved.IndexOf('\n');
    if(separator>0)SetSelection(startupRoot,false,saved.Substring(separator+1),saved.Substring(0,separator)=="all");
   }catch(IOException){}catch(ArgumentException){}catch(UnauthorizedAccessException){}
  }
 }
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  void InstallResolvedLibrary(bool refreshCaches){
   NativeScoreIdentity.Require(source,!Program.CheckMode);
   NativePreferences.Validate(source);
   string folder=NativeLibraryLocation.DirectoryFor(source,true);
   bool readable=false;
   foreach(string drawing in Directory.GetFiles(folder,"*.DRW")){
    try{if(DrawingLibrary.Load(drawing).Any(g=>g.Points.Length>0)){readable=true;break;}}
    catch(InvalidDataException){}
   }
   if(!readable)throw new InvalidDataException("The selected folder has no readable DRW drawings.");
   var library=new DrawingLibrary(source);
   var text=new ScoreText(source);
   var selection=NativeLibraryLocation.Get(source);
   if(selection!=null&&selection.All){new NativeDatGlyphs(source);OriginalMusSave.Prepare(score??Score.New(),source);}
   if(score!=null)using(var probe=new Canvas()){probe.Score=score;probe.Library=library;probe.TextLayout=text;probe.LayoutScore();}
   canvas.Library=library;canvas.TextLayout=text;
   if(score!=null){
    if(refreshCaches){RefreshTextCaches();RefreshAll(canvas.Selected);}
    else{canvas.LayoutScore();UpdateClassic();}
   }
   canvas.Invalidate();
  }
  void WithLibraryChange(Action change,Action rollback,bool reload,Action save,bool refreshCaches=false){
   var beforePreferences=NativePreferences.Read(source);
   var oldLibrary=canvas.Library;
   var oldText=canvas.TextLayout;
   try{
    change();
    if(reload)InstallResolvedLibrary(refreshCaches);
    if(save!=null)save();
   }catch{
    rollback();
    NativePreferences.Restore(source,beforePreferences);
    canvas.Library=oldLibrary;canvas.TextLayout=oldText;canvas.LayoutScore();
    throw;
   }
  }
  void ApplyLibraryFolder(string folder,bool all,bool save){
   if(!String.IsNullOrEmpty(folder)&&!Directory.Exists(folder))throw new DirectoryNotFoundException("The selected LIB folder does not exist.");
   bool scor4=NativeLibraryLocation.IsScor4(source);
   var before=NativeLibraryLocation.GetSelection(source,scor4);
   WithLibraryChange(
    ()=>{if(save)NativeLibraryLocation.Set(source,folder,all);},
    ()=>{if(save)NativeLibraryLocation.SetSelection(source,scor4,before==null?null:before.Folder,before!=null&&before.All);},
    true,save?(Action)(()=>NativeLibraryLocation.Save(source)):null,true);
   Message("LIB: "+NativeLibraryLocation.DirectoryFor(source,true)+(all?" (all resources, including save serial)":" (drawings only)"));
  }
  void AddLibraryMenu(ContextMenuStrip menu){var group=new ToolStripMenuItem("Library (LIB)");var browse=new ToolStripMenuItem("Browse for LIB folder...");var all=new ToolStripMenuItem("Use selected LIB for all resources");var reset=new ToolStripMenuItem("Use SCORE's default LIB");var dataFile=new ToolStripMenuItem("Choose serial DAT...");browse.Click+=(s,e)=>Safe(()=>{using(var dialog=new FolderBrowserDialog{Description="Choose an external LIB folder (drawings only by default)",SelectedPath=NativeLibraryLocation.DirectoryFor(source,true)})if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)==DialogResult.OK)ApplyLibraryFolder(dialog.SelectedPath,false,true);});all.Click+=(s,e)=>Safe(()=>{var selected=NativeLibraryLocation.Get(source);if(selected!=null)ApplyLibraryFolder(selected.Folder,!selected.All,true);});reset.Click+=(s,e)=>Safe(()=>ApplyLibraryFolder(null,false,true));group.DropDownItems.Add(browse);group.DropDownItems.Add(all);dataFile.Click+=(s,e)=>Safe(()=>{NativeScoreIdentity.Require(source,true,true);var current=NativeLibraryLocation.Get(source);ApplyLibraryFolder(current==null?null:current.Folder,current!=null&&current.All,false);});group.DropDownItems.Add(dataFile);group.DropDownItems.Add(reset);menu.Items.Add(group);menu.Opening+=(s,e)=>{var selected=NativeLibraryLocation.Get(source);all.Checked=selected!=null&&selected.All;all.Enabled=selected!=null;reset.Enabled=selected!=null;group.ToolTipText=NativeLibraryLocation.DirectoryFor(source,true)+(selected!=null&&selected.All?" — all LIB resources":" — drawings only");};}
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativeLibrarySymbolBrowser : ScoreDialog {
  sealed class Bank {
   internal string Path,Error;
   internal int First;
   internal Glyph[] Slots;
  }
  readonly List<Bank> banks=new List<Bank>();
  readonly DataGridView grid=new DataGridView{Dock=DockStyle.Fill,ReadOnly=true,AllowUserToAddRows=false,AllowUserToDeleteRows=false,
   AllowUserToResizeRows=false,RowHeadersVisible=false,MultiSelect=false,SelectionMode=DataGridViewSelectionMode.CellSelect,
   BackgroundColor=SystemColors.Window,ClipboardCopyMode=DataGridViewClipboardCopyMode.Disable};
  readonly ContextMenuStrip actions=new ContextMenuStrip();
  readonly string directory;
  readonly Label caption=new Label{Dock=DockStyle.Top,AutoSize=true,Padding=new Padding(5),AutoEllipsis=true};

  internal NativeLibrarySymbolBrowser(string root):base("library-symbol-browser"){
   directory=NativeLibraryLocation.DirectoryFor(root,true);
   Text="LIB Symbol Browser";StartPosition=FormStartPosition.CenterParent;ClientSize=new Size(1150,650);MinimumSize=new Size(470,300);

   grid.AccessibleName="LIB drawing banks and symbols";
   grid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn{HeaderText="Bank file",Width=145,Frozen=true,SortMode=DataGridViewColumnSortMode.NotSortable});
   for(int i=0;i<10;i++)grid.Columns.Add(new DataGridViewTextBoxColumn{
    HeaderText="Slot "+i.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),Width=190,SortMode=DataGridViewColumnSortMode.NotSortable});
   grid.RowTemplate.Height=190;
   var files=new Dictionary<string,string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
   foreach(var folder in new[]{Path.Combine(root,"LIB"),directory}.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
    if(Directory.Exists(folder))foreach(var path in Directory.EnumerateFiles(folder,"*.drw"))files[Path.GetFileName(path)]=path;
   foreach(var file in files.OrderBy(pair=>pair.Key,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){
    int first;DrawingLibrary.TryFirstSymbol(file.Value,out first);
    var bank=new Bank{Path=file.Value,First=first};Read(bank);
    if(IsEmpty(bank))continue;
    banks.Add(bank);
    int row=grid.Rows.Add();
    FillRow(row);
   }
   UpdateCaption();
   grid.CellPainting+=PaintTile;
   var copy=actions.Items.Add("Copy symbol number",null,(s,e)=>CopyNumber());
   var edit=actions.Items.Add("Edit in DRAW...",null,(s,e)=>EditSymbol());
   actions.Opening+=(s,e)=>{
    int row,slot;var bank=Selected(out row,out slot);
    e.Cancel=bank==null;
    edit.Enabled=bank!=null&&bank.Slots!=null&&bank.Slots[slot].Name.Length!=0;
    copy.Enabled=bank!=null&&bank.First>=0;
   };
   grid.ContextMenuStrip=actions;
   grid.CellMouseDown+=(s,e)=>{
    if(e.Button!=MouseButtons.Right)return;
    grid.CurrentCell=e.RowIndex>=0&&e.ColumnIndex>=0?grid[e.ColumnIndex,e.RowIndex]:null;
   };
   Controls.Add(grid);Controls.Add(caption);
  }

  static bool IsEmpty(Bank bank){
   return bank.Slots!=null&&bank.Slots.All(slot=>slot.Name.Length==0);
  }

  void UpdateCaption(){
   caption.Text=banks.Count==0?directory+" (no drawing symbols found)":directory;
  }

  static void Read(Bank bank){
   bank.Error=null;bank.Slots=null;
   try{bank.Slots=DrawingLibrary.Load(bank.Path);}
   catch(IOException ex){bank.Error=ex.Message;}
   catch(UnauthorizedAccessException ex){bank.Error=ex.Message;}
   catch(InvalidDataException ex){bank.Error=ex.Message;}
  }

  void FillRow(int row){
   var bank=banks[row];var cells=grid.Rows[row].Cells;
   cells[0].Value=Path.GetFileName(bank.Path);
   cells[0].ToolTipText=bank.Error==null?bank.Path:bank.Path+"\r\n"+bank.Error;
   for(int i=0;i<10;i++){
    string name=bank.Slots==null?"Unreadable":bank.Slots[i].Name.Length==0?"Empty":bank.Slots[i].Name;
    cells[i+1].Value=(bank.First<0?"Unnumbered":Number(bank,i))+"\r\n"+name;
    cells[i+1].ToolTipText=(string)cells[i+1].Value;
   }
  }

  static string Number(Bank bank,int slot){return (bank.First+slot).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);}

  void PaintTile(object sender,DataGridViewCellPaintingEventArgs e){
   if(e.RowIndex<0||e.ColumnIndex<1)return;
   var bank=banks[e.RowIndex];
   var glyph=bank.Slots==null?null:bank.Slots[e.ColumnIndex-1];
   e.Paint(e.ClipBounds,DataGridViewPaintParts.All & ~DataGridViewPaintParts.ContentForeground);
   var box=e.CellBounds;
   int line=TextRenderer.MeasureText("Ag",e.CellStyle.Font).Height;
   int pad=Math.Max(4,line/5);
   var art=new Rectangle(box.X+pad,box.Y+pad,box.Width-pad*2,box.Height-line*2-pad*2);
   if(glyph!=null)NativeSymbolPreview.Draw(e.Graphics,glyph,art);
   string[] label=((string)e.FormattedValue??"").Split(new[]{'\r','\n'},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
   var colour=(e.State&DataGridViewElementStates.Selected)!=0?e.CellStyle.SelectionForeColor:e.CellStyle.ForeColor;
   for(int i=0;i<label.Length;i++)TextRenderer.DrawText(e.Graphics,label[i],e.CellStyle.Font,
    new Rectangle(box.X+2,box.Bottom-(label.Length-i)*line-2,box.Width-4,line),colour,
    TextFormatFlags.HorizontalCenter|TextFormatFlags.VerticalCenter|TextFormatFlags.NoPrefix|TextFormatFlags.EndEllipsis);
   e.Handled=true;
  }

  Bank Selected(out int row,out int slot){
   var cell=grid.CurrentCell;row=cell==null?-1:cell.RowIndex;slot=cell==null?-1:cell.ColumnIndex-1;
   return row>=0&&slot>=0?banks[row]:null;
  }

  void CopyNumber(){
   int row,slot;var bank=Selected(out row,out slot);
   if(bank==null||bank.First<0)return;
   try{Clipboard.SetText(Number(bank,slot));}
   catch(System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExternalException ex){MessageBox.Show(this,ex.Message,"Copy symbol number");}
  }

  void EditSymbol(){
   int row,slot;var bank=Selected(out row,out slot);
   if(bank==null||bank.Slots==null||bank.Slots[slot].Name.Length==0)return;
   using(var draw=new NativeDrawDialog(directory){Icon=Icon}){
    draw.OpenBankSlot(bank.Path,bank.Slots,slot);
    draw.ShowDialog(this);
   }
   Read(bank);
   if(IsEmpty(bank)){
    banks.RemoveAt(row);
    grid.Rows.RemoveAt(row);
    UpdateCaption();
   }else{
    FillRow(row);
    grid.InvalidateRow(row);
   }
  }

  protected override void Dispose(bool disposing){if(disposing)actions.Dispose();base.Dispose(disposing);}
 }

 public sealed partial class Editor {
  void ShowLibrarySymbolBrowser(){
   using(var browser=new NativeLibrarySymbolBrowser(source){Icon=Icon})browser.ShowDialog(this);
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
  public static void AddMenu(ContextMenuStrip menu){

  static PointF Pixel(Canvas canvas,PointF point){point=new PointF(point.X/canvas.RenderScale,(point.Y+canvas.CropTop)/canvas.RenderScale);if(NativeNotationView.IsDosViewport)return new PointF(Math.Max(1,Math.Min(638,point.X)),Math.Max(canvas.DosClipTop,Math.Min(479,point.Y+97)));point=new PointF(point.X-canvas.CameraOffset.X-canvas.ScreenOrigin.X,point.Y-canvas.CameraOffset.Y-canvas.ScreenOrigin.Y);var projection=canvas.PageDocument.Projection;var pixel=new PointF((point.X-projection.OffsetX)*30/NativeDosViewport.Divisor+NativeDosViewport.OriginX,NativeDosViewport.OriginY-(projection.OffsetY-point.Y)*30/NativeDosViewport.Divisor);return canvas.UsesOriginalZoomFrame?new PointF(Math.Max(1,Math.Min(638,pixel.X)),Math.Max(97,Math.Min(479,pixel.Y))):pixel;}
  public static PointF Pointer(Canvas canvas,PointF screen){var point=Pixel(canvas,screen);return new PointF(Word(Math.Round(point.X,MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero)),Word(Math.Round(point.Y,MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero)));}
  static PointF ItemPixel(Canvas canvas,Item item){NativeNotationContext context;if(!canvas.PageDocument.Contexts.TryGetValue(item,out context))throw new NotSupportedException("Mouse item has no recovered staff context.");return Continuous(item,context,NativeDosViewport.Divisor,NativeDosViewport.Divisor,NativeDosViewport.OriginX,NativeDosViewport.OriginY,!HighResolution);}
  public static PointF DisplayPoint(Canvas canvas,Item item){var point=ItemPixel(canvas,item);if(NativeNotationView.IsDosViewport)return new PointF(point.X,point.Y-97);return canvas.PageDocument.Projection.Point((point.X-NativeDosViewport.OriginX)*NativeDosViewport.Divisor,(NativeDosViewport.OriginY-point.Y)*NativeDosViewport.Divisor);}
  static PointF DisplayCoordinates(Canvas canvas,PointF screen){
   var point=new PointF(screen.X/canvas.RenderScale,(screen.Y+canvas.CropTop)/canvas.RenderScale);
   if(!NativeNotationView.IsDosViewport)point=new PointF(point.X-canvas.CameraOffset.X-canvas.ScreenOrigin.X,point.Y-canvas.CameraOffset.Y-canvas.ScreenOrigin.Y);

  }
  static float TargetRadius(Canvas canvas){return Math.Max(6,8*canvas.DisplayDpi/canvas.RenderScale);}
  static Item BoundedHit(Canvas canvas,PointF screen){
   var mouse=DisplayCoordinates(canvas,screen);
   float radius=TargetRadius(canvas),best=Single.PositiveInfinity;
   Item selected=null;
   foreach(var item in canvas.Score.Items){
    if(item.Code==13||item.Code==2&&item.P(6)==-1||item.Code==14&&item.P(4)<0&&!NativeNotationView.UsesDat)continue;

   }

  public static Item HitTest(Canvas canvas,PointF screen){if(canvas.Score==null||canvas.PageDocument==null||canvas.Score.Items.Count==0)return null;if(!OriginalUnboundedSelection)return BoundedHit(canvas,screen);var mouse=Pixel(canvas,screen);int active=canvas.Score.Items.IndexOf(canvas.Selected);int selected;

  }
  internal static bool HoverChanged(Canvas canvas,PointF? before,PointF? after){

   PointF? old=before.HasValue&&canvas.ClientRectangle.Contains(Point.Round(before.Value))?(PointF?)DisplayCoordinates(canvas,before.Value):null;

    if((old.HasValue&&bounds.Contains(old.Value))!=(next.HasValue&&bounds.Contains(next.Value)))return true;
   return false;
  }
  public static void DrawPoints(Canvas canvas,Graphics g){if(!ShowPoints||canvas.Score==null||canvas.PageDocument==null||!canvas.HoverPoint.HasValue)return;var hover=canvas.HoverPoint.Value;if(!canvas.ClientRectangle.Contains(Point.Round(hover)))return;hover=DisplayCoordinates(canvas,hover);float unit=canvas.DisplayDpi/canvas.RenderScale;using(var pen=new Pen(Color.DarkRed,unit))using(var font=new Font("Consolas",(LargePointNumbers?16:10)*unit,GraphicsUnit.Pixel)){for(int n=0;n<canvas.Score.Items.Count;n++){RectangleF bounds;if(!canvas.ItemBounds.TryGetValue(canvas.Score.Items[n],out bounds)||!bounds.Contains(hover))continue;PointF p;try{p=DisplayPoint(canvas,canvas.Score.Items[n]);}catch(NotSupportedException error){string issue="Mouse click-point unavailable for item "+(n+1)+" (Code "+canvas.Score.Items[n].Code+"): "+error.Message;if(!canvas.DrawingIssues.Contains(issue))canvas.DrawingIssues.Add(issue);continue;}if(OutlinePoints&&!OriginalUnboundedSelection){float radius=TargetRadius(canvas);g.DrawRectangle(pen,p.X-radius,p.Y-radius,2*radius,2*radius);}else{g.DrawLine(pen,p.X-4*unit,p.Y,p.X+4*unit,p.Y);g.DrawLine(pen,p.X,p.Y-4*unit,p.X,p.Y+4*unit);}g.DrawString((n+1).ToString(),font,Brushes.DarkRed,p.X+(OutlinePoints&&!OriginalUnboundedSelection?TargetRadius(canvas)+2*unit:5*unit),p.Y+2*unit);}}}

 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Linq;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;using System.Windows.Forms;
namespace ScoreModern {public sealed class NativeMouseVisibility {
 [DllImport("user32.dll",SetLastError=true)]static extern IntPtr CreateCursor(IntPtr instance,int hotX,int hotY,int width,int height,byte[] andMask,byte[] xorMask);
 [DllImport("user32.dll")]static extern bool DestroyCursor(IntPtr handle);
 static Cursor blank;static IntPtr handle;int depth;Cursor saved;
 static Cursor Blank(){if(blank==null){handle=CreateCursor(IntPtr.Zero,0,0,32,32,Enumerable.Repeat((byte)255,128).ToArray(),new byte[128]);if(handle==IntPtr.Zero)throw new System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception();blank=new Cursor(handle);Application.ApplicationExit+=(s,e)=>{blank.Dispose();DestroyCursor(handle);handle=IntPtr.Zero;};}return blank;}
 public bool Hidden{get{return depth>0;}}
 public void Apply(Control target,bool show){if(show){if(depth>0)depth--;}else{if(depth==Int32.MaxValue)throw new NotSupportedException("Mouse-hide nesting exceeds the native counter range.");if(depth==0)saved=target.Cursor;depth++;}target.Cursor=Hidden?Blank():(saved??Cursors.Default);}
````
