````csharp
  }
  internal static List<List<Item>> AssembleTransposed(IList<Score> parts,int staves,float size,IList<NativePagePartPage> pages,float[] afterSymbol,float control43E0,short control43E4,Action<int,string,IList<Item>> observe,Action<string> warnings,NativePageMeasureNumbers numbering,int skip,int take,NativePageTranspose transpose,bool preserveInstrumentIds=false,float[] savedPositions=null,bool scor4=false){

  static void PositionOpeningRepeat(List<Item> items){
   if(!items.Any(i=>i.Code==14&&i.Count>=5&&i.P(5)==4))return;

   // opening repeat to one half unit before the first note or rest.
   var ordered=NativePageSort.Apply(items,true);
   int firstRhythm=ordered.FindIndex(i=>i.Code<=2);
   if(firstRhythm<0)return;
   var repeat=ordered.Take(firstRhythm).FirstOrDefault(i=>i.Code==14&&i.Count>=5&&i.P(5)==4);
   if(repeat==null)return;
   repeat.Set(3,(float)((double)ordered[firstRhythm].P(3)-.5));
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Linq;
namespace ScoreModern {
 // Original PAGE extraction stage, before bar assembly/page layout. The first
 // measured four-system part preserves every non-staff record word except
 // staff IDs and bar spans, and performs a stable horizontal sort.
 public static class NativePageParts {
  public sealed class Segment {public int SourceStaff;public Score Score;}
  internal sealed class MissingInstrumentOpening {
   internal readonly float Clef;
   internal readonly short? Key, MeterTop, MeterBottom;
   internal MissingInstrumentOpening(float clef,short? key,short? meterTop,short? meterBottom){
    Clef=clef;Key=key;MeterTop=meterTop;MeterBottom=meterBottom;
   }
  }
  sealed class WholeMeasure {public Item Item;public float Left,Right;}
  static void ValidateSourceCapacity(Score input){if(input==null)throw new ArgumentNullException("input");if(input.Items.Count>1420||input.Items.Sum(i=>i.Bytes.Length/4)>14200)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE input exceeds SCORE 3.11's original item/parameter capacities. Split the source before extracting parts; original over-capacity effects are not reproduced.");}
  static bool OrdinaryCueWave(Item item){return item.Code==4&&item.Count>=7&&item.P(7)<0&&item.P(6)==0;}
  static bool OrdinaryCueLine(Item item){return item.Code==4&&item.Count>=6&&item.P(7)>=0&&item.P(6)>item.P(3);}
  static bool OrdinaryGroupedCueSlur(Item item){
   return item.Code==5&&(item.Count==7||item.Count>=8&&item.Count<=20&&item.P(8)>=-4&&
    item.P(8)<=-1&&item.P(8)==Math.Truncate(item.P(8)))&&item.P(6)>item.P(3)&&item.P(7)!=0;
  }
  static bool SupportedGroupedCue(Item item,bool upper){
   if(OrdinaryCueLine(item)||OrdinaryGroupedCueSlur(item)||OrdinaryCueWave(item)||item.Code==9||item.Code==11||item.Code==15)return true;
   if(item.Code==1)return item.P(7)>0&&!Single.IsNaN(item.P(7))&&!Single.IsInfinity(item.P(7));
   if(item.Code==6)return item.Count>=7&&item.P(7)>=10&&item.P(7)<=19&&item.P(7)==Math.Truncate(item.P(7));
   if(ShortGroupedCueRest(item))return true;
   return upper&&item.Code==2&&item.P(5)==-2&&item.P(7)==4;
  }
  static bool ShortGroupedCueRest(Item item){
   return item.Code==2&&item.Count==7&&item.P(4)==100&&item.P(5)==-1&&
    item.P(6)==0&&(item.P(7)==.25f||item.P(7)==.5f);
  }
  static void FitGroupedCueBeam(Item beam,IEnumerable<Item> copies){
   // 09CA:151D selects the greatest P4 among cue notes within .1 of
   // each endpoint. The first copy is fitted by 09CA:12D2–1466.
   float left=GroupedCueBeamPitch(beam.P(3),copies);
   float right=GroupedCueBeamPitch(beam.P(6),copies);
   double span=((double)beam.P(6)-beam.P(3))/4;
   float limit=(float)span;
   if(span<1&&limit!=0)limit=1;
   if(Math.Abs((double)right-left)>=limit){
    if(right>left)left=(float)((double)right-limit);
    else right=(float)((double)left-limit);
   }
   beam.Set(4,(float)((double)left+(left<0?-100:100)));
   beam.Set(5,right);
  }
  static float GroupedCueBeamPitch(float x,IEnumerable<Item> copies){

  static StaffSpan[] SingleStaffSystemSpans(Score input,int staff,bool page4CuePart){

  }

  static SortedDictionary<int,int> UnmatchedDeclaredSystems(Score input,int instrument){

    .Select(i=>new{Bottom=i.Staff,Top=i.Staff+(int)i.P(4)-1}).Distinct().ToArray();
   foreach(var span in spans){
    if(spans.Any(other=>other!=span&&other.Bottom<=span.Top&&other.Top>=span.Bottom)||
     !Enumerable.Range(span.Bottom,span.Top-span.Bottom+1).All(headers.Contains)||

   }

  }
  static List<Segment> AddMissingInstrumentSegments(Score input,int instrument,int staffCount,List<Segment> result,SortedDictionary<int,int> missingSystems,Func<int,MissingInstrumentOpening> chooseOpening,bool firstSourceSegment){
   if(missingSystems.Count!=0){
    int topStaff=result.Select(segment=>segment.SourceStaff).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max();
    foreach(var span in missingSystems.Reverse()){
     MissingInstrumentOpening opening=null;
     if(firstSourceSegment&&span.Value>topStaff){
      opening=chooseOpening==null?new MissingInstrumentOpening(0,null,null,null):chooseOpening(instrument);

     }
     result.Add(MissingInstrumentSegment(input,span.Key,span.Value,opening,topStaff>span.Value?staffCount:0,staffCount));
    }
   }
   return result.OrderByDescending(segment=>segment.SourceStaff).ToList();
  }
  static Segment MissingInstrumentSegment(Score input,int bottom,int top,MissingInstrumentOpening opening,int barSpan,int staffCount){

   var globals=input.Items.Where(i=>Global(i)&&i.Staff>=bottom&&i.Staff<=top).ToArray();
   var meters=input.Items.Where(i=>i.Code==18&&i.Staff>=bottom&&i.Staff<=top)
    .OrderBy(i=>i.P(3)).ThenBy(i=>i.Staff).GroupBy(i=>i.P(3)).Select(g=>g.First()).ToArray();
   bool openingMeter=meters.Length!=0&&bars.Length!=0&&meters[0].P(3)<bars[0].P(3);

    throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE replacement systems need ordinary barlines and a measured first rest interval.");
   var page=new Score();
   if(opening!=null){
    page.Items.Add(Item.Make(8,1,0,0,.9f));
    page.Items.Add(Item.Make(3,1,1,0,opening.Clef));
    if(opening.Key.HasValue)page.Items.Add(Item.Make(17,1,2,0,opening.Key.Value,opening.Clef));

   }
   // 2E83 uses the first structural position as the left boundary. With
   // no opening meter, the first bar becomes that boundary (case 1735).
   foreach(var source in meters){var meter=source.Clone();meter.Set(2,1);page.Items.Add(meter);}
   var sharedRecords=new HashSet<Item>();

   }

   foreach(var sourceBar in bars.Skip(openingMeter?0:1)){
    float right=sourceBar.P(3);

    // rest always carries three beats, even after 2/4, 5/8 or 5/4.

   // next rest. Case 1745 repeats the same final write at bar X + .01.

   var records=page.Items.OrderBy(i=>i.P(3)).ToArray();
   var output=new Score{Trailer=(byte[])input.Trailer.Clone()};
   for(int staff=1;staff<=staffCount;staff++){
    foreach(var record in records){
     if(record.Code==14&&staff!=1||sharedRecords.Contains(record)&&staff!=staffCount)continue;
     var item=record.Clone();item.Set(2,staff);output.Items.Add(item);
    }
   }
   if(staffCount>1&&opening!=null)RebuildGroupOpening(output,staffCount);
   return new Segment{SourceStaff=top,Score=output};
  }
 }
````

````csharp
   options.Controls.Add(rangeLabel);options.Controls.Add(barRange);options.Controls.Add(oldMarkedPrecision);options.Controls.Add(turnLabel);options.Controls.Add(turnControls);turnControls.AccessibleName=turnLabel.Text;EnablePlanningControls();
   layout.Controls.Add(report,0,5);
   var footer=new TableLayoutPanel{Dock=DockStyle.Fill,AutoSize=true,ColumnCount=2,RowCount=1,Margin=Padding.Empty};
   footer.ColumnStyles.Add(new ColumnStyle(SizeType.AutoSize));
   footer.ColumnStyles.Add(new ColumnStyle(SizeType.Percent,100));
   var settingsButtons=Row();
   settingsButtons.Controls.AddRange(new Control[]{Button("Open settings...",OpenSettings),Button("Save settings...",SaveSettings)});
   footer.Controls.Add(settingsButtons,0,0);
   var buttons=Row();buttons.FlowDirection=FlowDirection.RightToLeft;
   var close=new Button{Text="Close",AutoSize=true,DialogResult=DialogResult.Cancel};
   buttons.Controls.AddRange(new Control[]{close,save,preview});
   footer.Controls.Add(buttons,1,0);
   layout.Controls.Add(footer,0,6);Controls.Add(layout);CancelButton=close;
   foreach(var value in new[]{instrument,staves,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,firstPage})value.ValueChanged+=(s,e)=>InvalidatePlan();
   foreach(var check in new[]{omit,centerNumbers,restLabels})check.CheckedChanged+=(s,e)=>InvalidatePlan();
   transposeWholeTone.SelectedIndexChanged+=(s,e)=>{EnablePlanningControls();InvalidatePlan();};
   transposeClef.SelectedIndexChanged+=(s,e)=>{EnablePlanningControls();InvalidatePlan();};
   transposeAddKey.CheckedChanged+=(s,e)=>InvalidatePlan();
   normalizeStems.CheckedChanged+=(s,e)=>{EnablePlanningControls();InvalidatePlan();};
   barRange.TextChanged+=(s,e)=>InvalidatePlan();
   oldMarkedPrecision.CheckedChanged+=(s,e)=>InvalidatePlan();
   turnControls.TextChanged+=(s,e)=>InvalidatePlan();
   restStyle.SelectedIndexChanged+=(s,e)=>InvalidatePlan();
   startMeasure.ValueChanged+=(s,e)=>{everyMeasure.Enabled=startMeasure.Value>0;InvalidatePlan();};everyMeasure.CheckedChanged+=(s,e)=>InvalidatePlan();
   foreach(var field in new[]{manualLines,linesPerPage,fixedProposal})field.TextChanged+=(s,e)=>{
    EnablePlanningControls();
    InvalidatePlan();
   };
   operation.SelectedIndexChanged+=(s,e)=>{EnablePlanningControls();InvalidatePlan();};
   preview.Click+=(s,e)=>Try(Preview);save.Click+=(s,e)=>Try(Save);
   InstallFileReordering();
   files.KeyDown+=(sender,e)=>{
    if(e.KeyData!=Keys.Delete)return;
    e.SuppressKeyPress=true;
    if(files.SelectedIndices.Count>0)Remove();
   };
   if(!String.IsNullOrEmpty(current)&&File.Exists(current))files.Items.Add(Path.GetFullPath(current));InvalidatePlan();
  }
  protected override void Dispose(bool disposing){if(disposing)optionTips.Dispose();base.Dispose(disposing);}
  void ConfigureTranspositions(){
   // Keep the indices stored by existing PAGE settings files.
   string[] descriptions={
    "None","B flat (Clar., Trpt., Sop. Sax)|up major 2","D (Clar., Trpt.)|down major 2",
    "Bass clef|up major 2","F (Horn, English Horn)|up perfect 5","|octave up",
    "|down perfect 5","|octave down","|up minor 2","|down minor 2","Normalize stems|up major 2",
    "Treble clef|up major 2","Alto clef|up major 2","Tenor clef|up major 2",
    "A flat (Clar. [high])|down major 6","F (Trpt. [high])|down perfect 4",
    "E (Trpt. [high])|down major 3","E flat (Clar., Trpt. [high])|down minor 3",
    "A (Clar., Trpt.)|up minor 3","G (Flute, Horn)|up perfect 4","E (Horn)|up minor 6",
    "E flat (Alto Sax, Horn)|up major 6","D (Horn)|up minor 7",
    "B flat (Tenor Sax, Bass Clar.)|up major 9","E flat (Baritone Sax)|up major 13"
   };
   transposeWholeTone.Items.AddRange(descriptions.Select(label=>label.TrimStart('|').Replace('|',' ')).ToArray());
   transposeWholeTone.DropDownWidth=Math.Max(transposeWholeTone.Width,
    transposeWholeTone.Items.Cast<string>().Max(label=>TextRenderer.MeasureText(label,Font).Width)+48);
   transposeWholeTone.DrawItem+=(sender,args)=>{
    args.DrawBackground();
    if(args.Index<0)return;
    string[] parts=descriptions[args.Index].Split('|');
    var flags=TextFormatFlags.Left|TextFormatFlags.VerticalCenter|TextFormatFlags.SingleLine|TextFormatFlags.NoPadding;
    var bounds=args.Bounds;
    bounds.X+=3;
    bounds.Width-=3;
    if(parts[0].Length>0){
     TextRenderer.DrawText(args.Graphics,parts[0],args.Font,bounds,args.ForeColor,flags);
     int width=TextRenderer.MeasureText(args.Graphics,parts[0]+" ",args.Font,Size.Empty,flags).Width;
     bounds.X+=width;
     bounds.Width-=width;
    }
    if(parts.Length==2&&bounds.Width>0)
     using(var bold=new Font(args.Font,args.Font.Style|FontStyle.Bold))
      TextRenderer.DrawText(args.Graphics,parts[1],bold,bounds,args.ForeColor,flags);
    args.DrawFocusRectangle();
   };
   transposeWholeTone.SelectedIndex=0;
  }
  internal void EnableStemNormalization(string root){
   if(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(root)||resourceRoot!=null)return;
   resourceRoot=root;
  }

  static FlowLayoutPanel Row(){return new FlowLayoutPanel{Dock=DockStyle.Fill,AutoSize=true,WrapContents=true};}
  static void Field(FlowLayoutPanel row,string title,Control field){row.Controls.Add(new Label{Text=title,AutoSize=true,Margin=new Padding(3,6,3,3)});field.AccessibleName=title;row.Controls.Add(field);}
  Button Button(string title,Action action){var b=new Button{Text=title,AutoSize=true};b.Click+=(s,e)=>Try(action);return b;}
  void Try(Action action){try{action();}catch(Exception e){if(!(e is IOException||e is UnauthorizedAccessException||e is ArgumentException||e is NotSupportedException||e is InvalidOperationException||e is OverflowException))throw;report.Text=e.Message;}}
  void EnablePlanningControls(){
   bool parts=operation.SelectedIndex==0,old=operation.SelectedIndex==3||operation.SelectedIndex==5,turn=operation.SelectedIndex==2||operation.SelectedIndex==3,multi=operation.SelectedIndex==4;
   turnLabel.Visible=turnControls.Visible=turn;
   rangeLabel.Visible=barRange.Visible=parts||operation.SelectedIndex==1;
   oldMarkedPrecision.Visible=operation.SelectedIndex==1;
   foreach(var c in new Control[]{size,height,centerNumbers,firstPage})c.Enabled=!old;
   rangeLabel.Text=parts?"Use measures (first, last; optional)":"Marked boundaries (start, end)";
   barRange.AccessibleName=rangeLabel.Text;
   foreach(var c in new Control[]{instrument,firstIndent,otherIndent,startMeasure,omit,restStyle,restLabels,transposeWholeTone})c.Enabled=parts;
   staves.Enabled=parts||multi;
   int transpose=transposeWholeTone.SelectedIndex;
   transposeClef.Enabled=parts&&transpose>0&&transpose!=3&&(transpose<10||transpose>13);
   normalizeStems.Enabled=transposeClef.Enabled;
   transposeAddKey.Enabled=parts&&transpose>0&&transpose!=10;
   everyMeasure.Enabled=parts&&startMeasure.Value>0;
   manualLines.Enabled=parts&&String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(linesPerPage.Text)&&String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fixedProposal.Text);
   linesPerPage.Enabled=parts&&String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(manualLines.Text)&&String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fixedProposal.Text);
   fixedProposal.Enabled=parts&&String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(manualLines.Text)&&String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(linesPerPage.Text);
  }
  void InvalidatePlan(){files.RefreshMetrics();prepared=null;int route=operation.SelectedIndex;preview.Enabled=route==0||route==4?files.Items.Count>0:files.Items.Count==1&&(route!=3&&route!=5||Path.GetFileName((string)files.Items[0]).Equals("BARS.TMP",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));save.Enabled=false;report.Text=route==5?"Open BARS.TMP with its source scores in the same folder.":route==4?"Add scores in reading order and set the number of staves per system.":route==3?"Open the original BARS.TMP with its score in the same folder. The verified route restores a single-staff, ten-inch job and proposes page turns.":route==2?"Choose one extracted part system. Enter turn quarters and pages; optionally add lines per page and first page number.":route==1?"Choose one score. Enter the mark to start after (0 for the beginning) and the mark to stop at. To select by bar number, enter N followed by the first and last bars.":preview.Enabled?"Preview the layout before saving.":"Add one or more input scores.";}
  void Add(){bool old=operation.SelectedIndex==3||operation.SelectedIndex==5;using(var dialog=new OpenFileDialog{Title=old?"Open PAGE Old Page Data":"Choose PAGE input scores",Filter=old?"Old Page Data (BARS.TMP)|BARS.TMP":"SCORE scores (*.mus;*.pag)|*.mus;*.pag|All files (*.*)|*.*",Multiselect=!old,RestoreDirectory=true})if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)==DialogResult.OK){if(old)files.Items.Clear();foreach(string path in dialog.FileNames)files.Items.Add(path);InvalidatePlan();}}
  void Remove(){foreach(int n in files.SelectedIndices.Cast<int>().OrderByDescending(x=>x).ToArray())files.Items.RemoveAt(n);InvalidatePlan();}
  void MoveFile(int direction){int index=files.SelectedIndex;ReorderFile(index,index+direction);}
  void Preview(){
   InvalidatePlan();UseWaitCursor=true;
   try{
    if(operation.SelectedIndex==5){
     if(files.Items.Count!=1)throw new ArgumentException("Choose one original BARS.TMP file.");
     prepared=NativePageScoreLayout.PrepareOld((string)files.Items[0]);
     ShowPlan();
    }else if(operation.SelectedIndex==4){
     prepared=NativePageScoreLayout.Prepare(files.Items.Cast<string>(),(int)staves.Value,(float)size.Value,(float)height.Value,(int)firstPage.Value,centerNumbers.Checked);
     ShowPlan();
    }else if(operation.SelectedIndex>=2){
     var fields=turnControls.Text.Split(new[]{' ', ',', '\t'},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
     float quarters;int requested;
     if(files.Items.Count!=1||(fields.Length<2||fields.Length>4)||!Single.TryParse(fields[0],System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float,System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out quarters)||!Int32.TryParse(fields[1],out requested))
      throw new ArgumentException("Enter turn gap and requested pages, optionally followed by lines per page and first page number.");
     int turnLines=1,turnFirst=(int)firstPage.Value;if(fields.Length>=3&&!Int32.TryParse(fields[2],out turnLines)||fields.Length==4&&!Int32.TryParse(fields[3],out turnFirst))throw new ArgumentException("Turn lines per page and first page number must be integers.");
     prepared=operation.SelectedIndex==3?NativePageTurnPlan.PrepareOld((string)files.Items[0],quarters,requested,turnLines,turnFirst):NativePageTurnPlan.Prepare((string)files.Items[0],quarters,requested,(float)size.Value,(float)height.Value,turnFirst,centerNumbers.Checked,turnLines);
     ShowPlan();
    }else if(operation.SelectedIndex==1){
     var marked=barRange.Text.Split(new[]{' ', ',', '\t'},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
     bool byNumber=marked.Length==3&&marked[0].Equals("N",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
     int first=byNumber||marked.Length==3&&marked[0].Equals("M",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)?1:0;
     int start,end;
     if(files.Items.Count!=1||marked.Length!=first+2||!Int32.TryParse(marked[first],out start)||!Int32.TryParse(marked[first+1],out end))
      throw new ArgumentException("Choose one score and enter two marked boundaries or N followed by the first and last bar numbers.");
     var source=(string)files.Items[0];
     prepared=byNumber
      ?NativePageMarkedLayout.PrepareNumbered(source,start,end,(float)size.Value,(float)height.Value,(int)firstPage.Value,centerNumbers.Checked,oldMarkedPrecision.Checked)
      :NativePageMarkedLayout.Prepare(source,start,end,(float)size.Value,(float)height.Value,(int)firstPage.Value,centerNumbers.Checked,oldMarkedPrecision.Checked);
     ShowPlan();
    }else{
    var proposal=fixedProposal.Text.Split(new[]{' ', ',', '\t'},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
    int pageCount=0,lines=0;
    if(proposal.Length!=0&&(proposal.Length!=2||!Int32.TryParse(proposal[0],out pageCount)||!Int32.TryParse(proposal[1],out lines)||pageCount<1||lines<1))throw new ArgumentException("Enter the page count and lines per page as two positive integers.");
    var range=barRange.Text.Split(new[]{' ', ',', '\t'},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
    int from=0,to=0;
    if(range.Length!=0&&(range.Length!=2||!Int32.TryParse(range[0],out from)||!Int32.TryParse(range[1],out to)||from<1||to<from))throw new ArgumentException("Enter the first and last measure numbers.");
    int transpose=transposeWholeTone.SelectedIndex;
    short interval=transpose<transposeIntervals.Length?transposeIntervals[transpose]:
     InputTranspositionInterval.Menu(new short[]{1,2,3,4,7,8,10,11,12,13,14}[transpose-transposeIntervals.Length]);
    bool normalize=transpose==10||normalizeStems.Enabled&&normalizeStems.Checked;
    if(normalize&&resourceRoot==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("PAGE stem normalization requires SCORE library resources.");
    short? clef=null;
    switch(transpose){case 3:clef=1;break;case 11:clef=0;break;case 12:clef=2;break;case 13:clef=3;break;}
    if(transposeClef.Enabled&&transposeClef.SelectedIndex>0)clef=(short)(transposeClef.SelectedIndex-1);
    prepared=NativePagePartsWorkflow.PrepareWithMissingInstrument(files.Items.Cast<string>(),(int)instrument.Value,(int)staves.Value,omit.Checked,(float)size.Value,(float)height.Value,(int)firstIndent.Value,(int)otherIndent.Value,(int)firstPage.Value,centerNumbers.Checked,restLabels.Checked,restStyle.SelectedIndex==1,(int)startMeasure.Value,everyMeasure.Enabled&&everyMeasure.Checked,manualLines.Text,linesPerPage.Text,pageCount,lines,from,to,interval,normalize?resourceRoot:null,transposeAddKey.Enabled&&transposeAddKey.Checked,clef,ChooseMissingInstrumentOpening,scor4);
    ShowPlan();
    }
   }
   catch(OperationCanceledException){return;}
   finally{UseWaitCursor=false;}
   if(prepared.Warnings.Count>0)report.AppendText(Environment.NewLine+Environment.NewLine+String.Join(Environment.NewLine+Environment.NewLine,prepared.Warnings));
  }
  NativePageParts.MissingInstrumentOpening ChooseMissingInstrumentOpening(int id){
   UseWaitCursor=false;
   using(var dialog=new Form{Text="PAGE — Missing instrument",Font=Font,StartPosition=FormStartPosition.CenterParent,AutoSize=true,AutoSizeMode=AutoSizeMode.GrowAndShrink,FormBorderStyle=FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog,MinimizeBox=false,MaximizeBox=false,ShowInTaskbar=false})
   using(var fields=new TableLayoutPanel{ColumnCount=2,AutoSize=true,AutoSizeMode=AutoSizeMode.GrowAndShrink,Padding=new Padding(12),Dock=DockStyle.Fill}){
    var explanation=new Label{Text="Instrument "+id+" is absent from a system. Choose the opening symbols for its replacement rests.",MaximumSize=new Size(340,0),AutoSize=true};
    fields.Controls.Add(explanation,0,0);fields.SetColumnSpan(explanation,2);
    var clef=new TextBox{Text="0",Width=115};
    var key=new TextBox{Width=115};
    var meter=new TextBox{Width=115};
    fields.Controls.Add(new Label{Text="Clef number (0 = treble)",AutoSize=true,Anchor=AnchorStyles.Left},0,1);fields.Controls.Add(clef,1,1);
    fields.Controls.Add(new Label{Text="Key signature (blank for none)",AutoSize=true,Anchor=AnchorStyles.Left},0,2);fields.Controls.Add(key,1,2);
    fields.Controls.Add(new Label{Text="Meter numbers (blank for none)",AutoSize=true,Anchor=AnchorStyles.Left},0,3);fields.Controls.Add(meter,1,3);
    var buttons=new FlowLayoutPanel{AutoSize=true,AutoSizeMode=AutoSizeMode.GrowAndShrink,Anchor=AnchorStyles.Right,WrapContents=false};
    var accept=new Button{Text="Continue",AutoSize=true};
    var cancel=new Button{Text="Cancel",AutoSize=true,DialogResult=DialogResult.Cancel};
    buttons.Controls.Add(accept);buttons.Controls.Add(cancel);fields.Controls.Add(buttons,0,4);fields.SetColumnSpan(buttons,2);
    dialog.Controls.Add(fields);dialog.AcceptButton=accept;dialog.CancelButton=cancel;
    NativePageParts.MissingInstrumentOpening opening=null;
    accept.Click+=(sender,args)=>{
     var words=meter.Text.Split(new[]{' ','\t','/'},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
     float clefValue;
     short keyValue=0,top=0,bottom=0;
     if(!Single.TryParse(clef.Text,NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out clefValue)||!(clefValue>=short.MinValue&&clefValue<=short.MaxValue)||
      !String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key.Text)&&!Int16.TryParse(key.Text,out keyValue)||
      words.Length>2||words.Length>0&&!Int16.TryParse(words[0],out top)||words.Length==2&&!Int16.TryParse(words[1],out bottom)){
      MessageBox.Show(dialog,"Enter a clef number, an optional key number and up to two meter numbers.","PAGE opening symbols",MessageBoxButtons.OK,MessageBoxIcon.Warning);
      return;
     }
     opening=new NativePageParts.MissingInstrumentOpening(clefValue,String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key.Text)?(short?)null:keyValue,words.Length==0?(short?)null:top,bottom);
     dialog.DialogResult=DialogResult.OK;
    };
    return dialog.ShowDialog(this)==DialogResult.OK?opening:null;
   }
  }
  void ShowPlan(){report.Text=String.Join(Environment.NewLine,prepared.Plan.Select((p,n)=>"Page "+p.Number+"   Bars per line: "+String.Join(", ",p.Bars)+"   "+prepared.Files[n].Length+" bytes"));save.Enabled=true;}
  void Save(){
   if(prepared==null)return;bool original=NativeScoreBehaviour.Enabled||names.SelectedIndex==0;
   using(var dialog=new SaveFileDialog{Title="First PAGE output",Filter="SCORE pages (*.pag)|*.pag",DefaultExt="pag",AddExtension=true,FileName="PART01.PAG",RestoreDirectory=true,OverwritePrompt=false}){
    if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
    var paths=NativePagePartsWorkflow.OutputNames(prepared,dialog.FileName,original);int existing=paths.Count(File.Exists);
    string listing=String.Join(Environment.NewLine,paths.Take(12));if(paths.Length>12)listing+=Environment.NewLine+"... "+(paths.Length-12)+" more pages";
    if(MessageBox.Show(this,listing+Environment.NewLine+Environment.NewLine+existing+" existing outputs will be replaced. Save these pages?","PAGE outputs",MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel,MessageBoxIcon.Question)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
    SavePrepared(dialog.FileName,original,existing!=0);report.Text=String.Join(Environment.NewLine,paths.Select(p=>"Saved "+p));
   }
  }
  void SavePrepared(string path,bool original,bool replace){
   var next=OutputBank.Clone();
   var contents=prepared.Files.Select(next.RetainPage).ToArray();
   NativePagePartsWorkflow.SavePages(prepared,path,original,replace,contents);
   OutputBank=next;
  }
 }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Globalization;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativePagePreparedPart {
  internal readonly IList<NativePagePartPage> Plan;
  internal readonly IList<byte[]> Files;
  internal readonly string[] Sources;
  internal readonly IList<string> Warnings;
  internal NativePagePreparedPart(IList<NativePagePartPage> plan,IList<byte[]> files,string[] sources,IList<string> warnings){Plan=plan;Files=files;Sources=sources;Warnings=warnings;}
 }

 internal static class NativePagePartsWorkflow {
  // The automatic Parts route has its own original working banks and PAG
  // writer. Keep it separate from Main SCORE Save and from SCORLAS tiling.
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart Prepare(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size){
   return PrepareWithHeight(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,10f);
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithHeight(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height){
   return PrepareWithLayout(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,0,0);
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithLayout(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent){
   return PrepareWithNumbering(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,1,false);
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithNumbering(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered){
   return PrepareWithRestLabels(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,firstPage,centered,true);
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithRestLabels(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest){
   return PrepareWithRestControls(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,firstPage,centered,numberSingleBarRest,false);
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithRestControls(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest,bool europeanRests){
   return PrepareWithMeasureNumbers(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,firstPage,centered,numberSingleBarRest,europeanRests,0,false);
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithMeasureNumbers(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest,bool europeanRests,int startMeasure,bool everyMeasure){
   return PrepareWithLinePlan(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,firstPage,centered,numberSingleBarRest,europeanRests,startMeasure,everyMeasure,"");
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithLinePlan(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest,bool europeanRests,int startMeasure,bool everyMeasure,string manualLines){
   return PrepareWithPagePlan(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,firstPage,centered,numberSingleBarRest,europeanRests,startMeasure,everyMeasure,manualLines,"");
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithPagePlan(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest,bool europeanRests,int startMeasure,bool everyMeasure,string manualLines,string linesPerPage){
   return PrepareFixedProposal(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,firstPage,centered,numberSingleBarRest,europeanRests,startMeasure,everyMeasure,manualLines,linesPerPage,0,0);
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareFixedProposal(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest,bool europeanRests,int startMeasure,bool everyMeasure,string manualLines,string linesPerPage,int pageCount,int fixedLinesPerPage){
   return PrepareBarRange(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,firstPage,centered,numberSingleBarRest,europeanRests,startMeasure,everyMeasure,manualLines,linesPerPage,pageCount,fixedLinesPerPage,0,0);
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareBarRange(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest,bool europeanRests,int startMeasure,bool everyMeasure,string manualLines,string linesPerPage,int pageCount,int fixedLinesPerPage,int fromBar,int toBar){
   return PrepareWithTranspose(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,firstPage,centered,numberSingleBarRest,europeanRests,startMeasure,everyMeasure,manualLines,linesPerPage,pageCount,fixedLinesPerPage,fromBar,toBar,false);
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithTranspose(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest,bool europeanRests,int startMeasure,bool everyMeasure,string manualLines,string linesPerPage,int pageCount,int fixedLinesPerPage,int fromBar,int toBar,bool transposeWholeTone){
   return PrepareWithInterval(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,firstPage,centered,numberSingleBarRest,europeanRests,startMeasure,everyMeasure,manualLines,linesPerPage,pageCount,fixedLinesPerPage,fromBar,toBar,transposeWholeTone?(short)2:(short)0);
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithInterval(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest,bool europeanRests,int startMeasure,bool everyMeasure,string manualLines,string linesPerPage,int pageCount,int fixedLinesPerPage,int fromBar,int toBar,short interval){
   return PrepareWithNormalization(paths,instrument,staves,omitLeft,size,height,firstIndent,otherIndent,firstPage,centered,numberSingleBarRest,europeanRests,startMeasure,everyMeasure,manualLines,linesPerPage,pageCount,fixedLinesPerPage,fromBar,toBar,interval,null);

  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithNormalization(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest,bool europeanRests,int startMeasure,bool everyMeasure,string manualLines,string linesPerPage,int pageCount,int fixedLinesPerPage,int fromBar,int toBar,short interval,string normalizationRoot){

  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithTransposition(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest,bool europeanRests,int startMeasure,bool everyMeasure,string manualLines,string linesPerPage,int pageCount,int fixedLinesPerPage,int fromBar,int toBar,short interval,string normalizationRoot,bool addKey,short? targetClef=null){

  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareWithMissingInstrument(IEnumerable<string> paths,int instrument,int staves,bool omitLeft,float size,float height,int firstIndent,int otherIndent,int firstPage,bool centered,bool numberSingleBarRest,bool europeanRests,int startMeasure,bool everyMeasure,string manualLines,string linesPerPage,int pageCount,int fixedLinesPerPage,int fromBar,int toBar,short interval,string normalizationRoot,bool addKey,short? targetClef,Func<int,NativePageParts.MissingInstrumentOpening> chooseOpening,bool scor4=false){
   if(paths==null)throw new ArgumentNullException("paths");
   var sources=paths.Select(Path.GetFullPath).ToArray();if(sources.Length==0)throw new ArgumentException("Choose at least one score file.");
   if(instrument<1||instrument>32767)throw new ArgumentException("Enter an instrument ID from 1 to 32767.");
   if(staves<1||staves>32)throw new ArgumentException("Enter a staff count from 1 to 32.");
   if(size<=0||Single.IsInfinity(size)||Single.IsNaN(size))throw new ArgumentException("Enter a positive staff size.");
   if(height<=0||Single.IsInfinity(height)||Single.IsNaN(height))throw new ArgumentException("Enter a positive page height.");
   if(firstIndent<0||firstIndent>=200||otherIndent<0||otherIndent>=200)throw new ArgumentException("Enter SCORE indents between 0 and 199.");
   if(startMeasure!=0&&(startMeasure< -1||startMeasure>32767||startMeasure==-1&&everyMeasure))
    throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE measure numbering requires a signed-word start. Pickup numbering applies to line openings.");
   bool manual=!String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(manualLines),regroup=!String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(linesPerPage);
   if(manual&&regroup||(manual||regroup)&&(pageCount!=0||fixedLinesPerPage!=0))throw new ArgumentException("Choose one manual PAGE layout method.");
   var parts=new List<Score>();short? measurement=null;bool mixedMeasurements=false;
   foreach(string path in sources){
    var score=Score.Load(path);
    short selectedMeasurement=NativeMeasurements.Get(score);
    mixedMeasurements|=measurement.HasValue&&measurement.Value!=selectedMeasurement;
    measurement=selectedMeasurement;
    var segments=NativePageParts.PrepareStaffGroupsWithMissing(score,instrument,staves,omitLeft,chooseOpening,parts.Count==0,scor4);
    parts.AddRange(segments.Select(x=>x.Score));
   }
   if(parts.Count==0)throw new InvalidDataException("No staves have the requested instrument ID in P9.");
   bool range=fromBar!=0||toBar!=0;int skip=0,take=0;
   if(range){
    int actual=NativePagePartWeightCollection.Prepare(parts).BarPlan.FileBars.Sum();
    if(fromBar<1||toBar<fromBar||toBar>actual)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE range must select existing measures in forward order.");
    skip=fromBar-1;take=toBar-fromBar+1;
   }
   var plan=!manual?NativePageDefaultPartPlan.PrepareRangeProposal(parts,staves,size,height,firstPage,centered,skip,take,pageCount,fixedLinesPerPage,firstIndent,otherIndent):
    NativePageDefaultPartPlan.NumberedPages(ParseLines(manualLines,staves,range?take:NativePagePartWeightCollection.Prepare(parts).BarPlan.FileBars.Sum()),height,firstPage,centered);
   if(regroup)
    plan=NativePageDefaultPartPlan.NumberedPages(RegroupLines(linesPerPage,staves,plan.SelectMany(p=>p.Bars).ToArray()),height,firstPage,centered);
   for(int n=0;n<plan.Count;n++)plan[n].Indents=Enumerable.Range(0,plan[n].Bars.Length).Select(i=>(float)(n==0&&i==0?firstIndent:otherIndent)).ToArray();
   var warnings=new List<string>();
   if(mixedMeasurements)warnings.Add("Input scores use different measurement units. PAGE preserves SCORE coordinates; the output uses "+(measurement.Value==1?"centimeters":"inches")+" from the last input file.");
   var numbering=startMeasure==0?null:new NativePageMeasureNumbers(startMeasure,everyMeasure);
   if(interval!=0&&manual&&range)
    throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE's explicit line plan requires an entire transposed part.");
   if(interval==0&&(addKey||targetClef.HasValue||normalizationRoot!=null))throw new ArgumentException("Select a PAGE transposition before setting its options.");
   var pages=NativePagePartPages.AssembleTransposed(parts,staves,size,plan,new float[4],numberSingleBarRest?1f:0f,europeanRests?(short)2:(short)1,null,warnings.Add,numbering,skip,take,interval==0?null:new NativePageTranspose(interval,normalizationRoot,addKey,targetClef,scor4),scor4:scor4);
   var writer=new NativePageFileBank(new byte[14200*4]);

   // measurement code to the PAG trailer (both mixed orders in source421).
   return new NativePagePreparedPart(plan,pages.Select(page=>writer.Encode(page,measurement.Value)).ToArray(),sources,warnings.AsReadOnly());

  static List<int[]> RegroupLines(string text,int staves,int[] bars){
   var pages=new List<int[]>();int used=0;
   foreach(string value in text.Split(new[]{' ', '\t', '\r', '\n', ','},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)){
    int n;
    if(!Int32.TryParse(value,NumberStyles.None,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out n)||n<1||n>bars.Length-used)throw new ArgumentException("Enter a positive line count for each page, covering all "+bars.Length+" automatic lines.");
    if(n>32/staves)throw new NotSupportedException("A PAGE layout exceeds 32 staves on one page.");
    pages.Add(bars.Skip(used).Take(n).ToArray());used+=n;
   }
   if(used!=bars.Length)throw new ArgumentException("The page grouping covers "+used+" of "+bars.Length+" automatic lines.");
   return pages;
  }

  static List<int[]> ParseLines(string text,int staves,int expectedBars){
   var pages=new List<int[]>();var lines=new List<int>();int used=0;
   foreach(var value in text.Split(new[]{' ', '\t', '\r', '\n', ','},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)){
    int n;
    if(!Int32.TryParse(value,NumberStyles.None,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out n)||n>expectedBars-used)throw new ArgumentException("Enter a positive bar count per line, and zero at page breaks.");
    if(n==0){if(lines.Count==0)throw new ArgumentException("A PAGE layout cannot have an empty page.");pages.Add(lines.ToArray());lines.Clear();}
    else{lines.Add(n);used+=n;if(lines.Count>32/staves)throw new NotSupportedException("A PAGE layout exceeds 32 staves on one page.");}
   }
   if(lines.Count!=0)pages.Add(lines.ToArray());
   if(used!=expectedBars)throw new ArgumentException("The manual PAGE layout accounts for "+used+" of "+expectedBars+" bars.");
   return pages;
  }

  internal static string[] OutputNames(NativePagePreparedPart part,string first,bool original){
   if(part==null)throw new ArgumentNullException("part");
   if(!String.Equals(Path.GetExtension(first),".PAG",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))throw new ArgumentException("Choose a .PAG output filename.");
   var names=original?NativePageFilenameSequence.OriginalNames(first,part.Files.Count):part.Files.Count==1?new[]{Path.GetFullPath(first)}:NativeScorlasBatch.OutputNames(first,part.Files.Count,true);
   var sourcePaths=new HashSet<string>(part.Sources,StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
   if(names.Any(sourcePaths.Contains))throw new IOException("A PAGE output would replace one of the input scores.");
   if(names.Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Count()!=names.Length)throw new IOException("The PAGE filenames are not distinct.");
   return names;
  }

  internal static void Save(NativePagePreparedPart part,string first,bool original,bool replace){
   SavePages(part,first,original,replace,part.Files);
  }
  internal static void SavePages(NativePagePreparedPart part,string first,bool original,bool replace,IList<byte[]> contents){
   var names=OutputNames(part,first,original);
   if(!replace&&names.Any(File.Exists))throw new IOException("A PAGE output already exists.");
   string folder=Path.GetDirectoryName(names[0]),token=Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
   var staged=new List<string>();var committed=new List<int>();var backups=new Dictionary<int,string>();bool success=false;
   try{
    for(int n=0;n<names.Length;n++){string temp=Path.Combine(folder,".page-"+token+"-"+n+".tmp");staged.Add(temp);File.WriteAllBytes(temp,contents[n]);}
    try{
     for(int n=0;n<names.Length;n++){
      if(File.Exists(names[n])){if(!replace)throw new IOException("A PAGE output already exists: "+names[n]);string backup=staged[n]+".backup";File.Replace(staged[n],names[n],backup);backups.Add(n,backup);}else File.Move(staged[n],names[n]);committed.Add(n);
     }
    }catch(Exception error){
     var failed=new List<string>();
     for(int i=committed.Count-1;i>=0;i--){int n=committed[i];try{string backup;if(backups.TryGetValue(n,out backup))File.Replace(backup,names[n],null);else File.Delete(names[n]);}catch(IOException restore){failed.Add(names[n]+": "+restore.Message);}catch(UnauthorizedAccessException restore){failed.Add(names[n]+": "+restore.Message);}}
     if(failed.Count!=0)throw new IOException("PAGE outputs could not all be restored. Remaining backups are in the output folder."+Environment.NewLine+String.Join(Environment.NewLine,failed),error);
     throw;
    }
    success=true;
   }finally{foreach(string temp in staged)if(File.Exists(temp))File.Delete(temp);if(success)foreach(string backup in backups.Values)if(File.Exists(backup))File.Delete(backup);}
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativePagePartWeights {internal short[] Widths,Leading;internal NativePagePartPlan BarPlan;}
 internal static class NativePagePartWeightCollection {
  static void F(byte[] d,int at,float value){Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(value),0,d,at,4);}
  static void W(byte[] d,int at,int value){Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(unchecked((short)value)),0,d,at,2);}
  // Explicit fresh native workspace. Raw source-history replays remain a
  // separate entry; no captured original memory is used by this producer.
  internal static NativePagePartWeights Prepare(IList<Score> parts){
   var plan=NativePageBarPlan.Prepare(parts);var widths=new List<short>();
   var leading=new short[parts.Sum(part=>part.Items.Count(item=>item.Code==14))+1];
   var trailing=new List<short>();var workspace=new byte[65536];int at=0;float scale=0;
   var counts=new int[parts.Count];var positions=new List<float>();var consumed=new List<float>();
   for(int file=0;file<parts.Count;file++){var part=parts[file];var rhythm=NativePageBarPlan.Collect(NativePageSort.Apply(part.Items,true),1,1);float[] durations=plan.Durations.Skip(at).Take(plan.FileBars[file]).ToArray();
    F(workspace,0x779c,1);W(workspace,0x7772,rhythm.Cursor);W(workspace,0x7794,rhythm.Rhythms.Length);F(workspace,0x7752,rhythm.Total);
    for(int n=0;n<durations.Length;n++)F(workspace,0x77a6+n*4,durations[n]);
    // A rest can share the preceding meter's rhythmic slot. The spacing
    // loop still consumes a duration for each drawn bar from its work bank.
    int capacity=part.Items.Count(item=>item.Code==14)+1;
    if(0x77a6+capacity*4>workspace.Length)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE part duration bank exceeded.");
    var spacingDurations=new float[capacity];
    Buffer.BlockCopy(workspace,0x77a6,spacingDurations,0,capacity*4);
    var result=NativePageSpacingPlan.Collect(rhythm.Items,spacingDurations,scale,null,workspace);scale=result.FinalMultiplier;
    counts[file]=result.Widths.Length;
    positions.AddRange(counts[file]==durations.Length?plan.Positions.Skip(at).Take(counts[file]):result.Positions);
    consumed.AddRange(spacingDurations.Take(counts[file]));
    int barAt=widths.Count;
    for(int n=0;n<result.Leading.Length;n++)if(result.LeadingWritten[n])leading[barAt+n]=unchecked((short)result.Leading[n]);
    widths.AddRange(result.Widths.Select(x=>unchecked((short)x)));trailing.AddRange(result.Trailing.Select(x=>unchecked((short)x)));at+=durations.Length;
   }
   var combined=new short[widths.Count];for(int n=0;n<combined.Length;n++)combined[n]=unchecked((short)Math.Min((int)unchecked((short)(leading[n+1]+trailing[n])),9000));
   return new NativePagePartWeights{Widths=widths.ToArray(),Leading=combined,
    BarPlan=new NativePagePartPlan{FileBars=counts,Positions=positions.ToArray(),Durations=consumed.ToArray()}};
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal static class NativePagePostLine {
  // PAGE 084F:0C83..10B2, negative end-mode path used by parts assembly.
  // Positive/automatic end modes call a separate producer at 10B3.
  internal static List<Item> ApplyNegativeEndMode(IList<Item> input,short mode,short outputTag){
   if(mode>=-1)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE automatic end-item production requires its separate source path.");
   var rows=input.Select(item=>item.Clone()).ToList();
   foreach(var item in rows){
    if(item.Code>=4&&item.Code<=8){if(item.Count<6)continue;if(item.Code==6&&item.Count>=11)for(int p=11;p<=15&&p<=item.Count;p++)if(item.P(p)>204)item.Set(p,204);if(item.P(6)>202)item.Set(6,202);}
    else if(item.Code==14&&item.P(3)>=199.89999389648438f&&item.P(3)<=200.10000610351562f)item.Set(3,200);
   }
   if(outputTag==69){if(rows.Count==0||rows[rows.Count-1].Count!=7)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE end-marker removal would cut through a record.");rows.RemoveAt(rows.Count-1);}
   return rows;
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

using System.Linq;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal static class NativePageRestFollowup {
  static short Word(float value){long result;if(!FiniteBinary32Integer64.TryConvert(BitConverter.ToUInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(value),0),out result))throw new NotSupportedException("Non-finite PAGE rest controls require the original error path.");return unchecked((short)result);}
  static readonly float[] leftOffsets={0,1.2f,2.2f,4.4f,1,4.4f,3,0};
  static readonly float[] rightOffsets={0,0,0,0,3.6f,3.4f,4,0};
  // PAGE 0C16:000D..0543. Raw retained controls stay explicit until their
  // separate menu producers are verified; this routine does not name them.
  internal static List<Item> Apply(IList<Item> input,float[] staffUnits,float retained43E0,short retained43E4){
   var rows=input.Select(item=>item.Clone()).ToList();
   foreach(var rest in rows){
    if(rest.Code!=2||rest.Count<5)continue;short mode=Word(rest.P(5));if(mode>-2)continue;int oldCount=rest.Count;
    if(oldCount>=8){if(mode==-2&&rest.P(8)==1)rest.Set(8,retained43E0);if(mode<=-12&&retained43E4==1){mode=rest.P(8)>1?(short)-5:(short)-2;rest.Set(5,mode);}}
    float x=rest.P(3),staff=rest.P(2),right=9999,left=-9999;short rightStyle=0,leftStyle=0;
    foreach(var bar in rows){if(bar.Code!=14)continue;float bottom=bar.P(2);if(bottom>staff)continue;float bx=bar.Count>=3?bar.P(3):0,span=bar.Count>=4?bar.P(4):1;if((double)bottom+span<=staff)continue;
     if(bx<right&&bx>x){right=bx;rightStyle=bar.Count>=5?Word(bar.P(5)):(short)0;}
     if(bx>left&&bx<x){left=bx;leftStyle=bar.Count>=5?Word(bar.P(5)):(short)0;}
    }
    if(right==9999)continue;if((double)x-left>9){left=(float)((double)x-3);leftStyle=0;}
    int staffWord=Word(staff);if(staffWord<1||staffUnits==null||staffWord>=staffUnits.Length)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE rest staff leaves its explicit unit table.");float unit=staffUnits[staffWord],value;
    if(mode==-5){
     if(leftStyle<0||leftStyle>=rightOffsets.Length||rightStyle<0||rightStyle>=leftOffsets.Length)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE rest bar style reads outside the recovered offset tables.");
     right=(float)((double)right-leftOffsets[rightStyle]);left=(float)((double)left+rightOffsets[leftStyle]);value=(float)((double)right-x+left);float scale=(float)((double)unit/25);
     if(((double)right-value)/scale>3.5)value=(float)((double)right-(double)scale*3.5);
    }else{float shift=mode==-4?0.137f:0.056f;value=(float)(((double)right-left)*0.5-(double)unit*shift+left);}
    if(oldCount<8)rest.Set(8,0);rest.Set(9,value);
   }return rows;
  }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal static class NativePageScoreLayout {
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart Prepare(IEnumerable<string> paths,int staves,float size,float height,int firstPage,bool centered){
   string[] sources=paths.Select(Path.GetFullPath).ToArray();
   if(sources.Length==0)throw new ArgumentException("Choose at least one input score.");
   return PrepareSources(sources,staves,size,height,firstPage,centered,null,null,null);
  }

  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareOld(string path){
   path=Path.GetFullPath(path);
   var rows=File.ReadAllLines(path).Where(line=>!String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line)).ToArray();
   if(rows.Length!=8)throw new InvalidDataException("Old Page Data has an unexpected row count.");
   Func<string,string[]> fields=line=>line.Split((char[])null,StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
   var header=fields(rows[0]);var counts=fields(rows[1]);var names=fields(rows[2]);var weights=fields(rows[3]);var positions=fields(rows[4]);var units=fields(rows[6]);
   int files,staves,maximum,totalBars,count;
   if(header.Length!=5||!Int32.TryParse(header[0],out files)||files<1||files!=names.Length||files!=counts.Length||
    !Int32.TryParse(header[1],out totalBars)||totalBars!=weights.Length||!Int32.TryParse(header[2],out maximum)||maximum!=32||
    !Int32.TryParse(header[3],out staves)||staves<1||staves>32||units.Length!=32||weights.Length<1||weights.Length>1000||positions.Length!=weights.Length||
    names.Any(name=>Path.GetFileName(name)!=name||name.IndexOf(':')>=0)||
    counts.Any(value=>!Int32.TryParse(value,out count)||count<1||count>1000)||counts.Sum(value=>Int32.Parse(value))!=weights.Length)
    throw new InvalidDataException("Old Page Data has invalid source file or staff fields.");
   float firstUnit;
   if(!Single.TryParse(units[0],System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float,System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out firstUnit)||
    !(firstUnit>0)||Single.IsInfinity(firstUnit))throw new InvalidDataException("Old Page Data has an invalid staff size.");
   var savedWidths=new short[weights.Length];
   var savedPositions=new float[positions.Length];
   var culture=System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
   for(int n=0;n<weights.Length;n++){
    if(!Int16.TryParse(weights[n],out savedWidths[n])||
     !Single.TryParse(positions[n],System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Float,culture,out savedPositions[n])||
     Single.IsNaN(savedPositions[n])||Single.IsInfinity(savedPositions[n]))
     throw new InvalidDataException("Old Page Data has invalid bar widths or positions.");
   }
   var sources=names.Select(name=>Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(path),name)).ToArray();
   return PrepareSources(sources,staves,firstUnit/25,10,1,false,savedWidths,savedPositions,counts.Select(value=>Int32.Parse(value)).ToArray());
  }

  static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareSources(string[] sources,int staves,float size,float height,int firstPage,bool centered,short[] savedWidths,float[] savedPositions,int[] savedFileBars){
   short measurement=0;
   var systems=new List<Score>();
   var weights=new List<short>();
   var leading=new List<short>();
   float scale=(float)((double)size*.01f);
   for(int file=0;file<sources.Length;file++){
    int firstBar=weights.Count;
    var score=Score.Load(sources[file]);
    measurement=NativeMeasurements.Get(score);
    var staffNumbers=score.Items.Where(item=>item.Code==8).Select(item=>item.Staff).OrderBy(n=>n).ToArray();
    if(staves<1||staffNumbers.Length<staves||staffNumbers.Length%staves!=0||
     staffNumbers.Where((number,index)=>number!=index+1).Any()||
     score.Items.Any(item=>item.P(2)!=item.Staff||item.Staff<1||item.Staff>staffNumbers.Length))
     throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE layout requires complete groups of consecutively numbered staves.");
    // PAGE writes DECAA.TMP onward from the top system down. Only the
    // staff number changes in each extracted record before the PAGE sort.
    for(int high=staffNumbers.Length;high>=staves;high-=staves){
     int low=high-staves;
     var rows=score.Items.Where(item=>item.Staff>low&&item.Staff<=high).Select(item=>{
      var copy=item.Clone();
      copy.Set(2,item.Staff-low);
      return copy;
     }).ToList();
     foreach(var header in rows.Where(item=>item.Code==8&&item.P(5)==0))header.Set(5,1);
     var system=new Score{Items=NativePageSort.Apply(rows,false),Trailer=(byte[])score.Trailer.Clone()};
     systems.Add(system);
     var spacing=NativePageBarPlan.PrepareLayoutFile(system);
     if(spacing.Widths.Length!=NativePageBarPlan.Prepare(new[]{system}).FileBars[0]||
      spacing.Widths.Any(width=>width<0))
      throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE score spacing needs a matching unmarked rhythm and spacing plan.");
     for(int n=0;n<spacing.Widths.Length;n++){
      int weight=spacing.Widths[n];
      if(savedWidths!=null&&(weights.Count>=savedWidths.Length||weight!=savedWidths[weights.Count]||
       Math.Abs((double)spacing.Positions[n]-savedPositions[weights.Count])>.0051))
       throw new InvalidDataException("The source score no longer matches Old Page Data.");
      weights.Add(checked((short)Math.Truncate((double)weight*scale+.5)));
      leading.Add(checked((short)(n<spacing.Leading.Length?spacing.Leading[n]:0)));
     }
    }
    if(savedFileBars!=null&&weights.Count-firstBar!=savedFileBars[file])
     throw new InvalidDataException("The source score no longer matches its saved bar count.");
   }
   if(savedWidths!=null&&weights.Count!=savedWidths.Length)throw new InvalidDataException("The source score no longer matches Old Page Data.");
   int total=weights.Sum(weight=>(int)weight);
   if(total<1||total>32767)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE total weight leaves its positive signed-word domain.");
   int lines=Math.Max(1,(int)(total/200.0+.6f));
   int capacity=Math.Max(1,(int)((double)height/(float)((double)staves*size)));
   var proposal=new NativePageAutomaticLayout().Apply(weights.ToArray(),leading.ToArray(),lines,capacity,height,1);
   var groups=new List<int[]>();
   for(int n=0;n<proposal.Bars.Length;n+=capacity)
    groups.Add(proposal.Bars.Skip(n).Take(capacity).Select(count=>(int)count).ToArray());
   var plan=NativePageDefaultPartPlan.NumberedPages(groups,height,firstPage,centered);
   var warnings=new List<string>();
   var pages=NativePagePartPages.AssembleTransposed(systems,staves,size,plan,new float[4],1,(short)1,null,warnings.Add,null,0,0,null,true,savedPositions);
   var writer=new NativePageFileBank(new byte[14200*4]);
   return new NativePagePreparedPart(plan,pages.Select(page=>writer.Encode(page,measurement)).ToArray(),sources,warnings.AsReadOnly());
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal static class NativePageSlurAdjustments {
  static int Bits(float value){return BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(value),0);}
  // PAGE 2F23:07C0..0B96, after LI/J and before final staff assignment.
  internal static List<Item> Apply(IList<Item> input,int bottom,int top){
   var rows=input.Select(item=>item.Clone()).ToList();int cursor=0;
   for(int staff=bottom;staff<=top;staff++){
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal static class NativePageSort {
  static int Integer(double value){if(Double.IsNaN(value)||Double.IsInfinity(value)||value<Int32.MinValue||value>Int32.MaxValue)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE sort key leaves the recovered signed-32 domain.");return (int)value;}
  // 0CC8:0385..060F: signed composite keys, stable minimum selection.
  // Reader mode zero adds the staff number to hundredths of P3; S/X
  // multiplies the staff word by 1,000,000 before adding the position key.
  internal static List<Item> Apply(IList<Item> input,bool staffFirst){
   var rows=input.Select((item,index)=>new{Item=item,Index=index,Key=unchecked((item.Count<3?0:Integer((double)item.P(3)*100))+Integer(item.P(2))*(staffFirst?1000000:1))}).ToArray();
   if(rows.Any(row=>row.Item.Count<2||row.Key>=99000000))throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE sort reaches its short-record or sentinel path.");
   return rows.OrderBy(row=>row.Key).ThenBy(row=>row.Index).Select(row=>row.Item.Clone()).ToList();
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
namespace ScoreModern {
 internal static class NativePageSpacingHelperCalls {
  static float F(byte[] d,int a){return BitConverter.ToSingle(d,a&65535);}
  static short W(byte[] d,int a){return BitConverter.ToInt16(d,a&65535);}
  static void F(byte[] d,int a,double v){Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes((float)v),0,d,a&65535,4);}
  // Actual PAGE 02F1 -> 1E20:0A47: seven pointers to a six-parameter
  // helper. Parameters are DS:779A and count DS:778E, NOT the item.
  // Capture337 verifies entry stack, writes and return stack extent.
  internal static void Meter(byte[] d){
   if(d==null||d.Length!=65536)throw new ArgumentException("PAGE helper requires an explicit complete workspace.");
   F(d,0x778a,0);F(d,0x7778,7.5);int previous=W(d,0x777e);
   if(previous==14){F(d,0x7786,(double)F(d,0x7786)-1.5f);F(d,0x778a,.5);}
   if(previous==1)F(d,0x778a,2);if(previous==17)F(d,0x778a,-1.5);
   Func<int,float> p=n=>F(d,0x779a+(n-1)*4);float scratch=p(5);
   if((p(6)>=10||scratch>=10)&&scratch<=90)F(d,0x7778,(double)F(d,0x7778)+2.5f);
   int last=W(d,0x778e),scanned=0;while(p(last)==0){last=unchecked((short)(last-1));if(++scanned>16384)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE meter helper has no nonzero word in its wrapped scan.");}
   if(last>=8){scratch=0;
    if(last<12||p(12)==0){scratch=4.5f;if(last>=10&&p(10)!=0)scratch=(float)((double)p(10)+scratch);}
    if(last>=11&&p(11)!=0)scratch=(float)((double)p(11)+scratch);
    float extra=p(8)>10||p(9)>10?6:3.5f;F(d,0x7778,(double)F(d,0x7778)+scratch+extra);
   }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativePageSpacingResult {
  internal int[] Widths,Leading,Trailing;internal bool[] LeadingWritten;internal float[] Positions;internal float FinalMultiplier;
 }
 internal static class NativePageSpacingPlan {
  static bool Nonzero(float value){return BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(value),0)!=0;}
  static short Word(double value){long n;if(!FiniteBinary32Integer64.TryConvert(BitConverter.ToUInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes((float)value),0),out n))throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE spacing integer conversion leaves its finite domain.");return unchecked((short)n);}
  // PAGE 0D29:0133..0892. Incoming items are the collector-mutated working
  // copy; assembly later rereads the untouched files. Initial multiplier is
  // explicit because the source retains it through key/meter branches.
  internal static NativePageSpacingResult Collect(IList<Item> input,float[] durations,float initialMultiplier,Action<int,int,float,float,float,float,float> observe=null,byte[] initialWorkspace=null){
   var rows=NativePageSort.Apply(input,false);var widths=new List<int>();var leading=new List<int>();var leadingWritten=new List<bool>();var trailing=new List<int>();var positions=new List<float>();
   float left=0,right=0,minLeft=0,minRight=0,sum=0,scale=initialMultiplier,lastGroup=0;int pending=0,restWeight=0,state=0,previous=0,seen=0;bool started=false;
   byte[] workspace=initialWorkspace==null?new byte[65536]:(byte[])initialWorkspace.Clone();if(workspace.Length!=65536)throw new ArgumentException("PAGE spacing requires a complete explicit workspace.");
   Action<int,float> setFloat=(address,value)=>Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(value),0,workspace,address,4);
   Action<int,int> setWord=(address,value)=>Buffer.BlockCopy(BitConverter.GetBytes(unchecked((short)value)),0,workspace,address,2);
   Action<int,int> put=delegate(int index,int value){while(leading.Count<=index){leading.Add(0);leadingWritten.Add(false);}leading[index]=value;leadingWritten[index]=true;};
   for(int i=0;i<rows.Count;i++){
    Item item=rows[i];int code=Word(item.P(1));
    if(code>=3&&code!=18&&code!=14&&(code!=17||!started))continue;
    if(code<3||code==18||code==17)started=true;
    for(int group=0;group<=rows.Count;group++){
     item=rows[i];var p=new float[14];for(int n=1;n<=Math.Min(item.Count,14);n++)p[n-1]=item.P(n);
     if(p[5]<=-4&&code==1){p[4]=0;p[8]=0;}
     bool scaled=false,skip=false;
     if(code==1){var note=NativePageNoteSpacing.Apply(p,item.Count,item.Count>=10?item.P(10):0);scale=note.Multiplier;left=note.Left;right=note.Right;state=1;}
     else if(code==2){scale=1;left=0;var rest=LayoutRestSpacing.Apply(scale,p[5],p[4],p[3],left,(short)item.Count,p[8],p[9],item.Count>=15?item.P(15):0);left=rest.Left;right=rest.Right;scale=rest.Multiplier;
      if(item.Count>=17&&item.P(17)!=0)p[6]=item.P(17);
      restWeight=Word((double)p[6]*100+.5);if(state==0)put(widths.Count,restWeight);state=2;scaled=true;
     }
     else if(code==14){
      if(pending<=0){pending=-1;skip=true;}
      else if(p[4]>7){if(!Nonzero(right)&&BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(p[3]),0)>=0)skip=true;}
      else if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(p[3]),0)>=0){
       // Measured 02A2: helper left goes to 778A, helper right to P5.
       // PAGE then zeros 778A; 778E is untouched. First helper write
       // replaces P5 with 2.5 before the style conversion.
       var bar=LayoutSymbolSpacing.Bar((short)previous,(short)item.Count,2.5f,p[6],p[7],p[12],p[13]);p[4]=bar.Right;right=0;
      }
     }
     else if(code==17){var key=LayoutSymbolSpacing.Key((short)previous,p[6],p[4]);left=key.Left;right=key.Right;}

     }

    }
   }
   while(leading.Count<widths.Count+1){leading.Add(0);leadingWritten.Add(false);}
   return new NativePageSpacingResult{Widths=widths.ToArray(),Leading=leading.ToArray(),LeadingWritten=leadingWritten.ToArray(),Trailing=trailing.ToArray(),Positions=positions.ToArray(),FinalMultiplier=scale};
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
  // PAGE 0B45:0353..095D: initialize templates from the first extracted

  internal static NativePageInitialization Initialize(IList<Item> input,float sizeRatio,byte[] retained){
   return InitializeMode(input,sizeRatio,retained,false);
  }
  internal static NativePageInitialization InitializeMode(IList<Item> input,float sizeRatio,byte[] retained,bool preserveInstrumentIds){
   if(input==null||input.Count==0||sizeRatio<=0||Single.IsNaN(sizeRatio)||Single.IsInfinity(sizeRatio))throw new ArgumentException("PAGE requires a nonempty first system and a positive finite size ratio.");
   var result=new NativePageInitialization{Input=input.Select(item=>item.Clone()).ToList(),Units=new float[34],Spans=new float[34]};
   var cache=new NativePageTemplates(retained??new byte[10756]);result.Templates=cache;
   Array.Clear(cache.bank,1540,9216);Array.Copy(BitConverter.GetBytes((short)999),0,cache.bank,0,2);Array.Copy(BitConverter.GetBytes((short)0),0,cache.bank,2,2);
   bool rhythmic=false;
   foreach(var item in result.Input){
    int staff=item.Staff;if(item.Code<=2)rhythmic=true;
    if(rhythmic){if(item.Code==14){if(staff<1||staff>32)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE bar span leaves the staff table.");float span=item.Count>=4?item.P(4):1;if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(span),0)==0)span=1;result.Spans[staff]=span;}continue;}

    int type=item.Code==8?1:item.Code==3?5:item.Code==17?6:item.Code==18?7:0;
    if(item.Code==14){if(item.Count<=4)type=2;else{int style=(int)Math.Truncate(item.P(5));if(style==8||style==9)type=style-5;}}
    if(type==0)continue;
    if(type==1&&item.Count<5)item.Set(5,0);
    int words=Math.Min(item.Count+1,12);Array.Copy(item.Bytes,0,cache.bank,cache.Offset(type,staff),words*4);if(words==12)cache.Set(type,staff,0,11);if(type==5)cache.Set(type,staff,0,5);

     float size=cache.Get(1,staff,5);if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(size),0)==0)size=1;double scaled=(double)sizeRatio*size;cache.Set(1,staff,5,(float)scaled);result.Units[staff]=(float)(scaled*25);

   return result;
  }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed partial class NativePageTemplates {
  readonly byte[] bank;
  internal NativePageTemplates(byte[] source){if(source==null||source.Length<10756)throw new ArgumentException("PAGE requires its seven by 32 staff template slots.");bank=(byte[])source.Clone();}
  internal byte[] Bytes{get{return (byte[])bank.Clone();}}
  int Offset(int type,int staff){if(type<1||type>7||staff<1||staff>32)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE template slot is outside the original bank.");return (type-1)*1536+(staff-1)*48+4;}
  float Get(int type,int staff,int parameter){return BitConverter.ToSingle(bank,Offset(type,staff)+parameter*4);}
  void Set(int type,int staff,int parameter,float value){Array.Copy(BitConverter.GetBytes(value),0,bank,Offset(type,staff)+parameter*4,4);}
  Item Copy(int type,int staff){float raw=Get(type,staff,0);if(Single.IsNaN(raw)||Single.IsInfinity(raw)||raw<1||raw>=12)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE template record length is outside its original 12-word slot.");int count=(int)Math.Truncate(raw);var bytes=new byte[(count+1)*4];Array.Copy(bank,Offset(type,staff),bytes,0,bytes.Length);return new Item(bytes);}
  // PAGE 084F:007D..033C. The caller has already removed Staff records
  // and executed the separate initial bar/time cleanup.
  internal List<Item> Insert(IList<Item> input){
   var rows=input.Select(item=>item.Clone()).ToList();int bottom=BitConverter.ToInt16(bank,0),top=BitConverter.ToInt16(bank,2);
   if(bottom<1||top>32||bottom>top)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE template staff bounds are invalid.");
   for(int type=1;type<=7;type++)for(int staff=bottom;staff<=top;staff++){
    if((int)Math.Truncate(Get(type,staff,0))==0)continue;
    if(type>=6){
     for(int n=0;n<rows.Count;n++){
      var item=rows[n];if(item.Staff!=staff)continue;if(item.Code<=2)break;
      if(item.Code==17&&type==6){rows.RemoveAt(n--);continue;}
      if(item.Code==18&&type==7){Set(type,staff,0,0);break;}
     }
     if((int)Math.Truncate(Get(type,staff,0))==0)continue;
    }
    if(type==5){Set(6,staff,6,Get(5,staff,5));float count=Get(6,staff,0);if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(count),0)!=0&&count<6)Set(6,staff,0,6);}
    rows.Add(Copy(type,staff));if(type==7)Set(type,staff,0,0);
    if(type==5)DeduplicateClefs(rows,staff);
   }
   return rows;
  }
  // PAGE resident 0B45:0A57..0C59. The appended starting clef is kept;
  // earlier matching clefs are removed or marked as changes with P4+100.
  void DeduplicateClefs(List<Item> rows,int staff){
   float code=Get(5,staff,1),owner=Get(5,staff,2);
   for(int n=0;n<rows.Count-1;n++){
    var item=rows[n];if(item.P(1)!=code||item.P(2)!=owner||code!=3)continue;float value=item.Count>=5?item.P(5):0;
    if(value==Get(5,staff,5)){rows.RemoveAt(n--);continue;}
    Set(5,staff,5,value);if(item.Count<4)item.Set(4,100);else if(item.P(4)<100)item.Set(4,(float)((double)item.P(4)+100));
   }
  }
 }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativePageTranspose {
  readonly short semitones;
  readonly string normalizationRoot;
  readonly bool addKey;
  readonly short? clef;
  readonly bool page4,preservePitch;
  internal Action<string> ReportWarning;
  internal NativePageTranspose():this(2){}
  internal NativePageTranspose(short interval){
   if(interval < -12 || interval > 23)
    throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE transposition supports intervals from down one octave to up a major fourteenth.");
   semitones=interval;
  }
  internal NativePageTranspose(short interval,string root):this(interval){normalizationRoot=root;}
  internal NativePageTranspose(short interval,string root,bool key):this(interval,root){
   addKey=key;
  }
  internal NativePageTranspose(short interval,string root,bool key,short? targetClef,bool page4=false,bool preservePitch=false):this(interval,root,key){
   if(targetClef.HasValue&&(targetClef.Value<0||targetClef.Value>3))throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE clef conversion requires a standard clef.");
   clef=targetClef;
   this.page4=page4;this.preservePitch=preservePitch;
  }
  readonly TranspositionWorkspace workspace=new TranspositionWorkspace(
   new TranspositionCollectorState(0),new TranspositionClefState(0x2020,0x2020),
   new short[200],new short[200],0,new TranspositionRelationshipWindow(),true);

  // 0CC8:03E3 copies the unsorted parameter bank to the scratch
  // segment. PAGE 1176:0F43 later tests the preceding word of the
  // accidental flags. The flag-clear routine starts two bytes later.
  internal void RetainSortScratch(IList<Item> records){
   const int kindZeroOffset=0x09d2;
   int offset=kindZeroOffset;
   foreach(var record in records){
    var bytes=record.Bytes;
    if(offset+2<=bytes.Length){
     workspace.KindZeroGuard=BitConverter.ToInt16(bytes,offset);
     return;
    }
    offset-=bytes.Length;
   }
  }

  // PAGE 0DFF:0235 reuses one workspace across the staff passes.
  // PAGE calls the tonal engine before LI/J and
  // adjusts attachments itself (05C7..06B7), without Main TR's slur rounding.
  internal List<Item> Apply(IList<Item> input){
   if(preservePitch&&input.Any(i=>i.Code==1&&Math.Abs((int)i.P(5))%10>5))throw new NotSupportedException("Quarter-tone transposition is outside the recovered conventional accidental table. The source has not been changed.");
   int staffCount=input.Where(item=>item.Code==8).Select(item=>item.Staff).DefaultIfEmpty(1).Max();
   if(staffCount<1||staffCount>32)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE transposition requires 1–32 staves.");
   if(input.Any(i=>i.Staff<1||i.Staff>staffCount||((i.Code==5||i.Code==6)&&
    (i.Count<6||
     Math.Abs(i.P(4))>=100&&!(i.Code==6&&i.Count>=7&&i.P(7)>=10&&i.P(7)<=19&&i.P(7)==Math.Truncate(i.P(7))&&Math.Abs(i.P(4))<200)||
     Math.Abs(i.P(5))>=100||i.P(3)<0||i.P(3)>201||i.P(6)<0))))
    throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE transposition requires ordinary beam and slur controls.");
   var source=input.Select(i=>Enumerable.Range(1,i.Count).Select(i.P).ToArray()).ToList();
   short shift=0;var staffShifts=new Dictionary<int,int>();
   for(int staff=1;staff<=staffCount;staff++){
    var before=preservePitch?source.Select(row=>(float[])row.Clone()).ToList():null;
    var session=InputTranspositionOperation.Begin(source,new TranspositionRequest{Staff=staff,Left=0,Right=200,Semitones=semitones},workspace);
    if(clef.HasValue)InputTranspositionOperation.ChangeClef(session,clef.Value);
    bool insertKey=addKey&&!(preservePitch&&source.Any(row=>row.Length>=8&&row[0]==17&&row[1]==staff&&row[7]!=0));
    var transposed=InputTranspositionOperation.FinishCore(session,insertKey,false);
    if(transposed.Rows.Count!=source.Count+(transposed.InsertedKey?1:0))
     throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE transposition reaches an unverified key or fingering path.");
    if(transposed.WarningRequired&&ReportWarning!=null)ReportWarning(InputTranspositionEmbeddedControl.FingeringWarning);
    if(preservePitch)InputChromaticPitchCorrection.Apply(before,transposed.Rows,(short)staff,semitones);
    staffShifts[staff]=session.Result.Interval.Diatonic;
    source=transposed.Rows;
    shift=session.Result.Interval.Diatonic;
   }
   var result=new List<Item>();
   for(int n=0;n<input.Count;n++){
    var row=source[n];
    bool resized=row.Length!=input[n].Count;
    if(resized&&!((input[n].Code==3&&input[n].Count<5&&row.Length==5)||(input[n].Code==17&&input[n].Count<6&&row.Length==6)))throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE transposition changes an unsupported record extent.");
    var item=input[n].Clone();if(resized)item.Bytes=Item.Make(row).Bytes;
    for(int p=1;p<=row.Length;p++)if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(row[p-1]),0)!=BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(item.P(p)),0))item.Set(p,row[p-1]);
    if(item.Code==5||item.Code==6){int localShift=preservePitch?staffShifts[item.Staff]:shift;for(int endpoint=0;endpoint<2;endpoint++){int parameter=endpoint==0?4:5;float x=item.P(endpoint==0?3:6);int correction=0;if(preservePitch){var notes=Enumerable.Range(0,input.Count).Where(k=>input[k].Code==1&&input[k].Staff==item.Staff&&Math.Abs(input[k].P(3)-x)<.0001).OrderBy(k=>Math.Abs(input[k].P(4)%100-input[n].P(parameter)%100)).ToArray();if(notes.Length>0){int note=notes[0];float delta=source[note][3]%100-input[note].P(4)%100;float value=input[n].P(parameter)+delta;if(item.Code==6&&parameter==4&&Math.Abs(input[n].P(4))>=100){float pitch=input[n].P(4)%100+delta;value=pitch+(pitch<0?-100:100);}item.Set(parameter,value);continue;}}item.Set(parameter,(float)((double)item.P(parameter)+localShift+correction));}}
    result.Add(item);
   }
   for(int n=input.Count;n<source.Count;n++){
    var key=source[n];
    if(key.Length!=6||key[0]!=17||key[1]<1||key[1]>staffCount)throw new InvalidOperationException("Unexpected PAGE key insertion record.");
    result.Add(Item.Make(key));
   }
   return normalizationRoot==null?result:Editor.NormalizePageStems(result,normalizationRoot,page4);
  }
 }
````
