````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal static class NativePageTurnPlan {
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart Prepare(string path,float quarters,int requested,float size,float height,int firstPage,bool centered,int linesPerPage=1){
   string source=Path.GetFullPath(path);var score=Score.Load(source);
   var headers=score.Items.Where(i=>i.Code==8).OrderBy(i=>i.Staff).ToArray();int staves=headers.Length;
   if(staves<1||staves>32||headers.Where((h,n)=>h.Staff!=n+1).Any()||score.Items.Any(i=>i.Staff<1||i.Staff>staves)||linesPerPage<1||linesPerPage>32/staves)
    throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE turns require one extracted system of consecutive staves and a lines-per-page count within the 32-staff output bank.");
   var raw=NativePageBarPlan.PrepareLayoutFile(score);
   var widths=new short[raw.Widths.Length];var leading=new short[widths.Length];
   for(int n=0;n<widths.Length;n++){
    var value=Math.Truncate(Math.Abs((double)raw.Widths[n])*(float)((double)size*.01f)+.5);
    if(value<1||value>32767)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE turn bar width leaves the original bank.");
    widths[n]=(short)value;leading[n]=checked((short)Math.Min(raw.Leading[n+1]+raw.Trailing[n],9000));
   }
   return Assemble(source,score,widths,leading,quarters,requested,size,height,firstPage,centered,linesPerPage,staves);
  }
  internal static NativePagePreparedPart PrepareOld(string path,float quarters,int requested,int linesPerPage=1,int firstPage=1){
   path=Path.GetFullPath(path);
   var lines=File.ReadAllLines(path).Where(s=>!String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)).ToArray();
   Func<string,string[]> fields=s=>s.Split((char[])null,StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
   if(lines.Length!=8)throw new NotSupportedException("Old Page Data currently supports a single SCORE system with its source file beside BARS.TMP.");
   var header=fields(lines[0]);var barCount=fields(lines[1]);var weights=fields(lines[3]);var positions=fields(lines[4]);var turns=fields(lines[5]);var staff=fields(lines[6]);
   int count;
   string name=lines[2].Trim();
   if(header.Length!=5||header[0]!="1"||barCount.Length!=1||!Int32.TryParse(barCount[0],out count)||count<2||count>1000||
    weights.Length!=count||positions.Length!=count||turns.Length!=count||staff.Length!=32||String.IsNullOrEmpty(name)||Path.GetFileName(name)!=name||name.IndexOf(':')>=0)
    throw new InvalidDataException("Old Page Data does not contain a supported single-system job.");
   string source=Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(path),name);
   var score=Score.Load(source);
   if(score.Items.Count(i=>i.Code==8)!=1||score.Items.Any(i=>i.Staff!=1))throw new NotSupportedException("Old Page Data is verified for a single staff.");
   float size;int inches;
   if(!Single.TryParse(staff[0],NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out size)||size!=25f||!Int32.TryParse(header[1],out inches)||inches!=10)
    throw new NotSupportedException("Old Page Data is verified for the original size-1, ten-inch page route.");
   var fresh=NativePageBarPlan.PrepareLayoutFile(score);
   if(fresh.Widths.Length!=count)throw new InvalidDataException("The source score no longer matches Old Page Data.");
   var widths=new short[count];var gaps=new short[count];
   for(int n=0;n<count;n++){
    short weight;float position;
    if(!Int16.TryParse(weights[n],out weight)||weight!=fresh.Widths[n]||!Single.TryParse(positions[n],NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out position)||Single.IsNaN(position)||
      Math.Abs((double)position-fresh.Positions[n])>.0051||!Int16.TryParse(turns[n],out gaps[n])||gaps[n]!=Math.Min(fresh.Leading[n+1]+fresh.Trailing[n],9000))
     throw new InvalidDataException("The source score no longer matches the saved bar plan.");
    widths[n]=checked((short)Math.Truncate(Math.Abs((double)weight)*.01f+.5));
   }
   return Assemble(source,score,widths,gaps,quarters,requested,1,10,firstPage,false,linesPerPage);
  }
  static NativePagePreparedPart Assemble(string source,Score score,short[] widths,short[] leading,float quarters,int requested,float size,float height,int firstPage,bool centered,int linesPerPage=1,int staves=1){
   var plan=NativePageDefaultPartPlan.NumberedPages(Propose(widths,leading,leading,quarters,requested,height,linesPerPage,firstPage),height,firstPage,centered);
   var warnings=new List<string>();
   var pages=NativePagePartPages.AssembleTransposed(new[]{score},staves,size,plan,new float[4],1,1,null,warnings.Add,null,0,0,null,true);
   var writer=new NativePageFileBank(new byte[14200*4]);short measurement=NativeMeasurements.Get(score);
   return new NativePagePreparedPart(plan,pages.Select(p=>writer.Encode(p,measurement)).ToArray(),new[]{source},warnings.AsReadOnly());
  }
  // PAGE 3197:108B..13EF chooses candidate ends and page counts;
  // 0FE6:11CC..137A replans each selected segment.
  internal static List<int[]> Propose(short[] widths,short[] turns,short[] leading,float quarters,int requested,float height,int linesPerPage=1,int firstPage=1){
   if(widths==null||turns==null||leading==null||widths.Length<2||widths.Length>1000||turns.Length!=widths.Length||leading.Length!=widths.Length||
    widths.Any(x=>x<=0)||turns.Any(x=>x<0)||requested<1||requested>99||linesPerPage<1||linesPerPage>32||firstPage<0||firstPage>32767||quarters<=0||quarters>300||Single.IsNaN(quarters))
    throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE turn planning requires positive page, line and silence controls within the original capacities.");
   var gaps=(short[])turns.Clone();gaps[gaps.Length-1]=30000;
   int total=widths.Sum(x=>(int)x),start=0,groupPages=firstPage%2==0?2:1,remaining=requested;
   if(total>32767)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE turn weights exceed the original table.");
   int minimum=(int)((double)quarters*100+.5);if(minimum==0)minimum=200;
   var result=new List<int[]>();var planner=new NativePageAutomaticLayout();
   while(start<widths.Length){
    int desired=remaining>0?remaining:total/200;
    if(desired<1)throw new NotSupportedException("PAGE turn request leaves no valid candidate pages.");
    if(desired<2)groupPages=1;
    remaining-=groupPages;
    int goal=(int)(float)((double)(total*groupPages)/desired),threshold=minimum;
    int end,subtotal;
    while(true){
     end=start;subtotal=widths[end];
     while(subtotal<goal&&end+1<widths.Length)subtotal+=widths[++end];
     if(subtotal<goal)throw new NotSupportedException("SCORE's turn search extends past the last bar.");
     int before=end,after=end,low=subtotal,high=subtotal,step=-1;
     while(gaps[end]<threshold){
      if(subtotal<goal/2){threshold-=50;break;}
      if(++step==0){
       if(++after>=widths.Length)throw new NotSupportedException("SCORE's turn search reads past the bar table.");
       high+=widths[after];subtotal=high;end=after;
      }else{
       if(step>=groupPages)step=-1;
       if(--before<0)throw new NotSupportedException("SCORE's turn search reads before the bar table.");
       low-=widths[before];subtotal=low;end=before;
      }
     }
     if(gaps[end]>=threshold)break;
    }
    total-=subtotal;
    if(total<=200)end=widths.Length-1;
    int count=end-start+1;
    if(count<groupPages*linesPerPage)throw new NotSupportedException("SCORE's turn proposal has an empty page.");
    var layout=planner.Apply(widths.Skip(start).Take(count).ToArray(),leading.Skip(start).Take(count).ToArray(),groupPages*linesPerPage,linesPerPage,height,1);
    result.AddRange(NativePageDefaultPartPlan.GroupLines(layout,count));
    start=end+1;groupPages=2;
   }
   return result;
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativePrintCaptions {
  sealed class Cell {
   internal float X,Y,Width;
   internal string Text,Font;
  }
  readonly List<Cell> cells=new List<Cell>();
  readonly List<float> tops=new List<float>();
  static readonly float[] dividers={211,327,401,450};

  internal NativePrintCaptions(NativePrintJob job,Score score):this(job,score,null,false){}
  internal NativePrintCaptions(NativePrintJob job,Score score,string displayedName,bool scorlas){
   if(job.Header.Equals("None",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))return;
   var source=score.SourcePath;
   string name=displayedName??(String.IsNullOrEmpty(source)?"":Path.GetFileName(source).ToUpperInvariant());
   DateTime? created=String.IsNullOrEmpty(source)||!File.Exists(source)?(DateTime?)null:File.GetLastWriteTime(source);
   var culture=CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
   string[] values={name,job.Project,created.HasValue?created.Value.ToString("MM-dd-yy",culture):"",
    created.HasValue?created.Value.ToString("HH:mm",culture):"",
    Number(job.Size)+" "+Number(job.Left/4000.0)+" "+Number(job.Bottom/4000.0)+"  "+job.Resolution+" "+job.LineWidth};
   if(scorlas){
    // SCORLAS0AE1:15B4..1659 decodes the DOS stamp, adds80 to
    // its year, then splits each date/time field with signed IDIV10.
    // Format077E prints each digit in one column; an overflowing tens
    // word becomes '*'. Preserve that original post-1999 behavior.
    values[0]=name.PadRight(24);values[1]=job.Project.PadRight(18);
    if(created.HasValue){var stamp=created.Value;if(stamp.Year<1980||stamp.Year>2107)throw new NotSupportedException("SCORLAS caption date is outside the DOS timestamp domain.");values[2]=Digits(stamp.Month)+"-"+Digits(stamp.Day)+"-"+Digits(stamp.Year-1900);values[3]=Digits(stamp.Hour)+":"+Digits(stamp.Minute);}
    // Format07A0: F4.2,2F6.2,I5,I2; each width is independent.
    float left=job.Left/4000f,bottom=job.Bottom/4000f;bool metric=NativeMeasurements.Get(score)==1;
    if(metric){left=(float)((double)left*2.54f);bottom=(float)((double)bottom*2.54f);}
    values[4]=Field(job.Size,4)+Field(left,6,metric?1:2)+Field(bottom,6,metric?1:2)+job.Resolution.ToString(culture).PadLeft(5)+job.LineWidth.ToString(culture).PadLeft(2);
   }
   if(!job.Header.Equals("Footer",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
    Add((float)Math.Round(72*(job.PaperHeight+job.HeaderOffset)),values);
   if(!job.Header.Equals("Header",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
    Add((float)Math.Round(72*job.FooterOffset)+12,values);
  }
  static string Digits(int value){int tens=value/10,ones=value%10;return (tens>9?"*":tens.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))+ones.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);}
  static string Field(float value,int width,int places=2){string text=RecoveredFragments.SingleFixedDecimal.Format(value,places);if(text.StartsWith("0."))text=text.Substring(1);else if(text.StartsWith("-0."))text="-"+text.Substring(2);return text.Length>width?new string('*',width):text.PadLeft(width);}
  static string Number(double value){return value.ToString(".00",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);}
  void Add(float top,string[] values){
   tops.Add(top);
   string[] labels={"SCORE File:","Project:","File Date:","Time:","Print data:"};
   float[] lx={22,213,329,403,453},vx={69,241,363,425,490};
   for(int n=0;n<labels.Length;n++){
    cells.Add(new Cell{X=lx[n],Y=top-9,Width=8.5f,Text=labels[n],Font="Times-Roman"});
    cells.Add(new Cell{X=vx[n],Y=top-9,Width=9,Text=values[n],Font="Helvetica-Bold"});
   }
  }
  internal string PostScript(){
   var result=new StringBuilder();
   result.AppendLine("gsave 0 setgray .1 setlinewidth");
   foreach(float top in tops){
    result.AppendLine("newpath 20 "+N(top)+" moveto 590 "+N(top)+" lineto 590 "+N(top-11)+" lineto 20 "+N(top-11)+" lineto closepath");
    foreach(float x in dividers)result.AppendLine(N(x)+" "+N(top)+" moveto "+N(x)+" "+N(top-11)+" lineto");
    result.AppendLine("stroke");
   }
   foreach(var cell in cells){
    string hex=BitConverter.ToString(Encoding.GetEncoding(1252).GetBytes(cell.Text)).Replace("-","");
    result.AppendLine("/"+cell.Font+" findfont ["+N(cell.Width)+" 0 0 9 0 0] makefont setfont "+N(cell.X)+" "+N(cell.Y)+" moveto <"+hex+"> show");
   }
   return result.AppendLine("grestore").ToString();
  }
  internal void Draw(Graphics graphics,float pageHeight){
   if(cells.Count==0)return;
   var fonts=new Dictionary<string,Type1Outline>();
   foreach(var cell in cells){
    if(fonts.ContainsKey(cell.Font))continue;
    var font=NativeTupletFonts.Find(cell.Font);
    if(font==null)throw new FileNotFoundException("Print captions require the external "+cell.Font+" Type 1 font.");
    fonts.Add(cell.Font,font);
   }
   using(var pen=new Pen(Color.Black,.1f)){
    foreach(float top in tops){
     float y=pageHeight-top;
     graphics.DrawRectangle(pen,20,y,570,11);
     foreach(float x in dividers)graphics.DrawLine(pen,x,y,x,y+11);
    }
   }
   foreach(var cell in cells){
    float x=cell.X;
    foreach(char character in cell.Text){
     float advance;
     using(var path=fonts[cell.Font].Character(character,out advance)){
      if(path.PointCount!=0){
       using(var transform=new Matrix(cell.Width/1000,0,0,-9f/1000,x,pageHeight-cell.Y))
        path.Transform(transform);
       graphics.FillPath(Brushes.Black,path);
      }
     }
     x+=advance*cell.Width/1000;
    }
   }
  }
  static string N(float value){return value.ToString("0.####",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);}
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Windows.Forms;
namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativePrintCommandBox:TextBox {
  internal Func<bool> AppendOnly;
  bool OriginalReader{get{return AppendOnly!=null&&AppendOnly();}}
  // Original2E2C:145E..1538 appends printable bytes, ignores navigation,
  // and backspaces the final byte. It is independent of the shared line editor.
  protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e){
   base.OnKeyDown(e);if(e.Handled||e.SuppressKeyPress||!OriginalReader)return;
   if(e.Modifiers==Keys.None&&e.KeyCode==Keys.Back){if(TextLength>0)Text=Text.Substring(0,TextLength-1);SelectionStart=TextLength;e.Handled=e.SuppressKeyPress=true;return;}
   if((e.Modifiers&(Keys.Control|Keys.Alt))!=0||e.KeyCode==Keys.Left||e.KeyCode==Keys.Right||e.KeyCode==Keys.Up||e.KeyCode==Keys.Down||e.KeyCode==Keys.Home||e.KeyCode==Keys.End||e.KeyCode==Keys.Insert||e.KeyCode==Keys.Delete||e.KeyCode==Keys.PageUp||e.KeyCode==Keys.PageDown||e.KeyCode==Keys.Tab)e.Handled=e.SuppressKeyPress=true;
  }
  protected override void OnKeyPress(KeyPressEventArgs e){base.OnKeyPress(e);if(e.Handled||!OriginalReader)return;if(e.KeyChar>=32&&e.KeyChar<=255){Text+=e.KeyChar;SelectionStart=TextLength;e.Handled=true;}else if(e.KeyChar!=13)e.Handled=true;}
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativePrintedChordGrid {
  internal sealed class Grid {
   public float X,Y,Top,Right,Horizontal,Vertical,Size,TextSize,TextY,FingeringSize;
   public int Strings,Frets,Markers,Font,Fingering,Barre;
   public bool Nut,Visible;
   public string Name;
  }
  static readonly float[] CrossX={-55,45,55,-45,-55};
  static readonly float[] CrossY={34,135,135,34,34};
  static float F(double x){return (float)x;}
  internal sealed class State {
   internal Grid Geometry;internal int First,Last,Minimum=99,LastOpen;
   internal void Advance(Grid grid,Item item){
    // Lookup writes only the first endpoint. Geometry/string loops and
    // 0B98:04CB..0506 independently replace the retained endpoint words.
    if(item.P(5)<=-4)First=item.P(5)==-5?1:Math.Max(0,Math.Min(4,(int)item.P(9)))+1;
    if(!grid.Visible)return;
    Geometry=grid;First=grid.Strings*160;
    if(grid.Barre>=100){First=grid.Barre/1000;if(First==0)First=1;Last=grid.Barre/100%10;if(Last==0)Last=6;}
    if(grid.Markers==0)return;
    Minimum=99;LastOpen=0;
    int remaining=grid.Markers,divisor=(int)Math.Pow(10,Math.Min(grid.Strings,6)-1);
    for(int n=1;n<=Math.Min(grid.Strings,6);n++){
     int digit=remaining/divisor;remaining%=divisor;divisor=Math.Max(1,divisor/10);
     if(digit>=8)LastOpen=n;
     else if(digit>0&&(n==First||n==Last))Minimum=Math.Min(Minimum,digit);
    }
   }
  }
  internal static State InitialState(NativePageDocument document,Score score,ScoreText text){
   var state=new State();if(score==null)return state;
   // Natural G redraw precedes the measured F6 scan. Run the same recovered
   // cache writes without drawing; no fixture-specific endpoint seed.
   foreach(var item in score.Items)if(item.Code==12&&item.P(5)<0){var grid=Prepare(item,document.Contexts[item],text);if(grid!=null)state.Advance(grid,item);}
   return state;
  }
  static List<PrimitiveTextPoint> RetainedBarre(Grid grid,State state,NativeNotationContext p,NativeDatGlyphs dat){
   if(grid.Visible||grid.Barre<100||state==null||state.Geometry==null||state.Last-state.First<1)return new List<PrimitiveTextPoint>();
   var frame=state.Geometry;int span=state.Last-state.First;
   float top=frame.Nut?F((double)frame.Top+frame.Vertical*60/160):frame.Top;
   float y=state.Minimum>1?F((double)top-(state.Minimum-1)*frame.Vertical):F((double)top+grid.Size*p.Scale*(state.LastOpen>=state.First&&state.LastOpen<=state.Last?8:4));
   float x=F((double)frame.X+(state.First-1)*frame.Horizontal),aspect=F((double)frame.Horizontal/frame.Vertical);
   return dat.ExternalDrawing(209,F((double)span*grid.Size*aspect*.2f),F((double)grid.Size*(span*.05f+.55f)),p.Scale,x,y);
  }

  // SCORE Code 12 grid, relative 0273:1010–1FF7.
  static Grid Prepare(Item i,NativeNotationContext p,ScoreText text){
   int subtype=(int)i.P(5),root=(int)i.P(7),dims=(int)i.P(14);
   if(subtype<-6||subtype>-1||subtype!=i.P(5)||root!=i.P(7)||root/10<1||root/10>7||root%10>2||
    dims!=i.P(14)||dims<0||dims>99||i.P(13)<0||i.P(13)>999999||i.P(13)!=(int)i.P(13))return null;
   bool lookup=subtype<=-4;
   if(i.P(20)!=0)return null;
   if(!lookup&&(i.P(8)<0||i.P(8)>9||i.P(8)!=(int)i.P(8)||i.P(9)<0||i.P(9)>699||i.P(9)!=(int)i.P(9)||
    i.P(10)<0||i.P(10)>3399||i.P(10)!=(int)i.P(10)||i.P(11)<0||i.P(11)>7399||i.P(11)!=(int)i.P(11)))return null;
   if(i.P(18)<0||i.P(18)>999999||i.P(18)!=(int)i.P(18)||i.P(12)<0||i.P(12)>=6667||Single.IsNaN(i.P(12)))return null;
   float size=i.P(6)==0?1:i.P(6),aspect=i.P(17)==0?1:Math.Abs(i.P(17));
   if(!(size>0&&size<=10&&aspect>0&&aspect<=10&&Math.Abs(i.P(15))<=200&&Math.Abs(i.P(19))<=50))return null;
   int columns=dims/10,frets=dims%10;
   if(columns<2)columns=6;
   if(frets==0)frets=5;
   int font=(int)i.P(16)/10;
   float labelScale=F(i.P(16)%10);
   if(font<0||font>99||labelScale<0)return null;
   if(labelScale==0)labelScale=1;
   float unit=F((double)size*p.Scale*.07500000298023224f);
   float x=F((double)p.Prepared.X+i.P(15)*150),y=p.Prepared.Y;
   var grid=new Grid{X=x,Y=y,Horizontal=F((double)unit*aspect*160),Vertical=F((double)unit*160),
    Size=size,TextSize=F((double)size*labelScale),Strings=columns,Frets=frets,Markers=(int)i.P(13),Font=font,
    Visible=true,Nut=false,Barre=(int)i.P(12),Fingering=(int)i.P(18),Name="CDEFGAB"[root/10-1].ToString()};
   if(root%10!=0)grid.Name+="?"+(root%10);
   if(!lookup)grid.Name+=ManualSuffix(i);
   if(lookup){
    if(i.P(10)!=0||i.P(11)!=0||i.P(12)!=0||i.P(13)!=0)return null;
    int chord=(int)i.P(8),alternative=(int)i.P(9);
    if(chord<0||chord>20||i.P(8)!=chord||i.P(9)!=alternative)return null;
    if(chord==0)chord=1;
    if(alternative<0||alternative>4||subtype==-5)alternative=0;
    ReadChord(grid,text.RootDirectory,root,chord,alternative);
    if(subtype==-6)grid.Name="";
   }
   // Original 0273:211B-2126 / 226C-2279: lookup grids become -1,
   // except name-only -5; a fret number switches that result to -2.
   // 111A-1140 then forces -2 for negative P17 before visibility tests.
   int style=lookup?(subtype==-5?-5:-1):subtype;
   if(lookup&&grid.Barre%100!=0)style=-2;
   if(i.P(17)<0)style=-2;
   grid.FingeringSize=F((double)size*F((1-(double)labelScale)/3.5+labelScale));
   grid.Visible=style!=-3&&style!=-5;
   grid.Nut=style==-1;
   grid.Top=F((double)y+grid.Vertical*frets);
   grid.Right=F((double)x+grid.Horizontal*(columns-1));
   float titleBaseP4=F((double)(frets-1)*size*1.7200000286102295f+i.P(4));
   float titleP4=F(((double)i.P(19)+5.199999809265137f)*size+titleBaseP4);
   grid.TextY=grid.Visible?F((double)titleP4*p.Scale*7+p.RawBase):y;
   return grid;
  }

  static string ManualSuffix(Item item){
   string[] kinds={"","maj","m","?0","?9","+","dim","aug","?-","?8"};
   string suffix=kinds[(int)item.P(8)];
   int interval=(int)item.P(9),addition=(int)item.P(10),bass=(int)item.P(11);
   suffix+=Interval(interval);
   if(addition!=0){
    int mode=addition/1000;
    string prefix=mode==1?"sus":mode==2?"add":mode==3?"(add":"";
    suffix+=prefix+Interval(addition%1000)+(mode==3?")":"");
   }
   if(bass!=0){
    int letter=bass/1000;
    suffix+="/"+(letter==0?"":"CDEFGAB"[letter-1].ToString())+Interval(bass%1000);
   }
   return suffix;
  }
  static string Interval(int value){
   int modifier=value/100,number=value%100;
   string mark=modifier>=1&&modifier<=3?"?"+modifier:modifier==4?"+":modifier==5?"?-":modifier==6?"8":"";
   return mark+(number==0?"":number.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
  }
  // 0273:20F8-2291 indexes twenty entries per chromatic pitch.
  static void ReadChord(Grid grid,string rootPath,int note,int chord,int alternative){
   int pitch=note*2/10-1;
   if(pitch>6)pitch--;
   if(note%10!=0)pitch+=2*(note%10)-3;
   pitch=(pitch+11)%12;
   string file=NativeLibraryLocation.FileFor(rootPath,"GUITAR.DAT");
   int row=pitch*20+chord-1;
   using(var reader=new StreamReader(file,System.Text.Encoding.GetEncoding(437))){
    string line=null;
    for(int n=0;n<=row;n++)line=reader.ReadLine();
    if(line==null)throw new InvalidDataException("GUITAR.DAT is missing the requested chord row.");
    string[] fields=line.Split(';');
    if(fields.Length<3)throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid GUITAR.DAT chord row.");
    string[] values=fields[1].Split((char[])null,StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
    int index=1+3*alternative;
    if(values.Length<index+3||values[index].Length!=6)throw new InvalidDataException("GUITAR.DAT is missing the requested fingering.");
    grid.Markers=0;
    foreach(char marker in values[index]){
     int digit=marker=='x'||marker=='X'?9:marker=='o'||marker=='O'?8:marker-'0';
     if(digit<0||digit>9)throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid GUITAR.DAT string marker.");
     grid.Markers=grid.Markers*10+digit;
    }
    grid.Barre=ReadNumber(values[index+1]);
    if(grid.Fingering==0)grid.Fingering=ReadNumber(values[index+2]);
    grid.Nut=grid.Barre%100==0;
    string name=fields[0].Trim();
    if(name.Length==0||name.Length>20||name[0]<'A'||name[0]>'G')
     throw new NotSupportedException("GUITAR.DAT chord name outside the verified format.");
    int prefix=name.Length>=3&&name[1]=='?'&&(name[2]=='1'||name[2]=='2')?3:1;
    grid.Name+=name.Substring(prefix);
   }
  }
  static int ReadNumber(string source){
   int value;
   if(!Int32.TryParse(source,NumberStyles.None,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out value))
    throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid GUITAR.DAT numeric field.");
   return value;
  }

  static Item Label(Item source,float size,int font){
   return Item.Make(16,source.P(2),source.P(3),source.P(4),1,size,0,1000+font,0,0,0,1,0);
  }
  static NativeNotationContext LabelPosition(NativeNotationContext p,float x,float y){
   var context=new NativeNotationContext{Staff=p.Staff,Projection=p.Projection,RawBase=p.RawBase,Prepared=p.Prepared};
   context.Prepared.X=x;
   context.Prepared.Y=y;
   return context;
  }
  static float LabelX(Grid grid,NativeNotationContext p,ScoreText text,Item label){
   if(!grid.Visible)return grid.X;
   // The text converter returns the width in horizontal SCORE units.
   return F((double)grid.X+((double)grid.Right-grid.X-text.PrepareLayout(label,grid.Name,p.Scale,0).Width*150)/2);
  }
  static void Point(List<PrimitiveTextPoint> points,float x,float y,short op=0){
   points.Add(new PrimitiveTextPoint{X=x,Y=y,Operation=op});
  }
  static void Fingerings(Grid grid,Item item,NativeNotationContext p,ScoreText text,Graphics g,List<PrimitiveTextPoint> points,int column){
   if(grid.Fingering==0||column>=6)return;
   int digit=grid.Fingering.ToString("D6",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)[column]-'0';
   if(digit>=5&&digit<=7)return;
   string value=digit==9?"T":digit==8?"0":digit.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
   float columnX=F((double)grid.X+grid.Horizontal*column);
   float x=F((double)columnX-grid.FingeringSize*.03200000151991844f*p.Scale*150);
   if(g!=null){
    // 0273:13D5-13E4 stores P3 after division/subtraction; the printer
    // truncates the subsequent single-precision product by 150.
    float offset=F((double)p.Scale*.03200000151991844f*grid.FingeringSize);
    float position=F((double)columnX/150-offset);
    x=(int)F((double)position*150);
   }
   float y=F((double)grid.Y-grid.FingeringSize*2.5999999046325684f*p.Scale*7);
   TextAt(g,item,p,text,points,value,F((double)grid.FingeringSize*.6000000238418579f),0,x,y);
  }
  static void TextAt(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext p,ScoreText text,List<PrimitiveTextPoint> points,string value,float size,int font,float x,float y,float spacing=0){
   var body=Label(item,size,font);
   body.Set(10,spacing);
   var context=LabelPosition(p,x,y);
   if(g==null)points.AddRange(text.ScanStrokeText(body,value,context,0));
   else{
    text.Set(body,value,p.Scale);
    text.Draw(g,body,body.Text,0,0,p.Scale/5,p.Scale,context);
   }
  }
  static List<PrimitiveTextPoint> Lines(Grid grid,bool printed,Item item,NativeNotationContext p,ScoreText text,Graphics g){
   var points=new List<PrimitiveTextPoint>();
   if(!grid.Visible)return points;
   for(int column=0;column<grid.Strings;column++){
    float x=F((double)grid.X+column*grid.Horizontal);
    Fingerings(grid,item,p,text,g,points,column);
    Point(points,x,grid.Y,1);
    Point(points,x,grid.Top);
   }
   for(int fret=0;fret<=grid.Frets;fret++){
    float y=F((double)grid.Y+fret*grid.Vertical);
    Point(points,grid.X,y,1);
    Point(points,grid.Right,y);
   }
   if(grid.Nut){
    float upper=F((double)grid.Top+grid.Vertical*60/160);
    Point(points,grid.X,upper,2);
    Point(points,grid.X,grid.Top);
    Point(points,grid.Right,grid.Top);
    Point(points,grid.Right,upper);
    Point(points,grid.X,upper);
    if(printed)Point(points,grid.X,grid.Top);
   }
   return points;
  }
  static bool LastFingeringIsZero(Grid grid){
   if(grid.Fingering==0)return false;
   string digits=grid.Fingering.ToString("D6",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);int last=-1;
   for(int n=0;n<Math.Min(6,grid.Strings);n++){int digit=digits[n]-'0';if(digit<=4||digit>=8)last=digit;}
   return last==0||last==8;
  }
  static void Markers(Grid grid,NativeNotationContext p,NativeDatGlyphs dat,List<PrimitiveTextPoint> points,Action<float,float,float,bool> arc){
   if(!grid.Visible)return;
   int remaining=grid.Markers,divisor=(int)Math.Pow(10,Math.Min(grid.Strings,6)-1);
   float unit=F((double)grid.Vertical/160);
   bool firstCircle=grid.Fingering!=0&&grid.Fingering!=666666,firstPrintedCircle=true;
   // G124/G127 original captures: the final zero fingering clears DS:8D52
   // before the first circle. The circle return changes it to the print flag -1.
   bool printedZero=LastFingeringIsZero(grid);
   float markerSize=F((double)grid.Size*1.2999999523162842f);
   for(int n=0;n<Math.Min(6,grid.Strings);n++){
    int digit=remaining/divisor;remaining%=divisor;divisor=Math.Max(1,divisor/10);
    if(digit==0)continue;
    float x=F((double)grid.X+n*grid.Horizontal);
    float y=F((double)grid.Top+(digit<8?80-digit*160:(grid.Nut?60:0)+(digit==8?95:10))*unit);
    if(digit==9){
     for(int side=0;side<2;side++)
      for(int k=0;k<5;k++)
       Point(points,F((double)x+(side==0?1:-1)*CrossX[k]*unit),F((double)y+CrossY[k]*unit),(short)(k==0?2:0));
     continue;
    }
    float radius=F((double)markerSize*(digit==8?.800000011920929f:1));
    if(arc!=null&&grid.Fingering==0){
     arc(x,y,F((double)p.Scale*radius*3.5),digit!=8);
     // 2453:0271 writes the circle printer's format flag to DS:8281,
     // the second byte of the grid's working marker size at DS:8280.
     var bytes=BitConverter.GetBytes(markerSize);
     bytes[1]=0x20;
     markerSize=BitConverter.ToSingle(bytes,0);
    }
    else points.AddRange(dat.Circle(p.Scale,x,y,radius,radius,digit!=8,arc!=null?(firstPrintedCircle&&printedZero?20:10):(firstCircle?10:20)));
    firstCircle=false;firstPrintedCircle=false;
   }
  }
  static void Paint(Graphics g,NativeNotationContext page,List<PrimitiveTextPoint> points,float width){
   if(points.Count!=0)NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,points.ConvertAll(q=>new BarlinePoint(q.X,q.Y,q.Operation)),width);
  }
  static List<PrimitiveTextPoint> Barre(Grid grid,NativeNotationContext p,NativeDatGlyphs dat){
   int first=Math.Max(1,grid.Barre/1000),last=grid.Barre/100%10;
   if(last==0)last=6;
   if(!grid.Visible||grid.Barre<100||last<=first||last>6)return new List<PrimitiveTextPoint>();
   int remaining=grid.Markers,divisor=(int)Math.Pow(10,Math.Min(grid.Strings,6)-1);
   int fret=99,lastOpen=0;
   for(int n=0;n<Math.Min(6,grid.Strings);n++){
    int digit=remaining/divisor;remaining%=divisor;divisor=Math.Max(1,divisor/10);
    if(digit>=8)lastOpen=n+1;
    if((n+1==first||n+1==last)&&digit>0&&digit<8)fret=Math.Min(fret,digit);
   }
   if(fret==99&&!NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)throw new NotSupportedException("Guitar barre endpoints have no fretted markers. Enable original invalid-state reproduction to retain SCORE's wrapped barre coordinates.");
   float x=F((double)grid.X+(first-1)*grid.Horizontal);
   float y=fret>1?F((double)grid.Top-(fret-1)*grid.Vertical):
    F((double)grid.Top+grid.Size*p.Scale*(lastOpen>=first&&lastOpen<=last?8:4));
   if(grid.Nut&&fret==1)y=F((double)y+grid.Size*p.Scale*4.5);
   int span=last-first;
   float aspect=F((double)grid.Horizontal/grid.Vertical);
   return dat.ExternalDrawing(209,F((double)span*grid.Size*aspect*.2f),F((double)grid.Size*(span*.05f+.55f)),p.Scale,x,y);
  }
  static void Fret(Graphics g,Grid grid,Item item,NativeNotationContext p,ScoreText text,List<PrimitiveTextPoint> points){
   int fret=grid.Barre%100;
   if(!grid.Visible||fret==0)return;
   float x=F((double)grid.Right+grid.Size*p.Scale*.04800000041723251f*150);
   // 0273:18D0-18E4 / 1957-198C stores each P4 stage before
   // the ordinary text-coordinate preparation; combining them loses a word.
   float topText=F((double)(grid.Frets-1)*grid.Size*1.7200000286102295f+item.P(4));
   float fretP4=F((double)grid.Size*.20000000298023224f+topText);
   fretP4=F((double)fretP4-F(item.P(12)%1)*grid.Size*17.200000762939453f);
   float y=F((double)fretP4*p.Scale*7+p.RawBase);
   TextAt(g,item,p,text,points,fret.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)+" fr",F((double)grid.FingeringSize*.6000000238418579f),0,x,y,-.65f);
  }
  internal static List<PrimitiveTextPoint> Scan(Item i,NativeNotationContext p,ScoreText text,NativeDatGlyphs dat,short previousFont,out short finalFont,State state=null){
   var grid=Prepare(i,p,text);
   if(grid==null)throw new NotSupportedException("Guitar-grid controls outside the verified route.");
   if(state!=null)state.Advance(grid,i);
   var points=Lines(grid,false,i,p,text,null);
   Markers(grid,p,dat,points,null);
   Fret(null,grid,i,p,text,points);
   points.AddRange(Barre(grid,p,dat));
   if(NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)points.AddRange(RetainedBarre(grid,state,p,dat));
   if(grid.Name.Length==0){finalFont=grid.Fingering!=0&&grid.Fingering!=666666||grid.Barre%100!=0?(short)0:previousFont;return points;}
   var label=Label(i,grid.TextSize,grid.Font);
   points.AddRange(text.ScanStrokeText(label,grid.Name,LabelPosition(p,LabelX(grid,p,text,label),grid.TextY),0,out finalFont));
   return points;
  }
  public static void Validate(Item item,NativeNotationContext page,ScoreText text){if(Prepare(item,page,text)==null)throw new InvalidDataException("Guitar chord parameters are outside the recovered SCORE grid controls.");}
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext p,ScoreText text,DrawingLibrary library){
   if(p==null||text==null||NativeNotationView.UsesDat)return false;
   var grid=Prepare(item,p,text);
   if(grid==null)return false;
   var state=NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates?NativePrintContext.GridState(p.SourceScore,text):null;if(state!=null)state.Advance(grid,item);
   var width=NativePrintContext.DefaultLineWidth;
   var points=Lines(grid,true,item,p,text,g);
   var dat=NativeDatDrawing.Get(library);
   Markers(grid,p,dat,points,(x,y,r,filled)=>NativePrintedShapes.DrawArc(g,p,x,y,r,1,-270,90,width,filled,!filled,exactDecimal:true));

   var titleVectors=new List<PrimitiveTextPoint>();

    var label=Label(item,grid.TextSize,grid.Font);
    TextAt(g,item,p,text,points,grid.Name,grid.TextSize,grid.Font,LabelX(grid,p,text,label),grid.TextY);

    if(plan==null)throw new NotSupportedException("Guitar-grid title contains unsupported SCORE text.");

    }
    plan.Parts.RemoveAll(part=>part.Vector!=null);
    if(NativeEpsExport.For(g)==null){
     foreach(var part in plan.Parts)GhostscriptTextRenderer.Prepare(part.Font,GhostscriptTextRenderer.Clip(g));
    }
    text.PaintPostScript(g,plan);
   }
   if(barre.Count==0)points.AddRange(titleVectors);
   Paint(g,p,points,width);
   if(barre.Count!=0){
    Paint(g,p,barre,NativePrintContext.Width(-1));
    Paint(g,p,titleVectors,width);
   }
   return true;
  }
 }
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Drawing;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Globalization;using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativePrintedClefs {
  static float F(double value){return (float)value;}
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library,ScoreText text,HashSet<int> cache){
   if(item.Code!=3||page==null||library==null)return false;
   float selector=item.P(5),pitchControl=item.P(4);
   if(Single.IsNaN(selector)||Single.IsInfinity(selector)||Math.Abs(selector)>32767)return false;
   int decimalCode=Math.Abs((int)Math.Round(selector*100.0,MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero));
   bool octave=decimalCode!=0&&(decimalCode<100||decimalCode==180);
   bool tab=selector==44||selector==55||(selector==66||selector==66.1f);
   bool libraryDrawing=selector>=45&&selector<3000&&selector==(int)selector&&!tab;
   bool primitive=selector>=0&&selector<44||selector==1.81f||selector>-1&&selector<1;
   if(!octave&&!tab&&!libraryDrawing&&!primitive&&(selector<0||selector>5||selector!=(int)selector))return false;
   for(int n=4;n<=7;n++)if(Single.IsNaN(item.P(n))||Single.IsInfinity(item.P(n)))return false;
   for(int n=8;n<=20;n++)if(n!=15&&n!=10&&item.P(n)!=0)return false;
   if(Single.IsNaN(item.P(10))||item.P(10)<-32768||item.P(10)>32767||item.P(10)!=(int)item.P(10))return false;
   short widthSelector=(short)item.P(10);
   if(Single.IsNaN(item.P(15))||Single.IsInfinity(item.P(15)))return false;
   if(Math.Abs(pitchControl)>32767)return false;
   bool cue=Math.Abs((int)pitchControl)>=100;
   int glyph=tab?3:(int)selector==3?2:(int)selector;
   if(libraryDrawing){
    var context=new NativeNotationContext{Staff=page.Staff,RawBase=page.RawBase,Projection=page.Projection,Prepared=page.Prepared};
    context.Prepared.X=F((double)page.Prepared.X+item.P(15)*150);
    var drawing=Item.Make(9,item.P(2),item.P(3),pitchControl,selector,item.P(6)==0?1:item.P(6),item.P(7),0,0,item.P(10));
    return NativeLibrarySymbols.Draw(g,drawing,context,library,text,cache,true);
   }
   if(!library.Symbols.ContainsKey(glyph))return false;
   float h=item.P(6)==0?1:item.P(6),v=item.P(7)==0?h:item.P(7),offset=(int)selector>5&&!octave?0:21;
   if(tab)return DrawTab(g,item,page,library,h,v);
   if(cue){
    h=F((double)h*.800000011920929f);
    v=h;
    offset=F((double)offset+(glyph==0||glyph==5?.3499999940395355f:glyph==1?8.75f:5.599999904632568f));
   }
   if((int)selector==3)offset=F((double)offset+14);
   if(octave){
    if(text==null)return false;
    float height=decimalCode==180?0:decimalCode==88||decimalCode==15?10.949999809265137f:-5.25f;
    float shift=decimalCode==180?.05999999865889549f:decimalCode==88?.11999999731779099f:decimalCode==15?.08500000089406967f:.07999999821186066f;
    int number=decimalCode==180?8:decimalCode/10;if(number==1)number=15;
    float pitch=F((double)height*h+(double)(pitchControl%100)+3);
    float position=F((double)page.Scale*h*shift+item.P(3));
    var context=new NativeNotationContext{SourceScore=page.SourceScore,Staff=page.Staff,RawBase=page.RawBase,StaffBases=page.StaffBases,Projection=page.Projection,Prepared=page.Prepared};context.Prepared.X=F(position*150.0);context.Prepared.Y=page.Vertical(pitch);
    var body=Item.Make(16,item.P(2),position,pitch,1,F((double)h*.699999988079071f),0,1003,0,0,0,1,0);string numeral=number.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);text.Set(body,numeral,page.Scale);
    RenderResourceAudit.Record("printed clef numeral",numeral,text.RootDirectory,"recovered choral tenor text request; external metric face3");text.Draw(g,body,body.Text,0,0,page.Scale/5,page.Scale,context);
    // Original 0CC1:0245 prepares the numeral integer cache; 0280..02CB restores only the clef fields. P10 remains zero.
    widthSelector=0;
   }
   float effective=F((double)page.Scale*h),scale=effective/25,y=F((double)page.Scale*offset+page.Prepared.Y);
   float x=F((double)page.Prepared.X+item.P(15)*150);
   if(h!=v||h<0)return NativePrimitiveGlyphs.Draw(g,page,library,cache,new PrimitiveGlyphRequest{Glyph=glyph,X=x,Y=y,Horizontal=h,Vertical=v,WidthSelector=widthSelector});
   return NativePrintedSymbols.DrawGlyph(g,page,library,glyph,x,y,PrintedGlyphDefinition.Fixed3(scale),h,cache,widthSelector);
  }
  static bool DrawTab(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library,float h,float v){
   int selector=(int)item.P(5);float factor=selector==44?.6000000238418579f:selector==55?.8299999833106995f:1;
   h=F((double)F(.10000000149011612*h)*factor);
   v=F((double)F(.10000000149011612*v)*factor);

   context.Prepared.X=F((double)page.Prepared.X+item.P(15)*150);
   if(selector!=66)context.Prepared.Y=page.Vertical(F((double)item.P(4)+(selector==44?1.2000000476837158f:.3499999940395355f)));
   var drawing=Item.Make(9,item.P(2),item.P(3),item.P(4),3,h,v,0,0,item.P(10));
   return NativeLibrarySymbols.Draw(g,drawing,context,library,null,null);

 }
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;using System.Drawing;using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;using System.Globalization;using System.Text;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativePrintedFilledWave {
  // Original SCORE.EXE REAL4 algorithm tables, offsets168194/168434;35 entries.
  static readonly float[] X={13f,7f,-1f,30f,39f,46f,52f,59f,65f,74f,87f,116f,125f,127f,131f,134f,138f,143f,148f,156f,124f,117f,110f,104f,97f,90f,83f,72f,40f,32f,27f,23f,19f,17f,13f};
  static readonly float[] Y={24f,18.5f,26f,57f,64f,67f,68f,68f,67f,63f,54f,29f,22f,21f,20f,20f,21f,25f,30f,22f,-10f,-16f,-19f,-20f,-20f,-19f,-16f,-8f,21f,27f,29f,29f,28f,27f,24f};
  static float F(double v){return (float)v;}
  static string R(float v){return ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments.SingleFixedDecimal.Format(v,1);}
  static float Q(float v){return Single.Parse(R(v),CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);}
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item i,NativeNotationContext p){
   if(i.Code!=4||i.P(7)!=-1||i.P(5)>=999)return false;
   for(int n=3;n<=20;n++)if(Single.IsNaN(i.P(n))||Math.Abs(i.P(n))>32767)return false;
   for(int n=10;n<=20;n++)if(n!=10&&n!=12&&n!=13&&n!=15&&i.P(n)!=0)return false;
   float width=i.P(8)>0?i.P(8):1;
   float height=i.P(9)==0?width:i.P(9);
   bool vertical=i.P(6)==0||i.P(3)==i.P(6);
   if(vertical||i.P(13)!=0)return DrawBuffered(g,i,p,width,height,vertical);
   if(i.P(3)>=i.P(6))return true;
   return DrawHorizontal(g,p,p.Prepared.X,p.Prepared.Y,F(i.P(6)*150.0),width,(short)i.P(12)!=0,height);
  }
  internal static bool DrawHorizontal(Graphics g,NativeNotationContext p,float x,float baseline,float end,float size,bool arrow=false,float? height=null){
   // Original 04ED:0A0C keeps the scale product in ST(0) for X,
   // then reloads the stored REAL4 at DS:C050 before multiplying for Y.
   double staffFactor=(double)p.Scale*.08250000327825546f;
   float horizontal=F(staffFactor*size),vertical=F((double)F(staffFactor)*(height??size));
   float rawStep=F(horizontal*146.0),step=Q(rawStep);
   float left=Q(x),right=Q(end),y=Q(baseline);if(!(step>0)||right<left)return false;
   int count=(int)Math.Floor(((double)right-left)/step)+1;if(count>30000)return false;
   var vertices=new PointF[X.Length];for(int n=0;n<X.Length;n++)vertices[n]=new PointF(Q(F(X[n]*(double)horizontal)),Q(F(Y[n]*(double)vertical)));
   float width=NativePrintContext.Width(-1);var state=g.Save();try{using(var matrix=p.Projection.Matrix())g.MultiplyTransform(matrix,MatrixOrder.Prepend);using(var pen=new Pen(Color.Black,width)){pen.LineJoin=LineJoin.Round;for(int repeat=0;repeat<count;repeat++)using(var path=new GraphicsPath(FillMode.Alternate)){var points=new PointF[vertices.Length];for(int n=0;n<points.Length;n++)points[n]=new PointF(F(left+(double)repeat*step+vertices[n].X),F(y+(double)vertices[n].Y));path.AddLines(points);g.TrackedFillPath(Brushes.Black,path);g.TrackedDrawPath(pen,path);}}}finally{g.Restore(state);}
   var eps=NativeEpsExport.For(g);if(eps!=null){var b=new StringBuilder(eps.DefaultInkProgram+"1 setlinejoin 0 setlinecap\n");b.Append(width.ToString("F4",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)).Append(" setlinewidth\ngsave ").Append(R(left)).Append(' ').Append(R(y)).Append(" translate\n").Append(R(left)).Append(' ').Append(R(step)).Append(' ').Append(R(right)).Append(" { pop newpath\n");for(int n=0;n<vertices.Length;n++)b.Append(R(vertices[n].X)).Append(' ').Append(R(vertices[n].Y)).Append(n==0?" moveto\n":" lineto\n");b.Append("gsave eofill grestore stroke\n").Append(R(step)).Append(" 0 translate } for grestore\n");eps.ScoreFilledWaveProgram(b.ToString(),count);}
   if(arrow)DrawArrow(g,p,x,baseline,end,horizontal,vertical,rawStep,width);
   NativePrintContext.RestoreDefaultLineWidth();
   RenderResourceAudit.Record("printed filled waveform","Code4 P7=-1","original executable REAL4 tables","printed decimal table and repeated fill/stroke; horizontal measured domain");return true;
  }
  static bool DrawBuffered(Graphics g,Item i,NativeNotationContext p,float width,float height,bool vertical){
   float x=p.Prepared.X,y=p.Prepared.Y,right=F(i.P(6)*150.0),angle=i.P(13);
   if(vertical){
    x=F((double)x+i.P(15)*150.0);
    angle=-90;
    float dy=F((double)i.P(5)-i.P(4));
    // SCORE 04ED:0A82–0AA5 lowers the printed baseline by DS:6828.
    y=F((double)y-p.Scale*(double).8f);
    if((short)i.P(12)<0){dy=-dy;y=F((double)p.Vertical(i.P(5))+p.Scale*14);}
    float length=F((double)p.Scale*dy*7);
    if(length<0){length=-length;angle=-angle;}
    right=F((double)x+length);
   }
   double unit=(double)p.Scale*.08250000327825546f;
   float h=F(unit*width),v=F((double)F(unit)*height),step=F((double)h*146);
   if(!(step>0))return false;if(right<=x)return true;
   var points=new List<PrimitiveTextPoint>();
   float origin=x;
   int count=0;
   do{
    if(++count>850)return false;
    AddContour(points,X,Y,origin,y,h,v);
    double next=(double)origin+step;
    origin=F(next);
    if(next>=right)break;
   }while(true);
   if((short)i.P(12)!=0)AddContour(points,ArrowX,ArrowY,F((double)origin-step),y,h,v);
   NativeDatLines.Rotate(points,angle,x,y);
   NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,p,points.ConvertAll(q=>new BarlinePoint(q.X,q.Y,q.Operation)),NativePrintContext.Width(-1));
   NativePrintContext.RestoreDefaultLineWidth();
   RenderResourceAudit.Record("printed filled waveform","Code4 P7=-1","original executable REAL4 tables","buffered contour and word rotation");
   return true;
  }
  static void AddContour(List<PrimitiveTextPoint> points,float[] xs,float[] ys,float x,float y,float h,float v){
   for(int n=0;n<xs.Length;n++)points.Add(new PrimitiveTextPoint{
    X=NativeNotationContext.Word(F((double)x+(double)xs[n]*h),true),
    Y=NativeNotationContext.Word(F((double)y+(double)ys[n]*v),false),
    Operation=(short)(n==0?2:0)
   });
  }
  // The thirteen entries immediately after each waveform table in SCORE.EXE
  // (file offsets 168334 and 168574) form the filled end arrow.
  static readonly float[] ArrowX={148,152,154,159,201,148,268,148,201,163,158,155,148};
  static readonly float[] ArrowY={29,32,33,34,34,106,29,-47,25,25,24,22,29};
  static void DrawArrow(Graphics g,NativeNotationContext page,float x,float y,float right,float horizontal,float vertical,float step,float width){
   int repeats=(int)(((double)right-x)/step+1);
   float next=F(x+(double)repeats*step);
   float last=F((double)next-step);
   var points=new System.Collections.Generic.List<BarlinePoint>();
   for(int n=0;n<ArrowX.Length;n++)
    points.Add(new BarlinePoint(F((double)last+ArrowX[n]*(double)horizontal),
     F((double)y+ArrowY[n]*(double)vertical),n==0?2:0));
   NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,points,width);
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Drawing;using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativePrintedFlags {
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library,HashSet<int> cache=null){
   if(NativeDatDrawing.Flags(g,item,page,library))return true;
   if(page==null||library==null||item.Code!=1||(int)item.P(9)%10<1||item.P(9)<0||item.P(9)>=2000)return false;
   var note=NativeNoteDetails.Prepare(item,page);if(note==null||(note.StemKind!=1&&note.StemKind!=2))return false;
   int head=(int)item.P(6);if(NativePrintedHeads.Parenthesized(item))head-=10;
   if(head < -1 || head>9&&head<20 || head>=3000)return false;
   Glyph glyph;if(!library.Symbols.TryGetValue(20,out glyph))return false;
   bool up=note.StemKind==1;int count=(int)item.P(9)%10;float scale=note.Scale;float headWidth=note.HeadWidth,increment=(float)((up?7.0:-7.0)*scale),x=up?(float)((double)note.NoteX+headWidth):note.NoteX,y=(float)((double)(item.P(8)%100)*increment+note.NoteY+increment);if(count>1)y=(float)((double)y-increment/2.0);int vertical=up?-1:1;var eps=NativeEpsExport.For(g);
   RenderResourceAudit.Record("printed flag","20:"+glyph.Name,glyph.Source,"measured black up/down flags, cue scale and corpus stem-extension controls; other note components verified separately");
   int firstFlag=0;
   // Original N127 P00 requests: a cached down-flag uses the shared
   // primitive procedure for the first flag, with remaining flags expanded.
   if(!up&&cache!=null&&cache.Contains(20)){
    float relative=(float)((double)scale/page.Scale);
    if(!NativePrimitiveGlyphs.Draw(g,page,library,cache,new PrimitiveGlyphRequest{Glyph=20,X=x,Y=y,Horizontal=relative,Vertical=relative,WidthSelector=-1}))return false;
    firstFlag=1;y=(float)((double)y+increment+increment);
   }
   var points=new List<BarlinePoint>();
   for(int flag=firstFlag;flag<count;flag++){
    for(int n=0;n<glyph.Points.Length;n++){
     int op=glyph.Operations[n];if(flag>0&&n>0&&op>0&&op!=3)break;
     points.Add(new BarlinePoint(NativeNotationContext.Word((float)((double)glyph.Points[n].X*scale/4+x),true),NativeNotationContext.Word((float)((double)glyph.Points[n].Y*scale/4*vertical+y),false),op));
    }
    y=(float)((double)y+increment+increment);
   }
   if(points.Count>0)NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,points,NativePrintContext.Width(-1),true);
   return true;
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Globalization;using System.Drawing;using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativePrintedHeads {
  internal static bool Parenthesized(Item item){
   return item.P(6)>=10&&item.P(6)<20&&item.P(6)==(int)item.P(6);
  }
  internal static bool Custom(Item item){
   return item.P(6)>=20&&item.P(6)<3000&&item.P(6)==(int)item.P(6);
  }
  internal static Item CustomOctaveText(Item item,NativeNotationContext page,ScoreText text){
   if(text==null||!Custom(item)||(item.P(6)<45||item.P(6)>47))return null;
   var body=Item.Make(16,item.P(2),item.P(3),item.P(4),1,item.P(6),item.P(7),item.P(11)==0?1002:item.P(11),item.P(9),.6f,0,1,0);
   text.Set(body,item.P(6)==45?"8va":item.P(6)==46?"8ba":"15ma",page.Scale);
   return body;
  }
  public static bool Request(Item item,NativeNotationContext page,out PrintedHeadRequest request){
   request=new PrintedHeadRequest();if(page==null||item.Code!=1||(item.P(4)<=-200||item.P(4)>=200)||(Single.IsNaN(item.P(15))||Single.IsInfinity(item.P(15))||Math.Abs(item.P(15))>32767)||(item.P(12)!=0&&item.P(12)!=1&&item.P(12)!=2)||item.P(20)!=0||item.P(6)<0||item.P(6)>=4)return false;
   float noteScale,headX,headY;try{NativeScanMusicVectors.HeadProjection(item,page,out noteScale,out headX,out headY);}catch(NotSupportedException){return false;}float scale=(float)((double)noteScale/25);if(scale==0)return false;
   request=new PrintedHeadRequest{Glyph=11+(int)item.P(6),X=NativeNotationContext.RawWord(headX),Y=NativeNotationContext.RawWord(headY),Scale=PrintedGlyphDefinition.Fixed3(scale),Width=PrintedGlyphDefinition.Fixed3(Math.Max(0,(float)((double)NativePrintContext.RawWidth(0)/scale)))};return true;
  }
  internal static bool DrawJoinedStem(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library,HashSet<int> cache){
   if(NativeNotationView.UsesDat||item.P(6)!=5||item.P(4)<=-100||item.P(4)>=100||
    item.P(10)!=0||item.P(12)!=0||item.P(15)!=0||(cache!=null&&cache.Contains(16)))return false;
   for(int n=16;n<=20;n++)if(item.P(n)!=0)return false;
   var plan=NativeNoteDetails.Prepare(item,page);
   if(plan==null||!plan.Stem||plan.Slash)return false;
   var head=new PrimitiveGlyphRequest{Glyph=16,X=page.Prepared.X,Y=page.Prepared.Y,Horizontal=1,Vertical=1};
   var stem=new[]{new BarlinePoint(plan.StemX,plan.StemStart,1),new BarlinePoint(plan.StemX,plan.StemEnd,0)};
   return NativePrimitiveGlyphs.Draw(g,page,library,cache,head,stem);
  }
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library){return Draw(g,item,page,library,null);}
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library,HashSet<int> cache){
   return Draw(g,item,page,library,cache,null);
  }
  internal static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library,HashSet<int> cache,ScoreText text){

   if(NativeDatDrawing.Head(g,item,page,library))return true;
   if(item.P(6)==-1)return true;
   if(Parenthesized(item)){
    var inner=item.Clone();
    inner.Set(6,item.P(6)-10);
    float projectedScale,hx,hy;NativeScanMusicVectors.HeadProjection(item,page,out projectedScale,out hx,out hy);
    float innerScale,innerX,innerY;NativeScanMusicVectors.HeadProjection(inner,page,out innerScale,out innerX,out innerY);
    var innerContext=new NativeNotationContext{Staff=page.Staff,RawBase=page.RawBase,StaffBases=page.StaffBases,Projection=page.Projection,Prepared=page.Prepared};
    innerContext.Prepared.X=(float)((double)page.Prepared.X+hx-innerX);
    if(!Draw(g,inner,innerContext,library,cache))return false;
    var context=new NativeNotationContext{Staff=page.Staff,RawBase=page.RawBase,StaffBases=page.StaffBases,Projection=page.Projection,Prepared=page.Prepared};
    context.Prepared.Scale=projectedScale;context.Prepared.Y=hy;
    float left=-13.800000190734863f;int accidental=(int)item.P(5)%10;
    if(accidental!=0)left=(float)((double)left-14.399999618530273);
    if(accidental==4)left=(float)((double)left-12.600000381469727);
    context.Prepared.X=(float)((double)hx+left*projectedScale);
    if(!NativeLibrarySymbols.Draw(g,Item.Make(9,item.P(2),item.P(3),item.P(4),208,1.4f,1.4f),context,library,null,null))return false;
    double right=item.P(9)<10?31.200000762939453:(int)item.P(9)%100<20?39.20000076293945:51.20000076293945;
    context.Prepared.X=(float)((double)hx+right*projectedScale);
    return NativeLibrarySymbols.Draw(g,Item.Make(9,item.P(2),item.P(3),item.P(4),208,-1.4f,1.4f),context,library,null,null);
   }

   if(Custom(item)){
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Drawing;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativePrintedLines {
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page){
   if(page==null||item.Code!=4||item.P(5)>=999)return false;
   if(item.P(7)==100||item.P(7)<=-2){
    bool multiPoint=item.P(7)==100;
    float strokeWidth=NativePrintContext.DefaultLineWidth;
    var waveGeometry=item;
    if(!multiPoint){
     if(Single.IsNaN(item.P(10))||Math.Abs(item.P(10))>32767)return false;
     strokeWidth=NativePrintContext.Width(unchecked((short)((short)item.P(10)*2)));
     waveGeometry=item.Clone();
     waveGeometry.Set(10,0);
    }
    var shared=multiPoint?NativeDatLines.MultiPoint(item,page):NativeDatLines.Waves(waveGeometry,page);
    var path=shared.ConvertAll(p=>new BarlinePoint(p.X,p.Y,p.Operation));
    NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,path,strokeWidth,true);
    if(!multiPoint&&item.P(10)!=0)NativePrintContext.RestoreDefaultLineWidth();
    return true;
   }
   if(NativePrintedFilledWave.Draw(g,item,page))return true;bool dashed=item.P(7)>=1&&item.P(7)<=6&&item.P(7)==(int)item.P(7);
   if(!dashed&&item.P(7)!=0)return false;
   if(dashed){
    // Printer P10 selects a stroke width; DAT P10 expands copied paths.
    // Keep the source item unchanged and reuse only the measured dash endpoints.
    if(Math.Abs(item.P(10))>32767||Single.IsNaN(item.P(10)))return false;
    for(int n=11;n<=20;n++)if(n!=11&&n!=12&&n!=13&&n!=14&&item.P(n)!=0)return false;
   }else{
    if(Math.Abs(item.P(10))>32767||Single.IsNaN(item.P(10)))return false;
    if(!NativeDatLines.SupportedStraightAuxiliary(item))return false;
   }
   var points=new List<BarlinePoint>();
   var geometry=item.Clone();
   geometry.Set(10,0);
   if(!dashed)geometry.Set(8,0);
   var vectors=dashed?NativeDatLines.Dashes(geometry,page):NativeDatLines.Straight(geometry,page);
   foreach(var p in vectors)points.Add(new BarlinePoint(p.X,p.Y,p.Operation));
   float width=NativePrintContext.Width(unchecked((short)((short)item.P(10)*2)));
   RenderResourceAudit.Record(dashed?"printed dashed line":"printed straight line","default","original shared Code4 endpoints","word coordinates and printer stroke selector twice cached P10");
   NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,points,width,true);if(item.P(10)!=0)NativePrintContext.RestoreDefaultLineWidth();return true;
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativePrintedOrnaments {

  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library,ScoreText text,HashSet<int> cache){

    NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,harp[0].ConvertAll(q=>new BarlinePoint(q.X,q.Y,q.Operation)),NativePrintContext.Width(2));
    NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,harp[1].ConvertAll(q=>new BarlinePoint(q.X,q.Y,q.Operation)),NativePrintContext.Width(2));
    var points=harp[2].ConvertAll(q=>new BarlinePoint(q.X,q.Y,q.Operation));
    for(int n=0;n<points.Count;n+=5){var pedal=points.GetRange(n,5);pedal.Add(pedal[1]);NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,pedal,NativePrintContext.DefaultLineWidth);}
    return true;
   }
   if(type==21||type==22){

    var points=NativeDatOrnaments.Prepare(item,page,null,library,text);
    var path=new List<BarlinePoint>();
    foreach(var point in points)path.Add(new BarlinePoint(point.X,point.Y,point.Operation));
    NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,path,NativePrintContext.DefaultLineWidth);
    return true;
   }
   string label=type==8?"8va":type==-8?"8ba":type==15?"15ma":type==88?"8":null;
   if(label==null)return false;
   foreach(int n in new[]{14,16,17,18,19,20})if(item.P(n)!=0)return false;
   float itemSize=item.P(5)==0?1:item.P(5);
   if(Single.IsNaN(itemSize)||Single.IsInfinity(itemSize)||Math.Abs(itemSize)>32767)return false;
   float size=F(F((double)itemSize*.75)*1.100000023841858);
   var body=Item.Make(16,item.P(2),item.P(3),item.P(4),1,size,0,1002,0,type==88?0:.6000000238418579f,0,1,0);
   if(type!=88)body.Set(11,item.P(11));

  }
  static bool DrawPedal(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library,HashSet<int> cache){
   Glyph pressed,pedal;
   if(!library.Symbols.TryGetValue(49,out pressed)||!library.Symbols.TryGetValue(48,out pedal))return false;
   float factor=item.P(9)==0?.4f:F((double)item.P(9)*.4f);

   float step=F((double)scale*53);

   var points=new List<BarlinePoint>();
   Action<int,Glyph,float,short> symbol=(id,glyph,xx,selector)=>{
    // The original pressed-pedal calls at 1C0C:093D/09B2/0A0E retain
    // the item width word. The expanded glyph path decrements it at
    // 0E38:0423, while the cached call uses it directly.
    if(cache==null||!cache.Contains(id)){

     points.Clear();return;

    var culture=System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
    width=Single.Parse(PrintedGlyphDefinition.Fixed3(width),culture);

    NativeLibrarySymbols.DrawCached(g,page,glyph,new LibrarySymbolPlan{Glyph=id},projection,width,6.25f,

   NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,points,NativePrintContext.Width(-1));
   if((short)item.P(6)!=0){
    var context=new NativeNotationContext{Staff=page.Staff,RawBase=page.RawBase,Prepared=page.Prepared,Projection=page.Projection};

    float left=item.P(8)==0?item.P(3):item.P(8);

    var line=Item.Make(4,item.P(2),left,item.P(4),item.P(4),item.P(6),0,0,0,item.P(10),item.P(11),item.P(12),item.P(13));
    if(!NativePrintedLines.Draw(g,line,context))return false;
   }
   RenderResourceAudit.Record("printed pedal", "48/49",pedal.Source,"original pedal bank and continuation");
   return true;
  }
  static void AppendGlyph(List<BarlinePoint> points,Glyph glyph,float x,float y,float scale){
   for(int n=0;n<glyph.Points.Length;n++)
    points.Add(new BarlinePoint(F((double)x+glyph.Points[n].X*(double)scale),
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Drawing;using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 // Original drawing requests accumulate word-coordinate subpaths until the
 // per-item printer drain. Cached glyph requests print independently.
 // Ledger requests are retained separately until after cached text/glyph calls.
 internal sealed class NativePrintedPointBuffer:IDisposable {
  [ThreadStatic]static NativePrintedPointBuffer current;
  sealed class Run {public NativeNotationContext Page;public float Width,Rotation;public PointF Pivot;public bool Words,InheritedWidth;public List<BarlinePoint> Points=new List<BarlinePoint>();}
  readonly Graphics graphics;readonly List<Run> runs=new List<Run>();readonly List<Action> beforeDrain=new List<Action>();readonly NativePrintedPointBuffer previous;bool completed;
  NativePrintedPointBuffer(Graphics g){graphics=g;previous=current;current=this;}
  internal static NativePrintedPointBuffer Begin(Graphics g){return new NativePrintedPointBuffer(g);}
  internal static bool Append(Graphics g,NativeNotationContext page,IEnumerable<BarlinePoint> points,float width,bool words,PointF pivot,float rotation,bool inheritedWidth){
   var buffer=current;if(buffer==null||buffer.graphics!=g||NativeNotationView.UsesDat)return false;
   Run run=buffer.runs.Count==0?null:buffer.runs[buffer.runs.Count-1];
   if(run==null||run.Page.Projection!=page.Projection||(run.InheritedWidth?NativePrintContext.DefaultLineWidth:run.Width)!=(inheritedWidth?NativePrintContext.DefaultLineWidth:width)||run.Words!=words||run.Pivot!=pivot||run.Rotation!=rotation){run=new Run{Page=page,Width=width,Words=words,Pivot=pivot,Rotation=rotation,InheritedWidth=inheritedWidth};buffer.runs.Add(run);}
   run.InheritedWidth|=inheritedWidth;run.Points.AddRange(points);return true;
  }
  void Drain(){current=previous;try{foreach(var draw in beforeDrain)draw();beforeDrain.Clear();foreach(var run in runs)NativeNoteDetails.Path(graphics,run.Page,run.Points,run.InheritedWidth?NativePrintContext.DefaultLineWidth:run.Width,run.Words,run.Pivot,run.Rotation);runs.Clear();}finally{current=this;}}
  internal static void BeforeDrain(Action draw){if(current==null){Direct(draw);return;}current.beforeDrain.Add(draw);}
  internal static void Direct(Action draw){var saved=current;current=null;try{draw();}finally{current=saved;}}
  internal static void FlushPending(Graphics g){if(current!=null&&current.graphics==g)current.Drain();}
  internal void Complete(){if(completed)return;Drain();completed=true;current=previous;}
  public void Dispose(){if(!completed)current=previous;}
 }
}
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Drawing;using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Globalization;
namespace ScoreModern {

  static float F(double v){return (float)v;}static bool Present(float v){return BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(v),0)!=0;}
  static void Dot(Graphics g,NativeNotationContext page,float scale,float x,float y){
   float radius=F((double)scale*3.5*.5799999833106995f);string sx=x.ToString("F1",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),sy=y.ToString("F1",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),sr=radius.ToString("F1",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

  }
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,NativePageDocument doc){
   if(item.Code!=14||page==null||doc==null||item.P(4)<0||item.P(4)!=(int)item.P(4))return false;
   int kind=(int)item.P(5);if(item.P(5)!=kind&&item.P(5)!=998.75f&&!NativeDatBarlines.DefaultCenteredDash(item)||kind<3||kind==8||kind==9||kind==10)return false;

   for(int n=6;n<=20;n++)if(n!=6&&n!=7&&n!=10&&n!=11&&n!=12&&n!=15&&(dashed?(n!=8&&n!=9&&n!=17):(n!=13&&n!=14&&n!=16&&n!=17))&&item.P(n)!=0)return false;
   if(item.P(12)!=0&&item.P(12)!=1)return false;
   if(dashed&&(item.P(6)<short.MinValue||item.P(6)>short.MaxValue||Math.Abs(item.P(8))>32767||Math.Abs(item.P(9))>32767))return false;
   if(!dashed&&(item.P(16)<short.MinValue||item.P(16)>short.MaxValue))return false;
   int high=page.Staff+Math.Max(1,(int)item.P(4))-1;if(high>doc.MaximumDefinedStaff||high>32)return false;
   float scale=page.Scale,x=NativePrintedBarlines.HorizontalOrigin(item,page),bottom=doc.Tables.Vertical(page.Staff,item.P(10)==0?(kind>=11?1:3):item.P(10)),top=doc.Tables.Vertical(high,item.P(11)==0?(kind>=11?13:11):item.P(11));var points=new List<BarlinePoint>();
   if(dashed){

     foreach(var q in NativeDatBarlines.CenteredDash(x,bottom,scale))points.Add(new BarlinePoint(q.X,q.Y,q.Operation));
    }else{
     var body=Item.Make(4,item.P(2),item.P(3),3,F(((double)top-page.RawBase)/(scale*7.0)),item.P(3),1,Present(item.P(8))?item.P(8):1,Present(item.P(9))?item.P(9):2);
     var context=new NativeNotationContext{Staff=page.Staff,RawBase=page.RawBase,StaffBases=page.StaffBases,Prepared=page.Prepared,Projection=page.Projection};

    NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,points,NativePrintContext.Width(unchecked((short)(2*widthWord))),true);
    RenderResourceAudit.Record("printed dashed bar","7","original shared vertical line supplier","original barline controls and printer thickness selector");return true;
   }
   if(Present(item.P(17)))scale=F((double)item.P(17)*25);
   float unit=F((double)scale*6),spacing=F((double)scale*6*item.P(13)),dotExtra=F((double)item.P(14)*unit);

   Action<float> heavy=right=>{float left=F((double)right-scale*6);points.Add(new BarlinePoint(left,bottom,1));points.Add(new BarlinePoint(right,top,0));points.Add(new BarlinePoint(right,top,2));points.Add(new BarlinePoint(right,bottom,0));points.Add(new BarlinePoint(left,bottom,0));points.Add(new BarlinePoint(left,top,0));points.Add(new BarlinePoint(right,top,0));};
   int packed=(short)(int)Math.Truncate(item.P(16));bool explicitDots=Present(item.P(16));int lower=explicitDots?packed/100:6,delta=explicitDots?packed%100-lower:2;if(delta==0)delta=2;

  }
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Drawing;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativePrintedRests {
  static float F(double value){return (float)value;}
  // Placement transcribed by NativeScanMusicVectors from the original shared
  // rest routine, now checked independently against all68 Wandh01 EPS rests.
  // Keep unverified printed auxiliary/cue domains out of this route.
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library,HashSet<int> cache,ScoreText text=null){
   if(item.Code!=2||page==null||library==null)return false;
   if(item.P(13)!=0||item.P(17)!=0){item=item.Clone();if(item.Count>=13)item.Set(13,0);if(item.Count>=17)item.Set(17,0);}
   int kind=(int)item.P(5);if(item.P(5)!=kind)return false;
   if(NativeDatRestAttachments.Invisible(item,kind)){
    RenderResourceAudit.Record("printed invisible rest",kind.ToString(),"original Code2 visibility branch","no body or attachments requested");return true;
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Drawing;using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Globalization;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativePrintedShapes {
  static float F(double v){return (float)v;}
  static bool Finite(float v){return !Single.IsNaN(v)&&!Single.IsInfinity(v);}
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library){
   if(page==null||item.Code!=12)return false;
   if(item.P(5)==10)return NativeAccordionButton.Draw(g,item,page,library);
   if(item.P(5)==2)return NativeGuitarBend.Draw(g,item,page,library);
   if(item.P(5)!=0&&item.P(5)!=1)return false;
   for(int n=6;n<=13;n++)if(!Finite(item.P(n)))return false;
   for(int n=14;n<=20;n++)if(item.P(n)!=0)return false;
   bool circle=item.P(5)==1;
   float horizontal=item.P(6),vertical=item.P(7)==0?horizontal:item.P(7),thickness=item.P(8),rotation=item.P(9);
   if(horizontal==0||vertical==0||Math.Abs(thickness)>32767||Math.Abs(rotation)>32767)return false;
   if(item.P(13)!=0&&item.P(13)!=1)return false;
   bool filled=item.P(13)==1;
   float width=NativePrintContext.DefaultLineWidth;
   // Original width selector truncates P8*printer basis before width clamping.
   if(thickness!=0)width=NativePrintContext.FixedWidth(unchecked((short)(int)F((double)thickness*NativePrintContext.Basis)));
   var pivot=new PointF(NativeNotationContext.Word(page.Prepared.X,true),NativeNotationContext.Word(page.Prepared.Y,false));
   rotation=(int)rotation==0?0:F(Math.Round(-rotation,2,MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero));
   List<BarlinePoint> points;
   if(circle){
    int step=(int)item.P(12),start=(int)item.P(10),stop=item.P(11)==0?360:(int)item.P(11);
    if(start<0)start+=360;
    if(library==null||step<0||step>360||start<0||start>360||stop<0||stop>360)return false;
    if(step==0){
     if(stop<start)stop+=360;
     float radius=F((double)page.Scale*3.5*horizontal),ratio=F((double)vertical/horizontal);
     // SCORE measures arc endpoints clockwise from the top. Its default
     // printer path fills P13 arcs without adding an outline stroke.
     DrawArc(g,page,page.Prepared.X,page.Prepared.Y,radius,ratio,90-stop,90-start,width,filled,!filled,pivot,rotation);
     if(thickness!=0)NativePrintContext.RestoreDefaultLineWidth();
     return true;
    }
    if(stop<start)stop+=360;
    points=NativeDatDrawing.Get(library).ShapeCircle(page.Scale,page.Prepared.X,page.Prepared.Y,horizontal,vertical,filled,step,start,stop)
     .ConvertAll(q=>new BarlinePoint(q.X,q.Y,q.Operation));
   }else{
    if(item.P(11)!=0||item.P(12)!=0||Math.Abs(item.P(10))>32767)return false;
    float factor=F(page.Scale*3.5),dx=F((double)factor*horizontal),dy=F((double)factor*vertical);
    float left=F((double)page.Prepared.X-dx),right=F((double)page.Prepared.X+dx);
    float bottom=F((double)page.Prepared.Y-dy),top=F((double)page.Prepared.Y+dy);
    // Direct Code12 tests the cached signed word before applying raw shear.
    // Fractional magnitudes below one are ignored; harp delegation differs.
    float shear=(short)(int)item.P(10)!=0?F((double)page.Scale*item.P(10)*7):0;
    points=new List<BarlinePoint>{
     new BarlinePoint(left,bottom,filled?2:1),new BarlinePoint(right,bottom,0),
     new BarlinePoint(F((double)right+shear),top,0),new BarlinePoint(F((double)left+shear),top,0),
     new BarlinePoint(left,bottom,0),new BarlinePoint(right,bottom,0)
    };
   }
   RenderResourceAudit.Record("printed shape",circle?"circle or arc":"centred rectangle","original Code12 print path","SCORE coordinates, fill and printer rotation");
   NativeNoteDetails.Path(g,page,points,width,false,pivot,rotation);
   if(thickness!=0)NativePrintContext.RestoreDefaultLineWidth();
   return true;
  }
  internal static void DrawArc(Graphics g,NativeNotationContext page,float x,float y,float radius,float ratio,int start,int stop,float width,bool fill,bool stroke,PointF pivot=default(PointF),float rotation=0,bool exactDecimal=false){
   var culture=CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
   Func<float,string> coordinate=value=>exactDecimal?ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments.SingleFixedDecimal.Format(value,1):value.ToString("F1",culture);
   string sx=coordinate(x),sy=coordinate(F((double)y/ratio)),sr=coordinate(radius);
   string sv=ratio.ToString("F5",culture),si=F(1.0/ratio).ToString("F5",culture);
   float xx=Single.Parse(sx,culture),yy=Single.Parse(sy,culture),rr=Single.Parse(sr,culture);
   var state=g.Save();
   try{
    using(var projection=page.Projection.Matrix())g.MultiplyTransform(projection,MatrixOrder.Prepend);
    if(rotation!=0){g.TranslateTransform(pivot.X,pivot.Y);g.RotateTransform(rotation);g.TranslateTransform(-pivot.X,-pivot.Y);}
    using(var path=new GraphicsPath(FillMode.Alternate))using(var pen=new Pen(Color.Black,width)){
     float magnitude=Math.Abs(rr);if(stop!=start)path.AddArc(xx-magnitude,yy-magnitude,magnitude*2,magnitude*2,start+(rr<0?180:0),stop-start);
     using(var scale=new Matrix(1,0,0,Single.Parse(sv,culture),0,0))path.Transform(scale);
     if(fill&&path.PointCount>0)g.TrackedFillPath(Brushes.Black,path);
     if(stroke&&path.PointCount>0)g.TrackedDrawPath(pen,path);
    }
   }finally{g.Restore(state);}
   var eps=NativeEpsExport.For(g);
   if(eps!=null)eps.ScoreArc(sx,sy,sr,sv,si,start,stop,width,fill,stroke,pivot,rotation);
  }
 }
}
````

````csharp
  internal static bool PrintedMusic(int code){return code>=80&&code<=82||code>=88&&code<=92||code>=162&&code<=167;}
  static int PrintedCharacter(string text,ref int p,short font,ref int accent,out char output,out string glyph){

  List<NativeTextToken> PrintedRenderingTokens(NativeTextLayout layout,short word,short prior){
   var original=RenderingTokens(layout,word,prior);if(!original.Exists(t=>t.Code==800))return original;
   var result=new List<NativeTextToken>();var run=new List<NativeTextToken>();bool forced=TextConverterFontState.Begin(word,prior).Forced;
   Action flush=()=>{if(!run.Exists(t=>t.Code==800))result.AddRange(run);else{

     if(++n==literal.Length)throw new NotSupportedException("SCORE's paired backslash leaves an unterminated PostScript text run.");c=literal[n];
     if(c>='0'&&c<='7'){int v=c-'0';for(int k=1;k<3&&n+1<literal.Length&&literal[n+1]>='0'&&literal[n+1]<='7';k++)v=v*8+literal[++n]-'0';c=(char)(v&255);}

  }
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Drawing;using System.Threading;using System.Windows.Forms;
namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativePrintExecution:IDisposable {
  [ThreadStatic]internal static NativePrintExecution Current;
  internal static Action<NativePrintExecution,int> TestInput=null;
  internal readonly NativePrintFlow Flow;internal readonly Canvas Canvas;
  readonly NativePrintExecution previous;readonly Action update;int last;
  internal NativePrintExecution(Canvas canvas,short desc,Action update){Canvas=canvas;Flow=new NativePrintFlow(desc);this.update=update;Flow.Changed=update;previous=Current;Current=this;}
  internal static void Before(Canvas canvas,Graphics graphics,int item){var run=Current;if(run==null||run.Canvas!=canvas||NativeEpsExport.For(graphics)==null&&!NativeNotationView.IsPrinting)return;run.Before(item);}
  void Before(int item){
   if(Flow.ExitRequested)throw new NativePrintExitException();
   if(Flow.FinishCurrent&&item>Flow.Item)throw new NativePrintFinishException();
   if(item==last)return;last=item;Flow.Item=item;if(update!=null)update();
   if(TestInput!=null)TestInput(this,item);
   if(!Program.CheckMode)Application.DoEvents();
   while(Flow.Paused&&!Flow.ExitRequested){if(Program.CheckMode)throw new InvalidOperationException("Print test paused without a supplied continuation.");Application.DoEvents();Thread.Sleep(10);}
   if(Flow.ExitRequested)throw new NativePrintExitException();
  }
  public void Dispose(){Current=previous;}
 }
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  NativePrintExecution printExecution;bool closeAfterPrint;
  bool PrintingKey(Keys key){if(printExecution==null)return false;if(key==(Keys.Alt|Keys.F4)){closeAfterPrint=true;printExecution.Flow.ExitRequested=true;return true;}
   Keys code=key&Keys.KeyCode;if(code==Keys.ShiftKey||code==Keys.ControlKey||code==Keys.Menu||code==Keys.LWin||code==Keys.RWin)return true;if(code==Keys.Enter||code==Keys.Escape||code==Keys.Back||code==Keys.Tab||code==Keys.Delete||code==Keys.Insert||code==Keys.Home||code==Keys.End||code==Keys.Left||code==Keys.Right||code==Keys.Up||code==Keys.Down||code==Keys.PageUp||code==Keys.PageDown||code>=Keys.F1&&code<=Keys.F24||(key&(Keys.Control|Keys.Alt))!=0){printExecution.Flow.Key(key);return true;}return false;
  }
  bool PrintingCharacter(KeyPressEventArgs key){if(printExecution==null)return false;printExecution.Flow.Character(key.KeyChar);key.Handled=true;return true;}
  void PrintProgress(){if(printExecution==null)return;var flow=printExecution.Flow;if(flow.Disabled&&!NativePrintBehaviour.TemporaryGo)printJob.Desc=1;responseLine.Text="**** Printing "+score.Items.Count+" items. ****"+Environment.NewLine+"Sending Item # "+flow.Item+(flow.Paused?Environment.NewLine+"X = Exit printing, P = Print now, C = Continue.":flow.Disabled?Environment.NewLine+"Escape disabled; subsequent keys are queued until printing finishes.":"");LayoutTextContents(true);}
  void ExecuteControlledPrint(Action output){
   if(printExecution!=null)throw new InvalidOperationException("A print job is already running.");
   var pending=new List<object>();bool exited=false;Exception failure=null;bool enabled=canvas.Enabled,context=ContextMenuStrip.Enabled,functions=functionStrip.Enabled;
   FormClosingEventHandler closing=(sender,args)=>{args.Cancel=true;closeAfterPrint=true;if(printExecution!=null)printExecution.Flow.ExitRequested=true;};FormClosing+=closing;
   try{canvas.Enabled=false;ContextMenuStrip.Enabled=false;functionStrip.Enabled=false;if(originalPrintPanel!=null)originalPrintPanel.Visible=false;command.Clear();command.Focus();
    using(var run=new NativePrintExecution(canvas,printJob.Desc,PrintProgress)){printExecution=run;try{output();}catch(NativePrintFinishException){}catch(NativePrintExitException){exited=true;}finally{pending.AddRange(run.Flow.TypeAhead);if(run.Flow.Disabled&&!NativePrintBehaviour.TemporaryGo)printJob.Desc=1;}}
   }catch(Exception error){failure=error;}finally{printExecution=null;FormClosing-=closing;canvas.Enabled=enabled;ContextMenuStrip.Enabled=context;functionStrip.Enabled=functions;canvas.Invalidate();}
   if(failure!=null){RefreshOriginalPrintMenu();throw failure;}
   mode=ScreenMode.Main;printStage=OriginalPrintStage.None;
   Action completed=()=>{UpdateClassic();LayoutClassic();Message(exited?"Printing exited.":"Output = "+(String.IsNullOrEmpty(printJob.Output)?"Laser":printJob.Output));command.Focus();};
   if(!BeginExternalDrawingRedraw(completed))completed();
   if(closeAfterPrint){closeAfterPrint=false;Close();return;}
   foreach(object value in pending){if(IsDisposed)break;if(value is char){char c=(char)value;if(c==13){string text=((NativeCommandBox)command).PhysicalText;RecordSharedLine(text);command.Clear();Safe(()=>Execute(text));}else ((NativeCommandBox)command).ReplayCharacter(c);}else{Keys key=(Keys)value;if(key==Keys.Enter){string text=((NativeCommandBox)command).PhysicalText;RecordSharedLine(text);command.Clear();Safe(()=>Execute(text));}else{var message=new Message();if(!ProcessCmdKey(ref message,key)){var e=new KeyEventArgs(key);OnKeyDown(e);if(!e.Handled&&!e.SuppressKeyPress)((NativeCommandBox)command).ReplayEditingKey(key);}}}}
  }
 }
````

````csharp
using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Windows.Forms;
namespace ScoreModern {
 // Original2FC5:0094..0153. Keyboard queue ownership is independent of transport.
 internal sealed class NativePrintFlow {
  internal bool Disabled,Paused,ExitRequested,FinishCurrent;
  internal int Item;internal readonly List<object> TypeAhead=new List<object>();
  internal Action Changed;
  internal NativePrintFlow(short desc){Disabled=desc!=0;}
  internal void Character(char value){
   if(Disabled){Queue(value);return;}
   if(Paused){switch(Char.ToLowerInvariant(value)){case 'x':ExitRequested=true;Paused=false;break;case 'p':FinishCurrent=true;Paused=false;break;case 'c':Paused=false;break;}Notify();return;}
   if(value=='G'||value=='g')Disabled=true;else if(value==27)Paused=true;
   Notify();
  }
  internal void Key(Keys value){if(Disabled){Queue(value);return;}if(value==Keys.Escape)Character((char)27);}
  void Queue(object value){if(TypeAhead.Count<15)TypeAhead.Add(value);}
  void Notify(){if(Changed!=null)Changed();}
 }
 internal sealed class NativePrintFinishException:Exception{}
 internal sealed class NativePrintExitException:Exception{}
 public static class NativePrintBehaviour {
  static bool retainIncomplete=NativeSettings.Read("print-incomplete-eps")=="retain";
  static bool temporaryGo=NativeSettings.Read("print-go-suppression")=="job";
  static bool scorlasEmpty=NativeSettings.Read("scorlas-empty-bounds")=="original";
  internal static bool RetainIncomplete{get{return NativeScoreBehaviour.Enabled||retainIncomplete;}}
  internal static bool TemporaryGo{get{return !NativeScoreBehaviour.Enabled&&temporaryGo;}}
  internal static bool OriginalScorlasEmpty{get{return NativeScoreBehaviour.Enabled||scorlasEmpty;}}
  internal static void SetScorlasEmpty(bool value,bool save){if(save)NativeSettings.WriteAllText("scorlas-empty-bounds",value?"original":"reject");scorlasEmpty=value;}
  internal static void AddMenu(ContextMenuStrip menu){
   var retain=new ToolStripMenuItem("Printing: retain incomplete EPS when exited (original)");retain.ToolTipText="SCORE leaves an unfinished PostScript stream after X. Off protects an existing EPS and discards the incomplete replacement; Strict SCORE retains the original side effect.";retain.Click+=(s,e)=>{retainIncomplete=!retainIncomplete;NativeSettings.WriteAllText("print-incomplete-eps",retainIncomplete?"retain":"discard");};menu.Items.Add(retain);
   var reset=new ToolStripMenuItem("Printing: reset Go suppression after this job (Tom's Help)");reset.ToolTipText="Measured SCORE keeps DESC=1 after G; Tom's Help describes suppression for one run.
````
