using System;using System.IO;using System.Globalization;using System.Collections.Generic;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed class NativePrintJob:IDisposable {
  [ThreadStatic]public static NativePrintJob Active;NativePrintJob previous;bool automaticResolved;public short? AutomaticMinimum;internal NativePrintExtents ResolvedExtents;public string OffsetWarning{get;private set;}
  public string Source,Output="",Header="None",Project="";public float HeaderOffset=-.18f,FooterOffset=.18f;public float Size=1,PaperWidth=8.5f,PaperHeight=11;public int Left=2000,Bottom=3000;int? configuredBottom;public short Resolution=300,LineWidth=2,Tray,Desc;public bool Freeze,Rotate,Mirror,Stroke,Manual;
  static float F(double n){return (float)n;}static readonly CultureInfo Culture=CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
  static float Number(string value){int split=value.IndexOfAny(new[]{' ','\t',','});if(split>=0)value=value.Substring(0,split);float n;if(!Single.TryParse(value,NumberStyles.Float,Culture,out n)||Single.IsNaN(n)||Single.IsInfinity(n))throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid finite print parameter: "+value);return n;}

  static short Word(string value){float n=Number(value);if(n!=Math.Truncate(n)||n<short.MinValue||n>short.MaxValue)throw new NotSupportedException("Print parameter requires a signed16 integer.");return (short)n;}
  internal void SetOffsets(float left,float bottom){int x=checked((int)Math.Truncate((double)left*4000)),y=checked((int)Math.Truncate((double)bottom*4000));Left=x;Bottom=y;configuredBottom=y;automaticResolved=false;OffsetWarning=null;}
  internal void SetRotation(bool rotate){if(rotate==Rotate)return;Size=RecoveredFragments.PrintRotation.Apply(Size,Rotate,rotate);if(!Freeze){Bottom=RecoveredFragments.PrintRotation.Offset(configuredBottom??Bottom,Rotate,rotate);configuredBottom=Bottom;automaticResolved=false;AutomaticMinimum=null;ResolvedExtents=null;OffsetWarning=null;}Rotate=rotate;}
  public static NativePrintJob Defaults(string root){var data=NativePreferences.Read(root);short resolution=data.Word("RESOLUTION",300);return new NativePrintJob{Resolution=resolution,LineWidth=(short)Math.Round(resolution/150.0,MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero),Stroke=data.Word("SETSTROKE",0)!=0};}
  internal NativePrintJob CopyConfiguration(){var copy=(NativePrintJob)MemberwiseClone();copy.previous=null;copy.automaticResolved=false;copy.AutomaticMinimum=null;copy.ResolvedExtents=null;copy.OffsetWarning=null;return copy;}
  public static NativePrintJob Read(string file){return Read(file,null);}
  public static NativePrintJob Read(string file,NativePrintJob retained){var job=retained==null?new NativePrintJob():(NativePrintJob)retained.MemberwiseClone();job.Source=Path.GetFullPath(file);job.previous=null;job.configuredBottom=null;job.automaticResolved=false;job.AutomaticMinimum=null;job.ResolvedExtents=null;job.OffsetWarning=null;var lines=File.ReadAllLines(file,System.Text.Encoding.GetEncoding(437));for(int index=0;index<lines.Length;index++){string line=lines[index].Trim();if(line.Length==0)continue;int space=line.IndexOfAny(new[]{' ','\t'});string key=space<0?line:line.Substring(0,space),value=space<0?"":line.Substring(space).Trim();switch(key.ToUpperInvariant()){
   case "OUTPUT":job.Output=value.TrimEnd('\0',' ','\t');break;case "SIZE":job.Size=Number(value);break;case "PAPER":case "OFFSETS":
   if(key.Equals("PAPER",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){
    string standard=value.ToUpperInvariant();
    if(standard=="LTR"||standard=="LEG"||standard=="LDG"){
     job.PaperWidth=standard=="LDG"?11:8.5f;
     job.PaperHeight=standard=="LEG"?14:standard=="LDG"?17:11;
     break;
    }
   }
   var parts=value.Split(new[]{' ','\t',','},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);if(parts.Length!=2)throw new InvalidDataException(key+" requires two values.");if(key.Equals("PAPER",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){job.PaperWidth=Number(parts[0]);job.PaperHeight=Number(parts[1]);}else{job.Left=checked((int)Math.Truncate((double)Number(parts[0])*4000));job.Bottom=checked((int)Math.Truncate((double)Number(parts[1])*4000));}break;
   case "FREEZE":job.Freeze=YesNo(value);break;case "RESOLUTION":job.Resolution=Word(value);break;case "LINE_WIDTH":job.LineWidth=Word(value);break;case "HEADER/FOOTER":
    job.Header=value;
    if(!value.Equals("None",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){
     string mode=value.ToUpperInvariant();
     bool header=mode=="HEADER"||mode=="BOTH",footer=mode=="FOOTER"||mode=="BOTH";
     if(!header&&!footer)throw new NotSupportedException("Unrecognized SCORE header/footer mode: "+value);
     if(index+(header&&footer?3:2)>=lines.Length)throw new InvalidDataException("Incomplete SCORE header/footer settings.");
     job.Project=lines[++index].TrimEnd();
     if(job.Project.Length>18)throw new InvalidDataException("SCORE project names are limited to 18 characters.");
     if(header)job.HeaderOffset=HeaderInput(Number(lines[++index].Trim()),job.HeaderOffset);
     if(footer)job.FooterOffset=FooterInput(Number(lines[++index].Trim()),job.FooterOffset);
    }

  }}if(job.Size<=0||job.PaperWidth<=0||job.PaperHeight<=0||job.Resolution<=0)throw new InvalidDataException("Print size, paper dimensions and resolution must be positive.");return job;}
  // Original2E2C:0D14..0D46 /0E11..0E3F: positive zero retains the
  // old offset; nonzero words normalize header negative and footer positive.
  internal static float HeaderInput(float value,float retained){uint bits=BitConverter.ToUInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(value),0);if(bits==0)return retained;return BitConverter.ToSingle(BitConverter.GetBytes(bits|0x80000000u),0);}
  internal static float FooterInput(float value,float retained){uint bits=BitConverter.ToUInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(value),0);if(bits==0)return retained;return BitConverter.ToSingle(BitConverter.GetBytes(bits&0x7fffffffu),0);}
  public void Write(string file){Write(file,false);}
  internal void Write(string file,bool scor4){
   var text=new System.Text.StringBuilder();
   Action<string> line=value=>text.Append(value).Append("\r\n");
   string output=Output;
   if(scor4&&output.Equals("Laser",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))output="";
   line("OUTPUT  "+output.PadRight(24,scor4&&output.Length==0?'\0':' '));
   line("ROTATE        "+Flag(Rotate).PadRight(3));
   line("SIZE      "+DecimalField(Size,3,5));
   string paper=PaperWidth==8.5f&&PaperHeight==11?"LTR":PaperWidth==8.5f&&PaperHeight==14?"LEG":
    PaperWidth==11&&PaperHeight==17?"LDG":PaperWidth.ToString("0.00",Culture)+"  "+PaperHeight.ToString("0.00",Culture);
   line("PAPER         "+paper);
   line("OFFSETS    "+DecimalField(Left/4000.0,2,4)+"   "+DecimalField((configuredBottom??Bottom)/4000.0,2,4));
   line("FREEZE        "+Flag(Freeze).PadRight(3));
   line("RESOLUTION    "+Resolution.ToString(Culture));
   line("LINE_width     "+LineWidth.ToString(Culture));
   line("HEADER/FOOTER "+Header.PadRight(6));
   if(!Header.Equals("None",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){
    line(Project.PadRight(18));
    if(!Header.Equals("Footer",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))line(DecimalField(HeaderOffset,3,7));
    if(!Header.Equals("Header",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))line(DecimalField(FooterOffset,3,7));
   }
   line("MIRROR        "+Flag(Mirror).PadRight(3));
   line("SETSTROKE     "+Flag(Stroke).PadRight(3));
   line("MANUAL_feed   "+Flag(Manual).PadRight(3));
   line("SETPAPERTRAY  "+Tray.ToString(Culture));
   line("DESC  "+Desc.ToString(Culture));
   ScoreFileStorage.Write(file,System.Text.Encoding.GetEncoding(437).GetBytes(text.ToString()));
  }
  static string DecimalField(double value,int places,int width){
   return value.ToString("."+new string('0',places),Culture).PadLeft(width);
  }
  static string Flag(bool state){return state?"Yes":"No";}
  // Original2587:0094..014f: retained x87 products, separate truncations.
  public float Scale{get{return F((double)Size*.017999999225139618);}}
  public float GeometryUnit{get{return F(4000.0/Resolution+.009999999776482582);}}
  public float Unit{get{return F((4000.0/Resolution+.009999999776482582)/Size);}}
  public float Width{get{return F((double)Unit*LineWidth);}}
  public int LeftMargin{get{return checked((int)Math.Truncate(4000.0/Size*F(Left/4000.0))+(int)Math.Truncate(100.0/Size));}}
  public int BottomMargin{get{return checked((int)Math.Truncate(4000.0/Size*F(Bottom/4000.0)+24000)+(int)Math.Truncate(250.0/Size));}}
  public void Resolve(Canvas canvas){if(Freeze)return;
   if(!configuredBottom.HasValue||OffsetWarning==null&&!automaticResolved)configuredBottom=Bottom;
   automaticResolved=false;AutomaticMinimum=null;OffsetWarning=null;ResolvedExtents=null;
   try{
    ResolvedExtents=NativePrintMinimum.Extents(canvas);
    short minimum=ResolvedExtents.Bottom;
    AutomaticMinimum=minimum;
    Bottom=RecoveredFragments.AutomaticPrintOffset.SelectBottom(RecoveredFragments.AutomaticPrintOffset.FromMinimumWord(minimum));
   }catch(NotSupportedException error){
    if(!NativeApproximation.Enabled)throw;
    Bottom=configuredBottom.Value;
    OffsetWarning="Automatic print offsets unavailable. Using the configured bottom offset. "+error.Message;
   }
   automaticResolved=true;}
  internal void ResolveScorlas(Canvas canvas){
   // SCORLAS retains the configured offsets; in particular rotation's
   // 3999-unit bottom candidate survives (measured emitted bmar27185).
   // SCORE's standalone automatic minimum selector is a different caller.
   var extent=NativePrintMinimum.Extents(canvas);
   configuredBottom=Bottom;ResolvedExtents=extent;AutomaticMinimum=extent.Bottom;OffsetWarning=null;automaticResolved=true;
  }
  public void ValidateOutput(){if(!Freeze&&!automaticResolved)throw new InvalidOperationException("Resolve the original vector minimum before automatic print output.");if(Tray<0||Tray>9||Desc<0||Desc>1)throw new NotSupportedException("SCORE printer tray must be 0–9 and DESC must be 0 or 1.");}
  internal string DeviceProgram(string drawingBox=null){
   string setup="";
   if(Tray!=0)setup+="statusdict /setpapertray known {statusdict begin "+Tray+" setpapertray end} if\n";
   bool automaticLedger=false;
   // Original2DAB:049B..0508 compares the rounded physical maxima before
   // the DSC +1 padding. It changes this output request, not F6 settings.
   if(PaperWidth==8.5f&&PaperHeight==11&&drawingBox!=null){var edges=drawingBox.Split(new[]{' '},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);if(edges.Length==4)automaticLedger=Int32.Parse(edges[2],Culture)-1>=594||Int32.Parse(edges[3],Culture)-1>=774;}
   if(automaticLedger||PaperWidth!=8.5f||PaperHeight!=11)
    setup+="statusdict /setpage known {statusdict begin "+(automaticLedger?"792":Math.Round(PaperWidth*72).ToString(Culture))+" "+(automaticLedger?"1224":Math.Round(PaperHeight*72).ToString(Culture))+" 1 setpage end} if\n";
   if(Manual)setup+="statusdict /manualfeed true put\n";
   return setup;
  }
  public IDisposable Begin(){ValidateOutput();previous=Active;Active=this;return this;}
  public void Dispose(){Active=previous;}
  public System.Drawing.Drawing2D.Matrix CanvasMatrix(){ValidateOutput();double scale=Double.Parse(Scale.ToString("F5",Culture),Culture);float coefficient=F(30*scale),horizontal=Mirror?-coefficient:coefficient;double rawOriginX=Mirror?32000:-2100;if(Rotate)return new System.Drawing.Drawing2D.Matrix(0,-horizontal,coefficient,0,F(612-scale*(27250+BottomMargin)),F(PaperHeight*72.0+6-scale*(LeftMargin+rawOriginX)));return new System.Drawing.Drawing2D.Matrix(horizontal,0,0,coefficient,F(scale*(LeftMargin+rawOriginX)),F(PaperHeight*72.0-scale*(27250+BottomMargin)));}
  internal string RawProgram(bool mirrorNotation=true){return (Rotate?"612 -6 translate 90 rotate\n":"")+Scale.ToString("F5",Culture)+" dup scale "+LeftMargin+" "+BottomMargin+" translate\n"+(Mirror&&mirrorNotation?"29900 0 translate -1 1 scale\n":"");}
  internal string IncludedProgramPhysicalSpace(float pageWidth,float pageHeight){
   // Undo the actual Windows notation matrix, expressed in PostScript's
   // bottom-left page coordinates. Included programs establish their own CTM.
   using(var matrix=CanvasMatrix()){
    var e=matrix.Elements;
    double x=pageWidth/612.0,y=pageHeight/792.0;
    double a=e[0]*x,b=-e[1]*x,c=-e[2]*y,d=e[3]*y;
    double tx=e[2]*(double)pageHeight+e[4];
    double ty=PaperHeight*72.0-e[3]*(double)pageHeight-e[5];
    double determinant=a*d-b*c;
    var inverse=new[]{d/determinant,-b/determinant,-c/determinant,a/determinant,
     (c*ty-d*tx)/determinant,(b*tx-a*ty)/determinant};
    return "["+String.Join(" ",Array.ConvertAll(inverse,value=>value.ToString("R",Culture)))+"] concat\n";
   }
  }
  public string DeltaProgram(){return RawProgram()+"-2100 -27250 translate 55.55555555555556 dup scale\n";}

using System;using System.Linq;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Drawing.Printing;using System.IO;using System.Drawing;using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;using System.Windows.Forms;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  NativePrintJob printJob;
  static PaperSource ManualSource(PrinterSettings settings){
   return settings.PaperSources.Cast<PaperSource>().FirstOrDefault(source=>
    source.Kind==PaperSourceKind.Manual||source.Kind==PaperSourceKind.ManualFeed);
  }
  void Print(){
   if(score==null)return;
   if(printJob==null)printJob=NativePrintJob.Defaults(source);
   var job=printJob;
   job.Resolve(canvas);
   job.ValidateOutput();
   var captions=new NativePrintCaptions(job,score);
   float pageHeight=job.PaperHeight*72;
   using(var document=new PrintDocument()){
    document.DocumentName=String.IsNullOrEmpty(current)?"SCORE":Path.GetFileName(current);
    document.DefaultPageSettings.PaperSize=new PaperSize("SCORE",
     (int)Math.Round(job.PaperWidth*100),(int)Math.Round(job.PaperHeight*100));
    if(job.Manual&&document.PrinterSettings.IsValid){
     var manual=ManualSource(document.PrinterSettings);
     if(manual!=null)document.DefaultPageSettings.PaperSource=manual;
    }
    document.PrintPage+=(sender,args)=>{
     var g=args.Graphics;
     var state=g.Save();
     try{
      g.PageUnit=GraphicsUnit.Point;
      g.TranslateTransform(-args.PageSettings.HardMarginX*.72f,-args.PageSettings.HardMarginY*.72f);
      g.SmoothingMode=SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
      captions.Draw(g,pageHeight);
      RenderControlledPrintPage(g,job,()=>args.Cancel=true);
     }catch{args.Cancel=true;throw;}
     finally{g.Restore(state);}
    };
    var driverNotes=new List<string>();
    if(job.Tray!=0)driverNotes.Add("SCORE requests PostScript tray "+job.Tray+
     ". Select the corresponding paper source in the Windows printer properties.");
    if(job.Manual)driverNotes.Add("SCORE requests manual feed. Check the selected printer's paper source.");
    if(driverNotes.Count!=0&&MessageBox.Show(this,String.Join("\r\n",driverNotes.ToArray()),
     "SCORE print settings",MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel,MessageBoxIcon.Information)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
    using(var dialog=new PrintDialog{Document=document,UseEXDialog=true}){
     if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
    }
    using(var bitmap=new Bitmap(1,1))
    using(var proof=Graphics.FromImage(bitmap))
    using(job.Begin()){
     captions.Draw(proof,pageHeight);
     NativeNotationView.Print(canvas,proof);
    }
    var warnings=new List<string>(canvas.ApproximatedItems);
    if(job.OffsetWarning!=null)warnings.Insert(0,job.OffsetWarning);
    if(warnings.Count==0||MessageBox.Show(this,String.Join("\r\n",warnings.ToArray()),
     "SCORE Modern print warnings",MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel,MessageBoxIcon.Warning)==DialogResult.OK)document.Print();
   }
  }
  void RenderControlledPrintPage(Graphics graphics,NativePrintJob job,Action cancel){
   Action render=()=>{using(job.Begin())using(var matrix=job.CanvasMatrix()){graphics.MultiplyTransform(matrix,MatrixOrder.Prepend);NativeNotationView.Print(canvas,graphics);}};
   if(mode==ScreenMode.Print&&UsesOriginalPrintMenu)ExecuteControlledPrint(()=>{try{render();}catch(NativePrintExitException){cancel();throw;}});else render();
  }
  void LoadPrintSettings(){using(var dialog=new OpenFileDialog{Title="Read SCORE print parameters",Filter="SCORE print settings (*.SCR)|*.SCR|All files (*.*)|*.*",FileName="PRINT.SCR",InitialDirectory=NativeLibraryLocation.DirectoryFor(source,false)})if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)==DialogResult.OK){var loaded=NativePrintJob.Read(dialog.FileName,printJob);printJob=loaded;RefreshPageFrame();Message("Print parameters read from "+loaded.Source+"\r\nSize="+loaded.Size+" Paper="+loaded.PaperWidth+" x "+loaded.PaperHeight+" Freeze="+loaded.Freeze+" Rotate="+loaded.Rotate+"\r\n"+"Settings are applied to EPS and printing; unsupported output controls are reported before output.");}}
  void SavePrintSettings(){
   if(printJob==null)printJob=NativePrintJob.Defaults(source);
   using(var dialog=new SaveFileDialog{Title="Save SCORE print parameters",
    Filter="SCORE print settings (*.SCR)|*.SCR",DefaultExt="SCR",FileName="PRINT.SCR",
    InitialDirectory=NativeOutputLocation.EnsureFolder(source),RestoreDirectory=true}){
    if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
    string destination=NativeOutputLocation.RequireWritableDestination(source,dialog.FileName);
    printJob.Write(destination);
    Message("Print parameters saved to "+destination);
   }
  }
  string PrintExportName(){
   string output=printJob.Output;
   if(!String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(output)&&!output.Equals("Laser",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)){
    string file=Path.GetFileName(output);
    if(!String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(file))return file;
   }
   return String.IsNullOrEmpty(current)?"SCORE.EPS":Path.ChangeExtension(Path.GetFileName(current),"EPS");
  }
  void ExportPrintEps(){if(printJob==null)printJob=NativePrintJob.Defaults(source);using(var dialog=new SaveFileDialog{Title="Export SCORE EPS",Filter="Encapsulated PostScript (*.EPS)|*.EPS",InitialDirectory=NativeOutputLocation.EnsureFolder(source),RestoreDirectory=true,FileName=PrintExportName()})if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)==DialogResult.OK){if(printJob!=null)printJob.Resolve(canvas);using(var scope=printJob==null?null:printJob.Begin())NativeEpsExport.Write(canvas,source,NativeOutputLocation.RequireWritableDestination(source,dialog.FileName));var message="EPS saved: "+dialog.FileName;
   if(printJob!=null&&printJob.OffsetWarning!=null)message+="\r\n"+printJob.OffsetWarning;
   if(canvas.ApproximatedItems.Count>0)message+="\r\n"+String.Join("\r\n",canvas.ApproximatedItems.ToArray());
   Message(message);}}
 }
}

The strict SCORE preset always uses SCORE format.";score.Click+=(s,e)=>Set(true,true);native.Click+=(s,e)=>Set(false,true);menu.Items.Add(score);menu.Items.Add(native);menu.Opening+=(s,e)=>{score.Checked=Original;native.Checked=!Original;native.Enabled=!NativeScoreBehaviour.Enabled;};}

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativePrintExtents {
  internal short Left=32760,Bottom=32750,Right=-32600,Top=short.MinValue;
  internal bool HasPoints;
  internal void Include(short x,short y){
   HasPoints=true;
   Left=Math.Min(Left,x);Bottom=Math.Min(Bottom,y);
   Right=Math.Max(Right,x);Top=Math.Max(Top,y);
  }
  internal string DscBox(NativePrintJob job){
   if(!HasPoints)return "0 0 0 0";
   return DscBox(job,Left,Bottom,Right,Top);
  }
  internal static string DscBox(NativePrintJob job,long leftRaw,long bottomRaw,long rightRaw,long topRaw){
   double scale=job.Scale;
   int offsetX=job.LeftMargin,offsetY=job.BottomMargin;
   // Original 3046:0238–02B3 rotates the scan extrema, independently
   // of the PostScript transform. Mirror affects engraving only.
   if(job.Rotate){
    offsetX=(int)Math.Truncate(34000.0/job.Size-offsetY);
    offsetY=unchecked((short)job.LeftMargin);
    long oldLeft=leftRaw,oldRight=rightRaw;leftRaw=-topRaw;
    rightRaw=-bottomRaw;
    bottomRaw=oldLeft-266;
    topRaw=oldRight-266;
   }
   double left=(offsetX+leftRaw)*scale,right=(offsetX+rightRaw)*scale;
   double bottom=(offsetY+bottomRaw)*scale,top=(offsetY+topRaw)*scale;
   return String.Join(" ",Array.ConvertAll(new[]{Round(left)-1,Round(bottom)-1,Round(right)+1,Round(top)+1},n=>n.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
  }
  static int Round(double value){return checked((int)Math.Round(value,MidpointRounding.ToEven));}
 }
 public static class NativePrintMinimum {
  public static short Scan(Canvas canvas,Action<int,short> checkpoint=null){return Extents(canvas,checkpoint).Bottom;}
  internal static NativePrintExtents Extents(Canvas canvas,Action<int,short> checkpoint=null){
   if(canvas==null||canvas.Score==null||canvas.Library==null)
    throw new InvalidOperationException("A score and external library are required for automatic print offsets.");
   canvas.RebuildGuideMeasurement=true;canvas.LayoutScore();
   var dat=new NativeDatGlyphs(canvas.Library.Root);
   var cache=new NativeDatHeadCache();
   var extent=new NativePrintExtents();
   short font=0;
   int index=0;
   foreach(var item in canvas.Score.Items){
    index++;
    try{
     short next;
     var points=NativeDatDrawing.Prepare(item,canvas.PageDocument.Contexts[item],canvas.PageDocument,canvas.Library,canvas.TextLayout,dat,cache,font,out next);
     foreach(var p in points){
      if(p.CommandOnly)continue;
      short x=NativeNotationContext.Word(p.X,true),y=NativeNotationContext.Word(p.Y,false);
      if(x>=-32600)extent.Include(x,y);
     }
     font=next;
    }catch(Exception error){
     if(!(error is NotSupportedException||error is System.IO.InvalidDataException||error is System.IO.IOException))throw;
     throw new NotSupportedException("Automatic print-offset scan item "+index+": "+error.Message,error);
    }
    if(checkpoint!=null)checkpoint(index,extent.Bottom);
   }
   return extent;
  }
 }
}

using System;

using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativeArrayDiagnostics {
  static bool configured;
  public static bool AllowLogicalArrays { get { return !NativeScoreBehaviour.Enabled && configured; } }
  public static void Set(bool enabled,bool save) { configured=enabled;if(save)NativeSettings.WriteAllText("dpy-native-arrays",enabled?"enabled":"strict"); }
  public static void Load() { Set(false,false);try { Set(NativeSettings.Read("dpy-native-arrays")=="enabled",false); }catch(IOException){}catch(UnauthorizedAccessException){} }
  public static void AddMenu(ContextMenuStrip menu) {
   var item=new ToolStripMenuItem("DPY: allow labelled native logical arrays");
   item.Click+=(s,e)=>Set(!AllowLogicalArrays,true);menu.Items.Add(item);
   menu.Opening+=(s,e)=>{item.Checked=AllowLogicalArrays;item.ToolTipText="Off: reject unverified DOS storage histories. On: show explicitly labelled logical arrays reconstructed from current items; unused DOS storage is not reproduced.";};
  }
 }
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  // Original1DBB:075C..08AA prints IPTR, then each indexed RN record.
  // A tracked contiguous bank can include the original edit and compaction
  // operations whose record order is verified alongside the display bank.
  static string RawArrayNumber(float value) {
   if(Single.IsNaN(value)||Single.IsInfinity(value))
    throw new NotSupportedException("DPY nonfinite array formatting requires original verification.");
   string formatted=ExportFixed(value,3);
   return formatted.Length>11?new string('*',11):formatted.PadLeft(11);
  }
  static IEnumerable<string> RawArrayRows(IEnumerable<string> fields,int perLine) {
   var values=fields.ToArray();
   for(int at=0;at<values.Length;at+=perLine) {
    string line=String.Concat(values.Skip(at).Take(perLine));
    // The original console consumes the first Fortran carriage-control column.
    yield return line.Substring(1);
   }
  }
  void ShowOriginalDisplayArray() {
   // Track the verified startup/load producer history, including untouched
   // marker words. Unmodelled mutation histories retain the strict guard.
   var physical=TrackedDisplayArray();bool logical=NativeArrayDiagnostics.AllowLogicalArrays||physical==null;
   if(logical&&!NativeArrayDiagnostics.AllowLogicalArrays)throw new NotSupportedException("DPY -1 display-array layout is not verified for this state. Explicitly enable labelled native logical arrays to inspect reconstructed vectors.");
   canvas.LayoutScore();var dat=new NativeDatGlyphs(canvas.Library.Root);var cache=new NativeDatHeadCache();short font=0;
   var records=new List<List<string>>();var pointers=new List<int>();int pointer=1;
   if(!logical){pointers=physical.Pointers.ToList();for(int item=0;item<pointers.Count-1;item++){var record=new List<string>();for(int at=pointers[item];at<pointers[item+1];at++)record.Add(physical.X[at].ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(6)+physical.Y[at-1].ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(7));records.Add(record);}}
   else {using(canvas.TextLayout.PreserveAlignmentMetricHistory())foreach(var item in score.Items) {
    pointers.Add(pointer);short next;var vectors=NativeDatDrawing.Prepare(item,canvas.PageDocument.Contexts[item],canvas.PageDocument,canvas.Library,canvas.TextLayout,dat,cache,font,out next);font=next;
    // Main's display buffer retains the staff-number contours in the staff
    // record. The F6 producer deliberately excludes this screen-only suffix.
    if(item.Code==8&&!canvas.TextLayout.ShowActualDatFonts)foreach(var number in NativeDosOverlays.Numbers(score,canvas.PageDocument,canvas.TextLayout,canvas.DisappearingStaffs))if(number.Staff==item.Staff)vectors.AddRange(number.Points);
    var record=new List<string>();
    foreach(var point in vectors) {
     if(point.Operation>0){record.Add((point.Operation-32700).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(6)+"      0");pointer++;}
     if(point.CommandOnly)continue;
     record.Add(NativeNotationContext.Word(point.X,true).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(6)+NativeNotationContext.Word(point.Y,false).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(7));pointer++;
    }
    records.Add(record);
   }
   pointers.Add(pointer);}var pages=new List<string[]>();var page=new List<string>();
   if(logical)page.Add("NATIVE LOGICAL ARRAY — reconstructed display vectors; DOS physical storage is not reproduced.");
   page.Add("DPY array");page.AddRange(RawArrayRows(pointers.ConvertAll(value=>value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(5)),10));int row=page.Count;
   // Original31F6:046E calls the BIOS-row pause helper before every pair,
   // including pairs inside a single long item, rather than only per item.
   foreach(var record in records)foreach(var pair in record){if(row>=20){page.Add("Press any key to continue.");pages.Add(page.ToArray());page.Clear();row=0;if(logical){page.Add("NATIVE LOGICAL ARRAY — continued; DOS physical storage is not reproduced.");row=1;}}page.Add(pair);row++;}
   page.Add("Press any key to continue.");pages.Add(page.ToArray());if(ShowCommandList("Display array",pages))return;letterHelpPages=pages;letterHelpIsType=false;letterHelpIsParameters=true;letterHelpPage=0;letterHelpTopicPending=false;letterHelpPreviousMessage="";ShowLetterHelpPage();
  }
  void ShowOriginalParameterArray() {
   bool logical=!score.RawStorageLayoutVerified&&TrackedDisplayArray()==null;
   if(logical&&!NativeArrayDiagnostics.AllowLogicalArrays)
    throw new NotSupportedException("DPY 1 parameter storage is unverified for this edit history. Save and reload, or enable labelled native logical-array dumps in Preferences.");
   var pointers=new List<int>();int pointer=1;
   foreach(var item in score.Items){pointers.Add(pointer);pointer+=item.Count+1;}
   pointers.Add(pointer);
   var pages=new List<string[]>();var page=new List<string>();
   if(logical)page.Add("NATIVE LOGICAL ARRAY — reconstructed current items; DOS physical storage is not reproduced.");
   page.Add(" IPTR array");
   page.AddRange(RawArrayRows(pointers.Select(value=>value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).PadLeft(5)),10));
   page.Add(" RN array");int row=page.Count;
   foreach(var item in score.Items) {
    if(row>=20){page.Add("Press any key to continue.");pages.Add(page.ToArray());page.Clear();row=0;if(logical){page.Add("NATIVE LOGICAL ARRAY — continued; DOS physical storage is not reproduced.");row=1;}}
    int last=item.P(1)==11?Math.Min(9,item.Count):item.Count;
    var values=new List<float>{BitConverter.ToSingle(item.Bytes,0)};
    for(int n=1;n<=last;n++)values.Add(item.P(n));
    var lines=RawArrayRows(values.Select(RawArrayNumber),7).ToArray();
    page.AddRange(lines);row+=lines.Length;
   }
   page.Add("Press any key to continue.");pages.Add(page.ToArray());
   if(ShowCommandList("Parameter array",pages))return;
   letterHelpPages=pages;letterHelpIsType=false;letterHelpIsParameters=true;
   letterHelpPage=0;letterHelpTopicPending=false;letterHelpPreviousMessage="";
   ShowLetterHelpPage();
  }
 }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal enum ScorlasInputSequence {PageNumberAndPartLetter,ConsecutiveNumbers,ConsecutiveCharacters}
 internal static class NativeScorlasBatch {
  static readonly Regex PagePart=new Regex(@"^(.*?)([0-9]+)([^0-9]*?)([A-Za-z])$");
  static readonly Regex NumberSuffix=new Regex(@"^(.*?)([0-9]+)$");
  internal static ScorlasInputSequence Detect(string file){string stem=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(file);return PagePart.IsMatch(stem)?ScorlasInputSequence.PageNumberAndPartLetter:NumberSuffix.IsMatch(stem)?ScorlasInputSequence.ConsecutiveNumbers:ScorlasInputSequence.ConsecutiveCharacters;}
  static string AddNumber(string value,int amount){char[] digits=value.ToCharArray();int carry=amount;for(int n=digits.Length-1;n>=0;n--){int sum=digits[n]-'0'+carry;digits[n]=(char)('0'+sum%10);carry=sum/10;}return (carry==0?"":carry.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))+new string(digits);}
  static char AddCharacter(char start,int amount){int end=start>='A'&&start<='Z'?'Z':start>='a'&&start<='z'?'z':start>='0'&&start<='9'?'9':-1;if(end<0||amount>end-start)throw new NotSupportedException("This character sequence would pass its final letter or digit. Choose numeric filenames or split the batch; character rollover has not been assumed.");return (char)(start+amount);}
  internal static List<List<string>> Define(string start,int perPage,int count,bool countFiles,ScorlasInputSequence sequence){
   if(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(start))throw new ArgumentException("Choose a starting page/file.");
   if(perPage<=0||count<=0)throw new ArgumentException("Files per page and count must be positive.");
   int total=checked(countFiles?count:perPage*count);if(total>100000)throw new NotSupportedException("Preview at most 100,000 files in one batch; split larger definitions into smaller batches.");
   string full=Path.GetFullPath(start),folder=Path.GetDirectoryName(full),stem=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(full),extension=Path.GetExtension(full);var part=PagePart.Match(stem);var number=NumberSuffix.Match(stem);
   if(sequence==ScorlasInputSequence.PageNumberAndPartLetter&&!part.Success)throw new ArgumentException("Page/part naming needs a page number followed by a part letter, such as MAT001A.MUS.");
   if(sequence==ScorlasInputSequence.ConsecutiveNumbers&&!number.Success)throw new ArgumentException("Numeric naming needs a number at the end of the filename, such as wandh01.mus.");
   if(stem.Length==0)throw new ArgumentException("The starting filename has no stem.");
   var pages=new List<List<string>>();for(int n=0;n<total;n++){
    int page=n/perPage,file=n%perPage;string next;
    if(sequence==ScorlasInputSequence.PageNumberAndPartLetter)next=part.Groups[1].Value+AddNumber(part.Groups[2].Value,page)+part.Groups[3].Value+AddCharacter(part.Groups[4].Value[0],file);
    else if(sequence==ScorlasInputSequence.ConsecutiveNumbers)next=number.Groups[1].Value+AddNumber(number.Groups[2].Value,n);
    else next=stem.Substring(0,stem.Length-1)+AddCharacter(stem[stem.Length-1],n);
    if(file==0)pages.Add(new List<string>());pages[page].Add(Path.Combine(folder,next+extension));
   }return pages;
  }
  internal static string[] OutputNames(string first,int count,bool numeric){
   string full=Path.GetFullPath(first),folder=Path.GetDirectoryName(full),stem=Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(full),extension=Path.GetExtension(full);if(stem.Length==0||count<=0)throw new ArgumentException("Choose a valid first output filename.");
   var number=NumberSuffix.Match(stem);if(numeric&&!number.Success)throw new ArgumentException("Numeric output names need a suffix such as TILED01.PS.");
   var names=new string[count];for(int n=0;n<count;n++){string next=n==0?stem:numeric?number.Groups[1].Value+AddNumber(number.Groups[2].Value,n):stem.Substring(0,stem.Length-1)+AddCharacter(stem[stem.Length-1],n);names[n]=Path.Combine(folder,next+extension);}return names;
  }
  internal static string Export(string root,IList<List<string>> pages,string firstOutput,NativePrintJob settings,bool numericNames,bool resolveInitialOffsets){
   return ExportControlled(root,pages,firstOutput,settings,numericNames,resolveInitialOffsets,null,null);
  }
  internal static string ExportControlled(string root,IList<List<string>> pages,string firstOutput,NativePrintJob settings,bool numericNames,bool resolveInitialOffsets,Func<bool> cancelled,Action<int,int> progress){
   if(pages==null||pages.Count==0||pages.Any(page=>page==null||page.Count==0))throw new ArgumentException("Every batch page needs at least one file.");
   string[] outputs=OutputNames(firstOutput,pages.Count,numericNames);var inputPaths=new HashSet<string>(pages.SelectMany(page=>page).Select(Path.GetFullPath),StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
   foreach(string file in inputPaths)if(!File.Exists(file))throw new FileNotFoundException("Batch input is missing.",file);
   foreach(string file in outputs)if(inputPaths.Contains(file))throw new InvalidDataException("An output filename would overwrite a batch input: "+file);
   var job=(settings??NativePrintJob.Defaults(root)).CopyConfiguration();
   if(resolveInitialOffsets)using(var last=new Canvas{Score=Score.Load(pages[0][pages[0].Count-1]),Library=new DrawingLibrary(root),TextLayout=new ScoreText(root)})job.Resolve(last);
   string token=Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"),folder=Path.GetDirectoryName(outputs[0]);var staged=new List<string>();var committed=new List<string>();var backups=new Dictionary<string,string>();bool success=false;var messages=new List<string>();
   try{
    for(int n=0;n<pages.Count;n++){if(progress!=null)progress(n,pages.Count);if(cancelled!=null&&cancelled())throw new OperationCanceledException("SCORLAS batch cancelled before publication; existing outputs were preserved.");string temporary=Path.Combine(folder,".scorlasbatch-"+token+"-"+n+".tmp");staged.Add(temporary);NativeScorlasWorkflow.ExportPrepared(root,pages[n],temporary,job,false);}
    if(progress!=null)progress(pages.Count,pages.Count);if(cancelled!=null&&cancelled())throw new OperationCanceledException("SCORLAS batch cancelled before publication; existing outputs were preserved.");
    try{
     for(int n=0;n<outputs.Length;n++){
      if(File.Exists(outputs[n])){string backup=Path.Combine(folder,".scorlasbatch-"+token+"-"+n+".backup");File.Replace(staged[n],outputs[n],backup);backups.Add(outputs[n],backup);}else File.Move(staged[n],outputs[n]);committed.Add(outputs[n]);messages.Add("Saved page "+(n+1)+": "+outputs[n]);
     }
    }catch(Exception publicationError){
     var failures=new List<string>();for(int n=committed.Count-1;n>=0;n--)try{string backup;if(backups.TryGetValue(committed[n],out backup))File.Replace(backup,committed[n],null);else File.Delete(committed[n]);}catch(IOException error){failures.Add(committed[n]+": "+error.Message);}catch(UnauthorizedAccessException error){failures.Add(committed[n]+": "+error.Message);}
     if(failures.Count>0)throw new IOException("Batch publication failed; some backups remain for recovery."+Environment.NewLine+String.Join(Environment.NewLine,failures.ToArray()),publicationError);throw;
    }
    success=true;return String.Join(Environment.NewLine,messages.ToArray());
   }finally{foreach(string temporary in staged)if(File.Exists(temporary))File.Delete(temporary);if(success)foreach(string backup in backups.Values)if(File.Exists(backup))File.Delete(backup);}
  }
 }
}

using System;using System.IO;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.Drawing;using System.Globalization;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
using IOPath=System.IO.Path;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class NativeEpsExport {
  void CompositeFrame(Canvas canvas,int delta,bool first,NativePrintJob job){
   if(first)writer.WriteLine("SMphysical setmatrix\n"+job.RawProgram()+"/SMcomposite gstate def");
   else {
    string move="0 "+delta.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)+" translate";
    writer.WriteLine("SMcomposite setgstate "+move+" SMcomposite currentgstate pop");
    // The original emits the next translation into the current PostScript
    // state, including effects of a preceding font99 program.
    if(literalState)writer.WriteLine("gsave SMliteral setgstate "+move+" SMliteral currentgstate pop grestore\ngsave SMcomposite setgstate /SMliteralbase matrix currentmatrix def grestore");
    if(textState)writer.WriteLine("gsave SMtextstate setgstate "+move+" SMtextstate currentgstate pop grestore");
   }
   // A PostScript matrix array stores real operands at lower precision than
   // the interpreter's retained CTM. Preserve gstate between raw translations.
   baseRawSetup="SMcomposite setgstate";
   writer.WriteLine("SMcomposite setgstate -2100 -27250 translate 55.55555555555556 dup scale /SMpage matrix currentmatrix def");
   writer.WriteLine(N(612.0/canvas.PageWidth)+" "+N(-792.0/canvas.PageHeight)+" scale 0 "+N(-canvas.PageHeight)+" translate /SMcanvas matrix currentmatrix def");
  }
  // Internal integration surface. Input is in source top-file order; SCORE
  // prints the last file first. Publish only after the complete stream succeeds.
  internal static void WriteScorlas(IList<Canvas> input,string root,string file,NativePrintJob job){WriteScorlasNamed(input,root,file,job,null);}
  internal static void WriteScorlasNamed(IList<Canvas> input,string root,string file,NativePrintJob job,IList<string> sourceNames){
   if(input==null||input.Count==0)throw new ArgumentException("SCORLAS needs at least one file.");
   if(job==null)throw new ArgumentNullException("job");
   if(sourceNames!=null&&sourceNames.Count!=input.Count)throw new ArgumentException("SCORLAS source-name count differs from files.");
   if(job.Header!="None"&&sourceNames==null)throw new NotSupportedException("SCORLAS captions need the source names supplied to the original file reader.");
   string destination=IOPath.GetFullPath(file),temporary=IOPath.Combine(IOPath.GetDirectoryName(destination),".scorlas-"+Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")+".tmp");
   var state=new ScorlasFilePlacementState();var frames=new List<ScorlasFilePlacement>();var canvases=new List<Canvas>();var extents=new List<NativePrintExtents>();
   foreach(var canvas in input){if(canvas==null||canvas.Score==null)throw new ArgumentException("Missing composite score.");canvas.LayoutScore();}
   for(int n=input.Count-1;n>=0;n--){var canvas=input[n];var extent=NativePrintMinimum.Extents(canvas);if(!extent.HasPoints){
     if(!NativePrintBehaviour.OriginalScorlasEmpty)throw new NotSupportedException("SCORLAS empty files can produce reversed original EPS bounds. Enable original empty-file bounds in printing preferences to reproduce verified cases.");
     if(canvas.Score.Items.Count!=0)throw new NotSupportedException("SCORLAS nonempty undrawable-file state needs verification.");
     // 0C7A:0421..0439, measured after an empty top file: no scan
     // points replace these sentinels before the normal tiling recurrence.
     extent=new NativePrintExtents{Left=32750,Bottom=32750,Right=-32700,Top=-32750};
    }float p8=0;foreach(var item in canvas.Score.Items)if(item.Code==8&&item.Staff==1)p8=item.P(8);int guide=ScorlasGuideConversion.Convert(p8,BitConverter.ToSingle(canvas.Score.Trailer,canvas.Score.Trailer.Length-12)==1);frames.Add(state.Add(extent.Bottom,extent.Top,guide));canvases.Add(canvas);extents.Add(extent);}
   job.ResolveScorlas(canvases[0]);
   long left=Int64.MaxValue,right=Int64.MinValue;
   for(int n=0;n<extents.Count;n++){left=Math.Min(left,extents[n].Left);right=Math.Max(right,extents[n].Right);}
   // Original 0C7A:06A2..0811 leaves the last scan minimum and accumulated
   // height for the later DSC rewrite, rather than unioning translated ink.
   var finalFrame=frames[frames.Count-1];
   string compositeBox=NativePrintExtents.DscBox(job,left,finalFrame.DscBottom,right,finalFrame.DscTop);
   try{using(var bitmap=new Bitmap(1,1))using(var graphics=Graphics.FromImage(bitmap))using(job.Begin())using(NativePrintContext.Begin(root))using(var eps=new NativeEpsExport(graphics,temporary,canvases[0].PageWidth,canvases[0].PageHeight,compositeBox,null,canvases[0].Score,sourceNames==null?null:sourceNames[input.Count-1],true)){
     // SCORLAS emits the glyph-definition catalogue from the first printed
     // file. Later files reuse it, including an empty initial catalogue.
     var sharedCache=NativeLibrarySymbols.Cache(canvases[0].Score,canvases[0].Library);
     try{for(int n=0;n<canvases.Count;n++){var canvas=canvases[n];var before=canvas.CompositeLibraryCache;try{canvas.CompositeLibraryCache=sharedCache;eps.CompositeFrame(canvas,frames[n].Delta,n==0,job);canvas.PageDocument.DatBarlineUnit=NativePrintContext.ExportGeometryUnit;canvas.Draw(graphics,false);}finally{canvas.CompositeLibraryCache=before;}}}
     catch{eps.Abort();throw;}
    }
    if(File.Exists(destination))File.Replace(temporary,destination,null);else File.Move(temporary,destination);
   }finally{File.Delete(temporary);}
  }
 }
}

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal static class NativeScorlasNames {
  static readonly Encoding Cp437=Encoding.GetEncoding(437,EncoderFallback.ExceptionFallback,DecoderFallback.ExceptionFallback);
  // Original M/T writes one starting filename and tile count per line.
  // Explicit path resolution keeps DOS-drive interpretation out of this parser.
  internal static List<List<string>> Read(string file,Func<string,string> resolve){
   var pages=new List<List<string>>();int line=0;
   foreach(string raw in File.ReadAllLines(file,Cp437)){
    line++;if(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))continue;
    var match=Regex.Match(raw,@"^\s*(.+?)\s+(\d+)\s*$");int count;
    if(!match.Success||!Int32.TryParse(match.Groups[2].Value,NumberStyles.None,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out count)||count<1)throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid SCORLAS name-list entry at line "+line+". Expected starting filename and files per page.");
    string name=match.Groups[1].Value.Trim();if(name.Length>1&&name[0]=='\"'&&name[name.Length-1]=='\"')name=name.Substring(1,name.Length-2);
    string path=resolve==null?Path.GetFullPath(name):resolve(name);
    pages.AddRange(NativeScorlasBatch.Define(path,count,1,false,ScorlasInputSequence.ConsecutiveCharacters));
   }
   if(pages.Count==0)throw new InvalidDataException("The SCORLAS name list is empty.");return pages;
  }
  internal static void Write(string file,IList<List<string>> pages){
   var text=new StringBuilder();if(pages==null||pages.Count==0)throw new ArgumentException("No pages to save.");
   foreach(var page in pages){if(page==null||page.Count==0)throw new ArgumentException("Every page needs at least one file.");var sequence=NativeScorlasBatch.Define(page[0],page.Count,1,false,ScorlasInputSequence.ConsecutiveCharacters)[0];for(int n=0;n<page.Count;n++)if(!String.Equals(Path.GetFullPath(page[n]),sequence[n],StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))throw new NotSupportedException("An original SCORLAS name list requires each page's files to advance by the final filename character. This page has a different order; its editable batch remains unchanged.");text.Append(page[0]).Append(' ').Append(page.Count.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)).Append("\r\n");}
   foreach(var page in pages)foreach(string input in page)if(String.Equals(Path.GetFullPath(input),Path.GetFullPath(file),StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))throw new InvalidDataException("The name list would overwrite an input score.");
   byte[] bytes=Cp437.GetBytes(text.ToString());string destination=Path.GetFullPath(file),temporary=Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(destination),".scorlasnames-"+Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")+".tmp");
   try{File.WriteAllBytes(temporary,bytes);if(File.Exists(destination))File.Replace(temporary,destination,null);else File.Move(temporary,destination);}finally{File.Delete(temporary);}
  }
 }
}

using System;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativeScorlasProgress:ScoreDialog {
  readonly Label status=new Label{AutoSize=true,Dock=DockStyle.Fill};
  readonly ProgressBar bar=new ProgressBar{Dock=DockStyle.Fill};
  internal bool Cancelled{get;private set;}
  internal NativeScorlasProgress():base("scorlas-progress"){
   Text="SCORLAS batch";Font=SystemFonts.MessageBoxFont;ClientSize=new Size(520,140);StartPosition=FormStartPosition.CenterParent;ControlBox=false;
   var panel=new TableLayoutPanel{Dock=DockStyle.Fill,Padding=new Padding(12),RowCount=3,ColumnCount=1};panel.ColumnStyles.Add(new ColumnStyle(SizeType.Percent,100));panel.RowStyles.Add(new RowStyle(SizeType.Percent,100));panel.RowStyles.Add(new RowStyle(SizeType.Absolute,24));panel.RowStyles.Add(new RowStyle(SizeType.AutoSize));
   var cancel=new Button{Text="Cancel after current page",AutoSize=true,Anchor=AnchorStyles.Right};cancel.Click+=(s,e)=>{Cancelled=true;cancel.Enabled=false;status.Text="Cancelling after the current page...";};panel.Controls.Add(status,0,0);panel.Controls.Add(bar,0,1);panel.Controls.Add(cancel,0,2);Controls.Add(panel);

Finalizing...":"Preparing page "+(completed+1)+" of "+total+". Cancellation takes effect between pages.";Application.DoEvents();}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal static class NativeScorlasStatistics {
  static string Integer(int value,int width){string text=value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);return text.Length>width?new string('*',width):text.PadLeft(width);}
  static string Real(float value){string text=SingleFixedDecimal.Format(value,2);if(text.StartsWith("0.",StringComparison.Ordinal))text=text.Substring(1);else if(text.StartsWith("-0.",StringComparison.Ordinal))text="-"+text.Substring(2);return text.Length>6?"******":text.PadLeft(6);}
  internal static string Create(string root,IList<List<string>> pages,NativePrintJob settings,IList<List<string>> displayNames=null){
   if(pages==null||pages.Count==0)throw new ArgumentException("Add at least one page.");
   if(displayNames!=null&&displayNames.Count!=pages.Count)throw new ArgumentException("Statistics names do not match the page count.");
   var report=new StringBuilder();int grand=0;float size=(settings??NativePrintJob.Defaults(root)).Size;
   for(int page=0;page<pages.Count;page++){
    var files=pages[page];if(files==null||files.Count==0)throw new ArgumentException("Every page needs at least one file.");if(displayNames!=null&&displayNames[page].Count!=files.Count)throw new ArgumentException("Statistics names do not match the file count.");
    for(int n=0;n<files.Count;n++){string name=displayNames==null?Path.GetFullPath(files[n]):displayNames[page][n];if(name.IndexOfAny(new[]{'\r','\n'})>=0)throw new ArgumentException("A statistics filename contains a line break.");report.Append(' ').Append(name.Length>24?name.Substring(0,24):name.PadRight(24)).Append("\r\n");}
    var placement=new ScorlasFilePlacementState();short items=0;
    for(int n=files.Count-1;n>=0;n--)using(var canvas=new Canvas{Score=Score.Load(files[n]),Library=new DrawingLibrary(root),TextLayout=new ScoreText(root)}){
     canvas.LayoutScore();var extents=NativePrintMinimum.Extents(canvas);
     if(!extents.HasPoints){if(canvas.Score.Items.Count!=0||!NativePrintBehaviour.OriginalScorlasEmpty)throw new NotSupportedException("Statistics for an empty tile require the original empty-file bounds option.");extents=new NativePrintExtents{Left=32750,Bottom=32750,Right=-32700,Top=-32750};}
     bool metric=BitConverter.ToSingle(canvas.Score.Trailer,canvas.Score.Trailer.Length-12)==1;float p8=0;foreach(var item in canvas.Score.Items)if(item.Code==8&&item.Staff==1)p8=item.P(8);
     var frame=placement.Add(extents.Bottom,extents.Top,ScorlasGuideConversion.Convert(p8,metric));items=unchecked((short)(items+(canvas.Score.Items.Count==0?1:canvas.Score.Items.Count)));
     float height=ScorlasStatisticsArithmetic.Height(frame.OverallHeight,size,metric);report.Append(metric?" Total centimeters =":" Total inches =").Append(Real(height)).Append("   Total items =").Append(Integer(items,4)).Append("\r\n\r\n");
    }
    grand=unchecked(grand+items);
   }
   return report.Append(" Grand total =").Append(Integer(grand,6)).Append(" items.\r\n\r\n").ToString();
  }
 }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;
using System.Drawing.Printing;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal sealed class NativeScorlasPrintPage {
  internal string PostScript,Image;internal float WidthPoints,HeightPoints;
 }
 internal static class NativeScorlasWindowsPrint {
  static string Q(string value){return "\""+value.Replace("\"","\\\"")+"\"";}
  internal static NativeScorlasPrintPage Describe(string postscript,NativePrintJob settings){
   string text=File.ReadAllText(postscript,Encoding.GetEncoding(28591));float width=settings.PaperWidth*72,height=settings.PaperHeight*72;
   var requests=Regex.Matches(text,@"statusdict /setpage known \{statusdict begin\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+1 setpage end\} if");
   if(requests.Count>0){var last=requests[requests.Count-1];width=Single.Parse(last.Groups[1].Value,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);height=Single.Parse(last.Groups[2].Value,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);}
   if(width<=0||height<=0||width>14400||height>14400)throw new NotSupportedException("The requested printer page size is outside the supported range.");
   return new NativeScorlasPrintPage{PostScript=postscript,WidthPoints=width,HeightPoints=height};
  }
  internal static void Rasterize(NativeScorlasPrintPage page,string image,int dpi){
   string executable=GhostscriptTextRenderer.Executable;if(!File.Exists(executable))throw new FileNotFoundException("Select the Ghostscript console executable before Windows batch printing. PS/EPS export remains available.",executable);
   if(dpi<72||dpi>2400)throw new NotSupportedException("Windows SCORLAS printing supports 72–2400 dpi.");
   long width=(long)Math.Round(page.WidthPoints*dpi/72),height=(long)Math.Round(page.HeightPoints*dpi/72);if(width*height>100000000)throw new NotSupportedException("This printer raster exceeds 100 million pixels. Reduce print resolution or page size.");
   string source=File.ReadAllText(page.PostScript,Encoding.GetEncoding(28591)),mapFile=image+".Fontmap";var fonts=new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);var map=new StringBuilder();
   foreach(Match match in Regex.Matches(source,@"/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)\s+findfont")){string name=match.Groups[1].Value;if(name=="SMfont"||name=="SMaccent"||name=="SMspecial"||name=="SMinitial"||!fonts.Add(name))continue;string path=NativeTupletFonts.ResolvePath(name);map.Append('/').Append(name).Append(" (").Append(path.Replace("\\","/").Replace("(","\\(").Replace(")","\\)")).Append(") ;\n");}
   File.WriteAllText(mapFile,map.ToString(),Encoding.ASCII);
   try{
    var info=new ProcessStartInfo(executable,"-dSAFER -dBATCH -dNOPAUSE -sDEVICE=pnggray -dFIXEDMEDIA -r"+dpi+" -g"+width+"x"+height+" -dTextAlphaBits=4 -dGraphicsAlphaBits=4 "+Q("-sFONTMAP="+mapFile)+" "+Q("-sOutputFile="+image)+" "+Q(page.PostScript)){UseShellExecute=false,CreateNoWindow=true,RedirectStandardOutput=true,RedirectStandardError=true};var log=new StringBuilder();
    using(var process=new Process{StartInfo=info}){process.OutputDataReceived+=(s,e)=>{if(e.Data!=null)lock(log)log.AppendLine(e.Data);};process.ErrorDataReceived+=(s,e)=>{if(e.Data!=null)lock(log)log.AppendLine(e.Data);};process.Start();process.BeginOutputReadLine();process.BeginErrorReadLine();GhostscriptTextRenderer.WaitForProcess(process,"SCORLAS printer-page rendering timed out.");if(process.ExitCode!=0||log.ToString().IndexOf("substitut",StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)>=0)throw new InvalidOperationException("SCORLAS printer-page rendering failed or attempted font substitution: "+log);}
    using(var bitmap=new Bitmap(image))if(bitmap.Width!=width||bitmap.Height!=height)throw new InvalidDataException("The printer raster has an unexpected size.");page.Image=image;
   }finally{File.Delete(mapFile);}
  }
  internal static void Draw(Graphics graphics,NativeScorlasPrintPage page,float hardX,float hardY){
   var state=graphics.Save();try{graphics.PageUnit=GraphicsUnit.Inch;graphics.TranslateTransform(-hardX/100,-hardY/100);graphics.InterpolationMode=InterpolationMode.NearestNeighbor;graphics.PixelOffsetMode=PixelOffsetMode.Half;using(var image=new Bitmap(page.Image))graphics.DrawImage(image,new RectangleF(0,0,page.WidthPoints/72,page.HeightPoints/72),new Rectangle(0,0,image.Width,image.Height),GraphicsUnit.Pixel);}finally{graphics.Restore(state);}
  }
  internal static void Show(Form owner,string root,IList<List<string>> pages,NativePrintJob settings,bool resolveInitialOffsets,bool preview){
   string folder=Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(),"ScoreModern-SCORLAS-print-"+Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);var job=settings.CopyConfiguration();
   try{
    var prepared=new List<NativeScorlasPrintPage>();using(var progress=new NativeScorlasProgress()){
     owner.Enabled=false;try{progress.Show(owner);NativeScorlasBatch.ExportControlled(root,pages,Path.Combine(folder,"PAGE01.ps"),job,true,resolveInitialOffsets,()=>progress.Cancelled,progress.Report);
      var names=NativeScorlasBatch.OutputNames(Path.Combine(folder,"PAGE01.ps"),pages.Count,true);for(int n=0;n<names.Length;n++){progress.Report(n,names.Length);if(progress.Cancelled)throw new OperationCanceledException("SCORLAS printing cancelled before sending pages to a printer.");var page=Describe(names[n],job);Rasterize(page,Path.Combine(folder,"page"+n+".png"),job.Resolution);prepared.Add(page);}if(progress.Cancelled)throw new OperationCanceledException("SCORLAS printing cancelled before sending pages to a printer.");
     }finally{owner.Enabled=true;progress.Close();}
    }
    using(var document=new PrintDocument()){
     document.DocumentName="SCORE Modern SCORLAS";document.OriginAtMargins=false;int index=0;document.BeginPrint+=(s,e)=>index=0;
     document.QueryPageSettings+=(s,e)=>{var page=prepared[index];e.PageSettings.Landscape=false;e.PageSettings.PaperSize=new PaperSize("SCORLAS page "+(index+1),(int)Math.Round(page.WidthPoints*100/72),(int)Math.Round(page.HeightPoints*100/72));e.PageSettings.Margins=new Margins(0,0,0,0);};
     document.PrintPage+=(s,e)=>{Draw(e.Graphics,prepared[index],e.PageSettings.HardMarginX,e.PageSettings.HardMarginY);index++;e.HasMorePages=index<prepared.Count;};
     if(preview){using(var dialog=new PrintPreviewDialog{Document=document,Width=1000,Height=750,UseAntiAlias=true})dialog.ShowDialog(owner);}
     else{
      if((job.Tray!=0||job.Manual)&&MessageBox.Show(owner,"SCORE requests "+(job.Manual?"manual feed":"tray "+job.Tray)+". Select the corresponding paper source in printer properties.","SCORLAS printer settings",MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel,MessageBoxIcon.Information)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
      using(var dialog=new PrintDialog{Document=document,UseEXDialog=true,AllowSomePages=false})if(dialog.ShowDialog(owner)!=DialogResult.OK)return;document.Print();
     }
    }
   }finally{foreach(string file in Directory.GetFiles(folder))File.Delete(file);Directory.Delete(folder);}
  }
 }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace ScoreModern {
 internal static class NativeScorlasWorkflow {
  internal static string Export(string root,IList<string> files,string destination,NativePrintJob settings){
   return ExportPrepared(root,files,destination,settings,true);
  }
  internal static string ExportPrepared(string root,IList<string> files,string destination,NativePrintJob settings,bool resolveOffsets){
   if(files==null||files.Count==0)throw new InvalidDataException("Add at least one SCORE file.");
   if(files.Any(file=>String.Equals(Path.GetFullPath(file),Path.GetFullPath(destination),StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))throw new InvalidDataException("The output filename would overwrite an input score.");
   var pages=new List<Canvas>();
   try{
    foreach(string file in files)pages.Add(new Canvas{Score=Score.Load(file),Library=new DrawingLibrary(root),TextLayout=new ScoreText(root)});
    var job=(settings??NativePrintJob.Defaults(root)).CopyConfiguration();
    if(resolveOffsets)job.Resolve(pages[pages.Count-1]);
    NativeEpsExport.WriteScorlasNamed(pages,root,destination,job,files);
    var messages=new List<string>{"Tiled page saved: "+destination};
    if(job.OffsetWarning!=null)messages.Add(job.OffsetWarning);
    if(pages.Any(page=>page.Score.Items.Count==0))messages.Add("Original empty-file scan bounds were reproduced; the EPS bounding box can be reversed.");
    foreach(var page in pages)messages.AddRange(page.ApproximatedItems);
    return String.Join(Environment.NewLine,messages.ToArray());
   }finally{foreach(var page in pages)page.Dispose();}
  }
 }

 internal sealed class ScorlasFileList:ListBox {
  int dropSlot=-1;
  internal int DropSlot{get{return dropSlot;}set{if(dropSlot==value)return;dropSlot=value;Invalidate();}}
  internal ScorlasFileList(){DrawMode=DrawMode.OwnerDrawFixed;AllowDrop=true;RefreshMetrics();}
  protected override void OnFontChanged(EventArgs e){base.OnFontChanged(e);RefreshMetrics();}
  internal void RefreshMetrics(){ItemHeight=Math.Max(1,TextRenderer.MeasureText("Ag",Font).Height+4);HorizontalExtent=Items.Cast<object>().Select(item=>TextRenderer.MeasureText(Convert.ToString(item),Font).Width+8).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max();Invalidate();}
  protected override void OnDrawItem(DrawItemEventArgs e){
   e.DrawBackground();
   if(e.Index>=0&&e.Index<Items.Count){TextRenderer.DrawText(e.Graphics,Convert.ToString(Items[e.Index]),e.Font,e.Bounds,e.ForeColor,TextFormatFlags.Left|TextFormatFlags.VerticalCenter|TextFormatFlags.NoPrefix|TextFormatFlags.SingleLine);e.DrawFocusRectangle();
    if(e.Index==dropSlot||e.Index+1==dropSlot)using(var pen=new Pen(SystemColors.Highlight,2)){int y=e.Index==dropSlot?e.Bounds.Top:e.Bounds.Bottom-1;e.Graphics.DrawLine(pen,e.Bounds.Left,y,e.Bounds.Right,y);}
   }
  }
 }

 internal sealed class NativeScorlasDialog:ScoreDialog {
  readonly string root;
  NativePrintJob settings;
  readonly ScorlasFileList files=new ScorlasFileList{Dock=DockStyle.Fill,IntegralHeight=false,HorizontalScrollbar=true,SelectionMode=SelectionMode.MultiExtended};

  readonly ComboBox pageSelector=new ComboBox{DropDownStyle=ComboBoxStyle.DropDownList,Width=180};
  readonly List<List<string>> batchPages=new List<List<string>>{new List<string>()};
  int currentPage;bool switchingPages,explicitOffsets;
  void StorePage(){if(!switchingPages)batchPages[currentPage]=files.Items.Cast<string>().ToList();}
  void RefreshPageSelector(){switchingPages=true;try{pageSelector.Items.Clear();for(int n=0;n<batchPages.Count;n++)pageSelector.Items.Add("Page "+(n+1)+" ("+batchPages[n].Count+" files)");pageSelector.SelectedIndex=currentPage;}finally{switchingPages=false;}}
  void SelectPage(){if(switchingPages||pageSelector.SelectedIndex<0)return;StorePage();currentPage=pageSelector.SelectedIndex;switchingPages=true;try{ReplaceRows(batchPages[currentPage],new int[0]);}finally{switchingPages=false;}UpdateActions();}
  void QuickBatch(){StorePage();using(var dialog=new NativeScorlasQuickBatchDialog(files.Items.Count>0?(string)files.Items[0]:""))if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)==DialogResult.OK){batchPages.Clear();batchPages.AddRange(dialog.Pages.Select(page=>new List<string>(page)));currentPage=0;switchingPages=true;try{ReplaceRows(batchPages[0],new int[0]);}finally{switchingPages=false;}RefreshPageSelector();UpdateActions();result.Text="Batch defined. Select a page to edit its files, sorting or order before export.";}}

Natural sorting compares numeric filename parts as numbers, so page2 precedes page10.");hints.SetToolTip(files,"Drag files to the insertion line to reorder them. The last listed file prints first. Move up/down are also available.");Disposed+=(s,e)=>hints.Dispose();
   sortBy.Width=sortBy.Items.Cast<object>().Max(item=>TextRenderer.MeasureText(item.ToString(),sortBy.Font).Width)+SystemInformation.VerticalScrollBarWidth+16;

   layout.Controls.Add(pageActions,0,0);

   layout.Controls.Add(actions,0,2);
   layout.Controls.Add(files,0,3);
   remove.Click+=(s,e)=>{foreach(int index in files.SelectedIndices.Cast<int>().OrderByDescending(index=>index))files.Items.RemoveAt(index);files.RefreshMetrics();UpdateActions();};
   up.Click+=(s,e)=>MoveEntry(-1);down.Click+=(s,e)=>MoveEntry(1);files.SelectedIndexChanged+=(s,e)=>UpdateActions();
   InstallDragReordering();
   var configuration=new TableLayoutPanel{AutoSize=true,Dock=DockStyle.Fill,ColumnCount=2};configuration.ColumnStyles.Add(new ColumnStyle(SizeType.Percent,100));configuration.ColumnStyles.Add(new ColumnStyle(SizeType.AutoSize));configuration.Controls.Add(settingsLine,0,0);
   var read=new Button{Text="Read PRINT.SCR...",AutoSize=true};read.Click+=(s,e)=>Try(ReadSettings);configuration.Controls.Add(read,1,0);layout.Controls.Add(configuration,0,4);layout.Controls.Add(result,0,5);
   var buttons=new FlowLayoutPanel{AutoSize=true,Dock=DockStyle.Fill,FlowDirection=FlowDirection.RightToLeft};var close=new Button{Text="Close",AutoSize=true,DialogResult=DialogResult.Cancel};var stats=new Button{Text="Statistics...",AutoSize=true};stats.Click+=(s,e)=>Try(Statistics);buttons.Controls.Add(close);buttons.Controls.Add(export);var preview=new Button{Text="Print preview...",AutoSize=true};preview.Click+=(s,e)=>Try(()=>WindowsPrint(true));var print=new Button{Text="Print...",AutoSize=true};print.Click+=(s,e)=>Try(()=>WindowsPrint(false));buttons.Controls.Add(print);buttons.Controls.Add(preview);buttons.Controls.Add(stats);layout.Controls.Add(buttons,0,6);CancelButton=close;
   export.Click+=(s,e)=>Try(Export);Controls.Add(layout);Resize+=(s,e)=>{explanation.MaximumSize=new Size(Math.Max(100,layout.ClientSize.Width-layout.Padding.Horizontal),0);settingsLine.MaximumSize=new Size(Math.Max(100,configuration.ClientSize.Width-read.Width-12),0);};

  }
  void Try(Action action){try{action();}catch(Exception error){if(!(error is IOException||error is UnauthorizedAccessException||error is ArgumentException||error is NotSupportedException||error is OverflowException||error is OperationCanceledException||error is TimeoutException||error is System.Drawing.Printing.InvalidPrinterException||error is InvalidOperationException))throw;result.Text=error.Message;}}
  void UpdateActions(){StorePage();if(!switchingPages&&pageSelector.Items.Count==batchPages.Count){switchingPages=true;try{pageSelector.Items[currentPage]="Page "+(currentPage+1)+" ("+files.Items.Count+" files)";}finally{switchingPages=false;}}export.Text=batchPages.Count>1?"Export batch...":"Export tiled page...";remove.Enabled=files.SelectedIndices.Count>0;up.Enabled=files.SelectedIndices.Count==1&&files.SelectedIndex>0;down.Enabled=files.SelectedIndices.Count==1&&files.SelectedIndex>=0&&files.SelectedIndex<files.Items.Count-1;export.Enabled=batchPages.All(page=>page.Count>0);sort.Enabled=sortBy.Enabled=files.Items.Count>1;sortDirection.Enabled=files.Items.Count>1&&sortBy.SelectedIndex!=4;}
  void AddFiles(){using(var dialog=new OpenFileDialog{Title="Add files in top-to-bottom order",Filter="SCORE music and pages (*.mus;*.pag)|*.mus;*.pag|All files (*.*)|*.*",Multiselect=true,InitialDirectory=Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(),RestoreDirectory=true})if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)==DialogResult.OK){foreach(string file in dialog.FileNames)files.Items.Add(Path.GetFullPath(file));files.RefreshMetrics();UpdateActions();}}
  void MoveEntry(int delta){if(files.SelectedIndices.Count!=1)return;int index=files.SelectedIndex,next=index+delta;if(next<0||next>=files.Items.Count)return;MoveRows(new[]{index},delta<0?next:next+1);}
  internal static int NaturalCompare(string left,string right){
   int a=0,b=0;while(a<left.Length&&b<right.Length){
    if(left[a]>='0'&&left[a]<='9'&&right[b]>='0'&&right[b]<='9'){
     int ae=a,be=b;while(ae<left.Length&&left[ae]>='0'&&left[ae]<='9')ae++;while(be<right.Length&&right[be]>='0'&&right[be]<='9')be++;
     int az=a,bz=b;while(az<ae&&left[az]=='0')az++;while(bz<be&&right[bz]=='0')bz++;
     int c=(ae-az).CompareTo(be-bz);if(c!=0)return c;for(int n=0;n<ae-az;n++){c=left[az+n].CompareTo(right[bz+n]);if(c!=0)return c;}a=ae;b=be;
    }else{int c=Char.ToUpperInvariant(left[a]).CompareTo(Char.ToUpperInvariant(right[b]));if(c!=0)return c;a++;b++;}
   }return (left.Length-a).CompareTo(right.Length-b);
  }
  void ReplaceRows(IList<string> paths,IEnumerable<int> selected){int top=files.TopIndex;var keep=selected.ToArray();files.BeginUpdate();try{files.Items.Clear();foreach(string path in paths)files.Items.Add(path);files.ClearSelected();foreach(int index in keep)files.SetSelected(index,true);files.DropSlot=-1;files.RefreshMetrics();if(files.Items.Count>0){files.TopIndex=Math.Min(top,files.Items.Count-1);if(keep.Length>0){int first=keep.Min(),visible=Math.Max(1,files.ClientSize.Height/files.ItemHeight);if(first<files.TopIndex)files.TopIndex=first;else if(first>=files.TopIndex+visible)files.TopIndex=Math.Max(0,first-visible+1);}}}finally{files.EndUpdate();}UpdateActions();}
  void SortFiles(){
   int key=sortBy.SelectedIndex;var rows=files.Items.Cast<string>().Select((path,index)=>new SortRow{Path=path,Index=index,Selected=files.GetSelected(index),Key=key==0?Path.GetFileName(path):path}).ToList();
   if(key==4)rows.Reverse();else{
    if(key==2||key==3)foreach(var row in rows){var info=new FileInfo(row.Path);if(!info.Exists)throw new FileNotFoundException("Cannot sort a missing file.",row.Path);row.Number=key==2?info.LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks:info.Length;}
    bool descending=sortDirection.SelectedIndex==1;rows.Sort((left,right)=>{int c=key<2?NaturalCompare(left.Key,right.Key):left.Number.CompareTo(right.Number);if(descending)c=-c;return c==0?left.Index.CompareTo(right.Index):c;});
   }
   ReplaceRows(rows.Select(row=>row.Path).ToArray(),rows.Select((row,index)=>new{row,index}).Where(value=>value.row.Selected).Select(value=>value.index));
  }
  void MoveRows(int[] indices,int slot){
   var before=files.Items.Cast<string>().ToArray();var selected=indices.Distinct().OrderBy(index=>index).ToArray();if(selected.Length==0)return;if(slot<0||slot>before.Length||selected.Any(index=>index<0||index>=before.Length))throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("indices");
   var moving=new HashSet<int>(selected);var result=before.Where((path,index)=>!moving.Contains(index)).ToList();int insertion=slot-selected.Count(index=>index<slot);result.InsertRange(insertion,selected.Select(index=>before[index]));ReplaceRows(result,Enumerable.Range(insertion,selected.Length));
  }
  FileDrag ReadDrag(IDataObject data){if(data==null||!data.GetDataPresent(typeof(FileDrag)))return null;var value=data.GetData(typeof(FileDrag)) as FileDrag;return value!=null&&value.Owner==this&&value.Snapshot.SequenceEqual(files.Items.Cast<string>())?value:null;}
  int DropSlot(Point point){int index=files.IndexFromPoint(point);if(index<0)return point.Y<0?files.TopIndex:files.Items.Count;var bounds=files.GetItemRectangle(index);return point.Y<bounds.Top+bounds.Height/2?index:index+1;}
  void InstallDragReordering(){
   files.MouseDown+=(s,e)=>{dragArmed=e.Button==MouseButtons.Left&&files.IndexFromPoint(e.Location)>=0;dragStart=e.Location;};files.MouseUp+=(s,e)=>dragArmed=false;
   files.MouseMove+=(s,e)=>{if(!dragArmed||(e.Button&MouseButtons.Left)==0)return;var size=SystemInformation.DragSize;if(new Rectangle(dragStart.X-size.Width/2,dragStart.Y-size.Height/2,size.Width,size.Height).Contains(e.Location))return;dragArmed=false;int[] selected=files.SelectedIndices.Cast<int>().ToArray();if(selected.Length==0)return;try{files.DoDragDrop(new FileDrag{Owner=this,Indices=selected,Snapshot=files.Items.Cast<string>().ToArray()},DragDropEffects.Move);}finally{files.DropSlot=-1;}};
   files.DragEnter+=(s,e)=>e.Effect=ReadDrag(e.Data)==null?DragDropEffects.None:DragDropEffects.Move;
   files.DragOver+=(s,e)=>{if(ReadDrag(e.Data)==null){e.Effect=DragDropEffects.None;return;}e.Effect=DragDropEffects.Move;Point p=files.PointToClient(new Point(e.X,e.Y));if(p.Y<files.ItemHeight&&files.TopIndex>0)files.TopIndex--;else if(p.Y>files.ClientSize.Height-files.ItemHeight&&files.TopIndex<files.Items.Count-1)files.TopIndex++;files.DropSlot=DropSlot(p);};
   files.DragLeave+=(s,e)=>files.DropSlot=-1;files.DragDrop+=(s,e)=>{var value=ReadDrag(e.Data);if(value!=null)MoveRows(value.Indices,DropSlot(files.PointToClient(new Point(e.X,e.Y))));files.DropSlot=-1;};
  }
  void UpdateSettings(){settingsLine.Text=String.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,"Print size {0}; paper {1} × {2} in; freeze {3}; rotation {4}; mirror {5}; captions {6}. Settings apply to every batch page.",settings.Size,settings.PaperWidth,settings.PaperHeight,settings.Freeze?"on":"off",settings.Rotate?"on":"off",settings.Mirror?"on":"off",settings.Header);}
  void ReadSettings(){using(var dialog=new OpenFileDialog{Title="Read SCORLAS print settings",Filter="SCORE print settings (*.scr)|*.scr|All files (*.*)|*.*",FileName="PRINT.SCR",InitialDirectory=NativeLibraryLocation.DirectoryFor(root,false),RestoreDirectory=true})if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)==DialogResult.OK){settings=NativePrintJob.Read(dialog.FileName,settings);explicitOffsets=true;UpdateSettings();}}
  void Export(){
   StorePage();
   if(batchPages.Count>1){ExportBatch();return;}
   using(var dialog=new SaveFileDialog{Title="Export SCORLAS tiled page",Filter="PostScript and EPS (*.ps;*.eps)|*.ps;*.eps",DefaultExt="ps",FileName="TILED.PS",InitialDirectory=NativeOutputLocation.EnsureFolder(root),RestoreDirectory=true,OverwritePrompt=true}){
    if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)!=DialogResult.OK)return;string destination=NativeOutputLocation.RequireWritableDestination(root,dialog.FileName);bool previous=UseWaitCursor;UseWaitCursor=true;export.Enabled=false;result.Text="Preparing tiled page...";result.Update();
    try{result.Text=NativeScorlasWorkflow.ExportPrepared(root,files.Items.Cast<string>().ToArray(),destination,settings,!explicitOffsets);}finally{UseWaitCursor=previous;UpdateActions();}
   }
  }

  void WindowsPrint(bool preview){StorePage();NativeScorlasWindowsPrint.Show(this,root,batchPages,settings,!explicitOffsets,preview);}
  void ReadNames(){
   using(var open=new OpenFileDialog{Title="Read original SCORLAS name list",Filter="SCORLAS lists (*.txt;*.tmp)|*.txt;*.tmp|All files (*.*)|*.*",RestoreDirectory=true})if(open.ShowDialog(this)==DialogResult.OK)
   using(var folder=new FolderBrowserDialog{Description="Choose the folder containing the listed SCORE files. Filenames are resolved in this folder; saved DOS paths are not used.",SelectedPath=Directory.GetCurrentDirectory()})if(folder.ShowDialog(this)==DialogResult.OK){
    var pages=NativeScorlasNames.Read(open.FileName,name=>Path.Combine(folder.SelectedPath,Path.GetFileName(name.Replace('/',Path.DirectorySeparatorChar))));
    batchPages.Clear();batchPages.AddRange(pages);currentPage=0;switchingPages=true;try{ReplaceRows(batchPages[0],new int[0]);}finally{switchingPages=false;}RefreshPageSelector();UpdateActions();int missing=pages.SelectMany(page=>page).Count(file=>!File.Exists(file));result.Text="Read "+pages.Count+" pages; "+missing+" missing files. Check each page before output.";
   }
  }
  void SaveNames(){StorePage();using(var save=new SaveFileDialog{Title="Save original SCORLAS name list",Filter="SCORLAS names (*.txt)|*.txt|All files (*.*)|*.*",DefaultExt="txt",FileName="SCORLAS-LIST.TXT",RestoreDirectory=true})if(save.ShowDialog(this)==DialogResult.OK){NativeScorlasNames.Write(save.FileName,batchPages);result.Text="Saved name list: "+save.FileName;}}
  void Statistics(){
   StorePage();string content=NativeScorlasStatistics.Create(root,batchPages,settings);
   using(var dialog=new ScoreDialog("scorlas-statistics"){Text="SCORLAS statistics",ClientSize=new Size(800,500),Font=SystemFonts.MessageBoxFont,StartPosition=FormStartPosition.CenterParent})
   using(var font=new Font("Consolas",10)){
    var text=new TextBox{Dock=DockStyle.Fill,Multiline=true,ReadOnly=true,WordWrap=false,ScrollBars=ScrollBars.Both,Font=font,Text=content};var menu=new ContextMenuStrip();menu.Items.Add("Copy",null,(s,e)=>text.Copy());menu.Items.Add("Select all",null,(s,e)=>text.SelectAll());menu.Items.Add(new ToolStripSeparator());menu.Items.Add("Save as...",null,(s,e)=>{using(var save=new SaveFileDialog{Title="Save SCORLAS statistics",Filter="Text (*.txt)|*.txt|All files (*.*)|*.*",DefaultExt="txt",RestoreDirectory=true})if(save.ShowDialog(dialog)==DialogResult.OK)Try(()=>File.WriteAllText(save.FileName,content,System.Text.Encoding.GetEncoding(437,System.Text.EncoderFallback.ExceptionFallback,System.Text.DecoderFallback.ExceptionFallback)));});text.ContextMenuStrip=menu;dialog.Controls.Add(text);dialog.Disposed+=(s,e)=>menu.Dispose();dialog.AddTextOutputCloseButton();dialog.ShowDialog(this);
   }
  }
  void ExportBatch(){
   using(var dialog=new SaveFileDialog{Title="First SCORLAS batch output (numeric suffix increments)",Filter="PostScript and EPS (*.ps;*.eps)|*.ps;*.eps",DefaultExt="ps",FileName="TILED01.PS",InitialDirectory=NativeOutputLocation.EnsureFolder(root),RestoreDirectory=true,OverwritePrompt=false}){
    if(dialog.ShowDialog(this)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
    string first=NativeOutputLocation.RequireWritableDestination(root,dialog.FileName);var outputs=NativeScorlasBatch.OutputNames(first,batchPages.Count,true);
    var missing=batchPages.SelectMany(page=>page).Where(file=>!File.Exists(file)).Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).ToArray();if(missing.Length>0)throw new FileNotFoundException("Resolve missing batch inputs before exporting:"+Environment.NewLine+String.Join(Environment.NewLine,missing));
    string preview=String.Join(Environment.NewLine,outputs.Take(12).Select((file,n)=>"Page "+(n+1)+": "+file).ToArray());if(outputs.Length>12)preview+=Environment.NewLine+"... "+(outputs.Length-12)+" more pages";
    int existing=outputs.Count(File.Exists);if(MessageBox.Show(this,preview+Environment.NewLine+Environment.NewLine+existing+" existing outputs will be replaced. Export this batch?","SCORLAS batch outputs",MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel,MessageBoxIcon.Question)!=DialogResult.OK)return;
    bool previous=UseWaitCursor;UseWaitCursor=true;export.Enabled=false;result.Text="Preparing batch...";result.Update();try{using(var progress=new NativeScorlasProgress()){Enabled=false;try{progress.Show(this);result.Text=NativeScorlasBatch.ExportControlled(root,batchPages,first,settings,true,!explicitOffsets,()=>progress.Cancelled,progress.Report);}finally{Enabled=true;progress.Close();}}}finally{UseWaitCursor=previous;UpdateActions();}
   }
  }

 }
