using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;
using System.Windows.Forms;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativeSlurDisplay {
  static bool configuredRejectInvalidTrims;public static bool RejectInvalidTrims{get{return NativeScoreBehaviour.Enabled?false:configuredRejectInvalidTrims;}private set{configuredRejectInvalidTrims=value;}}public static string Status{get;internal set;}
  static string Settings{get{return "slurs";}}
  static NativeSlurDisplay(){SetReject(true,false);}
  public static void Load(){SetReject(true,false);try{if(NativeSettings.Exists(Settings)&&NativeSettings.ReadAllText(Settings).Trim()=="policy1:original")SetReject(false,false);}catch(IOException){}catch(UnauthorizedAccessException){}}
  public static void SetReject(bool reject,bool save){RejectInvalidTrims=reject;Status=reject?"Default: reject reversed or out-of-range trims":"Compatibility: original trim-buffer effects";if(save)NativeSettings.WriteAllText(Settings,reject?"policy1:reject":"policy1:original");foreach(Form f in Application.OpenForms)f.Invalidate(true);}
  public static float ReadThickness(string root){return String.IsNullOrEmpty(root)?1:NativePreferences.Read(root).Number("SLUR",1);}
  public static void AddMenu(ContextMenuStrip menu){NativeEndingDisplay.AddMenu(menu);var item=new ToolStripMenuItem("Slurs and hairpins: reject invalid trim ranges");item.Click+=(s,e)=>SetReject(!RejectInvalidTrims,true);menu.Items.Add(item);menu.Opening+=(s,e)=>{item.Checked=RejectInvalidTrims;item.ToolTipText=Status;};}
 }
 public sealed class NativeSlurFrame {
  readonly bool printed=NativeBeamDisplay.Appearance==BeamAppearance.Printed;
  sealed class StaffBuffer {public SlurVectorBuffer Buffer=new SlurVectorBuffer{End=20};public float Origin;public NativeNotationContext Page;public readonly List<TupletPlacement> Labels=new List<TupletPlacement>();public readonly List<Item> LabelOwners=new List<Item>();public readonly List<float> Scales=new List<float>();}
  readonly Dictionary<int,StaffBuffer> staffs=new Dictionary<int,StaffBuffer>();


  static int Word(float v){return unchecked((short)(int)Math.Truncate(v));}
  float? configuredControl;public int Records{get;private set;}public int Failures{get;private set;}
  public bool Add(Graphics g,Item item,float staffStep,float staffBase,ScoreText text,NativeNotationContext page=null){
   bool scor4=text!=null&&NativeLibraryLocation.IsScor4(text.RootDirectory);int offset=ScoreVersionControls.SlurSubtype(scor4,item.P(8),item.P(16));if(offset>0&&offset<10)return false;
   float[] p=new float[21];for(int n=1;n<=20;n++)p[n]=item.P(n);float scale=page==null?5*staffStep:page.Scale;
   // Keep the verified word geometry in a local coordinate window. Applying
   // full-page Windows offsets before 16-bit storage would wrap lower staves.
   // Shared ordered buffer effects are retained within each staff projection.
   int key=page==null?item.Staff:0;StaffBuffer staff;if(!staffs.TryGetValue(key,out staff)){staff=new StaffBuffer();staffs.Add(key,staff);}var buffer=staff.Buffer;staff.Page=page;staff.Origin=page==null?staffBase+3*staffStep-20000/35f:page.Projection.OffsetY;
   var context=new SlurOriginContext{Scor4=scor4,Scale=scale,LeftX=(float)((double)p[3]*150),LeftY=page==null?(float)((double)p[4]*7*scale-20000):page.Prepared.Y,RightY=page==null?(float)((double)p[5]*7*scale-20000):page.Vertical(p[5])};
   bool straight=Word(p[9])==99;bool widthPrefix=straight?Word(p[13])!=0:Word(p[11])==0;if(printed)buffer.End=straight?1:(widthPrefix?2:1);
   try{
    if(!configuredControl.HasValue)configuredControl=NativeSlurDisplay.ReadThickness(text==null?null:text.RootDirectory);
    var result=SlurGeometry.Build(p,context,printed,configuredControl.Value,buffer,NativeSlurDisplay.RejectInvalidTrims);Records++;
    if(!printed&&NativeItemBounds.Active){var measurement=g.Save();try{g.TranslateTransform(0,staff.Origin);DrawBuffer(g,buffer,result.Root,50,false,false,staff.Page,true);}finally{g.Restore(measurement);}}
    if(printed){var state=g.Save();try{g.TranslateTransform(0,staff.Origin);DrawBuffer(g,buffer,result.Root,NativePrintContext.Width((short)(!straight&&Word(p[11])==0?-1:0)),Word(p[11])==0&&!result.Number.HasValue,true,page);}finally{g.Restore(state);}}
    if(result.Number.HasValue){if(printed){var state=g.Save();try{g.TranslateTransform(0,staff.Origin);DrawLabel(g,text,result.Number.Value,scale,page);}finally{g.Restore(state);}}else {staff.Labels.Add(result.Number.Value);staff.LabelOwners.Add(item);staff.Scales.Add(scale);}}
   }catch(ArgumentException e){Failures++;if(!NativeNotationView.UsesDat)throw;Failure(g,item,staffBase,e.Message);}catch(NotSupportedException e){Failures++;if(!NativeNotationView.UsesDat)throw;Failure(g,item,staffBase,e.Message);}
   return true;
  }
  static void Failure(Graphics g,Item item,float staffBase,string message){NativeSlurDisplay.Status=message;using(var font=new Font("Consolas",9,GraphicsUnit.Pixel))g.VectorDrawString("[slur: "+message+"]",font,Brushes.Firebrick,120+item.P(3)*5,staffBase-30);}
  static void DrawLabel(Graphics g,ScoreText text,TupletPlacement label,float scale,NativeNotationContext page=null){if(text!=null)NativeTupletFonts.Draw(g,text.ExternalFontName(2),label.Number,(page==null?120:page.Projection.OffsetX)+(int)label.X/30f,-(int)label.Y/(page==null?35f:30f),TupletGeometry.PrintedEm(label.FontScale,scale),page!=null);}
  public void Finish(Graphics g,ScoreText text){if(printed)return;foreach(var staff in staffs.Values){var state=g.Save();try{g.TranslateTransform(0,staff.Origin);DrawBuffer(g,staff.Buffer,20,50,false,false,staff.Page);for(int j=0;j<staff.Labels.Count;j++){NativeItemBounds.Select(staff.LabelOwners[j]);DrawLabel(g,text,staff.Labels[j],staff.Scales[j],staff.Page);NativeItemBounds.Select(null);}}finally{g.Restore(state);}}}
  static void DrawBuffer(Graphics g,SlurVectorBuffer b,int root,float width,bool restore,bool printed,NativeNotationContext page=null,bool observeOnly=false){
   var requests=SlurVectorCommands.Decode(b,root,restore,printed);var state=g.Save();try{using(var matrix=new Matrix(1/30f,0,0,page==null?-1/35f:-1/30f,page==null?120:page.Projection.OffsetX,0))g.MultiplyTransform(matrix,MatrixOrder.Prepend);
    using(var pen=new Pen(Color.Black,width))using(var path=new GraphicsPath(FillMode.Alternate)){pen.LineJoin=LineJoin.Round;pen.StartCap=LineCap.Flat;pen.EndCap=LineCap.Flat;bool fill=false,have=false;PointF previous=new PointF();
     Action flush=()=>{if(path.PointCount>0){if(observeOnly){NativeItemBounds.Path(g,path,pen);}else if(printed&&page!=null){if(fill)g.TrackedFillPath(Brushes.Black,path);g.TrackedDrawPath(pen,path);var eps=NativeEpsExport.For(g);if(eps!=null)eps.ScorePath(path,fill,pen.Width);}else{if(fill)g.VectorFillPath(Brushes.Black,path);g.VectorDrawPath(pen,path);}}path.Reset();have=false;};
     foreach(var request in requests){
      if(request.Kind==98||request.Kind==99){flush();pen.Width=NativePrintContext.FixedWidth(request.Kind==98?request.Y:(short)0);if(printed&&!observeOnly){if(request.Kind==99)NativePrintContext.RestoreDefaultLineWidth();else NativePrintContext.CarryLineWidth(pen.Width);}fill=false;continue;}
      var next=new PointF(request.X,request.Y);
      if(request.Kind==1||request.Kind==2){flush();fill=request.Kind==2;path.StartFigure();previous=next;have=true;}
      else if(request.Kind==3){path.StartFigure();previous=next;have=true;}
      else {if(have)path.AddLine(previous,next);previous=next;have=true;}
     }flush();
    }
   }finally{g.Restore(state);}
  }
 }
}

using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;using System;using System.Collections.Generic;using System.IO;
namespace ScoreModern {public static class NativeSpacingScale {
 public static List<PrimitiveTextPoint> Device(Canvas canvas){var result=new List<PrimitiveTextPoint>();int staff=canvas.SpacingScaleStaff;if(staff==0)return result;var doc=canvas.PageDocument;float ordinate=(float)((double)doc.Tables.Scales[staff]*72+doc.Tables.Bases[staff]-1800);float scaled=(float)(ordinate/(double)NativeDosViewport.Divisor);short anchor=unchecked((short)(int)((double)NativeDosViewport.OriginY-scaled));var words=NativeDatDrawing.Get(canvas.Library).SpacingScaleWords();for(int n=0;n<words.Length;n+=2){int tag=words[n+1]/10000,y=words[n+1]-tag*10000;result.Add(new PrimitiveTextPoint{X=unchecked((short)(words[n]/NativeDosViewport.Divisor+NativeDosViewport.OriginX)),Y=unchecked((short)(anchor-y/NativeDosViewport.Divisor)),Operation=(short)tag});}return result;}
 public static void DrawVector(Canvas canvas,System.Drawing.Graphics graphics){if(canvas.SpacingScaleStaff==0||NativeNotationView.IsDosViewport||NativeNotationView.IsPrinting||NativeEpsExport.For(graphics)!=null)return;var result=Device(canvas);for(int n=0;n<result.Count;n++){var p=result[n];p.X=(p.X-NativeDosViewport.OriginX)*NativeDosViewport.Divisor;p.Y=(NativeDosViewport.OriginY-p.Y)*NativeDosViewport.Divisor;result[n]=p;}NativeDatDrawing.Points(graphics,new NativeNotationContext{Projection=canvas.PageDocument.Projection},result);}
}}

using System;using System.Globalization;using System.Drawing;using System.IO;using System.Windows.Forms;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  const string TextAreaFontSizeSetting="text-area-font-size";
  float textAreaFontPoints;
  void LoadTextAreaFontSize(){
   textAreaFontPoints=0;
   try{float points;if(Single.TryParse(NativeSettings.Read(TextAreaFontSizeSetting),NumberStyles.Float,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,out points)&&points>=6&&points<=24)textAreaFontPoints=points;}
   catch(IOException){}catch(UnauthorizedAccessException){}
  }
  void SetTextAreaFontSize(float points,bool save){
   if(Single.IsNaN(points)||Single.IsInfinity(points)||points!=0&&(points<6||points>24))throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("points","Choose Automatic or 6–24 points.");
   if(save)NativeSettings.WriteAllText(TextAreaFontSizeSetting,points==0?"auto":points.ToString("0.##",CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));

    body.Controls.Add(automatic);body.Controls.Add(line);body.Controls.Add(new Label{AutoSize=true,MaximumSize=new Size(420,0),Text="Fixed sizes scale with Windows DPI. Smaller text leaves more room for the graphics. Lines remain whole. Automatic retains the existing window-based sizing."});
    var footer=new FlowLayoutPanel{Dock=DockStyle.Bottom,AutoSize=true,FlowDirection=FlowDirection.RightToLeft,Padding=new Padding(8)};
    var cancel=new Button{Text="Cancel",AutoSize=true,DialogResult=DialogResult.Cancel};var apply=new Button{Text="Apply",AutoSize=true,DialogResult=DialogResult.OK};footer.Controls.Add(cancel);footer.Controls.Add(apply);
    dialog.Controls.Add(body);dialog.Controls.Add(footer);dialog.AcceptButton=apply;dialog.CancelButton=cancel;

using System;using System.IO;
namespace ScoreModern {public sealed partial class Editor {
 Item textArrowItem;readonly float[] textArrowTail=new float[6];
 void ResetOriginalTextArrowState(Item item){textArrowItem=item;Array.Clear(textArrowTail,0,textArrowTail.Length);}
 float OriginalArrowValue(int parameter){return OriginalArrowValueFor(canvas.Selected,parameter);}
 float OriginalArrowValueFor(Item item,int parameter){if(item!=null&&item.Code==16&&parameter>=14&&parameter<=19)return Object.ReferenceEquals(textArrowItem,item)?textArrowTail[parameter-14]:0;return item==null?0:item.P(parameter);}
 void EditOriginalArrowParameter(int parameter,float value){
  var item=canvas.Selected;if(item==null||item.Code!=16||parameter<12){EditOriginalParameters(new[]{(float)parameter,value});return;}
  if(!Object.ReferenceEquals(textArrowItem,item))ResetOriginalTextArrowState(item);
  if(parameter==12&&(Single.IsNaN(value)||Single.IsInfinity(value)||value!=Math.Truncate(value)||value<0||value>Math.Min(160,item.Bytes.Length-56)))throw new NotSupportedException("This text-length arrow would read outside the captured text buffer. Use TX to supply the text; retained-buffer extension still requires verification.");
  Checkpoint();if(parameter==12)item.Set(12,value);else if(parameter>=14&&parameter<=19)textArrowTail[parameter-14]=value;
  // Converter recalculates P13 and appends its measured space terminator.
  // P14–P19 are working numeric words; packed text replaces them on storage.
  RefreshAll(item);

":item.Text,context.Scale,0);if(!layout.MetricsSupported||layout.Tokens.Any(t=>t.Code<0))throw new NotSupportedException("Unverified text controls: cached width retained.");text.RecordOriginalGlyphPass(layout);if(NativeTextTerminator.Refresh(score,item))result.TerminatorWrites++;float value=layout.Width;if(Single.IsNaN(value)||Single.IsInfinity(value))throw new NotSupportedException("Non-finite text width: cached value retained.");if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(item.P(13)),0)!=BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(value),0)){item.Set(13,value);result.Updated++;}}
   catch(Exception e){if(!(e is IOException)&&!(e is InvalidDataException)&&!(e is NotSupportedException))throw;result.Unresolved.Add("Item "+(score.Items.IndexOf(item)+1)+": "+e.Message);}}

using System;using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
namespace ScoreModern {public sealed partial class Editor {
 // Shared numerical projection of original lyric dash creation and
 // 2F6F:0200..05FA, with explicit binary32 stores at the original points.
 // 20DD:0C70 truncates the live x87 value with FISTP qword. A float
 // store here would turn a quotient just below1 into1 and add a dash.
 static float OriginalDashAutomaticCount(double quotient){if(Double.IsNaN(quotient)||Double.IsInfinity(quotient)||quotient< -32768||quotient>=32768)throw new NotSupportedException("Automatic dash count leaves the verified signed16 domain.");return (short)(int)quotient+1;}
 static float[] OriginalDashedTextGeometry(float left,float leftWidth,float right,float staffScale,float size,float baseY,float dashSize,float? countOverride){return OriginalDashedTextGeometryCore(left,leftWidth,right,staffScale,size,baseY,dashSize,countOverride,false);}
 static float[] OriginalLyricDashedTextGeometry(float left,float leftWidth,float right,float staffScale,float size,float baseY,float dashSize,float? countOverride){return OriginalDashedTextGeometryCore(left,leftWidth,right,staffScale,size,baseY,dashSize,countOverride,true);}
 //2C0C:038C uses the live x87 gap;2F6F:0531 reloads its binary32 store.
 static float[] OriginalDashedTextGeometryCore(float left,float leftWidth,float right,float staffScale,float size,float baseY,float dashSize,float? countOverride,bool liveGap){
  float dashFactor=BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(dashSize),0)==0?1.2833375930786133f:(float)((double)dashSize/.8571400046348572);float scale=(float)((double)staffScale/25),factor=(float)((double)staffScale/25*size),endOfText=(float)((double)leftWidth+left);right=Math.Min(right,201);float end=(float)((double)right-3.1700000762939453*factor);double available=(double)right-3.1700000762939453*factor-endOfText;float count=countOverride.HasValue?countOverride.Value:OriginalDashAutomaticCount(available/((double)factor*25));if(count==-1||factor==0||scale==0)throw new NotSupportedException("Degenerate lyric dash geometry is prevented.");double gap=((float)available-(double)dashFactor*factor*count)/((double)count+1);float startBase=(float)((double)endOfText+gap);end=(float)((double)end+scale*.20000000298023224);float y=(float)((double)baseY+size*.800000011920929),length=(float)((double)dashFactor*size*.8571400046348572),spacing=(float)(.8571400046348572*(liveGap?gap:(float)gap)/scale);float start=(float)((double)scale*1.5+startBase),stop=(float)((double)scale*.10000000149011612+endOfText);if(start<stop)start=stop;if((double)end-startBase<.20000000298023224)end=(float)((double)startBase+.019999999552965164);return new[]{start,y,end,length,spacing};
 }
 // CD solid branch 2F6F:0315..0475 uses staff-relative note clearances.
 float[] OriginalSolidTextGeometry(float staff,float left,float width,float right,float staffScale,float size,float y){
  float scale=(float)((double)staffScale/25),factor=(float)((double)staffScale/25*size),endOfText=(float)((double)left+width),end=(float)((double)Math.Min(right,201)-3.1700000762939453*factor),limit=(float)((double)end-scale*4),note=0;int bits=BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(staff),0);
  foreach(var item in score.Items)if(item.P(1)==1&&BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(item.P(2)),0)==bits&&item.P(3)<=limit&&item.P(3)>note)note=item.P(3);float candidate=(float)((double)scale*4+note);if((double)scale*2+endOfText<candidate&&candidate<end)end=candidate;float start=(float)((double)scale*1.5+endOfText);if((double)end-endOfText<.20000000298023224)end=(float)((double)endOfText+.019999999552965164);return new[]{start,y,end,0f,0f};
 }
 void CenterOriginalTextDashes(float[] values){
  var line=canvas.Selected;if(line==null||line.P(1)!=4)return;
  bool changedCount=values.Length>0&&CenterWord(values[0])!=0;
  var edits=OriginalDashEdits(line,changedCount?values[0]:line.P(14),changedCount,NativePreferences.Read(source).Number("DASH",1.1f));
  if(edits.Length!=0)EditOriginalParameters(edits);
 }

 float[] OriginalDashEdits(Item line,float count,bool changedCount,float dashSize){
  bool solid=BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(line.P(7)),0)==0;Item left=null,right=null;float leftX=-9999,rightX=9999;int staffBits=BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(line.P(2)),0);
  foreach(var text in score.Items){if(text.P(1)!=16||BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(text.P(2)),0)!=staffBits||Math.Abs((double)text.P(4)-line.P(4))>1.899999976158142)continue;double x=(double)text.P(3)+text.P(11);float stored=(float)x;if(x<=line.P(3)){if(stored>=leftX){left=text;leftX=stored;}}else if(stored<rightX){right=text;rightX=stored;}}
  if(left==null&&right==null)return changedCount?new[]{14f,count}:new float[0];if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(leftX),0)<0)leftX=0;var sizeSource=left??right;float size=sizeSource.P(6);if(BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(size),0)==0)size=1;canvas.LayoutScore();int staff=(int)sizeSource.P(2);if(staff<1||staff>32)throw new NotSupportedException("CD staff scale leaves the original table.");float staffScale=canvas.PageDocument.Tables.Scales[staff];var g=solid?OriginalSolidTextGeometry(line.P(2),leftX,left==null?0:left.P(13),rightX,staffScale,size,sizeSource.P(4)):OriginalDashedTextGeometry(leftX,left==null?0:left.P(13),rightX,staffScale,size,sizeSource.P(4),dashSize,BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(count),0)==0?(float?)null:count);var edits=new List<float>{3,g[0],4,g[1],5,g[1],6,g[2],8,g[3],9,g[4]};if(changedCount){edits.Add(14);edits.Add(count);}return edits.ToArray();
 }

 void CenterScor4GroupDashes(short staff){
  var preferences=NativePreferences.Read(source);
  float dashSize=preferences.Number("DASH",1.2857099771499634f);
  short count=preferences.Word("XDASH",0);
  var records=score.Items.ToArray();
  bool changed=false;
  for(int n=0;n<records.Length;n++){
   Item item=records[n];
   if(item.Code!=4||(staff>0&&item.Staff!=staff)||item.Count<6||(item.Count>10&&item.Count!=14))continue;
   if(BitConverter.ToInt32(item.Bytes,16)!=BitConverter.ToInt32(item.Bytes,20))continue;
   bool dashed=BitConverter.ToInt32(BitConverter.GetBytes(item.P(7)),0)!=0;
   var edits=OriginalDashEdits(item,dashed?count:0,dashed&&item.Count==14,dashSize);
   if(edits.Length==0)continue;
   var replacement=item.Clone();
   for(int p=0;p<edits.Length;p+=2)replacement.Set((int)edits[p],edits[p+1]);
   if(replacement.Bytes.SequenceEqual(item.Bytes))continue;
   records[n]=replacement;changed=true;
  }
  if(changed){
   using(var storage=BeginParameterMutation()){
    Checkpoint();score.Items=records.ToList();dirty=true;RefreshAll(null);storage.Complete();
   }
  }
  Message("");
 }

using System;

using System.Windows.Forms;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed class NativeTextMemory:IScreenHookMemory {
  public readonly byte[] Bda=new byte[256];
  public NativeTextMemory(){Bda[0x49]=0x12;Bda[0x4a]=80;Bda[0x84]=29;Bda[0x85]=16;Bda[0x60]=7;Bda[0x61]=6;}
  public byte ReadByte(ushort s,ushort o){if(s!=0x40||o>=256)throw new InvalidOperationException("Display memory outside BIOS data area.");return Bda[o];}
  public ushort ReadWord(ushort s,ushort o){return (ushort)(ReadByte(s,o)|(ReadByte(s,(ushort)(o+1))<<8));}
  public void WriteByte(ushort s,ushort o,byte v){if(s!=0x40||o>=256)throw new InvalidOperationException("Display memory outside BIOS data area.");Bda[o]=v;}
  public void WriteWord(ushort s,ushort o,ushort v){WriteByte(s,o,(byte)v);WriteByte(s,(ushort)(o+1),(byte)(v>>8));}
  public void OrByte(ushort s,ushort o,byte v){throw new NotSupportedException("Direct video memory is not a text service.");}
 }
 public sealed class NativeTextSession {
  public readonly NativeTextMemory Memory=new NativeTextMemory();public readonly Mode12CellSurface Surface=new Mode12CellSurface();readonly Mode12VideoServices video;
  public NativeTextSession(){video=new Mode12VideoServices(Surface);}
  public void Clear(){video.ExecuteService(Memory,new SignedDivide16State{AX=0x600,DX=0x1d4f});Move(0,0);}
  public void Move(int row,int column){video.ExecuteService(Memory,new SignedDivide16State{AX=0x200,DX=(ushort)((row<<8)|column)});}
  public void Write(byte[] bytes){foreach(byte b in bytes)video.ExecuteService(Memory,new SignedDivide16State{AX=(ushort)(0xe00|b),BX=7});}
 }
 public static class NativeInterfaceText {
  static readonly Dictionary<string,Mode12CellSurface> cache=new Dictionary<string,Mode12CellSurface>();
  static readonly Encoding cp=Encoding.GetEncoding(437,EncoderFallback.ExceptionFallback,DecoderFallback.ExceptionFallback);
  static ExternalVgaFont vga;public static string VgaPath{get;private set;}public static bool UseVga{get;private set;}
  static string Settings {get{return "display";}}
  public static void Load(){if(!NativeSettings.Exists(Settings))return;try{string[] lines=NativeSettings.ReadAllLines(Settings);if(lines.Length>1&&lines[0]=="vga")SetVga(lines[1],false);}catch(Exception){UseVga=false;vga=null;}}
  public static void SetVga(string path,bool save){var font=new ExternalVgaFont(File.ReadAllBytes(path));vga=font;VgaPath=Path.GetFullPath(path);UseVga=true;if(save)NativeSettings.WriteAllLines(Settings,new[]{"vga",VgaPath});Invalidate();}
  public static void SetConsolas(bool save){UseVga=false;if(save)NativeSettings.WriteAllText(Settings,"consolas\r\n");Invalidate();}
  static void Invalidate(){foreach(Form f in Application.OpenForms)f.Invalidate(true);}
  public static void ChooseFont(IWin32Window owner){using(var d=new OpenFileDialog{Title="Choose an external 8x16 VGA font",Filter="Raw 8x16 VGA font (4096 bytes)|*.f16;*.bin|All files|*.*"})if(d.ShowDialog(owner)==DialogResult.OK){try{SetVga(d.FileName,true);}catch(Exception e){MessageBox.Show(owner,e.Message,"Font could not be loaded");}}}
  public static void Install(Form form){var menu=new PreferencesActionsMenu{Tag=form};var ui=new ToolStripMenuItem("Interface text: choose UI font...");ui.Click+=(s,e)=>NativeUiFont.Choose(form);menu.Items.Add(ui);menu.Opening+=(s,e)=>ui.ToolTipText=NativeUiFont.Family;menu.Items.Add("Interface text: reset to Consolas",null,(s,e)=>{NativeUiFont.Set("Consolas",true);SetConsolas(true);});menu.Items.Add("Use external VGA font...",null,(s,e)=>ChooseFont(form));NativeBeamDisplay.AddMenu(menu);NativeApproximation.AddMenu(menu);GhostscriptTextRenderer.AddMenu(menu);IncludedPostScriptDisplay.AddMenu(menu);AttachMenu(form,menu);}
  internal static void AttachMenu(Form form,ContextMenuStrip menu){form.ContextMenuStrip=menu;Attach(form,menu);}
  static void Attach(Control c,ContextMenuStrip menu){foreach(Control child in c.Controls){if(!(child is TextBoxBase))child.ContextMenuStrip=menu;Attach(child,menu);}}
  internal static StringFormat WindowsFormat(bool wrap=false){var format=(StringFormat)StringFormat.GenericTypographic.Clone();format.FormatFlags|=StringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces;if(!wrap)format.FormatFlags|=StringFormatFlags.NoWrap;return format;}
  internal static float TextWidth(Graphics graphics,string text,Font font){if(String.IsNullOrEmpty(text))return 0;if(UseVga)return text.Length*graphics.MeasureString("M",font,100,StringFormat.GenericTypographic).Width;using(var format=WindowsFormat())return graphics.MeasureString(text,font,Int32.MaxValue,format).Width;}
  internal static RectangleF TextSpan(Graphics graphics,string text,Font font,int start,int length,RectangleF bounds){start=Math.Max(0,Math.Min(start,text.Length));length=Math.Max(0,Math.Min(length,text.Length-start));if(UseVga){float cell=graphics.MeasureString("M",font,100,StringFormat.GenericTypographic).Width;return new RectangleF(bounds.X+start*cell,bounds.Y,length*cell,bounds.Height);}if(length==0)return new RectangleF(bounds.X+TextWidth(graphics,text.Substring(0,start),font),bounds.Y,0,bounds.Height);using(var format=WindowsFormat()){format.SetMeasurableCharacterRanges(new[]{new CharacterRange(start,length)});var regions=graphics.MeasureCharacterRanges(text,font,bounds,format);try{var measured=regions[0].GetBounds(graphics);return new RectangleF(measured.X,bounds.Y,measured.Width,bounds.Height);}finally{foreach(var region in regions)region.Dispose();}}}
  public static void Draw(Graphics g,string text,Font font,Brush brush,float x,float y){Draw(g,text,font,brush,new PointF(x,y));}
  public static void Draw(Graphics g,string text,Font font,Brush brush,PointF point){Draw(g,text,font,brush,new RectangleF(point.X,point.Y,10000,font.GetHeight(g)*2));}
  public static void Draw(Graphics g,string text,Font font,Brush brush,RectangleF bounds,bool wrap=false){
   if(String.IsNullOrEmpty(text)||bounds.Width<=0||bounds.Height<=0)return;
   if(!UseVga){var clip=g.Save();try{g.SetClip(bounds,CombineMode.Intersect);using(var format=WindowsFormat(wrap))g.DrawString(text,font,brush,bounds,format);}finally{g.Restore(clip);}return;}byte[] bytes;
   try{bytes=cp.GetBytes(text.Replace("\t"," "));if(bytes.Any(b=>b<32&&b!=10&&b!=13))throw new EncoderFallbackException();}catch(EncoderFallbackException){g.DrawString(text,font,brush,bounds,StringFormat.GenericTypographic);return;}
   // The Windows text pane is not an 80-column BIOS surface. Keep its explicit
   // line breaks, and wrap only at the supplied control width when requested.
   float cell=g.MeasureString("M",font,100,StringFormat.GenericTypographic).Width;float line=font.GetHeight(g);
   int columns=Math.Max(1,(int)(bounds.Width/cell)),row=0,column=0;var saved=g.Save();try{g.SetClip(bounds,CombineMode.Intersect);
    for(int index=0;index<bytes.Length;index++){byte value=bytes[index];if(value==13||value==10){if(value==13&&index+1<bytes.Length&&bytes[index+1]==10)index++;row++;column=0;continue;}
     if(wrap&&column>=columns){column=0;row++;}
     float y=bounds.Y+row*line;if(y>=bounds.Bottom)break;
     DrawGlyph(g,new Mode12Glyph(value,7),bounds.X+column*cell,y,cell,line,font,brush,UseVga?vga:null);column++;
    }
   }finally{g.Restore(saved);}
  }
  public static int MeasureRows(string text){if(String.IsNullOrEmpty(text))return 1;try{var session=new NativeTextSession();session.Write(cp.GetBytes(text));for(int row=29;row>=0;row--)for(int col=0;col<80;col++)if(session.Surface.Cell(row,col).Any(v=>v.Character!=32))return row+1;return 1;}catch(EncoderFallbackException){return Math.Min(30,Math.Max(1,text.Split('\n').Sum(x=>Math.Max(1,(x.Length+79)/80))));}}
  public static void DrawSurface(Graphics g,Mode12CellSurface cells,PointF origin,float cellWidth,float cellHeight,Font font,Brush foreground,ExternalVgaFont external,int rows,bool singleLine=false){
   g.TextRenderingHint=TextRenderingHint.AntiAliasGridFit;
   for(int row=0;row<rows;row++)for(int col=0;col<80;col++){
    var layers=cells.Cell(row,col);if(layers.Length==0)continue;float x=origin.X+(singleLine?col+row*80:col)*cellWidth,y=origin.Y+(singleLine?0:row*cellHeight);
    if(layers.Length>1||layers.Any(a=>(a.Color&0x80)!=0)){DrawComposite(g,layers,x,y,cellWidth,cellHeight,font,foreground,external);continue;}
    DrawGlyph(g,layers[0],x,y,cellWidth,cellHeight,font,foreground,external);

   }
  }
  static void DrawGlyph(Graphics g,Mode12Glyph glyph,float x,float y,float width,float height,Font font,Brush brush,ExternalVgaFont external){if((glyph.Color&7)==0||glyph.Character==32)return;if(external!=null){for(int n=0;n<16;n++){byte bits=external.Row(glyph.Character,n);for(int b=0;b<8;b++)if((bits&(128>>b))!=0)g.FillRectangle(brush,x+b*width/8,y+n*height/16,width/8+.01f,height/16+.01f);}}else{string value=Encoding.GetEncoding(437).GetString(new[]{glyph.Character});if(glyph.Character==7)value="\u2022";g.DrawString(value,font,brush,x,y,StringFormat.GenericTypographic);}}
  static void DrawComposite(Graphics target,Mode12Glyph[] layers,float x,float y,float width,float height,Font font,Brush brush,ExternalVgaFont external){int w=Math.Max(1,(int)Math.Ceiling(width)),h=Math.Max(1,(int)Math.Ceiling(height));float[] coverage=new float[w*h];using(var mask=new Bitmap(w,h,System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb))using(var g=Graphics.FromImage(mask))using(var result=new Bitmap(w,h,System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb)){foreach(var layer in layers){g.Clear(Color.Transparent);g.TextRenderingHint=TextRenderingHint.AntiAliasGridFit;DrawGlyph(g,layer,0,0,width,height,font,Brushes.White,external);for(int py=0;py<h;py++)for(int px=0;px<w;px++){int at=py*w+px;float value=mask.GetPixel(px,py).A/255f;coverage[at]=(layer.Color&0x80)!=0?coverage[at]+value-2*coverage[at]*value:value;}}Color color=brush is SolidBrush?((SolidBrush)brush).Color:Color.Black;for(int py=0;py<h;py++)for(int px=0;px<w;px++)result.SetPixel(px,py,Color.FromArgb(Math.Max(0,Math.Min(255,(int)(coverage[py*w+px]*255))),color));target.DrawImageUnscaled(result,(int)x,(int)y);}}

 }
 public sealed class NativeTextLabel:Label {
  public bool Wrapped;internal int SelectedMessageRow=-1;
  internal int LinePitch;
  const TextFormatFlags MessageLineFlags=TextFormatFlags.NoPadding|TextFormatFlags.NoPrefix|TextFormatFlags.SingleLine|TextFormatFlags.ExpandTabs;

  System.Collections.Generic.List<string> MessageLines(int width){
   if(NativeInterfaceText.UseVga)return VgaLines(width);
   var lines=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
   foreach(string paragraph in Text.Replace("\r\n","\n").Replace('\r','\n').Split('\n')){
    string remaining=paragraph;
    while(TextRenderer.MeasureText(remaining,Font,Size.Empty,MessageLineFlags).Width>width&&remaining.Length>1){
     int low=1,high=remaining.Length-1;
     while(low<high){
      int middle=(low+high+1)/2;
      if(TextRenderer.MeasureText(remaining.Substring(0,middle),Font,Size.Empty,MessageLineFlags).Width<=width)low=middle;
      else high=middle-1;
     }
     int space=remaining.LastIndexOf(' ',low,low+1);
     int cut=space>0?space:low;
     lines.Add(remaining.Substring(0,cut));
     remaining=remaining.Substring(cut).TrimStart(' ');
    }
    lines.Add(remaining);
   }
   return lines;
  }

  void PaintMessageRows(Graphics graphics){
   var lines=MessageLines(ClientSize.Width);
   using(var ink=new SolidBrush(ForeColor)){
    for(int index=0;index<lines.Count;index++){
     var row=new Rectangle(0,index*LinePitch,ClientSize.Width,LinePitch);
     if(!row.IntersectsWith(Rectangle.Ceiling(graphics.VisibleClipBounds)))continue;

using System;using System.Linq;using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace ScoreModern {internal sealed class OriginalTextTabSpacingException:InvalidOperationException {internal OriginalTextTabSpacingException():base("*** When both JR and tabs are used, p5 must = 1.") {}}
public sealed partial class ScoreText {
 // Original323E:0B45..0CD4: JR can align the prefix before its first
 // stored tab, and Type1 ink edges come from the second external PSC
 // record. Primitive-font correction uses the external DAT metric table.

  int id=token.FontWord%100,code=token.Code;float difference;
  if(id>=90&&id<=98){int index=code+1;if(index==136||index==150)index-=56;float metric;if(index<=105)metric=BitConverter.ToSingle(textDat,2892+index*4);else{int word=index*2-217;lock(originalMetricHistoryLock){if(word<0||word+1>=originalConverterWords.Length||!originalConverterWords[word].HasValue||!originalConverterWords[word+1].HasValue)throw new NotSupportedException("Original built-in-font alignment reads unestablished adjacent converter state.");uint bits=(uint)(ushort)originalConverterWords[word].Value|((uint)(ushort)originalConverterWords[word+1].Value<<16);metric=BitConverter.ToSingle(BitConverter.GetBytes(bits),0);}}difference=(float)((double)metric*.10000000149011612);}
  else{Face face;int metricFace=token.DatMetricFace;if(metricFace<0||metricFace>=90||!faces.TryGetValue(metricFace,out face)||face.RightEdges==null)throw new NotSupportedException("Text alignment requires the selected font's external PSC advance and ink-edge records.");if(code>=162){
    //323E:0C69..0CC9 uses162 entries per face, even for embedded
    // music codes162..166 and literal800. Banks follow load order,
    // not logical font numbers; unused banks stay zero until loaded.
    // Four cold controls and the font1-before-font0 history are measured.
    if(!(code==162||code==163||code==164||code==166||code==800))throw new NotSupportedException("This trailing text control leaves the measured font-bank adjacency domain.");
    int adjacent=-1,index=code%162;lock(originalMetricHistoryLock){int slot=originalAlignmentMetricFaces.IndexOf(metricFace);if(slot<0)throw new NotSupportedException("The original metric load order is unavailable.");slot+=code/162;if(slot>=10)throw new NotSupportedException("Text alignment beyond the ten original metric banks requires adjacent-storage verification.");if(slot<originalAlignmentMetricFaces.Count)adjacent=originalAlignmentMetricFaces[slot];}
    if(adjacent<0)difference=0;else{Face next;if(!faces.TryGetValue(adjacent,out next)||next.RightEdges==null)throw new NotSupportedException("The retained adjacent metric bank is unavailable.");float advance=(float)((double)next.Widths[index]/638);difference=(float)((double)advance-(double)next.RightEdges[index]/638);}
   }else{float advance=(float)((double)face.Widths[code]/638);difference=(float)((double)advance-(double)face.RightEdges[code]/638);}}float factor=(float)((double)layout.Parameters.Horizontal*staffScale/25);return (float)((double)difference*factor*3.2832999229431152);

  public static bool FontControl(string text,int p,out int id,out int length){

  static bool ReadTab(string text,int start,out float x,out int end){
   x=0;
   end=start;

    int id,length,tabEnd;float tabX;var t=new NativeTextToken();

## NativeTextTerminator

````csharp
using System;
using ScoreModern.RecoveredFragments;
namespace ScoreModern {
 // Original converter 0A33:0090..0096 appends one space after the
 // declared text. Preserve the measured in-record padding write. A write
 // into the next record is gated by the existing original-invalid-states policy.
 public static class NativeTextTerminator {
  public static bool Refresh(Score score,Item item){
   if(item==null||item.Code!=16||item.Count<13)return false;
   // A stored empty line is measured using the caller's temporary blank,
   // not a writable zero-byte RN payload (natural all-blank RIP capture).
   float length=item.P(12);if(Single.IsNaN(length)||Single.IsInfinity(length)||length<=0||length>item.Bytes.Length-56)return false;
   int at=56+(int)Math.Truncate(length);
   if(at<item.Bytes.Length){if(item.Bytes[at]==InputTextTerminatorWrite.Space)return false;item.Bytes[at]=InputTextTerminatorWrite.Space;return true;}
   if(at!=item.Bytes.Length||!NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates)return false;
   int index=score.Items.IndexOf(item);if(index<0||index+1>=score.Items.Count)return false;
   var next=score.Items[index+1];if(next.Bytes.Length==0||next.Bytes[0]==InputTextTerminatorWrite.Space)return false;
   next.Bytes[0]=InputTextTerminatorWrite.Space;return true;
  }
 }
}

````csharp
using System;using System.Drawing;using System.Collections.Generic;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class NativeTrillGlyph {
  // Shared by standalone Code7 and Code1's delegated trill. Relative
  // 13E8:0024..012B, without the optional continuation/accidental branches.
  public static PrimitiveGlyphRequest Prepare(float size,float x,float y,float scale){if(size==0)size=1;float h=(float)((double)size*1.100000023841858);return new PrimitiveGlyphRequest{Glyph=37,X=x,Y=(float)((double)y+scale*7),Horizontal=h,Vertical=h,WidthSelector=-1};}
  static float F(double value){return (float)value;}
  internal static PrimitiveGlyphRequest Accidental(int accidental,float size,float x,float y,float scale){
   float horizontal=F((double)size*scale*23);
   float vertical=F((double)size*(scale*7)*(accidental==1?3:3.5999999046325684));
   float glyphSize=F((double)size*.6499999761581421);
   return new PrimitiveGlyphRequest{Glyph=accidental+5,X=F((double)x+horizontal),Y=F((double)y+vertical),
    Horizontal=glyphSize,Vertical=glyphSize,WidthSelector=-1};
  }
  public static bool Draw(Graphics g,Item item,NativeNotationContext page,DrawingLibrary library,HashSet<int> cache){
   if(item.Code!=7||page==null||item.P(7)!=0||Single.IsNaN(item.P(5))||Single.IsInfinity(item.P(5))||Math.Abs(item.P(5))>32767)return false;
   for(int n=10;n<=20;n++)if(n!=11&&n!=12&&n!=13&&n!=15&&item.P(n)!=0)return false;
   if(NativeNotationView.UsesDat&&item.P(8)!=0)return false;
   int accidental=(int)item.P(8);
   if(item.P(8)!=accidental||accidental<0||accidental>3||
    (accidental!=0&&(library==null||!library.Symbols.ContainsKey(accidental+5))))return false;
   float end=item.P(6),size=item.P(5)==0?1:item.P(5);
   float x=F((double)page.Prepared.X+item.P(15)*150);
   var glyph=Prepare(size,x,page.Prepared.Y,page.Scale);
   if(end<=item.P(3)){
    if(!NativePrimitiveGlyphs.Draw(g,page,library,cache,glyph))return false;
   }else{
    if(NativeNotationView.UsesDat||Single.IsNaN(end)||Single.IsInfinity(end)||
     (Single.IsNaN(item.P(9))||Single.IsInfinity(item.P(9))||Math.Abs(item.P(9))>32767)||Single.IsNaN(item.P(12))||Math.Abs(item.P(12))>32767)return false;
    float wiggle=item.P(9)==0?1:item.P(9),waveSize=F((double)wiggle*size);if(!(waveSize>0))waveSize=1;
    float start=F((double)x+size*page.Scale*22.850000381469727),right=F((double)end*150);
    if(start>right)return false;
    float pitch=F((double)item.P(11)-wiggle+item.P(4)+2.200000047683716f);
    float y=page.Vertical(F((double)pitch+.4000000059604645f));
    bool rotated=item.P(13)!=0;
    if(library==null||!library.Symbols.ContainsKey(glyph.Glyph))return false;
    // Cached primitives print immediately. Expanded body points stay in
    // SCORE's vector buffer while a horizontal continuation prints directly.
    // Buffered rotated continuations retain the ordinary append order.
    bool bodyBeforeWave=rotated||cache!=null&&cache.Contains(glyph.Glyph);
    if(bodyBeforeWave&&!NativePrimitiveGlyphs.Draw(g,page,library,cache,glyph))return false;
    // SCORE emits cached accidentals immediately. Expanded points drain
    // after the continuation, which writes directly to the printer stream.
    if(accidental!=0&&(rotated||cache!=null&&cache.Contains(accidental+5))){
     if(!NativePrimitiveGlyphs.Draw(g,page,library,cache,Accidental(accidental,size,glyph.X,glyph.Y,page.Scale)))return false;
     accidental=0;
    }
    if(rotated){
     var context=new NativeNotationContext{Staff=page.Staff,RawBase=page.RawBase,Prepared=page.Prepared,Projection=page.Projection};
     context.Prepared.X=start;context.Prepared.Y=y;
     var wave=Item.Make(4,item.P(2),item.P(3),pitch,pitch,end,-1,waveSize,0,0,0,item.P(12),item.P(13));
     if(!NativePrintedFilledWave.Draw(g,wave,context))return false;
    }else if(!NativePrintedFilledWave.DrawHorizontal(g,page,start,y,right,waveSize,(short)(int)item.P(12)!=0))return false;
    if(!bodyBeforeWave&&!NativePrimitiveGlyphs.Draw(g,page,library,cache,glyph))return false;
   }
   return accidental==0||NativePrimitiveGlyphs.Draw(g,page,library,cache,
    Accidental(accidental,size,glyph.X,glyph.Y,page.Scale));
  }
 }
}

using System;using System.IO;using System.Linq;using System.Text;using System.Windows.Forms;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public sealed partial class Editor {
  Item externalDrawingNameItem;Score externalDrawingLoad;string externalDrawingLoadPath;bool externalDrawingOldBlock,externalDrawingReturnDisk;Action externalDrawingRedrawContinuation;ScreenMode externalDrawingRedrawMode;
  static bool NeedsExternalDrawingReset(Item item){return item.Code==11&&item.P(13)==1||item.Code==15&&item.P(13)!=0;}
  // D114/D115: edit replies change the record; load-time replies change only
  // the drawing working copy. Never encode the latter into the MUS record.
  bool BeginLoadedDrawingNames(Score next,string path){
   if(externalDrawingNameItem!=null)throw new InvalidOperationException("Finish the drawing filename request before opening another score.");
   Item item=next.Items.FirstOrDefault(i=>NeedsExternalDrawingReset(i)&&!i.ExternalDrawingResetResolved);
   if(item==null)return false;externalDrawingLoad=next;externalDrawingLoadPath=path;BeginExternalDrawingName(item);return true;
  }
  bool BeginExternalDrawingRedraw(Action continuation){
   var reset=score.Items.Where(NeedsExternalDrawingReset).ToArray();if(reset.Length==0)return false;
   foreach(var item in reset){item.ExternalDrawingResetResolved=false;item.ExternalDrawingNameOverride=null;item.ExternalPostScriptBoxOverride=null;}
   externalDrawingRedrawContinuation=continuation;externalDrawingRedrawMode=mode;externalDrawingLoad=score;externalDrawingLoadPath=current;
   mode=ScreenMode.Main;RefreshOriginalPrintMenu();LayoutClassic();BeginExternalDrawingName(reset[0]);return true;
  }
  void BeginExternalDrawingName(Item item){
   if((item.Code!=11&&item.Code!=15)||item.Count<13)throw new NotSupportedException("Code11 filename reset requires its P13 control.");
   externalDrawingNameItem=item;externalDrawingOldBlock=canvas.BlockItemEditing;canvas.BlockItemEditing=true;
   string name=Encoding.GetEncoding(437).GetString(item.Bytes,56,Math.Max(0,Math.Min(24,item.Bytes.Length-56)));int zero=name.IndexOf('\0');if(zero>=0)name=name.Substring(0,zero);
   Message((externalDrawingLoad==null?"Old name = "+name.TrimEnd(' ')+Environment.NewLine:"")+(item.Code==15?"Enter PostScript program name or \"-\" to cancel. ->":"Enter library name or \"-\" to cancel. ->"));command.Clear();command.Focus();
  }
  bool SubmitExternalDrawingName(string text){
   if(externalDrawingNameItem==null)return false;var item=externalDrawingNameItem;
   if(scor4ExternalItemInsertion&&text=="-"){
    scor4ExternalItemInsertion=false;externalDrawingNameItem=null;canvas.BlockItemEditing=externalDrawingOldBlock;
    SetScor4ItemsBank(0);Message("");command.Clear();command.Focus();return true;
   }
   if(scor4ExternalItemInsertion&&text=="*"){
    ShowScoreDirectory(item.Code==15?"*.EPS":"*.DRW");command.Clear();command.Focus();return true;
   }
   if(item.Code==15)return SubmitOriginalPostScriptName(text);
   if(text!="-"){
    if(text.Length>24)throw new NotSupportedException("Drawing names longer than 24 bytes have not been verified against SCORE.");
    var encoding=Encoding.GetEncoding(437,EncoderFallback.ExceptionFallback,DecoderFallback.ExceptionFallback);
    char[] upper=text.ToCharArray();for(int n=0;n<upper.Length;n++)if(upper[n]>='a'&&upper[n]<='z')upper[n]=(char)(upper[n]-'a'+'A');
    string value=new String(upper);byte[] bytes=encoding.GetBytes(value.PadRight(24,' '));
    var preview=item.Clone();preview.Set(13,0);preview.ExternalDrawingNameOverride=value.PadRight(24,' ');preview.ExternalDrawingResetResolved=true;
    if(!NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates){
     if(value.Length==0||value.Any(Char.IsControl))throw new NotSupportedException("Enter a drawing library name, or - to keep the current name. Strict SCORE can retain original control bytes.");
     int selector;NativeDatUserDrawings.Load(preview,canvas.Library,out selector);
    }
    if(externalDrawingLoad!=null)item.ExternalDrawingNameOverride=preview.ExternalDrawingNameOverride;
    else{if(item.Count<19)item.Set(19,0);item.Set(13,0);Array.Copy(bytes,0,item.Bytes,56,24);item.ExternalDrawingNameOverride=null;item.ExternalPostScriptBoxOverride=null;}
   }
   CompleteExternalDrawingName(item,"");return true;
  }
  void CompleteExternalDrawingName(Item item,string message){
   item.ExternalDrawingResetResolved=true;externalDrawingNameItem=null;canvas.BlockItemEditing=externalDrawingOldBlock;command.Clear();
   if(scor4ExternalItemInsertion){scor4ExternalItemInsertion=false;AppendScor4ItemForEdit(item);Message(message);return;}
   if(externalDrawingLoad!=null){
    var next=externalDrawingLoad;string path=externalDrawingLoadPath;
    if(externalDrawingRedrawContinuation!=null){
     Item pending=next.Items.FirstOrDefault(i=>NeedsExternalDrawingReset(i)&&!i.ExternalDrawingResetResolved);
     if(pending!=null){BeginExternalDrawingName(pending);return;}
     var continuation=externalDrawingRedrawContinuation;externalDrawingRedrawContinuation=null;externalDrawingLoad=null;externalDrawingLoadPath=null;mode=externalDrawingRedrawMode;Message("");continuation();
    }else{externalDrawingLoad=null;externalDrawingLoadPath=null;SetDocument(next,path);if(externalDrawingNameItem==null&&externalDrawingReturnDisk){externalDrawingReturnDisk=false;mode=ScreenMode.Disk;UpdateClassic();LayoutClassic();}}
   }else{RefreshAll(item);Message(message);command.Focus();}
  }
  bool ExternalDrawingNameKey(KeyEventArgs e){
   if(externalDrawingNameItem==null)return false;
   if(e.Alt&&e.KeyCode==Keys.D&&!e.Shift){e.SuppressKeyPress=true;MoveTextBoundary(e.Control?-1:1);return true;}
   if(e.KeyCode==Keys.Enter){e.SuppressKeyPress=true;string text=command.Text;command.Clear();Safe(()=>SubmitExternalDrawingName(text));return true;}
   if(e.KeyCode==Keys.Escape){e.SuppressKeyPress=true;command.Focus();command.AppendText("\x1b");return true;}
   if(e.KeyCode>=Keys.F1&&e.KeyCode<=Keys.F12||e.Control&&(e.KeyCode==Keys.O||e.KeyCode==Keys.S||e.KeyCode==Keys.Z||e.KeyCode==Keys.Y)){e.SuppressKeyPress=true;command.Focus();return true;}
   command.Focus();return true;
  }
 }

using System;using System.IO;using System.Linq;
namespace ScoreModern {
 public static class OriginalMusSave {
  // Recorded DOS save: the 20-byte older trailer gains the external producer
  // DWORD after its first word; the 24-byte trailer carries preceding-word count 5.
  // DOS SCORE3.11 stamps version3.0, including on the measured WinScore6 input.
  // Measurement and undefined trailer bytes are preserved.
  internal static uint ReadProducer(string root){string path=NativeLibraryLocation.FileFor(root,"SCOR3_10.DAT");byte[] data=File.ReadAllBytes(path);if(data.Length<4)throw new InvalidDataException("External SCORE producer data is truncated.");uint producer=BitConverter.ToUInt32(data,0);if(producer<1000000||producer>9999999)throw new InvalidDataException("External SCORE producer identifier is outside the verified seven-digit format.");return producer;}
  public static Score Prepare(Score score,string root){if(score==null)throw new ArgumentNullException("score");return Prepare(score,ReadProducer(root));}
  internal static Score Prepare(Score score,uint producer){var copy=score.Clone();byte[] old=copy.Trailer,next=new byte[24];if(old.Length==20){Array.Copy(old,0,next,0,4);Array.Copy(old,4,next,8,16);}else if(old.Length==24)Array.Copy(old,next,24);else throw new InvalidDataException("MUS trailer outside the verified save formats.");if(score.RetainedUndefinedWord!=null&&score.RetainedUndefinedWord.Length==4)Array.Copy(score.RetainedUndefinedWord,0,next,0,4);Array.Copy(BitConverter.GetBytes(producer),0,next,4,4);Array.Copy(BitConverter.GetBytes(3f),0,next,8,4);Array.Copy(BitConverter.GetBytes(5f),0,next,16,4);if(NativeEditCompatibility.ReproduceInvalidStates&&score.CancelledSaveRecords!=null){if(!score.CancelledSaveValid||score.CancelledSaveUndefinedWord==null)throw new NotSupportedException("Cancelled lyric physical save is not established for this state.");copy.Items.AddRange(score.CancelledSaveRecords.Select(i=>i.Clone()));Array.Copy(score.CancelledSaveUndefinedWord,0,next,0,4);copy.CancelledSaveRecords=null;}copy.Trailer=next;return copy;}
 }
}

    public static Score Load(string path) {

        // as a single Fortran record containing the complete MUS payload.

            b=framed[0];
        }
        if(b.Length<22 || (b.Length-2)%4!=0)throw new InvalidDataException("Not a supported SCORE binary file.");
        if(BitConverter.ToUInt16(b,0)!=(b.Length-2)/4)throw new InvalidDataException("The SCORE word count does not match the file size.");
        if(BitConverter.ToSingle(b,b.Length-4)!=-9999)throw new InvalidDataException("Missing SCORE end marker.");

        while(b.Length-o>24) {

            int n=(int)Math.Round(f); if(n<1||n>4096 || Math.Abs(f-n)>.1 || o+(n+1)*4>b.Length-20)throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid record at byte "+o);

using System;

namespace ScoreModern {
public sealed partial class ScoreText {
    sealed class Face {public string Name;public short[] Widths,RightEdges;}
    readonly Dictionary<int,Face> faces=new Dictionary<int,Face>();
    readonly List<int> originalAlignmentMetricFaces=new List<int>();
    readonly object originalMetricHistoryLock=new object();
    int originalMetricNextSlot;bool originalMetricEvicted;
    readonly short?[] originalConverterWords=InitialConverterWords();
    static short?[] InitialConverterWords(){var words=new short?[162];for(int n=0;n<words.Length;n++)words[n]=0;return words;}
    void RecordOriginalMetricFace(int face){if(face<0||face>=90||!faces.ContainsKey(face))return;lock(originalMetricHistoryLock){if(originalAlignmentMetricFaces.Contains(face))return;if(originalAlignmentMetricFaces.Count<10){originalAlignmentMetricFaces.Add(face);originalMetricNextSlot=originalAlignmentMetricFaces.Count%10;}else{originalAlignmentMetricFaces[originalMetricNextSlot]=face;originalMetricNextSlot=(originalMetricNextSlot+1)%10;originalMetricEvicted=true;}}}
    internal void RecordOriginalConverterPass(NativeTextLayout layout){lock(originalMetricHistoryLock){bool tab=false;foreach(var token in layout.Tokens)if(token.TabX.HasValue)tab=true;if(tab){for(int n=1;n<=Math.Min(161,layout.RawCharacterCount);n++)originalConverterWords[n]=null;}else{if(layout.Tokens.Count>161)throw new NotSupportedException("Original text conversion exceeds the verified token buffer.");for(int n=0;n<layout.Tokens.Count;n++)originalConverterWords[n+1]=layout.Tokens[n].Code;}}}
    internal void RecordOriginalGlyphPass(NativeTextLayout layout){RecordOriginalConverterPass(layout);foreach(var token in layout.Tokens)RecordOriginalMetricFace(token.DatMetricFace);}
    internal MetricHistoryScope PreserveAlignmentMetricHistory(){List<int> before;int next;bool evicted;short?[] converterBefore;lock(originalMetricHistoryLock){converterBefore=(short?[])originalConverterWords.Clone();before=new List<int>(originalAlignmentMetricFaces);next=originalMetricNextSlot;evicted=originalMetricEvicted;}return new MetricHistoryScope(()=>{lock(originalMetricHistoryLock){originalAlignmentMetricFaces.Clear();originalAlignmentMetricFaces.AddRange(before);originalMetricNextSlot=next;originalMetricEvicted=evicted;Array.Copy(converterBefore,originalConverterWords,converterBefore.Length);}});}
    internal sealed class MetricHistoryScope:IDisposable {Action restore;internal MetricHistoryScope(Action value){restore=value;}internal void Commit(){restore=null;}public void Dispose(){if(restore!=null){var action=restore;restore=null;action();}}}

    const string Characters="0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ.,()abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz:;?!+-*/=`'";
    public string RootDirectory {get;private set;}
    public ScoreText(string root) {
        RootDirectory=Path.GetFullPath(root);
        for(int n=0;n<=89;n++) {
            string path=NativeLibraryLocation.FileFor(root,"FM"+n.ToString("00")+".PSC");if(!File.Exists(path))continue;
            try {var records=FortranRecords.Read(File.ReadAllBytes(path));byte[] b=records[0];if(b.Length<354)continue;var face=new Face{Name=Encoding.ASCII.GetString(b,0,28).Trim(),Widths=new short[163]};for(int j=0;j<163;j++)face.Widths[j]=BitConverter.ToInt16(b,28+j*2);if(records.Count>1&&records[1].Length==326){face.RightEdges=new short[163];for(int j=0;j<163;j++)face.RightEdges[j]=BitConverter.ToInt16(records[1],j*2);}faces[n]=face;}catch(InvalidDataException){}
        }
    }
    public string ExternalFontName(int id){Face face;return faces.TryGetValue(id,out face)?face.Name:null;}
    static float Size(float value){value=Math.Abs(value)%100;return value==0?1:value;}
    int Override(Item item,int font){int n=(int)item.P(8);if(n>=1000)return n%100;if(n>=90)return n%10;return font;}
    public static bool FontCode(string text,int p,out int id){id=0;if(p+2>=text.Length||text[p]!='_'||!Char.IsDigit(text[p+1])||!Char.IsDigit(text[p+2]))return false;id=(text[p+1]-'0')*10+text[p+2]-'0';return true;}
    float Advance(char c,int id) {
        Face face;int index=Characters.IndexOf(c);if(c==' ')index=94;
        if(faces.TryGetValue(id,out face)&&index>=0&&index<face.Widths.Length&&face.Widths[index]>1)return face.Widths[index]/1000f;
        return c==' '?.25f:c=='"'?.408f:c=='&'?.778f:c=='W'?.944f:.5f;
    }
    public float Measure(Item item,string text,float staffSize) {
        var layout=PrepareMetricLayout(item,text,(float)((double)staffSize*25),0);RecordOriginalConverterPass(layout);return layout.Width;
    }
    public void Set(Item item,string text,float staffSize) {Set(item,text,staffSize,160);}
    static string EncodeLegacyAccents(string text) {
        const string letters = "aeiouAEIOU";
        string[] accents = { "áéíóúÁÉÍÓÚ", "àèìòùÀÈÌÒÙ", "âêîôûÂÊÎÔÛ", "äëïöüÄËÏÖÜ" };
        string[] controls = { "<<", ">>", "^^", "%%" };
        var encoded = new StringBuilder();
        foreach (char character in text.Normalize(NormalizationForm.FormC)) {
            if (character == 'ç' || character == 'Ç') {
                encoded.Append(character == 'ç' ? "##c" : "##C");
                continue;
            }
            int tilde = "ãñõÃÑÕ".IndexOf(character);
            if (tilde >= 0) {
                encoded.Append('~').Append("anoANO"[tilde]);
                continue;
            }
            int group = 0;
            int letter = -1;
            while (group < accents.Length && (letter = accents[group].IndexOf(character)) < 0) group++;
            if (letter >= 0) encoded.Append(controls[group]).Append(letters[letter]);
            else encoded.Append(character);
        }
        return encoded.ToString();
    }
    internal void Set(Item item,string text,float staffSize,int maximumBytes) {
        if (item.P(8) != 99) text = EncodeLegacyAccents(text);
        var encoding=Encoding.GetEncoding(437,EncoderFallback.ExceptionFallback,DecoderFallback.ExceptionFallback);byte[] chars=encoding.GetBytes(text);if(chars.Length>maximumBytes)throw new InvalidDataException("SCORE text exceeds the verified "+maximumBytes+"-byte limit for this entry route.");
        int words=13+(chars.Length+3)/4;byte[] bytes=new byte[(words+1)*4];Array.Copy(item.Bytes,bytes,Math.Min(56,item.Bytes.Length));Array.Copy(BitConverter.GetBytes((float)words),bytes,4);Array.Copy(chars,0,bytes,56,chars.Length);for(int padding=56+chars.Length;padding<bytes.Length;padding++)bytes[padding]=32;
        item.Bytes=bytes;item.Set(12,chars.Length);item.Set(13,Measure(item,text,staffSize));
    }
}
